A temporal convolutional network and a graph attention network with weighted fused adjacency extract multiscale temporal patterns and spatial dependencies among sensors. A hybrid temporal Transformer and variational autoencoder then evaluates window-level anomalies using prediction errors and reconstruction probabilities. Continuous-time Shapley attribution identifies critical sensors and high-contribution intervals while preserving the temporal continuity of fault evolution. A structured evidence package combines detection results, graph relationships, temporal attribution, sensor attribution, and operating context. An evidence-constrained diagnosis protocol uses this package to generate flight-level conclusions with traceable evidence identifiers. Cross-flight holdout experiments on the public ALFA fixed-wing flight dataset yield a window-level area under the precision-recall curve of 0.976, accuracy of 0.973, recall of 0.902, and F1 score of 0.920. Flight-level fault diagnosis achieves recall of 0.943 and an F1 score of 0.944. These results demonstrate accurate anomaly detection and quantitatively supported fault-tracing cues, providing a basis for interpretable post-flight fault review and analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出 TGTV，一个结合时空图学习与大语言模型的可解释无人机故障检测与溯源框架，在公开的 ALFA 固定翼飞行数据集上，窗口级 PR 曲线下面积达 0.976，飞行级故障诊断 F1 达 0.944，并为大模型诊断提供可追溯的量化证据。
AI.motivation: 固定翼无人机的工况转换、异步传感器采样与控制补偿会掩盖故障特征；现有时间序列检测方法难以表示跨子系统耦合的故障、追踪其演化过程，也无法用定量证据约束语言模型的诊断。
AI.method: 时间卷积网络与带加权融合邻接矩阵的图注意力网络提取多尺度时间模式及传感器间的空间依赖；混合时间 Transformer 与变分自编码器基于预测误差与重构概率评估窗口级异常；连续时间 Shapley 归因识别关键传感器与高贡献时间区间；结构化证据包整合检测结果、图关系、时间与传感器归因及工况信息，并由证据约束的诊断协议生成带可追溯证据编号的飞行级结论。
AI.result: 在 ALFA 数据集的跨飞行留出实验中，窗口级 PR 曲线下面积为 0.976，准确率 0.973，召回率 0.902，F1 0.920；飞行级故障诊断的召回率为 0.943，F1 为 0.944。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明该框架能够准确检测异常并提供有定量支持的故障溯源线索，为飞行后的可解释故障审查与分析提供了基础。

title: A Separation Principle for Adversarial Attacks and Defense of Graph Neural Networks
summary: Adversarial attacks on graph neural networks (GNNs) have been studied as a model-centric optimization problem driven by gradients, learned policies, or meta-learning, with the graph treated as a passive substrate. This view overlooks a defining feature of GNNs: their predictions are produced by structured message passing along the graph, so their adversarial vulnerabilities are encoded as much in the geometry of the graph as in the learned weights. We develop a structure-driven framework for feature attacks in which the attack is derived from the spectral properties of the normalized adjacency operator. Its central result is a separation principle: under a natural relaxation of the attack objective, the optimal feature perturbation is rank one and factorizes into a graph-dependent component (degree-proportional spatial allocation, depending only on the graph) and a weight-dependent component (top singular vector of the composed weights, depending only on the weights). Node degree thus emerges as the fundamental graph quantity governing adversarial vulnerability to feature perturbations. The resulting attack, which we call SepAttack, requires no gradient computation, carries analytical guarantees, achieves competitive or superior performance against established baselines such as Nettack and IG-Attack with up to ${\sim}70\times$ speedup in the targeted setting, and transfers near-perfectly across architectures on continuous-feature graphs because its graph-dependent component is architecture-invariant by construction. We further derive a separation-principle adversarial training procedure (SepAT) directly from the closed-form worst-case attack and report robustness gains on binary-feature benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出结构驱动的特征攻击 SepAttack，证明在松弛的攻击目标下，最优特征扰动为秩一，并可分解为仅依赖图的、与节点度成正比的空间分配，以及仅依赖权重的顶部奇异向量两部分；该攻击无需梯度计算，定向攻击场景下速度约快 70 倍，并可在连续特征图上近乎完美地跨架构迁移。
AI.motivation: 已有的图神经网络对抗攻击多把图视为被动结构，以梯度、学习策略或元学习为核心；但 GNN 的预测依赖于沿图的结构化消息传递，其脆弱性同时编码在图的几何与学到的权重之中。
AI.method: 从归一化邻接算子的谱性质推导特征攻击；提出分离原理，把最优扰动拆分为图依赖的空间分配与权重依赖的顶部奇异向量；并基于闭式的最坏情形攻击推导分离原理对抗训练过程 SepAT。
AI.result: SepAttack 无需梯度计算，具有解析保证，相比 Nettack 与 IG-Attack 等基线取得有竞争力或更优的性能，在定向攻击设置下速度提升约 70 倍；在连续特征图上可近乎完美地跨架构迁移，因为其图依赖分量按构造与架构无关；SepAT 在二值特征基准上带来了鲁棒性提升。
AI.conclusion: 节点度是决定图神经网络在特征扰动下对抗脆弱性的基本图量。

title: Estimating Implicit Expected Log Density Ratios
summary: When exact probabilities cannot be computed, \emph{density ratio estimation (DRE)} is a key subroutine in the wide range of applications where density ratios appear, from experimental design to generative modelling and reinforcement learning. In this paper, we introduce the concept of an \emph{expected log density ratio (ELDR)}: log density ratios that are integrated under some third, possibly distinct measure. We show many problems with implicit densities where DRE is naïvely used are actually ELDR estimation tasks, and prove fundamental limitations on finite-sample ELDR estimation. Based on these results, we argue that the typical DRE-based approaches are unsuitable for ELDR estimation, and provide some foundational motivation towards bespoke ELDR estimators. To demonstrate, we propose a simple modification to some DRE methods that allows samples convergent to the integral distribution to appear in training data. We show through benchmarks that this can improve ELDR estimation error.

AI.tldr: 提出期望对数密度比（ELDR）的概念，指出许多隐式密度问题中被直接使用的密度比估计（DRE）实际上是 ELDR 估计任务，证明有限样本下 ELDR 估计的基本限制，并对部分 DRE 方法作简单修改，使训练数据中可包含收敛到积分分布的样本，在基准上改善了估计误差。
AI.motivation: 当精确概率无法计算时，密度比估计是实验设计、生成建模与强化学习中的关键子程序；但在隐式密度问题中，其真正的目标往往是在某个第三测度下对对数密度比求积分，而典型的 DRE 方法并不适合这类估计。
AI.method: 引入期望对数密度比（ELDR）的概念，即在某个可能不同的第三测度下对对数密度比进行积分；证明有限样本 ELDR 估计的基本限制；对部分 DRE 方法作简单修改，使训练数据包含收敛到该积分分布的样本。
AI.result: 在基准测试中，所提的修改能够改善 ELDR 估计误差。
AI.conclusion: 典型的基于 DRE 的方法不适用于 ELDR 估计，需要专门设计的 ELDR 估计器，本文为此提供了基础性的动机。

title: MASS: Multi-mask Selective Self-Distillation for Leakage-Resilient Reasoning
summary: On-policy self-distillation enables the same model to act as student and teacher, with dense token-level supervision obtained by the teacher being given access to privileged information. However, conditioning the teacher on a single reference can concentrate its predictions on one reasoning trajectory and limit transfer to the student. We propose Multi-Mask Selective Self-Distillation (MASS), which approximates the unavailable marginal over diverse reference realizations using multiple independently masked views of one verified solution. MASS aggregates these complementary teacher predictions, selectively transfers reliable token-level corrections, and adaptively focuses masking on influential reference spans. Across mathematical reasoning benchmarks and model families, MASS consistently outperforms strong self-distillation baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 MASS（Multi-Mask Selective Self-Distillation），在同一已验证解的多个独立掩码视图上聚合教师预测，缓解带特权信息的在线策略自蒸馏中教师过度依赖单一推理轨迹的问题。在数学推理基准和多个模型族上，MASS 持续优于强自蒸馏基线。
AI.motivation: 在线策略自蒸馏中，教师模型以特权信息（参考解）为条件提供 token 级监督，但仅依赖单一参考会使教师预测集中于一条推理轨迹，限制向学生模型的迁移。
AI.method: 对同一已验证解构造多个独立掩码视图，以近似对多样参考实现的边际分布；聚合这些互补的教师预测，选择性地迁移可靠的 token 级修正，并自适应地将掩码聚焦于影响较大的参考片段。
AI.result: 在多个数学推理基准和多个模型族上，MASS 一致优于强自蒸馏基线。摘要未给出具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 多掩码视图的聚合使教师监督不再局限于单一推理轨迹，从而提升自蒸馏向学生模型的迁移效果。摘要未进一步讨论适用范围。

title: Floor It, Then Fill It: Simulating Creator Ecosystems for Fair Video-Content Recommendation Systems at Billion User Scale
summary: Engagement-optimized content recommendation systems exhibit a well-documented rich-get-richer dynamic that structurally disadvantages emerging creators on large-scale platforms. Evaluating debiasing interventions at scale demands faithful simulation of creator-viewer ecosystems, yet the fidelity, diversity, and validity of such simulators remain underexplored. We present a grounded user-simulation framework that models a heterogeneous population of ${\sim}42$K creators and their coupled viewer interactions over 12~weeks, and use it to evaluate equitable view-allocation policies formulated as a budgeted multi-armed bandit (MAB). The simulator captures three behavioral dimensions: (i)~\textbf{creator diversity}, modeled via a clustering approach grounded in real platform creator-level distributions; (ii)~\textbf{behavioral fidelity}, captured through coupled creator-content state machines that represent growth trajectories, engagement accumulation, and graduation dynamics; and (iii)~\textbf{population-level validity}, measured by calibration against observed platform metrics. We evaluate simulative-configurations that vary content-viewership target definitions, reward functions, and a small-creator reserve lever to maximize creator-content recommendation equity. A floor-protected per content-view-target with a view-parity-gap reward guarantees 90\% of view targets being met by creators every week, grows small-creator organic reach ${\sim}{+}33\%$ per week, and achieves high distribution stability (set of creators with funded-views Jaccard $= 0.819$). We analyze the Sim2Real gap and propose validation protocols, contributing evidence for when simulation-derived fairness conclusions can be trusted.

AI.tldr: 提出一个基于真实平台统计的创作者-观众生态仿真框架（约 4.2 万创作者，模拟 12 周），用预算化多臂老虎机评估公平的流量分配策略。最佳配置（带底线保护的每内容观看目标加观看均衡差距奖励）使 90% 的观看目标每周达成，小创作者自然触达约每周增长 33%。
AI.motivation: 基于互动优化的推荐系统存在强者恒强的马太效应，使新兴创作者处于结构性劣势；大规模去偏干预需要可信的仿真来评估，但此类仿真的保真度、多样性与有效性尚缺乏研究。
AI.method: 构建异质创作者群体的用户仿真器，包含三部分：基于真实创作者分布聚类的创作者多样性建模；耦合的创作者-内容状态机，刻画成长轨迹、互动累积和毕业动态；以及与平台指标校准的群体层面有效性检验。将公平的流量分配建模为预算多臂老虎机，比较不同的观看目标定义、奖励函数和小创作者保留机制。
AI.result: 带底线保护的每内容观看目标配合观看均衡差距奖励，使 90% 的观看目标每周被达成，小创作者自然触达约每周增长 33%，资金化观看创作者集合的 Jaccard 相似度为 0.819，分布稳定性较高。摘要还分析了 Sim2Real 差距。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了评估推荐公平性干预的仿真方法，并提出验证协议，给出了何时可以信任仿真得出的公平性结论的证据，其可信度取决于 Sim2Real 差距。

title: Replaying the Same Gradients at a Different $\varepsilon$: A Registered Test of the Fixed-Trajectory Account of Adam's $\varepsilon$ for One Rare Row
summary: Adam divides every update by the square root of a running average of squared gradients plus a small constant, epsilon. For an output-embedding row whose token is rare, which we call the probe row, raising epsilon can be read as shrinking that row's steps by arithmetic alone. We test that reading directly. While a training run proceeds, we also divide the probe row's update by a different epsilon, using the run's own moment estimates; this replay is exact arithmetic on the gradients the run actually saw, so it holds the run's trajectory fixed. A rule for when the replay counts as wrong was written down before the runs. We train a small causal transformer in a standard configuration. When epsilon rises by four orders of magnitude, the replay counts as wrong on each of the three seeds registered for the test: the probe row keeps 8.9--11.4 times more of its displacement than predicted with the main, sampled-negative head, and 5.0--7.7 times more with a full-softmax head scored as a second instrument. At three orders of magnitude, tested with the main head only, it does not, by narrow margins; a further two seeds, registered after this result had been committed and scored on their own, follow the same pattern. In separate real runs, raising epsilon on the probe row alone is enough to reproduce the row's change and raising it on every other parameter alone also moves the row part of the way --- readings about the runs that do not rescue the replay; scaling the row's learning rate instead, with the denominator untouched, is mispredicted by the replay in the same direction. This is one embedding row of one model family on one corpus; we make no claim about rates, about rows in general (other rows were read only as a panel on one trajectory) or about how the effect changes with model size.

AI.tldr: 在一个小型因果 Transformer 上，对一个稀有词元的输出嵌入行进行预先登记的检验，判断"固定轨迹"解释（增大 Adam 的 epsilon 等价于缩小该行步长）是否成立。在 epsilon 增大四个数量级时，该回放预测在三个登记种子上均被判为错误；在三个数量级时，主头测试未能判为错误（差距较小）。
AI.motivation: Adam 的 epsilon 通常被视为数值稳定常数，但对稀有词元的输出嵌入行而言，提高 epsilon 可以在算术上等效于缩小该行的更新步长。需要直接检验这一"固定轨迹"解释是否与真实训练一致。
AI.method: 训练过程中，用该运行自身的一阶、二阶矩估计，把稀有词元行的更新按另一个 epsilon 重新计算，得到不改变训练轨迹的精确回放，并与实际位移比较；判定规则在实验前写定。主实验使用采样负例的输出头，并以全 softmax 头作为第二个测量工具；另做真实运行对照，包括仅对该行提高 epsilon、对其他所有参数提高 epsilon，以及仅缩放该行学习率而不改动分母。
AI.result: epsilon 增大四个数量级时，三个登记种子上该行保留的位移为回放预测的 8.9 至 11.4 倍（主头），全 softmax 头为 5.0 至 7.7 倍，回放被判为错误。增大三个数量级时（仅主头），未被判为错误，差距较小；另外两个在结果提交后登记的种子呈现相同模式。仅提高该行的 epsilon 即可复现其变化；仅提高其他参数的 epsilon 也能部分带动该行变化；缩放学习率时，回放同方向误判。
AI.conclusion: 在该单一模型族、单一语料和单一嵌入行上，固定轨迹的算术解释在较大的 epsilon 增幅下不成立，说明 epsilon 对稀有行的作用不能仅由分母的算术效应解释。论文不对其他更新速率、其他行或模型规模作结论。

title: B2P-Corr: Batch-to-Population Gradient Estimators for Non-Decomposable Correlation Losses
summary: Correlation metrics such as the Pearson Correlation Coefficient (PCC) and Concordance Correlation Coefficient (CCC) are standard regression metrics and learning objectives, but their non-decomposable nature poses a challenge for stochastic optimization. Since these metrics depend on dataset-level moments (mean, variance, covariance), naive mini-batch training with local statistics yields biased, high-variance gradients whose expectation does not align with the population gradient. To bridge this ``batch-to-population'' (B2P) gap, we propose \textbf{B2P-Corr}, a novel framework that transforms correlation objectives into decomposable pseudo-losses driven by lightweight global ``moment sketches''. We introduce two efficient variants: \textbf{B2P-EMA}, which utilizes exponential moving averages and stop-gradient operators to ensure asymptotic gradient tracking with $O(B)$ cost ($B$ is batch size); and \textbf{B2P-U}, which uses sampled cross-batch U-statistic estimators and a reservoir-based stabilization with an $O(B)$ implementation. Theoretically, we quantify the $O(B^{-1})$ bias of naive mini-batch optimization, prove a moving-target tracking result for B2P-EMA under a fast-sketch / slow-parameter regime, and provide an idealized control-variate analysis for B2P-U. Experiments on two synthetic and three real-world datasets demonstrate B2P-Corr achieves stable optimization and higher correlation than naive mini-batch optimization with negligible overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出 B2P-Corr，将 PCC、CCC 等非可分解的相关性损失转化为由全局矩草图驱动的可分解伪损失，使小批量随机优化的梯度更接近总体梯度。在两个合成数据集和三个真实数据集上，相比朴素小批量优化获得更稳定的优化和更高的相关性，且额外开销可忽略。
AI.motivation: PCC 与 CCC 依赖数据集级的均值、方差和协方差，不可分解。朴素小批量训练用局部统计量计算梯度，得到有偏且高方差的估计，其期望与总体梯度不一致，即"批量到总体"（B2P）缺口。
AI.method: 用轻量的全局矩草图替代数据集级统计量，把相关性目标改写为可分解伪损失。提出两种变体：B2P-EMA 使用指数滑动平均与停止梯度算子，以 O(B) 成本实现渐近梯度跟踪（B 为批大小）；B2P-U 使用采样的跨批次 U 统计量估计器，并配合蓄水池式稳定，实现同为 O(B) 的计算成本。
AI.result: 理论上量化了朴素小批量优化的 O(B^{-1}) 偏差；证明了 B2P-EMA 在快草图、慢参数机制下的移动目标跟踪结果，并给出 B2P-U 的理想化控制变量分析。实验在两个合成数据集和三个真实数据集上显示，B2P-Corr 优化稳定，相关性高于朴素小批量优化，且开销可忽略。摘要未给出具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 全局矩草图构成的可分解伪损失可以有效弥合非可分解相关性目标中批量与总体之间的梯度差距，为相关性指标的随机优化提供了低开销方案。

title: Data Amount Heterogeneity Improves Performance in Federated Learning for Neuroimaging
summary: Federated Learning (FL) allows for secure analysis of distributed data without data sharing. We and others have successfully applied FL to neuroimaging tasks, such as Alzheimer's disease classification from structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). FL trains a deep learning model locally at each site, encrypts the local model parameters and sends them to a federation controller that aggregates the local models under homomorphic encryption, the resulting community model is sent back to the sites for further training, and the process repeats for a number of rounds. FL often achieves learning performance (e.g., accuracy) close to centralized training, but no data leaves the sites and model parameters are protected through encryption and other measures. In this paper, we show that federations composed of sites with heterogeneous amounts of data (1 large site plus small sites) perform better than homogeneous (same data per site) federations, particularly in low data regimes, while reaching performance close to centralized training. Having a big site often results in faster convergence and higher final accuracy. Heterogeneous federations better exploit sites with small amounts of data, a common situation in large consortia such as ENIGMA.

AI.tldr: 研究联邦学习中各站点数据量异构的影响，发现"一个大站点加若干小站点"的异构联邦优于各站点数据量相同的同质联邦，在低数据场景下尤其明显，且性能接近集中式训练。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习已被用于神经影像任务，例如基于结构 MRI 的阿尔茨海默病分类，但既有工作通常默认各站点数据量同质，站点间数据量不均衡的影响缺乏研究；而在 ENIGMA 等大型联盟中，小站点数据量较少是常见情况。
AI.method: 比较两类联邦设置：一个大站点加多个小站点的异构联邦，与各站点数据量相同的同质联邦。各站点在本地训练深度学习模型，将模型参数加密后发送给联邦控制器，控制器在同态加密下聚合得到社区模型，再回传各站点继续训练，重复若干轮。
AI.result: 异构联邦在低数据场景下尤其优于同质联邦，并且性能接近集中式训练。大站点通常带来更快的收敛和更高的最终精度。摘要未给出具体数值和数据集细节。
AI.conclusion: 数据量异构的联邦结构能更好地利用小站点的数据，对大型联盟中的站点组织和协作设计有参考价值。

title: A Gradient based Adversarial Augmentation Framework for Mitigating Unlearnable Datasets
summary: Unlearnable data methods (ULD) protect public data from unauthorized model training by adding imperceptible perturbations that create a learning shortcut. A deep neural network can exploit the shortcut learning path to minimize training loss without learning generalizable features. Intuitively, finding adversarial versions of perturbed images that can substantially increase the model's loss can force the model to learn generalizable features. Existing data augmentation based attacks rely on heuristic search strategies/random sampling over a curated augmentation set to identify adversarial augmentation operations, an approach that often does not scale when the number of candidate operations is large. To address the challenge of a large search space, we propose {\techname}, a gradient based adversarial augmentation framework that learns an augmentation policy via stochastic gradient ascent. {\techname} leverages a differentiable data augmentation pipeline to efficiently search a set of up to 18 augmentation techniques, from which a grid search selects a protection-specific subset. The augmentation subset is trained to maximize a surrogate model's classification loss. We introduce a perceptual-plus-pixel regularization to learn operation parameters that preserve image semantics. Under a controlled ablation, {\techname} consistently outperforms an equivalent random sampling baseline (80.0\% vs. 77.29\% clean test accuracy on EMIN-protected CIFAR-10 for ResNet-18 and 83.28\% vs. 66.45\% on NTGA-protected CIFAR-10 for MobileNet-V2), demonstrating that gradient guidance drives the clean test accuracy recoverability rather than the expanded search space. {\techname} offers an effective and scalable adversarial augmentation framework for stress-testing ULD methods, a critical tool for developing robust ULD methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于梯度的对抗增强框架，通过随机梯度上升学习增强策略，用于压力测试不可学习数据（ULD）保护方法。在受控消融中，该框架优于等量随机采样基线，例如在 EMIN 保护的 CIFAR-10 上，ResNet-18 的干净测试精度为 80.0%，对比基线为 77.29%。
AI.motivation: 不可学习数据方法通过添加不可察觉的扰动制造捷径学习，以阻止未授权训练。评估这类方法需要有效的对抗增强，但已有基于启发式搜索或随机采样的数据增强攻击在候选操作数量很大时难以扩展。
AI.method: 在可微分的数据增强流水线上，通过随机梯度上升学习增强策略，搜索至多 18 种增强技术，并用网格搜索为特定保护方法选出子集；增强子集以最大化代理模型的分类损失为目标进行训练，并加入感知加像素的正则项，以保持图像语义。
AI.result: 在受控消融中，该框架持续优于等量随机采样基线：在 EMIN 保护的 CIFAR-10 上，ResNet-18 的干净测试精度为 80.0% 对 77.29%；在 NTGA 保护的 CIFAR-10 上，MobileNet-V2 为 83.28% 对 66.45%。
AI.conclusion: 梯度引导而非扩大搜索空间，驱动了干净测试精度的可恢复性。该框架可作为压力测试 ULD 方法的可扩展工具，有助于开发更稳健的不可学习数据方法。

title: Convex-SKM-Net: Low-Latency Block Halfspace Corrections for Neural Convex Constraint Satisfaction
summary: Fast inference and strict constraint satisfaction are essential for learning-based decision-making. Existing methods often rely on constraint-specific projections or feasible-set parameterizations, while iterative repair can be costly. We introduce Convex-SKM-Net, a convex constraint-satisfaction layer that forms linearization halfspaces from residual and (sub)gradient oracles without constraint-specific inequality projectors. It applies fixed-depth dual projected-gradient descent (dual PGD) to minimum-displacement block problems using GPU-friendly matrix operations. We jointly learn the predictor and a positive-definite mobility, adapting the correction geometry to improve objective quality. We prove convergence of the outer iterates at fixed dual depth and linear convergence in distance under Slater's condition and bounded subgradients. All our test outputs on three second-order-cone model-predictive control (SOC-MPC) horizons and six power-system convex relaxations satisfy a $10^{-3}$ feasibility tolerance. Comparisons with the latest constraint-satisfaction methods show inference speedups of up to $144.3\times$ on SOC-MPC and $7.7\times$ on a convex quadratically constrained quadratic programming (QCQP) benchmark with joint training. On QCQP, the mean objective gap is $0.012\%$, with full test feasibility at $10^{-4}$. Learning mobility reduces the five-seed affine-task mean gap by $22.4\%$ and improves gaps in matched power-system comparisons.

AI.tldr: 提出 Convex-SKM-Net，一个凸约束满足层，通过固定深度的对偶投影梯度下降求解最小位移块问题，将预测结果修正到可行域内。在 SOC-MPC 和凸 QCQP 基准上，相比最新约束满足方法推理加速最高分别达 144.3 倍和 7.7 倍，测试输出满足 1e-3 的可行性容差。
AI.motivation: 基于学习的决策需要快速推理并严格满足约束，但现有方法往往依赖特定约束的投影或可行集参数化，而迭代修复的代价较高。
AI.method: 由残差和（次）梯度的 oracle 构造线性化半空间，无需特定约束的不等式投影器；对最小位移块问题应用固定深度的对偶投影梯度下降，并以 GPU 友好的矩阵运算实现；同时联合学习预测器与一个正定的 mobility 矩阵，以调整修正几何、改善目标质量。
AI.result: 在三个二阶锥模型预测控制（SOC-MPC）时域和六个电力系统凸松弛问题上，所有测试输出均满足 1e-3 的可行性容差。相比最新约束满足方法，SOC-MPC 上推理加速最高达 144.3 倍，凸 QCQP 基准上（联合训练）达 7.7 倍。QCQP 上平均目标差距为 0.012%，在 1e-4 容差下测试可行性完全满足。学习 mobility 使五个随机种子的仿射任务平均差距降低 22.4%。
AI.conclusion: 该层在固定对偶深度下证明了外层迭代的收敛性，并在 Slater 条件与次梯度有界下给出距离上的线性收敛，在速度与目标质量之间取得较好折中，适用于需要快速且严格可行推理的约束学习场景。

title: Averaged Annealed Markov Chains Achieve the Algorithmic Threshold for Tensor PCA, Part II: Langevin Dynamics
comment: Companion paper to arXiv:2610.16705 (Part I). 71 pages, 1 figure
summary: We consider the tensor principal components analysis (tensor PCA) problem on the sphere, in which we are asked to recover an unknown vector in $\mathcal{S}_N=\{x\in\mathbb{R}^N:\lVert x\rVert^2=N\}$ from a noisy observation of its $k$-th tensor power, for a fixed $k\ge3$. Tensor PCA exhibits a well-studied information-computation gap: global algorithms such as spectral methods and sum-of-squares work above an algorithmic threshold, below which we know matching lower bounds (against these and some other restricted models of computation). In contrast, local algorithms such as Markov chains were only known to succeed from a random initialization at a polynomially larger signal-to-noise ratio, and were believed to be inferior to global algorithms for tensor PCA. Continuing the program initiated in Part I [arXiv:2610.16705], we show that spherical Langevin dynamics, when supplemented with annealing and ergodic averaging, achieves polynomial-time strong recovery above the algorithmic threshold from a uniformly random initialization. Together with Part I, our results demonstrate that local Markov chains can succeed all the way down to the algorithmic threshold from an uninformative cold start.

AI.tldr: 证明在球面上的张量 PCA 问题中，带退火与遍历平均的球面 Langevin 动力学可以在多项式时间内、从均匀随机初始化出发，达到高于代数阈值的强恢复，说明局部马尔可夫链可以一直成功到代数阈值。
AI.motivation: 张量 PCA 存在信息-计算差距：谱方法和 sum-of-squares 等全局算法只在代数阈值以上有效。此前认为马尔可夫链等局部算法只能在多项式倍更大的信噪比下从随机初始化成功，因而被认为劣于全局算法。
AI.method: 考虑单位球面上的张量 PCA，即从 k 次张量幂的噪声观测中恢复未知向量（k 不小于 3）。使用球面 Langevin 动力学，并辅以退火和遍历平均，从均匀随机初始化出发运行。本文为 Part II，延续 Part I（arXiv:2610.16705）的研究计划。
AI.result: 该方法在多项式时间内实现了高于代数阈值的强恢复，且初始化为无信息的冷启动。摘要未给出具体的阈值常数或数值实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 结合 Part I，结果表明局部马尔可夫链可以从无信息的冷启动一直成功到代数阈值，挑战了局部方法必然劣于全局方法的看法。

title: Progressive Coupling Method for Diffusion Posterior Sampling in Ptychography
summary: Ptychography is a computational imaging method that reconstructs a sample from overlapping diffraction measurements. This technique relies on these overlapping measurements to provide the redundancy information needed for robust reconstruction, but dense scanning increases acquisition time and data volume. Reducing scan overlaps can improve measurement efficiency but weakens the physical constraints available for reconstruction. Diffusion models provide strong learned prior information, offering a promising approach to compensate for the loss of measurement redundancy. However, effectively utilizing this prior information under weak measurement constraints remains a challenge. We propose a progressive coupling posterior sampling (PCPS) method, which allows for a broader exploration of the solution space under high uncertainty while maintaining stronger diffusion-guided consistency as the reconstruction becomes more refined. Experiments on real X-ray ptychographic data at various scan overlaps demonstrate that PCPS consistently improves reconstruction accuracy compared to traditional iterative methods and existing diffusion posterior samplers, especially at low overlaps. These results show that diffusion priors can reduce the measurement redundancy required for accurate ptychography reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出渐进耦合后验采样方法 PCPS，将扩散模型先验用于 X 射线叠层成像（ptychography）重建，在扫描重叠率降低时仍能提高重建精度。
AI.motivation: 叠层成像依赖密集的重叠衍射测量提供冗余约束，但密集扫描会增加采集时间和数据量。降低扫描重叠可以提高测量效率，却会削弱物理约束；如何在较弱测量约束下有效利用扩散先验仍是挑战。
AI.method: 提出渐进耦合后验采样（PCPS）：在不确定性较高时允许更广泛地探索解空间，随着重建逐渐精细，逐步加强扩散引导的一致性。
AI.result: 在真实 X 射线叠层数据、多种扫描重叠率下的实验表明，PCPS 相比传统迭代方法和现有扩散后验采样器持续提高重建精度，在低重叠时尤为明显。摘要未给出具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 扩散先验可以降低精确叠层成像重建所需的测量冗余，从而提高测量效率。

title: RainCheck: Harnessing Historical Weather Data with Machine Learning for Rainfall Forecasting in Bangladesh
summary: Machine-learning rainfall forecasts are often evaluated by shuffling station records into random training and test sets. For rainfall, this lets a model see what happened at neighbouring stations on the very day it is asked to forecast, and it hides the fact that a seasonal lookup table already explains most of the variance. We quantify both effects on 618,650 station-days from 35 Bangladesh Meteorological Department stations (1948-2014). We compare random, temporal (train <=1999, test 2005-2014) and spatio-temporal (unseen stations and unseen years) evaluation, calendar-only versus antecedent-rainfall features, and six learners against climatology, persistence and SARIMA. Three findings stand out. First, a station-month climatology alone classifies high-rainfall months with 88.4% accuracy (AUC 0.950), and no learner improved on it by more than 0.8 points under temporal evaluation. Second, a calendar-only random forest reached a next-day wet-day AUC of 0.889 under a random split, higher than any model with real predictors under temporal evaluation, yet fell to 0.835, below climatology (0.859), on future years. Third, models with lagged rainfall add genuine but modest skill for next-day forecasts: a Brier skill score of 0.074 (95% CI 0.064-0.088) over climatology, rising to 0.091 when station and year inputs are removed and to 0.131 when other stations' same-day observations are added. A GRU sequence model matches but does not exceed gradient boosting, and skill disappears beyond a two-day lead. For monthly totals, no learner beat climatology significantly. We release a leakage-aware protocol and code so that future station-based studies report skill against climatology on held-out years.

AI.tldr: 研究孟加拉国的降雨预报，指出随机划分训练测试集会因数据泄漏和季节查找表而高估模型能力。在时间与时空的严格评估下，滞后降雨特征仅带来有限的次日预报技巧，月度总量预报中没有学习器能显著优于气候学。
AI.motivation: 机器学习降雨预报常以随机划分评估，这会让模型看到邻近站点的同日观测，并掩盖站点-月份气候学已能解释大部分方差的事实，从而高估预报能力。
AI.method: 使用孟加拉国气象局 35 个站点、1948 至 2014 年共 618,650 个站日数据。比较随机、时间（训练于 1999 年及以前，测试于 2005 至 2014 年）和时空（未见站点与未见年份）三种评估方式；比较仅日历特征与包含滞后降雨特征的设置；比较六种学习器，并与气候学、持续性预报和 SARIMA 基线对照。
AI.result: 站点-月份气候学单独即可以 88.4% 的准确率（AUC 0.950）分类高降雨月份，时间评估下没有学习器比其提高超过 0.8 个百分点。仅含日历特征的随机森林在随机划分下次日湿日 AUC 达 0.889，但在未来年份上降至 0.835，低于气候学的 0.859。滞后降雨模型相对气候学的 Brier 技能评分为 0.074（95% CI 0.064 至 0.088），去除站点和年份输入后升至 0.091，加入其他站点同日观测后升至 0.131。GRU 与梯度提升相当但未超过，技巧在两日以上的预见期消失。月度总量上没有学习器显著优于气候学。
AI.conclusion: 站点降雨预报应在未见年份上与气候学比较并报告技巧，真实的预报技巧有限但确实存在。论文发布了防泄漏评估协议与代码，以支持后续研究。

title: HotPOT: Operator Transformer with Heterogeneous Physics Experts for Large-Scale PDE Pre-training
summary: Large-scale PDE pre-training trains a single model on the data from multiple partial differential equations (PDEs). However, adding heterogeneous PDEs with different governing equations, physical variables, and variable interactions does not always improve predictive performance across tasks. Existing PDE mixture-of-experts models mitigate cross-task interference through learned routing, but typically use homogeneous expert architectures, making it difficult to directly reflect differences in state evolution across equations. We introduce HotPOT, an operator transformer with heterogeneous physics experts for large-scale PDE pre-training. HotPOT uses a shared encoder to capture information common across PDEs, while each PDE family uses a neural-numerical expert that pairs a learnable predictor with a fixed numerical update containing no trainable parameters. Each predictor outputs the quantities required by its paired numerical update, which then computes the next state. This design allows different PDEs to share a common encoder while retaining their own learnable predictors and numerical updates. Experiments across five PDE families and six settings show that HotPOT outperforms MoE-POT in all 24 matched-scale comparisons before and after fine-tuning, reducing rollout error by 50.7% on average. Notably, the 17M model also surpasses substantially larger MoE-POT models, and the performance gains extend to zero-shot prediction under unseen physical conditions. Code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 提出 HotPOT，一种带异构物理专家的算子 Transformer，用于大规模 PDE 预训练：共享编码器，每个 PDE 族配一个由可学习预测器和无参数数值更新组成的神经-数值专家。在五个 PDE 族、六种设置下，相比 MoE-POT 在全部 24 组匹配规模对比中均更优，滚动误差平均降低 50.7%。
AI.motivation: 多 PDE 联合预训练时，方程、物理变量和变量交互各不相同，加入异构 PDE 并不总能提升性能。现有 PDE 混合专家模型通过学习路由缓解跨任务干扰，但专家结构同质，难以体现不同方程状态演化的差异。
AI.method: 共享编码器捕获跨 PDE 的共同信息；每个 PDE 族使用一个神经-数值专家，由可学习预测器输出数值更新所需的量，再由固定且不含可训练参数的数值更新计算下一时刻的状态。
AI.result: 在五个 PDE 族、六种设置下，HotPOT 在微调前后的全部 24 组匹配规模比较中均优于 MoE-POT，滚动误差平均降低 50.7%。17M 参数模型超过了规模大得多的 MoE-POT 模型，性能增益也可推广到未见物理条件下的零样本预测。
AI.conclusion: 共享编码器与各自保留可学习预测器和数值更新的异构专家相结合，使不同 PDE 能共享共性，同时保留各自的状态演化结构，是改进大规模 PDE 预训练的有效方向。

title: Variational Consequence-Driven Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) typically mitigates distribution shift by imposing divergence constraints on the action distributions of the learned and behavior policies. However, this paradigm cannot ensure the underlying dynamic consistency structure: even minor action deviations can lead to drastically different transitions, inadvertently driving the agent away from the offline dataset. To address this, we explore policy constraints through their induced state-consequence distributions rather than relying on pure action-distribution matching. Nevertheless, directly enforcing such consequence-aware constraints is computationally intractable without access to the true underlying dynamics model. To bypass this issue, we propose Structural Behavior Regularization (StBR), which replaces the intractable objective with a closed-form latent divergence. Structuring this latent space to reflect transition dynamics renders the latent divergence a theoretically bounded surrogate for the true consequence-distribution divergence. By regularizing the learned policy with this latent divergence, StBR adaptively tightens the behavior constraint in dynamics-sensitive regions, effectively preventing deviations outside the offline dataset. Empirically, we demonstrate that StBR achieves superior performance across diverse offline RL benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出结构化行为正则化（StBR），通过策略诱导的状态后果分布而非动作分布来约束离线强化学习策略。它用闭式的潜在空间散度替代难以计算的后果分布散度，并在多个离线 RL 基准上取得优越性能。
AI.motivation: 离线 RL 通常用动作分布的散度约束来缓解分布偏移，但即使动作有微小偏差，转移也可能截然不同，使智能体偏离离线数据集，因此动作分布匹配无法保证动态一致性结构。
AI.method: 将策略约束定义在其诱导的状态后果分布上。直接实施这种约束需要真实的动力学模型，因而不可行。StBR 用闭式的潜在散度替代该目标，并将潜在空间组织为反映转移动态的结构，使该散度成为后果分布散度的、具有理论界的代理；以此正则化学习到的策略，在动态敏感区域自适应地收紧行为约束。
AI.result: 摘要称 StBR 在多个离线 RL 基准上取得优越性能，未给出具体数值或基准名称。
AI.conclusion: 基于后果分布的约束能在动态敏感区域自适应地抑制偏离离线数据的行为，为离线 RL 中的行为正则化提供了新思路。

title: Nearly Minimax Optimal Regret for Adversarial Linear Bandits with Strong Corruptions
summary: We study adversarial linear bandits with strong corruption, in which an adaptive adversary chooses the reward vectors and a strong adversary corrupts each observed reward after seeing the learner's action, subject to a known total corruption budget $C$. Strong corruption breaks the importance-weighted reward estimates used by adversarial bandit algorithms: by corrupting only the rounds in which a rarely sampled action is drawn, the adversary amplifies each unit of corruption by the inverse of its sampling probability. The best known bound for this problem, $\tilde O(\sqrt{d^3T} + dC)$ by Liu et al. (2024), is a factor $\sqrt{d}$ above the corruption-free rate in its leading term, and whether $\tilde O(d\sqrt{T} + dC)$ regret is achievable was left open. We propose CRW-FTRL, which runs follow-the-regularized-leader with a radius-weighted entropy regularizer and estimates rewards with a normalized kernel estimator whose sensitivity to corruption is governed by per-action radii instead of inverse sampling probabilities. The radii are nondecreasing and are chosen jointly with the sampling distribution through a monotone log-determinant barrier problem, so that a negative linear term in the regularizer cancels both the corruption bias and the estimation error of every comparator. For $K$ actions in $\mathbb{R}^d$, CRW-FTRL achieves $\tilde O(\sqrt{dT\log K} + dC)$ regret with high probability against an adaptive adversary, which matches the best known corruption-free rate and the $\Omega(dC)$ lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Applied to a discretization of a general compact action set, it yields $\tilde O(d\sqrt{T} + dC)$ regret, which settles the statistical rate of corrupted adversarial linear bandits under strong corruption.

AI.tldr: 针对带强腐败的对抗线性赌博机，提出 CRW-FTRL，在自适应对手下以高概率达到 O~(sqrt(dT log K) + dC) 的遗憾界，与无腐败的速率及 Omega(dC) 下界仅差对数因子；由此在紧致动作集的离散化上得到 O~(d sqrt(T) + dC)，确定了该问题的统计速率。
AI.motivation: 强腐败下，对手在看到学习者动作后篡改奖励，使重要性加权估计失效：对手只需在稀有动作被采样时腐败，就能把每单位腐败放大为采样概率的倒数。已知最好界 O~(sqrt(d^3 T) + dC) 在主项上比无腐败速率高出 sqrt(d)，而 O~(d sqrt(T) + dC) 是否可达此前未解决。
AI.method: 提出 CRW-FTRL：以半径加权熵为正则项的跟随正则领导者算法，并用归一化核估计器估计奖励，其对腐败的敏感性由每个动作的半径而非逆采样概率控制。半径单调不减，并与采样分布通过单调的对数行列式屏障问题联合选取，使正则项中的负线性项抵消每个比较器的腐败偏差与估计误差。
AI.result: 对 R^d 中的 K 个动作，CRW-FTRL 在自适应对手下以高概率达到 O~(sqrt(dT log K) + dC) 的遗憾，与已知无腐败速率及 Omega(dC) 下界在对数因子内匹配。应用于紧致动作集的离散化时，得到 O~(d sqrt(T) + dC) 的遗憾。
AI.conclusion: 该结果确定了强腐败下对抗线性赌博机的统计速率并回答了此前的开放问题；腐败预算 C 的代价体现为线性项 dC，与下界匹配。

title: Transportable Offline Reinforcement Learning in Presence of Unmeasured Confounding
summary: Offline reinforcement learning seeks to learn decision policies from previously collected data, but deployment environments may differ from the domains in which the data were collected, and logged variables may omit confounders that affected both historical actions and outcomes. We study offline policy learning under the joint challenges of domain discrepancy and unmeasured confounding, where multiple heterogeneous source datasets provide complementary information about a target domain. We develop a causally adjusted transportability framework combining transportability theory with instrumental variables, negative controls, and proxies to identify target-domain causal quantities. For confounded contextual bandits, identification reduces to systems of bridge-function integral equations, enabling minimax estimation from finite samples. Confidence sets for the identified quantities are then used for pessimistic policy optimization, yielding CAT-CCB. We extend the framework to episodic confounded Markov decision processes, where complementary sources identify target reward and transition mechanisms under structural and completeness conditions. Under Gaussian dynamics and linear function approximation, this yields CAT-CMDP. We establish high-probability finite-sample suboptimality guarantees that quantify the effects of approximation, estimation, source-to-target shift, offline coverage, and sample size. For bounded finite-dimensional linear classes, the contextual-bandit guarantee recovers the standard $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(N^{-1/2})$ rate. Numerical experiments support the effectiveness of the framework for learning target-domain policies from heterogeneous confounded data. Together, the results provide a principled approach when no single source dataset suffices for causal identification and policy optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出 CAT-CCB 与 CAT-CMDP 框架，将迁移理论与工具变量、阴性对照和代理变量结合，在存在不可测混杂和多源域偏移时为目标域学习悲观的离线策略，并给出高概率的有限样本次优性保证。
AI.motivation: 离线策略学习同时面临两类挑战：部署环境与数据采集域不同，且记录变量可能遗漏同时影响历史动作和结果的混杂因子；单个源数据集往往不足以完成因果识别与策略优化。
AI.method: 因果调整的迁移框架：将迁移理论与工具变量、阴性对照和代理变量结合，识别目标域的因果量。对带混杂的上下文赌博机，识别问题化为桥函数积分方程组，可从有限样本进行极小化极大估计；对识别量构造置信集，用于悲观策略优化，得到 CAT-CCB。扩展到带混杂的episodic MDP，在结构与完备性条件下由互补源识别目标奖励与转移机制；在高斯动力学与线性函数逼近下得到 CAT-CMDP。
AI.result: 给出高概率的有限样本次优性保证，量化了函数逼近、估计、源到目标的偏移、离线覆盖和样本量的影响。对有界有限维线性类，上下文赌博机的保证恢复标准的 O~(N^{-1/2}) 速率。数值实验支持该框架从异质混杂数据中学习目标域策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 当没有单个源数据集足以完成因果识别与策略优化时，该框架提供了一种有原则的方法，可在异质混杂数据上学习目标域策略。

title: ParaTTT: Parallelizing Test-Time Training Layers with Deep Memories
comment: 34 pages, 7 figures. Project repository: this https URL
summary: Test-time training (TTT) layers replace the linear fast-weight memory of modern recurrent architectures with a small neural network trained online by gradient descent. This nonlinear memory is more expressive than the linear memories of Gated DeltaNet and Mamba-2, but is difficult to parallelize: existing implementations such as TTT-MLP rely on sequential, block-wise weight updates that run several times slower than chunkwise-parallel linear recurrences. Moreover, their block-wise execution only approximates the token-by-token online recurrence, whereas linear recurrences admit an exact chunkwise-parallel evaluation. We introduce ParaTTT (PTTT), an algorithm for parallelizing arbitrarily deep nonlinear memories by iteratively refining estimates of the inner-loop gradient trajectory. Starting from a guess of the hidden-layer gradients, each refinement consists of three chunkwise-parallel passes: a forward pass that evaluates the resulting feature trajectory, an exact gated-delta-rule pass that computes the readout trajectory and its feature gradients, and a backward pass that propagates these gradients into a new estimate. The exact online gradient descent recurrence is a fixed point of the iteration, while decoding requires no refinement iterations. We prove geometric convergence for a two-layer variant under sufficient contraction conditions. In practice, two iterations suffice. With two refinement steps at 4K context, PTTT evaluates the inner-loop trajectory $32\times$ faster than TTT-MLP with the block approximation at matched error, while the full 340M model trains $4.9\times$ faster. Models trained at 340M and 1.3B parameters match or exceed Gated DeltaNet and Mamba-2 and remain competitive with same-size Transformers on language-modeling perplexity and zero-shot accuracy, with better recall than the linear recurrences.

AI.tldr: 提出 ParaTTT（PTTT），通过迭代细化内层梯度轨迹，将任意深度的非线性测试时训练（TTT）记忆层并行化。在 4K 上下文下，两次细化使内层轨迹评估比带块近似的 TTT-MLP 快 32 倍，340M 模型训练快 4.9 倍；340M 与 1.3B 模型在语言建模上达到或超过 Gated DeltaNet 与 Mamba-2。
AI.motivation: TTT 层用经在线梯度下降训练的小神经网络作为记忆，比线性记忆更有表达力，但难以并行。已有实现（如 TTT-MLP）依赖顺序的块级权重更新，比分块并行的线性递推慢数倍，且块级执行只是对逐 token 在线递推的近似。
AI.method: 迭代细化内层梯度轨迹：从隐藏层梯度的初始猜测出发，每轮包括三个分块并行的步骤：前向传播评估特征轨迹；精确的门控 delta 规则计算读出轨迹及其特征梯度；反向传播把这些梯度传回，形成新的估计。精确的在线梯度下降递推是该迭代的不动点，解码时无需细化迭代。
AI.result: 两轮细化即已足够。在 4K 上下文下，内层轨迹评估在匹配误差时比带块近似的 TTT-MLP 快 32 倍，340M 完整模型训练快 4.9 倍。340M 与 1.3B 参数模型在语言建模困惑度和零样本准确率上达到或超过 Gated DeltaNet 与 Mamba-2，与同规模 Transformer 相当，且召回能力优于线性递推。两层变体在充分的压缩条件下证明了几何收敛。
AI.conclusion: 该算法使深层非线性记忆可以高效并行，在保持精确在线递推语义的同时缩小了与线性递推之间的速度差距，并在语言建模中具有竞争力。

title: A Hybrid Physics-informed holomorphic neural networks Method
summary: Physics-informed holomorphic neural networks (PIHNNs) exploit complex-analytic representations to satisfy homogeneous PDEs by construction, but their extension to nonhomogeneous problems is nontrivial. We propose a hybrid physics-informed holomorphic neural network (HPIHNN) framework based on a decomposition of the solution into particular and homogeneous components. The particular component is computed by a spectral method on a simple extended domain, while the homogeneous component is approximated by a PIHNN trained only on the boundary with modified boundary data. The resulting formulation avoids meshing complex geometries and retains the dimensionality-reduction advantage of holomorphic representations. The method is applied to nonhomogeneous Poisson, Stokes, biharmonic, linear elasticity, and Helmholtz equations. Numerical experiments covering complex geometries, corner singularities, and nearly incompressible regimes demonstrate that the proposed method accurately resolves the corresponding solutions and, in the considered tests, generally achieves lower errors and shorter training times than standard PINNs. The results indicate that coupling spectral particular solutions with holomorphic neural approximations provides an efficient approach to nonhomogeneous PDEs on complex domains.

AI.tldr: 提出混合物理信息全纯神经网络（HPIHNN）方法，将解分解为特解与齐次部分：特解用简单扩展域上的谱方法计算，齐次部分由仅在边界上训练的 PIHNN 逼近，用于求解非齐次 PDE。在所测试的问题中，该方法通常比标准 PINN 误差更低、训练更快。
AI.motivation: PIHNN 利用复解析表示天然满足齐次 PDE，但其扩展到非齐次问题并不直接。希望在避免复杂几何网格划分的同时，保留全纯表示的降维优势。
AI.method: 将解分解为特解与齐次分量。特解由简单扩展域上的谱方法计算；齐次分量由 PIHNN 逼近，该网络仅在边界上、使用修改后的边界数据进行训练。
AI.result: 方法应用于非齐次 Poisson、Stokes、双调和、线弹性和 Helmholtz 方程，数值实验涵盖复杂几何、角点奇异性和近不可压缩情形。结果表明该方法能准确求解相应问题，并且在所考虑的测试中通常比标准 PINN 误差更低、训练时间更短。
AI.conclusion: 将谱方法特解与全纯神经近似耦合，为复杂区域上的非齐次 PDE 提供了一种高效途径。

title: NAGO: Noise-Aware Generative Operator via Flow Matching
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 49 pages including appendices and checklist. Code: this https URL
summary: We introduce NAGO, a noise-aware generative operator for efficient sampling from invariant measures of stochastic partial differential equations (SPDEs) in function space. Our central idea is to treat the source measure as a design variable rather than a fixed Gaussian default. We establish admissibility conditions for well-defined infinite-dimensional flows and show that the finite-band source--target covariance ratio controls the spectral stiffness of the marginal velocity field. This analysis yields an admissibility-constrained spectral-matching rule: choose a source that is sufficiently rough for well-posedness, then minimize covariance mismatch over the resolved Fourier modes. On three representative stochastic-field benchmarks, this source design improves few-step spectral accuracy and several complementary distributional and physical statistics. In a controlled Matern-field ablation, it reduces the accurate RK4 budget from about 30 steps for Gaussian functional flow matching to 3--5 steps, a $6$--$10\times$ reduction in neural ODE evaluations. These gains are strongest for stationary multiscale fields and depend on the metric, resolution, and guidance protocol.

AI.tldr: 提出 NAGO，一种基于流匹配的噪声感知生成算子，用于从随机偏微分方程（SPDE）的不变测度中采样。它将源测度视为设计变量而非固定高斯，在三个随机场基准上提高了少步谱精度，在 Matern 场消融中将精确 RK4 所需步数从约 30 步降至 3 至 5 步。
AI.motivation: 基于高斯的函数流匹配将源分布固定为高斯，其谱刚度会使少步积分需要大量神经 ODE 求值；希望在函数空间中为 SPDE 的不变测度高效采样，同时保证无限维流的良定性。
AI.method: 建立无限维流良定的可容许性条件，并证明有限带宽下源-目标协方差比控制边缘速度场的谱刚度。据此得到一个可容许性约束下的谱匹配规则：选择足够粗糙以保证良定性的源分布，再在已分辨的 Fourier 模式上最小化协方差失配。
AI.result: 在三个代表性随机场基准上，该源分布设计提高了少步谱精度以及多项互补的分布与物理统计量。在受控的 Matern 场消融中，精确 RK4 所需步数由高斯函数流匹配的约 30 步降至 3 至 5 步，神经 ODE 求值次数减少 6 至 10 倍。增益在平稳多尺度场上最明显，并依赖于度量、分辨率和引导协议。
AI.conclusion: 对源测度的设计可以显著降低生成采样的计算成本，但收益依赖于具体的度量、分辨率和引导设置，适用范围需结合具体任务判断。

title: The Role of Quantization in Loss Spikes
summary: Loss spikes in language model pretraining can waste substantial compute and derail otherwise healthy training runs. A primary driver of these instabilities is the growth and divergence of output logits in the final language modeling (LM) head. In this work, we study a particularly costly form of this instability associated with output logit growth: delayed, terminal divergences that emerge only after prolonged training, which we call time-bomb spikes. We find that these instabilities are preceded by rapidly growing quantization error in the LM head, which eventually culminates in a loss spike. Crucially, reducing numerical precision accelerates time-bomb spikes, while increasing precision improves stability. We then propose a simple yet effective mitigation that replaces AdamW on the LM head with SGD with momentum, suppressing logit growth and improving stability over long training horizons. Finally, we find that existing mitigation techniques from the literature (along with our own) all reduce quantization error, suggesting a shared numerical mechanism behind their effectiveness. Together, our results identify finite precision error as a hidden driver of time-bomb spikes and show that suppressing this error is key to stable long-horizon pretraining.

AI.tldr: 研究语言模型预训练中的损失尖峰，指出一类延迟出现的"定时炸弹"式尖峰由 LM 头的输出 logit 增长引起，并与 LM 头量化误差的快速增长相伴；降低数值精度会加速此类尖峰。将 LM 头上的 AdamW 替换为带动量的 SGD 可抑制 logit 增长，改善长时程稳定性。
AI.motivation: 预训练中的损失尖峰会浪费大量算力并破坏原本健康的训练。已知驱动因素是最终 LM 头输出 logit 的增长与发散，但对长时间训练后才出现的延迟性终局发散（定时炸弹式尖峰），其机制尚不清楚。
AI.method: 分析发现，这类不稳定之前伴随 LM 头量化误差的快速增长。提出一种简单缓解方法：在 LM 头上用带动量的 SGD 替代 AdamW。同时考察文献中已有的缓解技术。
AI.result: 降低数值精度会加速定时炸弹式尖峰，提高精度则改善稳定性；用带动量的 SGD 替代 LM 头上的 AdamW 可抑制 logit 增长，并在长时程训练中改善稳定性；文献中已有的缓解技术及作者的方法都降低了量化误差，提示其背后存在共同的数值机制。摘要未给出具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 有限精度误差是定时炸弹式尖峰的隐藏驱动因素，抑制该误差是实现长时程预训练稳定性的关键。

title: A Case Study of a Multi-Agent Kernel-Optimization Loop That Learns a New AI Accelerator
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Round 1 of the NPU Model Optimization Competition at MICRO 2026. Code: this https URL
summary: Frontier large language models write correct CUDA kernels for most single-operator benchmark tasks, yet their accuracy collapses on accelerators whose architecture and programming language they have rarely seen. We present a case study of an LLM agent loop built for such accelerators. Our example is the FuriosaAI RNGD NPU, programmed in a recent, sparsely documented Rust DSL, where the loop optimized three Gemma-4-12B decode kernels over 12 days on a shared, scarce device. The loop builds its own target knowledge: it writes and checks a summary of the DSL documentation, measures the chip with microbenchmarks, records compiler-derived legality rules, and revisits this knowledge when the toolchain changes, rechecking rules and measurements where it can. A role-based search over per-kernel Design Trees explores whole-kernel designs and accumulates small accepted changes in the best version of each kernel. Because device time is scarce and readings are noisy, cheap checks screen new designs before any device run, and late in the run a change was accepted only after repeated comparisons with the best kernel on the device. The final kernels reach a 9.293x geomean speedup over the official baseline, each within 1.25x of the cycles needed just to move its weights. Our prompts, profiler and acceptance test are available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 以一个多智能体 LLM 内核优化循环为案例，在 FuriosaAI RNGD NPU 上针对一种文档稀少的 Rust DSL 优化三个 Gemma-4-12B 解码内核，历时 12 天，最终内核相对官方基线达到 9.293 倍的几何平均加速，且每个内核都在搬运其权重所需周期的 1.25 倍以内。
AI.motivation: 前沿大语言模型在多数单算子 CUDA 内核任务上能写出正确代码，但在架构与编程语言都很少见的加速器上，其正确率会急剧下降。
AI.method: 循环自行构建目标平台知识：撰写并检查 DSL 文档摘要，用微基准测量芯片，记录编译器推导出的合法性规则，并在工具链变化时重新审视这些知识。采用基于角色的搜索，在每个内核的设计树上探索整体内核设计，并把小的已接受改动累积到每个内核的最佳版本中。由于设备时间稀缺且读数有噪声，新设计需先经廉价检查筛选；后期的改动须在与最优内核多次比较后才被接受。
AI.result: 最终内核相对官方基线的几何平均加速为 9.293 倍，每个内核都在搬运其权重所需周期的 1.25 倍以内。摘要未给出其他基准或对比方法。
AI.conclusion: LLM 智能体循环可以在缺乏训练数据的新加速器上，通过自我构建知识并结合受控的搜索与验证，产出性能显著的内核，为新硬件的内核开发提供了一个案例。

title: Multi-Token Prediction Done Right
summary: Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) is now a common ingredient in language-model pre-training, as it improves downstream performance and enables faster inference through speculative decoding. We identify a flaw in standard MTP training, in which a residual component of the MTP gradient interferes with both next-token and multi-token learning, increasingly so with scale. Specifically, the MTP cross-entropy gradient can be decomposed exactly into a KL self-distillation term that pulls each MTP head toward the model's own next-token prediction (NTP) distribution and improves speculative decoding, and a residual that has a low signal-to-noise ratio and buries the useful KL signal. We introduce the KL gradient-recovery trick: when two distributions share a linear output head, the gradient of their KL divergence can be recovered exactly by combining their cross-entropy gradients through straight-through gradient routing. Unlike minimizing the KL directly, this trick requires no vocabulary-sized logit matrices and is compatible with standard fused cross-entropy kernels. This enables Soft Multi-Token Prediction (Soft-MTP), a one-line code change to MTP that removes the noisy residual and backpropagates only the KL self-distillation signal by reusing the existing NTP and MTP cross-entropy computations. Soft-MTP supports both DeepSeek- and Meta-style MTP, adds no parameters, and incurs no measurable overhead. From 167M to 1.2B parameters, Soft-MTP improves over standard MTP with lower NTP perplexity, faster speculative decoding and higher zero-shot accuracy at every scale, lower MTP perplexity from 689M onward, and stronger math and code reasoning after fine-tuning at 1.2B. Soft-MTP also matches, if not exceeds, direct KL divergence minimization on most metrics. Soft-MTP is, in effect, a free lunch for MTP optimization. Our code can be found at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 指出标准多 token 预测（MTP）训练中，MTP 梯度的残差项会干扰下一 token 学习与多 token 学习。提出 Soft-MTP，只保留 KL 自蒸馏信号、去除残差，仅需对 MTP 代码做一行修改，不增加参数且无可测开销，并在 167M 至 1.2B 参数的各规模上优于标准 MTP。
AI.motivation: MTP 已成为语言模型预训练的常见组件，可提升下游性能并通过推测解码加速推理，但标准 MTP 的交叉熵梯度含有低信噪比的残差，且随规模增大而愈发严重，埋没了有用的 KL 信号。
AI.method: 将 MTP 交叉熵梯度精确分解为两部分：一是把每个 MTP 头拉向模型自身下一 token 预测分布的 KL 自蒸馏项，它有利于推测解码；二是低信噪比的残差。提出 KL 梯度恢复技巧：当两个分布共享线性输出头时，可通过直通梯度路由组合两者的交叉熵梯度，精确恢复其 KL 散度的梯度，无需词表大小的 logit 矩阵，并兼容标准的融合交叉熵内核。据此实现 Soft-MTP，只反向传播 KL 自蒸馏信号，并复用已有的 NTP 与 MTP 交叉熵计算；支持 DeepSeek 式与 Meta 式 MTP。
AI.result: 在 167M 至 1.2B 参数范围内，Soft-MTP 相比标准 MTP 在每个规模上都获得更低的 NTP 困惑度、更快的推测解码和更高的零样本准确率；从 689M 起 MTP 困惑度更低；1.2B 模型在微调后数学与代码推理更强。Soft-MTP 在多数指标上与直接最小化 KL 散度相当或更好。
AI.conclusion: 去除残差、只保留 KL 自蒸馏信号，可以在不增加成本的前提下改进 MTP 训练；作者称其为 MTP 优化中的免费午餐，其效果以上述规模与指标为限。

title: MUSE: Multi-Level Memory with Selective Runtime Injection for Scientific Coding Agents
summary: Historical experience can guide scientific coding at multiple levels, but task-level retrieval may miss implementation lessons that become relevant during execution. We introduce MUSE, a memory management framework combining multi-level memory with selective runtime injection for scientific coding agents. MUSE builds global, approach-level, and implementation-level memory from historical trajectories. At initialization, the agent receives global memory and problem-matched approach-level memory. During execution, current interactions are used to retrieve implementation-level memory. An LLM gate selects relevant experience and generates specific review advice, or skips injection. Across four benchmarks spanning numerical problem solving, kernel optimization, and scientific software repair, MUSE outperforms retrieval and memory baselines on all evaluation metrics. Ablations support the multi-level design and gated injection, while transfer experiments show that memory remains useful across kernel benchmarks. These results show that multi-level memory and selective runtime injection enable effective reuse of experience in scientific coding. Code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 提出 MUSE，一种面向科学编程智能体的记忆管理框架，结合多层级记忆与选择性运行时注入；在四个基准上优于检索与记忆基线。
AI.motivation: 任务级检索可能遗漏执行过程中才变得相关的实现层经验，现有方法缺少分层且按需注入的记忆机制。
AI.method: 从历史轨迹构建全局、方法层（approach-level）和实现层（implementation-level）三级记忆；初始化时注入全局记忆和问题匹配的方法层记忆，执行中用当前交互检索实现层记忆，由 LLM 门控选择相关经验并生成审查建议，或跳过注入。
AI.result: 在数值问题求解、kernel 优化和科学软件修复四个基准上，MUSE 在所有评估指标上均优于检索和记忆基线；消融实验支持多层设计和门控注入，迁移实验显示记忆在 kernel 基准间仍然有用。
AI.conclusion: 多层记忆与选择性运行时注入能够在科学编程中有效复用经验。

title: Optimal Regret for Communication-Efficient Decentralized Online Learning
summary: In this paper, we investigate decentralized online convex optimization with compressed communication, where $n$ learners over a network jointly minimize a sequence of global loss functions based only on their local losses and compressed messages from their neighbors. The best known regret bounds for this problem are $O(\omega^{-1/2}n\rho^{-1}\sqrt{T\ln n})$ and $O(\omega^{-1}n\rho^{-2}\ln n\ln T)$ for convex and strongly convex loss functions, respectively, where $\rho\in(0,1)$ is the spectral gap of the communication matrix and $\omega\in(0,1]$ is the compression quality factor. Compared with the corresponding lower bounds of $\Omega(\omega^{-1/2}n\rho^{-1/4}\sqrt{T})$ and $\Omega(\omega^{-1}n\rho^{-1/2}\ln T)$, these upper bounds exhibit polynomial gaps in their dependence on $\rho^{-1}$. To close these gaps, we first develop Ascent-gossip, which combines an online compression strategy with a Chebyshev recursion and attains a faster consensus rate than existing compressed gossip methods. Furthermore, by adopting Ascent-gossip, we propose an online algorithm that achieves optimal regret bounds of $\widetilde O(\omega^{-1/2}n\rho^{-1/4}\sqrt{T})$ and $\widetilde O(\omega^{-1}n\rho^{-1/2}\ln T)$ for convex and strongly convex loss functions, respectively. Up to logarithmic factors in $n$ and $\rho^{-1}$, these results match the lower bounds in terms of $T$, $n$, $\rho$, and $\omega$.

AI.tldr: 研究带压缩通信的去中心化在线凸优化，提出 Ascent-gossip 并据此得到与下界在 T、n、rho、omega 上匹配（忽略对数因子）的最优遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 已知遗憾上界在谱间隙 rho 的倒数上相比下界存在多项式差距，现有压缩 gossip 方法的共识速度不够快。
AI.method: 提出 Ascent-gossip，将在线压缩策略与 Chebyshev 递推结合，获得比现有压缩 gossip 方法更快的共识速率；基于该方法设计在线算法。
AI.result: 对凸和强凸损失分别达到 O~(omega^{-1/2} n rho^{-1/4} sqrt(T)) 和 O~(omega^{-1} n rho^{-1/2} ln T) 的遗憾界，与下界一致（忽略 n 和 rho 的对数因子）。
AI.conclusion: 该结果消除了已知上界与下界之间的多项式差距，给出了该问题的最优遗憾。

title: Learning a Prior-Data Fitted Network for Graph Foundation Models via Structural Causal Model Priors
summary: Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for learning transferable representations across different graphs and domains. However, existing GFMs face notable limitations, including limited pre-training scale or reliance on aligning with textual information in Large Language Models (LLMs). To overcome these limitations, recent studies have drawn inspiration from prior-data fitted networks (PFNs), which learn from large synthetic datasets and support multi-domain prediction backed by causal learning. However, existing graph PFNs encounter severe difficulties in modeling causal relationships within and across node and edge sets, generating diverse graph structures, and designing suitable architectures that can learn from complex synthetic datasets. To address these challenges, we propose **GSCM-PFN** (Graph SCM-based Prior-Data Fitted Network), a graph PFN pre-trained on synthetic data generated from an SCM-based prior that jointly models nodes and graph topology. Specifically, we (1) design a joint feature-edge-label structural causal model (SCM) to guide synthetic graph generation and capture causal relationships within and across node and edge sets; (2) introduce prior-guided node-edge dependency modeling to instantiate diverse graph generation strategies, and prove that our SCM-based generation prior is more expressive than existing priors; and (3) propose a feature-permutation-invariant dual-path graph network with theoretical guarantees for learning from diverse synthetic graphs. Experiments on 23 real-world benchmarks show that GSCM-PFN outperforms both conventional GFMs and PFN-based GFMs, without utilizing real-world graph data for pre-training. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出 GSCM-PFN，一种在基于结构因果模型（SCM）先验生成的合成图数据上预训练的图 PFN；在 23 个真实基准上优于传统 GFM 和基于 PFN 的 GFM，且预训练未使用真实图数据。
AI.motivation: 现有图基础模型受限于预训练规模，或依赖与 LLM 的文本对齐；现有图 PFN 难以建模节点与边集合内外的因果关系、生成多样的图结构，并为复杂合成数据设计合适的架构。
AI.method: 设计联合特征-边-标签的 SCM 指导合成图生成，刻画节点和边集合内外的因果关系；引入先验引导的节点-边依赖建模以实现多样的图生成策略，并证明该先验比现有先验更具表达力；提出特征置换不变的双路径图网络，并给出理论保证。
AI.result: 在 23 个真实世界基准上，GSCM-PFN 优于传统 GFM 和基于 PFN 的 GFM，且预训练中未使用真实图数据。
AI.conclusion: 由结构因果先验生成的合成图可以替代真实图数据用于图基础模型的预训练，并支持多领域预测。

title: How Much Do Teacher Bridges Matter in Interleaved On-Policy Distillation?
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student using teacher predictions on student-generated responses. Some methods insert teacher-written segments, or bridges, but disagree on how to train on those tokens. We compare no loss, forward KL and reverse KL on identical trajectories using Qwen3-1.7B as student and Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 as teacher. We separate gradients by which model wrote each token. Under our short training runs and BF16 inference, pre-specified tests detected no added accuracy benefit from teacher text as context or as a training target. A one-paragraph bridge after the student's first paragraph is only 2.7% of the tokens and contributes a small gradient nearly orthogonal to the student-token gradient. In this main comparison, the three loss treatments gave similar gradient directions and were statistically equivalent in accuracy within a +/-5 percentage-point margin. An exploratory pilot placing the bridge where failed responses disagreed most with the teacher suggested a benefit from teacher-token loss. A pre-specified replication did not confirm this, and fourfold weighting showed no significant accuracy benefit. Two limitations bound these findings. Among the tested amounts of training on fixed responses, gains peaked after four updates before the student increasingly failed to stop generating. None of the tested online training variants met the criteria for stable stopping and improved accuracy. Our evaluations used BF16 inference, which rounds away most of the small weight changes. When evaluated in exact FP32, the tested replication models frequently reached the response-length limit. Our accuracy findings therefore concern BF16 inference; they do not establish that teacher-token supervision is generally unnecessary.

AI.tldr: 在交错式 on-policy 蒸馏中比较了桥接（bridge）token 的不同损失处理方式，发现在所测设置下，教师文本作为上下文或训练目标均未带来可检测的准确率收益。
AI.motivation: 部分 OPD 方法在学生生成的响应中插入教师撰写的段落（bridge），但对这些 token 的训练方式存在分歧，缺乏系统比较。
AI.method: 在相同轨迹上比较无损失、前向 KL 和反向 KL 三种处理，学生为 Qwen3-1.7B，教师为 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507；按 token 由哪个模型生成来分离梯度，并使用预先指定的检验。
AI.result: 主要比较中三种损失处理的梯度方向相似，在 ±5 个百分点的范围内准确率统计等价；bridge 仅占 2.7% 的 token，其梯度与学生 token 梯度近乎正交；探索性试点提示教师 token 损失可能有益，但预先指定的复现未证实，四倍加权也无显著收益；在固定响应的训练中，收益在四次更新后达到峰值，随后学生越来越难以停止生成。
AI.conclusion: 在 BF16 推理下，教师 token 监督未带来可检测的准确率提升，但这并不能证明教师 token 监督普遍不必要；在 FP32 下复现模型常达到长度上限。

title: Continual Adaptation Across Modalities: Learning and Forgetting in Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs), which can process and generate diverse modalities within a single framework, have recently emerged as a powerful paradigm. However, when these models undergo continual learning on multiple tasks across different modalities, their learning and forgetting dynamics remain poorly understood. In this paper, we systematically investigate how architectural design and adaptation method shape intra-modal learning and cross-modal interference between the generation and understanding sides. Specifically, we report three findings. First, the severity of cross-modal interference decreases with the degree of modality-specific parameter isolation. Second, a within-model asymmetry: the generation side of a UMM is markedly more fragile than its understanding side. Third, what post-training adds is the first to be forgotten: purely post-training capabilities such as personalized generation collapse by 84\% to 90\%, while pretraining capabilities remain stable. Together, these results clarify how parameter isolation and post-training fragility shape UMMs' learning and forgetting dynamics, offering a starting point for developing continually evolving UMMs.

AI.tldr: 系统研究统一多模态模型（UMM）在跨模态持续学习中的遗忘动态，发现模态参数隔离可减轻跨模态干扰，生成端比理解端更脆弱，后训练获得的能力最先被遗忘。
AI.motivation: UMM 在跨模态的多任务持续学习中，学习与遗忘动态尚不清楚，需要理解架构设计和适应方法如何影响模态内学习以及生成端与理解端之间的跨模态干扰。
AI.method: 系统考察架构设计与适应方法对模态内学习以及生成侧与理解侧之间跨模态干扰的影响。
AI.result: 三个发现：跨模态干扰的严重程度随模态特定参数隔离程度的增加而降低；生成侧比理解侧明显更脆弱；纯后训练能力（如个性化生成）会下降 84% 到 90%，而预训练能力保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 参数隔离与后训练脆弱性共同塑造了 UMM 的学习与遗忘动态，为发展持续演化的 UMM 提供了起点。

title: AtomSteer: Test-Time Constraint Steering for Atomistic Generative Models
summary: Diffusion and flow matching models offer scalable approaches to generating crystalline materials, molecular conformers, and protein-ligand complexes. However, satisfying crystallographic symmetry, structural geometry, and accurate stereochemistry remains challenging. Satisfying these requirements calls for corrections that preserve the geometry already captured by the pretrained model. In this work, we propose AtomSteer, a test-time inference framework for steering pretrained atomistic generative models with structural constraints. During sampling, AtomSteer corrects intermediate structure predictions with bounded local projections, graph-rigid stereochemical transformations, and projections over periodic symmetries, accepting updates that improve constraint satisfaction while limiting changes to the rest of the structure. We demonstrate AtomSteer across three pretrained backbones, FlowMM, ET-Flow, and Boltz-2, spanning de novo crystal generation and crystal structure prediction, molecular conformer generation, and protein-ligand complex structure prediction. AtomSteer improves space-group distribution coverage in de novo crystal generation and improves target space-group recovery in crystal structure prediction. AtomSteer improves molecular validity and E/Z stereochemical accuracy while retaining conformer ensemble fidelity. For protein-ligand complexes, AtomSteer reduces ligand E/Z errors relative to experimental reference structures while achieving competitive docking success and PoseBusters validity. Our method provides a unified framework for adding chemical and crystallographic control to existing atomistic generative models without retraining or architectural changes.

AI.tldr: 提出 AtomSteer，一种测试时推理框架，在采样过程中用结构约束引导预训练的原子生成模型，无需重训练或改变架构，即可提升对称性、几何与立体化学的正确性。
AI.motivation: 扩散和流匹配模型在生成晶体、分子构象和蛋白-配体复合物时，难以同时满足晶体对称性、结构几何和精确立体化学的约束，而修正又需保留预训练模型已学到的几何。
AI.method: 在采样中用有界局部投影、图刚性立体化学变换以及周期对称投影修正中间结构预测，仅接受能提高约束满足度的更新，并限制对其余结构的改动；在 FlowMM、ET-Flow 和 Boltz-2 三个骨干上验证。
AI.result: 在从头晶体生成中提升空间群分布覆盖，在晶体结构预测中提升目标空间群的恢复率；分子有效性和 E/Z 立体化学准确率提高，同时保持构象集合保真度；蛋白-配体复合物的配体 E/Z 误差相对实验参考结构降低，并保持有竞争力的对接成功率和 PoseBusters 有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为现有原子生成模型提供了统一的化学与晶体学控制框架，无需重训练或改变架构。

title: REVBRAIN: Real-time Probabilistic EEG Forecasting Using Residual Vector Quantization
summary: Real-time forecasting of resting-state EEG signals is required by applications like brain-state-dependent stimulation, where computer generated actions are coupled with ongoing neural oscillations. Recently, the deep learning model WaveNet was proposed for the forecasting task. It shows superior accuracy compared to the prevailing method, the linear autoregressive (AR) model, and provides a built-in uncertainty measure due to its probabilistic modeling framework. However, inference using WaveNet is too slow for real-time use due to its sample-by-sample autoregressive operation: a single forecast requires evaluating the model tens or hundreds of times depending on the length of the prediction window. In this paper, we present REVBRAIN, a probabilistic deep learning method that produces forecasts in real time by generating the forecast over the whole prediction horizon at once. This is achieved by tokenizing the output space using residual vector quantization (RVQ) and generating forecasts over the items in the tokenized space. We tested REVBRAIN for forecasting 200 ms of EEG time series in the alpha-frequency band (8-13 Hz) and compared our results against WaveNet model. We found that REVBRAIN achieved real-time inference on a laptop GPU and an over $50\times$ speedup compared to WaveNet, while reaching superior prediction accuracy. By achieving real-time inference speed, REVBRAIN enables incorporating accurate and probabilistic EEG forecasting into BCI applications, opening up new ways for investigating the functioning of the human brain.

AI.tldr: 提出 REVBRAIN，用残差向量量化（RVQ）对输出空间进行词元化，一次性生成整个预测时域的概率性 EEG 预测，实现实时推理，并且预测精度优于 WaveNet。
AI.motivation: WaveNet 的逐样本自回归推理太慢，无法满足脑状态依赖刺激等需要与神经振荡实时耦合的应用需求。
AI.method: 用残差向量量化对输出空间进行词元化，并在词元空间中一次生成整个预测窗口的预测；在 alpha 频段（8-13 Hz）上预测 200 ms 的静息态 EEG，并与 WaveNet 对比。
AI.result: 在笔记本电脑 GPU 上实现实时推理，相比 WaveNet 加速超过 50 倍，同时预测精度更高。
AI.conclusion: 实时的概率性 EEG 预测可以用于 BCI 应用，为研究人脑功能提供新途径。

title: Persona Learning from Feedback for Personalized AI Assistants
summary: Personalizing AI assistants requires adapting their behavior to users' preferences and task contexts. Existing work elicits assistant personas through persona prompting or finetuning on persona-conditioned generations. However, persona descriptions alone do not identify what to change or preserve in a particular response, or which behaviors suit the current request. We introduce $\textit{Persona Learning from Feedback (PLF)}$, a framework that learns reusable, preference-grounded assistant personas as independent LoRA adapters on a shared frozen backbone. During training, a frozen self-teacher conditions on persona specifications and response-specific feedback to provide token-level supervision on each adapter's own generated prefixes. A feedback gate focuses corrective updates on responses judged to need improvement. At deployment, a supervised router uses the request or dialogue to select a single adapter or a fixed composition, without user-specific finetuning. We evaluate PLF on single-turn personalization with model-generated critiques and multi-turn tutoring with simulated students' reactions. Across both settings, PLF improves model-judged preference fit over fixed-persona policies and strong baselines including persona prompting and persona distillation, demonstrating how feedback-trained behaviors can be reused for adaptive assistant personalization without degrading general capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出 Persona Learning from Feedback（PLF），将可复用、基于偏好的助手人设学习为共享冻结骨干上的独立 LoRA 适配器，部署时由路由器选择；在单轮个性化和多轮辅导任务中，模型评判的偏好契合度优于固定人设策略及强基线。
AI.motivation: 仅靠人设描述无法指明某个具体回复应改变或保留什么，也无法判断哪种行为适合当前请求；现有的人设提示和人设微调方法存在这一局限。
AI.method: 训练时，冻结的自教师依据人设规格和针对具体回复的反馈，对每个适配器自身生成的前缀提供词元级监督；反馈门控将修正更新集中在判定需要改进的回复上；部署时，监督式路由器根据请求或对话选择单个适配器或固定组合，无需用户特定微调。
AI.result: 在基于模型生成批评的单轮个性化和基于模拟学生反应的多轮辅导两类设置中，PLF 相比固定人设策略、人设提示和人设蒸馏等强基线，模型评判的偏好契合度均有提升，且未损害通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 基于反馈训练得到的行为可以被复用于自适应的助手个性化，而不削弱通用能力。

title: Episodic looking - using reinforcement learning to bias perception enhances few-shot and continual learning with protection from forgetting
summary: There is a fundamental contradiction between the desire for models that can generalize, and models that can continuously adapt to recent input with changing statistics. These conditions, captured in few-shot and continual learning settings, can bias or disrupt learned representations. This harms generalization to a broader context, leaving the model unable to overcome input variance. This paper proposes a solution based on the Complementary Learning System architecture (CLS), in which a Short-Term Memory (STM) delegates generalization to a slow, statistical Long-Term Memory (LTM). Delegation is achieved by working in a space of robust, generalized perceptions produced by the LTM. With this separation, the STM can focus on memorizing recent input and avoiding interference between memories. We show that on an image classification task, the resulting CLS model is more resistant to forgetting in a domain-incremental continual learning setting than a baseline ResNet LTM, and generalizes more effectively in a few-shot setting than other continual learners. In the continual setting, overall accuracy is slightly worse than existing continual learning models, but with a different mix of performance characteristics. Results analysis suggests that the model is limited by the representations and representational plasticity of the LTM. In future work, we will seek to address this by replaying STM memories to the LTM.

AI.tldr: 提出基于互补学习系统（CLS）的模型，由短期记忆（STM）把泛化委托给慢速统计的长期记忆（LTM）；在域增量持续学习中比 ResNet 基线 LTM 更抗遗忘，在少样本学习中泛化优于其他持续学习方法。
AI.motivation: 泛化能力与对变化统计量的持续适应之间存在矛盾，少样本和持续学习设定会扰乱或偏置已学表征，损害对更广范围的泛化。
AI.method: 在 CLS 架构中，STM 专注于记忆近期输入并避免记忆间干扰，泛化则委托给 LTM 产生的鲁棒泛化表征空间；在图像分类任务上进行评估。
AI.result: 在域增量持续学习中，CLS 模型比基线 ResNet LTM 更抗遗忘，在少样本设置中泛化优于其他持续学习方法；在持续设定下总体准确率略低于现有持续学习模型，但性能特征组合不同；结果分析表明模型受限于 LTM 的表征及其表征可塑性。
AI.conclusion: 作者计划在未来工作中通过向 LTM 回放 STM 记忆来解决这一限制。

title: Dual DeltaNet: Value-Side Memory Reorganization for Linear Attention
summary: Linear attention and state space models (SSMs) offer efficient alternatives to softmax attention by maintaining a fixed-size recurrent state, but this design requires careful management to preserve useful historical associations and limit interference. The delta rule helps reduce interference through correction of the value associated with each key, but it does not explicitly account for how related value features are distributed across the state. We observe that a state $\boldsymbol{S}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_k\times d_v}$ can be viewed as a bank of $d_k$ addresses storing $d_v$-dimensional values. While a key-side read $\boldsymbol{S}^\top\boldsymbol{k}$ retrieves the value associated with $\boldsymbol{k}$, a value-side read $\boldsymbol{S}\boldsymbol{e}$ aggregates addresses whose stored value features match the selector $\boldsymbol{e}$. Based on this observation, we propose Dual DeltaNet (DDN), which extends Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) with a two-sided delta rule. The key-side delta rule reads with the current key to correct its associated value, while the complementary value-side delta rule reads with selected features of the current value to reorganize the addresses it occupies. We derive a chunkwise parallel training algorithm and a rank-2 recurrence that increases arithmetic intensity during inference. Compared with KDA, GDN-2, and Mamba-3, DDN achieves the strongest overall performance across language modeling, zero-shot downstream tasks, and retrieval, while incurring modest training and inference overhead relative to KDA. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出 Dual DeltaNet（DDN），在 Kimi Delta Attention（KDA）基础上加入双侧 delta 规则，在语言建模、零样本下游任务和检索上整体表现最强，相对 KDA 的开销适中。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力和状态空间模型的固定大小循环状态需要精细管理，才能保留有用的历史关联并限制干扰；现有 delta 规则只修正键对应的值，未显式考虑相关值特征在状态中的分布。
AI.method: 将状态视为存储 d_v 维值的 d_k 个地址的集合，在键侧读取之外增加值侧读取（用当前值的选择特征聚合地址）；在 KDA 基础上加入双侧 delta 规则，推导分块并行训练算法，并给出可提高推理算术强度的秩-2 递推。
AI.result: 相比 KDA、GDN-2 和 Mamba-3，DDN 在语言建模、零样本下游任务和检索上取得最强的整体表现，相对 KDA 仅有适度的训练和推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 值侧的记忆重组可以作为键侧 delta 规则的补充，以较小的额外开销提升线性注意力的性能。

title: Rethinking LLM Jailbreak Evaluation: Continuous Risk Landscapes Beyond Binary Outcomes
summary: A binary success indicator is a natural representation for discriminative tasks such as image classification under adversarial perturbations, where each input is mapped to a single prediction. However, generative tasks are fundamentally different: an LLM jailbreak prompt induces a distribution over open-ended trajectories, while a sampled response reveals only one path. Yet LLM jailbreak evaluation typically retains the binary response indicator underlying attack success rate, obscuring the surrounding structure of possible generations. We introduce a continuous, context-conditioned risk landscape over first-token branches, estimated by fixing candidate openings and repeatedly sampling their continuations. This continuous risk-landscape perspective reveals two complementary properties: current decoder exposure and safe rerouting capacity, which have been obscured by binary-indicator-based ASR. The resulting representation also provides a common basis for comparing clean prompts, attacked variants, and attack strength against a known adaptive defense. Across multiple target models and jailbreak attacks, we uncover risky branches beneath apparently safe outputs, identify qualitatively different ways attacks reshape the model's opening distribution, and show that attacks strongest before a defense do not necessarily remain the strongest after the adaptive defense reacts. These findings recast jailbreaks as deformations of the surrounding continuation-risk landscape, establishing a more informative foundation for understanding jailbreak behavior and developing safer language models.

AI.tldr: 以首词元分支为基础构建上下文条件的连续风险图景，替代二元攻击成功率指标；揭示安全输出之下存在风险分支，并表明防御前最强的攻击在自适应防御后未必仍然最强。
AI.motivation: 二元成功指标适用于图像分类这类判别任务，但 LLM 越狱属于生成任务，单次采样只反映一条路径，二元 ASR 掩盖了可能生成结果的整体结构。
AI.method: 固定若干候选开头并多次采样其续写，估计上下文条件的连续风险图景；由此刻画当前解码器暴露度和安全重路由能力两种性质，并用于比较干净提示、攻击变体以及对已知自适应防御的攻击强度。
AI.result: 在多个目标模型和越狱攻击上，发现表面安全输出之下存在风险分支；不同攻击以定性不同的方式重塑模型的开头分布；防御前最强的攻击，在防御对其做出自适应反应后不一定仍然最强。
AI.conclusion: 越狱可以理解为对周围续写风险图景的形变，为理解越狱行为和开发更安全的语言模型提供了更有信息量的基础。

title: Two-Stage Clipping: Linear-Time Approximate and Exact Mixed-Norm Projections for Transformers
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) based on Transformer architectures have achieved remarkable performance across artificial intelligence tasks, but their computational cost remains a major bottleneck. Structured sparsification provides a promising approach to reducing this cost. In particular, $\ell_{1,\infty}$ projections can induce column-wise sparsity in model matrices, but existing proximal methods (Prox) typically require $\mathcal{O}(nm\log(nm))$ operations for matrices in $\mathbb{R}^{n\times m}$, limiting their computational and energy efficiency. In this paper, we introduce Two-Stage Clipping (TSC), an efficient structured sparsification operator inspired by bilevel optimization. Rather than solving a bilevel optimization problem in the strict sense, TSC decomposes the computation into two successive stages. First, group-level quantities are projected to allocate the global sparsity budget and identify active groups. Second, the resulting values are used as group-wise clipping thresholds for the matrix coefficients. For square attention matrices ($n \times n$), the complexity of our TSC method is $O(n^2)$, which is linear in the number of matrix coefficients. We establish a theoretical bound on the discrepancy between TSC and the exact proximal projection and show on synthetic data that the additional Euclidean approximation cost remains small in practice. Extensive benchmarks demonstrate substantial runtime improvements over proximal baselines and validate the theoretical norm identities underlying the proposed construction.

AI.tldr: 提出 Two-Stage Clipping（TSC），一种受双层优化启发的结构化稀疏化算子，对 n x n 注意力矩阵将 l_{1,∞} 投影的复杂度从现有近端方法的 O(nm log(nm)) 降到线性于矩阵系数个数的 O(n^2)。
AI.motivation: l_{1,∞} 投影可以诱导模型矩阵的列级稀疏，但现有近端方法计算代价高，限制了 Transformer 结构化稀疏化的效率。
AI.method: 将计算分为两个连续阶段：第一阶段对组级量进行投影，分配全局稀疏预算并确定活跃组；第二阶段把得到的值用作组级裁剪阈值作用于矩阵系数。
AI.result: 给出 TSC 与精确近端投影之间差异的理论界；合成数据上附加的欧氏近似代价较小；大量基准显示相对近端基线有显著的运行时改进，并验证了底层范数恒等式。
AI.conclusion: TSC 在接近精确投影的同时大幅降低计算成本，为 Transformer 的结构化稀疏化提供了更高效的途径。

title: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Teacher Evolution
summary: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), which aligns a student model's token-level distribution with that of its self-teacher prompted by privileged context, has emerged as a promising direction to mitigate reward sparsity in sequence-level post-training paradigms. However, OPSD often fails to achieve continuous performance gains during training. In this paper, we find that the model's limited self-teaching capability underlies this phenomenon by generating unreliable guidance on certain samples. To address this problem, we propose Teacher-Evolution Self-Distillation (TESD), which enables the self-teacher to generate rollouts and receive environmental feedback based on task correctness and context independence. First, using these rewards as training objectives, we perform teacher-oriented optimization to continuously enhance the model's self-teaching capability during distillation. Second, by estimating teacher guidance reliability from these rewards, we apply adaptive student-oriented optimization to down-weight samples with unreliable guidance. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets and model scales show that TESD consistently outperforms representative token-level and sequence-level methods, highlighting the necessity of improving supervision quality in OPSD.

AI.tldr: 提出 Teacher-Evolution Self-Distillation（TESD），通过提升自教师的自教能力，并下调指导不可靠样本的权重，改进 OPSD；在多个数据集和模型规模上持续优于代表性的词元级和序列级方法。
AI.motivation: OPSD 在训练中常无法持续获得性能提升，作者认为原因在于模型的自教能力有限，会对部分样本给出不可靠的指导。
AI.method: 让自教师生成 rollout 并依据任务正确性和上下文独立性获得环境反馈；以这些奖励作为训练目标进行教师导向优化，持续增强自教能力；并通过奖励估计教师指导的可靠性，对不可靠样本进行自适应的学生导向优化降权。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和模型规模上，TESD 持续优于代表性的词元级和序列级方法。
AI.conclusion: 提升蒸馏中的监督质量对 OPSD 至关重要。

title: CFKS: Continuum-Feature Kernel PDE Solvers
summary: Neural-network-based PDE solvers require architectural choices, particularly the number of layers and neurons per layer. Fixing a single Gaussian radial basis function (RBF) feature layer and taking the number of features to the continuum limit removes the need to prescribe a finite feature count or select individual feature centers, thereby reducing representation arbitrariness. Motivated by this principle, we introduce Continuum-Feature Kernel Solver (CFKS), a deterministic framework for PDEs obtained by analytically marginalizing a bounded continuum of Gaussian RBF features. CFKS works directly with the resulting continuum-feature mean kernel and its operator-applied counterparts, parameterized by prescribed Gaussian widths and bounded center distributions. For linear PDEs, CFKS leads to symmetric operator-kernel collocation systems with null-space enforcement of physical constraints. Nonlinear PDEs are addressed through linearized initialization and nonlinear least-squares residual minimization using analytical kernel derivatives and Jacobians. Residual-guided collocation enrichment and sequential space--time-slab marching provide additional resolution strategies, while prescribed multiscale kernel refinement helps resolve localized nonlinear structures. Finite-feature experiments confirm convergence of empirical value and operator Gram matrices toward their continuum counterparts. Numerical studies include oscillatory and multiscale ODEs, irregular-domain Poisson and biharmonic problems, singular perturbations, transient transport equations, and viscous Burgers' equation. The results establish CFKS as a direct computational connection between finite Gaussian-RBF representations and continuum-feature kernel PDE solvers. Codes: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出 CFKS（Continuum-Feature Kernel Solver），对有界连续体的高斯 RBF 特征进行解析边缘化，得到确定性的 PDE 求解框架，无需预先指定有限的特征数量和中心。
AI.motivation: 神经网络 PDE 求解器需要人为选择层数和每层神经元数，带来表示上的任意性；作者希望通过单一高斯 RBF 特征层并取连续极限来减少这种任意性。
AI.method: 直接使用连续特征均值核及其算子作用版本，参数为给定的高斯宽度和有界中心分布；线性 PDE 得到对称的算子-核配置系统，并以零空间方式强制物理约束；非线性 PDE 采用线性化初始化，以及基于解析核导数和雅可比的非线性最小二乘残差最小化；另辅以残差引导的配置点加密、时空分片推进和多尺度核细化。
AI.result: 有限特征实验证实经验值和算子 Gram 矩阵收敛到其连续对应物；数值研究涵盖振荡和多尺度 ODE、不规则区域的 Poisson 和双调和问题、奇异摄动、瞬态输运方程以及粘性 Burgers 方程。
AI.conclusion: CFKS 建立了有限高斯 RBF 表示与连续特征核 PDE 求解器之间的直接计算联系。

title: Logical Guidance of Stochastic Interpolants
summary: Guidance and composition of generative models have applications in visual design, chemistry, and biology. Logical guidance composes conditional scores exactly for diffusion models. However, Flow Matching (FM) and Stochastic Interpolants (SI) learn velocity fields. We show that negation and exclusive disjunction admit exact conditional velocity composition on any interpolant, whereas conjunction, and therefore any formula containing one, is exact on Gaussian paths but in general incurs a drift-interaction error, so composed velocities need not sample the logical target. LOGSI solves this by using score-based re-equilibration as our principled mechanism and falling back to the Gaussian-path velocity rule as an approximate transport predictor. In non-Gaussian bridge problems, generation alternates transport steps with score re-equilibration steps.
