On image trans fer (EMNIST to CMNIST, CelebA) and QM9 source-to-target molecular editing with logical attribute constraints, LOGSI improves rule conformity at the same network-evaluation budget over composed-velocity baselines, while also improving fidelity on the image tasks. More broadly, LOGSI applies wherever stochastic interpolants need guidance and logical combinations of constraints are natural.

AI.tldr: 提出 LOGSI，将逻辑组合引导扩展到随机插值（stochastic interpolants）和流匹配模型；否定与异或可在任意插值上精确组合速度场，合取在高斯路径上精确，但一般情形存在漂移交互误差，LOGSI 用基于得分的重平衡加以解决。
AI.motivation: 逻辑引导可以对扩散模型的条件得分精确组合，但流匹配和随机插值学习的是速度场，合取组合在一般情形下不能保证采样到逻辑目标。
AI.method: 证明否定与异或可对任意插值精确组合条件速度，而合取在高斯路径上精确、一般情形有漂移交互误差；LOGSI 以基于得分的重平衡作为原则性机制，并以高斯路径速度规则作为近似输运预测器；在非高斯桥问题中，生成过程交替进行输运步和得分重平衡步。
AI.result: 在 EMNIST 到 CMNIST、CelebA 的图像转换任务以及带逻辑属性约束的 QM9 分子编辑任务上，在相同网络评估预算下，LOGSI 相比组合速度基线提高了规则符合度，并在图像任务上提升了保真度。
AI.conclusion: LOGSI 适用于任何需要对随机插值进行引导、且约束的逻辑组合自然出现的场景。

title: ExplainCC: Explaining Correlated Clusters by Node Labels
summary: An increasingly important requirement for clustering algorithms is that decisions and outcomes need to be clearly understandable for human users. We address this requirement for the Correlation Clustering (CC) problem, in case the objects to be clustered are accompanied by labels. In CC one seeks to partition a set of objects into clusters based on pairwise similarity and dissimilarity information. Our proposed model only considers clusters that can be explained by a label tree, which is essentially a decision tree that partitions the objects according to labels. The goal is to find an explainable partition of the data that minimizes the CC objective function. We formalize this problem from a theoretical viewpoint, and prove several hardness of approximation results, also when constraining the size of the tree. Our proposed greedy method finds locally optimal splits, and works recursively in a top-down approach. To efficiently compute the best split, we carefully maintain certain counters. An experimental evaluation demonstrates its effectiveness. The proposed algorithm processes graphs with over million edges in a few minutes, can find the ground truth in synthetic data, and is able to produce interpretable clusters in real world networks.

AI.tldr: 提出只考虑可由标签树解释的簇的相关聚类（Correlation Clustering）模型，给出贪心的自顶向下算法，能在几分钟内处理超过一百万条边的图并生成可解释的簇。
AI.motivation: 聚类结果需要对人类用户清晰可理解，而现有相关聚类未考虑对象标签所能提供的可解释性约束。
AI.method: 只考虑能由标签树（按标签划分对象的决策树）解释的簇；从理论上形式化该问题，并证明若干近似难度结果（包括限制树大小的情形）；提出贪心方法，递归地自顶向下寻找局部最优划分，并通过维护特定计数器高效计算最佳划分。
AI.result: 实验表明方法有效，能在几分钟内处理超过一百万条边的图，在合成数据上能恢复真实结构，并在真实网络中产生可解释的簇。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在兼顾相关聚类目标的同时，给出可解释的簇划分。

title: On the Generalization Gap of Streaming Federated Learning with Markovian Data
summary: Streaming federated learning (SFL) allows clients to train a shared model from continuously arriving data without retaining large local datasets. Such streams often exhibit temporal dependence, yet its effect on generalization remains poorly understood. In this paper we study the expected generalization gap of the aggregated model when client data follow Markov processes, using information-theoretic and rate-distortion techniques. Our framework accommodates heterogeneous Markovian dynamics across clients and distinguishes temporal dependence from information acquired during local learning. We establish bounds under cross-entropy loss, specializing them to Linear Next-Token Prediction (LNTP) and Self-Attention Next-Token Prediction (SANTP). These results quantify the effects of client count, communication rounds, sample size, data dimension, mixing time, and context length. In particular, they reveal a communication--generalization tradeoff: although frequent aggregation may help optimization, it can weaken generalization guarantees. They also suggest a potential advantage of distributed over centralized streaming learning under a fixed total data budget. Temporal dependence enters through the square root of the mixing time. By analyzing the history-state process, we obtain refined bounds with improved context-length dependence under suitable mixing conditions. Experiments on GPT-style language-model pretraining with TinyStories and real-world time-series forecasting illustrate how collaboration and communication frequency influence generalization under temporal dependence

AI.tldr: 在数据服从马尔可夫过程的流式联邦学习中，利用信息论和率失真技术推导聚合模型的泛化差距界，揭示通信与泛化之间的权衡，并表明时间依赖通过混合时间的平方根影响泛化。
AI.motivation: 流式联邦学习中客户端数据常具有时间依赖，但其对泛化的影响仍知之甚少。
AI.method: 考虑各客户端异构的马尔可夫动态，将时间依赖与本地学习中获得的信息区分开；在交叉熵损失下给出界，并特化到线性下一词元预测（LNTP）和自注意力下一词元预测（SANTP）；通过分析历史-状态过程，在合适的混合条件下得到改进的上下文长度依赖。
AI.result: 界量化了客户端数量、通信轮数、样本量、数据维度、混合时间和上下文长度的影响；揭示通信-泛化权衡；在固定总数据预算下，可能优于集中式流式学习；在 TinyStories 上的 GPT 式语言模型预训练和真实时间序列预测实验说明了协作与通信频率对泛化的影响。
AI.conclusion: 频繁聚合虽可能有助于优化，但会削弱泛化保证；在固定数据预算下，分布式流式学习可能比集中式流式学习更有优势。

title: SatOps-Decision: Low-Latency Discriminative Decisions for Onboard Satellite Communication Operations
summary: We propose SatOps-Decision, a method for low-latency decisions in satellite communication operations. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first application of Jev-style general-purpose discriminative decision models to satellite operations, and the accompanying benchmark is the first dedicated to this approach. The learned scorer, a locally adapted Laya encoder with its native decision head, selects among supplied operational answers in a single forward pass. The benchmark combines authored operational contracts, controlled state changes and independently checked labels in an auditable construction. Evaluation prioritizes complete-request latency and raw decision accuracy; all main accuracy comparisons use the same 1,024 held-out questions, separate from training and development. SatOps-Decision's local scorer has a median latency of 90.3 ms per decision, versus 493.9 ms for Qwen3.5-0.8B generation and 388.4 ms for OneJev1.6-0.8B: $5.47\times$ and $4.30\times$ speedups based on median request times in the measured FP32/MPS implementations. Its mean raw accuracy is 85.3%, versus 42.5% for frozen Laya, 40.7% for Qwen generation and 58.6% for OneJev. As cloud accuracy references, original Jev 1.14/1.13 reach 87.4/81.9%.

AI.tldr: 提出 SatOps-Decision，将 Jev 式通用判别式决策模型用于星载卫星通信运维的低延迟决策；在单次前向传播中从给定答案中选择，中位延迟 90.3 ms，平均原始准确率 85.3%。
AI.motivation: 卫星通信运维需要低延迟决策，此前尚无将 Jev 式判别式决策模型应用于该领域的工作，也缺少专门的基准。
AI.method: 使用本地适配的 Laya 编码器及其原生决策头，在单次前向传播中从给定的运维答案中选择；基准由人工编写的运维契约、受控状态变化和独立核验的标签构成；在 1,024 个保留问题上评估完整请求延迟和原始准确率。
AI.result: 本地评分器中位延迟 90.3 ms，相比 Qwen3.5-0.8B 生成的 493.9 ms 和 OneJev1.6-0.8B 的 388.4 ms，分别加速 5.47 倍和 4.30 倍（FP32/MPS 实现）；平均原始准确率 85.3%，而冻结 Laya 为 42.5%，Qwen 生成为 40.7%，OneJev 为 58.6%；云端参考版 Jev 1.14 和 1.13 分别达到 87.4% 和 81.9%。
AI.conclusion: 判别式决策模型可以在显著降低延迟的同时达到与云端参考模型相近的准确率，适用于星载低延迟决策。

title: Latent Decision Flow Rewards for Clinical Guideline Reasoning
summary: Clinical practice guidelines encode evidence-based recommendations as conditional decision flows, which makes them a natural source of process supervision for training reasoning models. Two properties of clinical reasoning make this supervision difficult to use. A decision flow consistent with a guideline does not by itself determine the correct answer for a given patient, which we call the path--answer gap, and several valid decision flows can support the same clinical decision, which we call path multiplicity. Current training approaches address parts of this problem. Answer rewards supervise the final decision, and process rewards computed against a reference flow supervise one valid decision flow per case. Supervised fine-tuning on annotated flows teaches guideline-consistent reasoning but constrains the model to one trajectory per case and can reduce answer accuracy. We introduce GUIDER, a method that jointly optimizes a decision flow controller and a reasoning policy. The controller learns to generate plausible decision flows from guideline-derived supervision, and the policy learns to generate a decision flow and a final answer for each patient case. GUIDER computes the process reward for the policy over several controller-generated flows, which accounts for path multiplicity, and gates this reward on answer correctness, which addresses the path--answer gap. Joint training allows the process supervision to evolve with the policy. On MedGUIDE, GUIDER with Qwen3-14B achieves 82.5 weighted accuracy and 73.5 guideline adherence, 3.3 and 3.1 points above the strongest clinical reinforcement learning baseline. With Qwen3-14B and Gemma4-12B backbones, GUIDER also improves over CRPO, MRPO, and FaithMed on the out-of-domain benchmarks AMEGA-LLM, RealMedQA, and CancerGUIDE.

AI.tldr: 提出 GUIDER，联合优化决策流控制器与推理策略；在 MedGUIDE 上，以 Qwen3-14B 达到 82.5 的加权准确率和 73.5 的指南依从度，分别比最强的临床强化学习基线高出 3.3 和 3.1 个点。
AI.motivation: 临床指南可作为推理模型的过程监督，但路径-答案鸿沟（与指南一致的决策流不能决定某位患者的正确答案）和路径多重性（多条有效决策流可支持同一临床决策）使现有方法难以有效利用：答案奖励只监督最终决策，参考流过程奖励只监督一条有效流，而在标注流上的监督微调会限制每个病例只有一条轨迹且可能降低答案准确率。
AI.method: 控制器从指南导出的监督中学习生成合理的决策流，策略为每个病例生成决策流和最终答案；过程奖励基于控制器生成的多条决策流计算以应对路径多重性，并以答案正确性为门控以应对路径-答案鸿沟；联合训练使过程监督随策略一同演化。
AI.result: 在 MedGUIDE 上，Qwen3-14B 骨干的 GUIDER 达到 82.5 加权准确率和 73.5 指南依从度，分别比最强的临床强化学习基线高 3.3 和 3.1 个点；在 Qwen3-14B 和 Gemma4-12B 骨干上，GUIDER 在域外基准 AMEGA-LLM、RealMedQA 和 CancerGUIDE 上也优于 CRPO、MRPO 和 FaithMed。
AI.conclusion: 联合训练以及对路径多重性和路径-答案鸿沟的显式处理，使临床指南的过程监督既能保持指南一致性，又不损害答案准确率。

title: Adversarial Self-Distillation
summary: Even though current safety-aligned language models are able to refuse harmful requests, their guard can still be bypassed by adversarial perturbations. As in other domains, adversarial training is considered a standard defense. However, due to the autoregressive nature of language generation, supervised finetuning on template refusals does not necessarily teach the model to refuse. Evidence of this is that the adversarially trained model still complies when the attacker injects a compliant prefill. We propose Adversarial Self-Distillation (ASD), which extends a model's own safe behavior to the space of adversarial perturbations. The teacher (the model itself given the clean prompt) can refuse the harmful request by default, or with the help of an additional instruction in its context. ASD distills this knowledge to the student (which is the same model under attack) at the prefixes that the student visits (due to on-policy sampling). These potentially include compliant openings. ASD achieves lower attack success than state-of-the-art defenses with little loss in multiple-choice accuracy, and it becomes able to recover a refusal even after a compliant opening.

AI.tldr: 提出对抗自蒸馏（ASD），让模型以自身在干净提示下的安全行为为教师，把拒绝能力蒸馏给受对抗扰动攻击的同一模型，攻击成功率低于现有防御，并能在合规开头之后恢复拒绝。
AI.motivation: 对抗训练是常用的防御手段，但在自回归生成下，对模板化拒绝的监督微调未必教会模型真正拒绝；被对抗训练的模型在攻击者注入合规前缀时仍会继续服从。
AI.method: 教师是同一模型在干净提示下的行为（可附加额外指令），默认或借助指令即可拒绝有害请求；学生是受攻击的同一模型，知识在学生访问的前缀（由同策略采样产生，可能包含合规开头）上进行蒸馏。
AI.result: 与最先进的防御相比，ASD 的攻击成功率更低，多项选择准确率仅有少量损失，并且在合规开头之后仍能恢复拒绝。
AI.conclusion: ASD 将模型自身的安全行为扩展到对抗扰动空间，为语言模型的对抗防御提供了新途径。

title: Alpha-TCM: A Nine-Layer Framework for TCM-Guided Multimodal Inference and Structured-Prior Auditing
summary: Alpha-TCM makes two contributions under a central thesis: auditable systems should separate domain knowledge, case evidence, probabilistic inference, and downstream authority. First, it proposes a nine-layer TCM-oriented architecture covering semantic definitions, multimodal acquisition, quality control, provenance-bearing knowledge, probabilistic inference, longitudinal updating, constrained decisions, language interaction, and human governance. Each layer specifies its information contract, failure boundary, dependencies, and validation status. This is a system-design proposal, not a claim of complete clinical implementation. Second, a controlled synthetic prototype instantiates Layers 1-5 to audit the knowledge-evidence interface. Four conditional-Gaussian encoders process synthetic tongue images, pulse waveforms, inquiry fields, and text, while a frozen bridge predicts a five-dimensional synthetic outcome. A versioned contextual prior is compiled independently of the renderer. Fusion removes duplicated reference-prior information before adding context. Equal-information controls, prior regularization, graded contamination, and structural corruption test contextual benefits, Bayesian specificity, and conflict detection. Across ten paired seeds and four training sizes, contextual knowledge improved mean absolute error over marginal committee fusion at 600 and 1,200 cases, but not over equal-information neural controls. Fully incorrect context harmed performance at every size, while prior effects were inconsistent and conflict scores did not track case-level damage. The results support contextual structure in low-data synthetic settings, not a specifically Bayesian advantage. The prototype establishes no claims about TCM theory or clinical, diagnostic, therapeutic, causal, longitudinal, or transfer validity.

AI.tldr: 提出面向中医的九层多模态推理架构 Alpha-TCM，并用受控合成原型检验其知识与证据接口的可审计性。在合成低数据设定下，上下文知识优于边际委员会融合，但未超过等信息神经对照，结果不构成临床或理论有效性的证据。
AI.motivation: 作者认为可审计系统应将领域知识、病例证据、概率推理与下游决策权限分开，并以中医为背景给出这一设计原则；此前的系统缺少这种结构化的信息契约与验证机制。
AI.method: 设计九层架构，涵盖语义定义、多模态采集、质量控制、带溯源的知识、概率推理、纵向更新、约束决策、语言交互与人工治理，并为各层规定信息契约、失效边界、依赖关系与验证状态。原型实例化第1至5层：四个条件高斯编码器分别处理合成舌像、脉搏波形、问诊字段和文本，冻结的桥接模块预测五维合成结局；上下文先验独立于渲染器编译，融合前去除与参考先验重复的信息。
AI.result: 在十个配对随机种子和四种训练规模下，上下文知识在600和1200例时相对边际委员会融合降低了平均绝对误差，但未优于等信息神经对照。完全错误的上下文在各规模下都使性能变差；先验效应不稳定；冲突分数与病例级损害不一致。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持低数据合成环境中上下文结构的作用，但不能证明贝叶斯方法具有特定优势。该原型对中医理论以及临床、诊断、治疗、因果、纵向和迁移有效性不作任何论断。

title: Rennala NSGD: Asynchronous Stochastic Optimization Beyond Euclidean Geometry
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 111 pages, 2 algorithms, 3 tables
summary: The empirical success of matrix-aware optimizers, such as Muon (Jordan et al., 2024) and Shampoo (arXiv:1802.09568), highlights the potential of non-Euclidean geometry for deep learning, including large language model (LLM) training. Despite this progress, the theoretical understanding of stochastic optimization in general normed spaces remains limited, particularly in distributed settings. We analyze minibatch stochastic gradient descent (SGD) for smooth nonconvex optimization with respect to an arbitrary norm on a finite-dimensional space. Using the framework of $\kappa$-regular normed spaces (arXiv:0809.0813), we derive high-probability oracle complexity bounds under a light-tail condition stated directly in the dual norm induced by the update norm. The bounds make the dependence on geometry explicit through the regularity constant $\kappa$ of the dual space. In the Euclidean case, our bound recovers the standard minibatch SGD rate up to logarithmic factors. For some non-Euclidean geometries and noise models, it is sharper than bounds obtained by converting a Euclidean noise assumption, reducing a linear dimension dependence to a logarithmic one. Building on this framework, we introduce Rennala NSGD, a semi-asynchronous distributed algorithm, and establish wall-clock time complexity guarantees under fixed, heterogeneous worker computation times. In the Euclidean case ($\kappa=1$), our bound matches the parameter dependence of classical Rennala SGD up to logarithmic factors.

AI.tldr: 分析任意范数下光滑非凸随机优化的小批量 SGD，给出由对偶空间正则常数 kappa 刻画几何依赖的高概率复杂度界，并提出半异步分布式算法 Rennala NSGD 及其挂钟时间复杂度保证。
AI.motivation: Muon、Shampoo 等矩阵感知优化器在深度学习中取得经验成功，但一般赋范空间中随机优化的理论理解有限，分布式场景下尤其如此。
AI.method: 基于 kappa-正则赋范空间框架，在更新范数诱导的对偶范数上给出轻尾条件，推导高概率 oracle 复杂度界，使几何依赖通过对偶空间的正则常数显式呈现。在此基础上提出半异步分布式算法 Rennala NSGD，并在固定且异构的工作节点计算时间下分析其挂钟时间复杂度。
AI.result: 欧氏情形下的界与标准小批量 SGD 速率相差仅一个对数因子。对某些非欧几何与噪声模型，该界比由欧氏噪声假设转换得到的界更紧，可将线性维度依赖降为对数依赖。在 kappa=1 时，Rennala NSGD 的参数依赖与经典 Rennala SGD 一致，相差对数因子。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为非欧几何下的随机优化与分布式异步算法提供了统一的理论框架，表明几何选择会实质性地影响复杂度界。

title: Auditable Hierarchical Inference with Multimodal Evidence and Bayesian Active Inquiry
summary: Most multimodal classifiers assume that all useful evidence is available upfront, whereas clinical inquiry is sequential. We present a synthetic evaluation framework separating objective multimodal inference from active inquiry. An objective model maps synthetic tongue, bilateral multipressure pulse, and acoustic observations to eight syndrome families. A provenance-bearing Knowledge Core and training-only answer model support Bayesian narrowing over 33 fine terms using 25 typed questions, while seven safety questions remain outside the diagnostic posterior. Weak shared symptom factors limit fine-term influence on objective phenotypes, and an objective-only probe tests leakage. In a preregistered 600-case synthetic evaluation, objective family accuracy was 87.0%. Cost-sensitive expected information gain (cost-EIG) raised family accuracy to 95.5% and exact fine-term accuracy to 42.5%, versus 92.7% and 33.0% for an unoptimized fixed-order baseline. Selective family accuracy reached 96.9% at 95.3% coverage. However, cost-EIG asked more questions on average than fixed order (9.795 versus 9.352). Missing-audio routing retained 94.0% family accuracy, and a workflow invariant enforced abstention when all objective modalities were absent. Permuting fine-term answer likelihoods reduced family accuracy to 78.7%. Five of six frozen checks passed, but the question-efficiency hypothesis failed. Comparisons are descriptive because only aggregate, not paired case-level, outputs were retained. These results establish a reproducible synthetic workflow, not clinical diagnostic or treatment validity.

AI.tldr: 提出一个合成评估框架，将客观多模态推理与主动问诊分离。在600例合成评估中，代价敏感的期望信息增益（cost-EIG）选题提高了证候族准确率和精确细分证型准确率，但平均提问数多于固定顺序基线。
AI.motivation: 多数多模态分类器假设所有有用证据事先可得，而临床问诊是序贯进行的；此前工作没有将客观多模态推理与主动问诊分开评估。
AI.method: 客观模型将合成舌像、双侧多压力脉搏和声学观测映射到八个证候族。带溯源的知识核心与仅用于训练的答案模型支持对33个细分术语进行贝叶斯收窄，使用25个带类型的问题；7个安全性问题不纳入诊断后验。以cost-EIG选题，并与固定顺序的未优化基线比较；另设仅含客观模态的探针以检验泄漏。
AI.result: 客观证候族准确率为87.0%。cost-EIG将证候族准确率提升至95.5%，精确细分证型准确率为42.5%；固定顺序基线分别为92.7%和33.0%。在95.3%覆盖率下，选择性证候族准确率达96.9%。cost-EIG平均提问9.795个，固定顺序为9.352个。缺失音频时的路由保持94.0%的证候族准确率；置换细分术语的似然后，证候族准确率降至78.7%。冻结检验的六项中通过五项，问题效率假设未通过。由于只保留了汇总输出而非配对的病例级输出，比较仅具描述性。
AI.conclusion: 结果建立了一个可复现的合成工作流，但不能证明其具备临床诊断或治疗的有效性。

title: Skillful and realistic precipitation forecasting with reinforced diffusion
summary: Accurate precipitation forecasting remains elusive as physics-based models struggle to resolve mesoscale convection and machine learning often yields physically inconsistent, blurred results that consistently underestimate extreme events. We present FitzRoy, the first system that simultaneously achieves state-of-the-art predictive skill and physical realism over the continental United States. Through a reinforced diffusion framework, where a conditional discrete diffusion model is refined via reinforcement learning, FitzRoy effectively resolves the long-standing trade-off between pointwise accuracy and structural fidelity. Across lead times up to 24 hours, FitzRoy consistently matches or exceeds state-of-the-art models while preserving structural realism and capturing extreme events. Its low-latency inference further enables deployment in real-time operational settings. In case studies such as the 2025 Texas Hill Country floods and the 2026 Missouri floods, FitzRoy signals record-breaking accumulations that existing models largely missed. By bridging the gap between realism and skill, FitzRoy establishes a new frontier for high-fidelity precipitation forecasting.

AI.tldr: 提出 FitzRoy，一个基于强化扩散的降水预报系统，在美国大陆上同时达到接近最先进的预报技能与物理真实性，预报时效可达24小时，并能捕捉极端降水事件。
AI.motivation: 物理模型难以刻画中尺度对流；机器学习预报常产生物理不一致、模糊的结果，并系统性地低估极端事件。逐点精度与结构真实性之间的长期权衡尚未解决。
AI.method: 采用强化扩散框架：先训练条件离散扩散模型，再用强化学习对其进行优化，以同时兼顾逐点精度与结构保真度。系统具备低延迟推理能力，便于实时业务部署。
AI.result: 在直至24小时的预报时效内，FitzRoy 持续达到或超过最先进模型的水平，同时保持结构真实性并捕捉极端事件。在2025年得克萨斯州山区洪水和2026年密苏里洪水的案例中，它预示了多数现有模型基本漏报的创纪录累积降水。
AI.conclusion: 该工作弥合了真实性与预报技能之间的差距，为高保真降水预报确立了新的前沿。

title: Loss is Not Behavior: A Unified Output-Space Analysis of Gradient-Based Machine Unlearning
summary: Gradient-based machine unlearning methods typically ``unlearn'' by optimizing forget and retain losses, but similar losses do not necessarily imply similar output-space behavior. Prior work has shown that high forget loss alone does not certify that unlearning has produced retraining-like output behavior. We therefore ask: when a gradient-based unlearner differs from the model that would have been learned on only the retain data, what structure does the resulting output-space gap have? We derive closed-form expressions for this gap in linear regression, with an extension to nonlinear models via a generalized Gauss-Newton and local linearity approximations. Our analysis puts various gradient-based methods under a unified framework parametrized by geometry, reweighting, and projection. Two leverage matrices emerge that capture the forget-retain entanglement under the retrained model geometry: forget self-leverage and retain cross-leverage. We show both theoretically and empirically that these two leverage matrices drive the impact of the forget residual on the forget and retain outputs, and existing methods account for this geometry only partially. Our framework yields precomputable leverage diagnostics for auditing forget sets to identify what type of gradient-based unlearning is likely to be successful.

AI.tldr: 给出线性回归中基于梯度的机器遗忘方法与仅用保留数据重训练模型之间输出空间差距的闭式表达，并用两个杠杆矩阵统一解释各类方法。非线性情形通过广义 Gauss-Newton 与局部线性近似推广。
AI.motivation: 基于梯度的遗忘方法通过优化遗忘损失与保留损失实现“遗忘”，但相似的损失并不意味着相似的输出行为；已有工作表明，遗忘集上的高损失不能保证输出接近重训练模型。
AI.method: 推导线性回归中输出差距的闭式表达，并借助广义 Gauss-Newton 与局部线性近似推广至非线性模型。将各种梯度遗忘方法纳入一个由几何、重加权和投影三个参数刻画的统一框架。在重训练模型的几何下，定义两个杠杆矩阵：遗忘自杠杆与保留交叉杠杆，用以刻画遗忘数据与保留数据的纠缠。
AI.result: 理论与实验均表明，这两个杠杆矩阵决定了遗忘残差对遗忘集输出与保留集输出的影响；现有方法只部分地考虑了这一几何结构。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可给出可预先计算的杠杆诊断量，用于审计遗忘集，判断哪类基于梯度的遗忘方法可能成功。

title: Routed Continual Learning
summary: Agents deployed at scale repeatedly encounter related problems, and it is natural to let them learn from each other's experience rather than starting over each time. Unfortunately, there is no single way to retain that experience that works well across settings, and no way to know in advance which future problems a given experience will help with. A global history preserves every detail but becomes expensive and mixes together experience that may not belong together; compressing that history into one fixed representation limits the cost but can throw away valuable details. We introduce Routed Continual Learning (Routed CL), an architecture that decides how to partition and retain experience. Past trajectories are grouped into clusters, each of which maintains state using one memory system from a fixed library. Before each run, an LLM-based router either reuses an existing cluster or creates a new one, basing its decision on the problem statement, memory system descriptions, and cluster summaries. We also introduce Context Memory Adapter, which mediates between the memory system and the agentic loop. We evaluate the architecture on a heterogeneous stream that interleaves 301 instances from the six CL-Bench tasks with 97 banking instances from $\tau^3$-Bench. Across four language models and five matched rollouts, Routed Continual Learning raises normalized reward over a single global in-context learning (ICL) history by 15-30% of the maximum attainable normalized reward, achieves higher mean normalized reward than ICL-only clustering, and reduces estimated API cost by 65-72% relative to Global ICL. These results support approaching continual learning as a routing problem that chooses both a learning mechanism and a state cluster rather than committing to one representation globally.

AI.tldr: 提出 Routed Continual Learning，将智能体的经验划分为簇，并由 LLM 路由器为每次运行选择记忆系统与簇。在 CL-Bench 与 τ3-Bench 的混合任务流上，相较单一全局 ICL 历史，它提高了归一化奖励，并将估计 API 成本降低65%至72%。
AI.motivation: 大规模部署的智能体需要复用彼此的经验，但单一全局历史成本高昂且混杂不相关的经验；把历史压缩为单一固定表示又会丢失有价值的细节。此外，事先无法知道某段经验会对哪些未来问题有帮助。
AI.method: 将过往轨迹聚类，每个簇使用固定记忆系统库中的一种系统维护状态。每次运行前，基于 LLM 的路由器依据问题描述、记忆系统说明与簇摘要，决定复用已有簇还是新建簇。另提出 Context Memory Adapter，作为记忆系统与智能体循环之间的中介。
AI.result: 在交错301个 CL-Bench 实例（六个任务）与97个 τ3-Bench 银行业务实例的异构任务流上评估，使用四种语言模型和五组匹配的 rollout。相较单一全局 ICL 历史，归一化奖励提高了可达最大归一化奖励的15%至30%；优于仅用 ICL 的聚类方法；相对全局 ICL 估计 API 成本降低65%至72%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将持续学习视为一个路由问题：同时选择学习机制与状态簇，而不是在全局范围内固定采用某一种表示。

title: Causal Attention on CPU: A Cache-Aware and Load-Balanced Scheduling Kernel for Prefill
summary: Agentic AI drives significant productivity gains across diverse domains, but concurrent long-context prefills from multiple agents can saturate GPU compute resources. Although CPUs offer a viable alternative, existing CPU attention kernels fall short in adapting to multi-tier cache hierarchies and lack effective thread scheduling. To address this, we introduce CACPU, a high-performance attention kernel featuring tiered cache blocking and an in-kernel task dispatching mechanism designed for causal full-sequence prefilling. CACPU achieves up to a 2.01x speedup over PyTorch SDPA, FlexAttention, and SGLang attention kernels. Integrated into SGLang, it reduces Time to First Token (TTFT) of Llama-3.1-8B by up to 1.74x while preserving model accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出 CACPU，一种面向因果全序列预填充的 CPU 注意力内核，采用分层缓存分块与内核内任务调度。相较 PyTorch SDPA、FlexAttention 和 SGLang 注意力内核最高加速2.01倍；集成进 SGLang 后，Llama-3.1-8B 的首 token 时间最多降低1.74倍，且保持模型精度。
AI.motivation: 多个智能体并发的长上下文预填充会耗尽 GPU 计算资源，CPU 是一种可行的替代方案；但现有 CPU 注意力内核无法适应多级缓存层次，也缺乏有效的线程调度。
AI.method: 设计分层缓存分块（tiered cache blocking）以适配多级缓存，并引入内核内任务分发机制，专为因果全序列预填充设计。
AI.result: 相较 PyTorch SDPA、FlexAttention 与 SGLang 注意力内核，最高加速2.01倍；集成进 SGLang 后，Llama-3.1-8B 的首 token 时间（TTFT）最多降低1.74倍，模型精度保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 经过缓存与调度优化的 CPU 注意力内核可用于长上下文预填充，并显著降低首 token 时间，CPU 因而可作为智能体工作负载的一种可行计算后端。

title: Discovering Jailbreaks via Curriculum of Models
summary: Automated jailbreak discovery aims to find prompts that elicit prohibited behaviors from safety-trained language models, helping developers identify vulnerabilities before deployment. One class of approaches uses reinforcement learning to train an investigator model to generate prompts that elicit a specified behavior from a target model. However, training directly against a safety-trained target is difficult because nearly all prompts are refused, leaving the investigator with a sparse reward signal. Prior work addresses this with the propensity bound (PRBO), a proxy reward estimated by sampling responses from a more compliant target, and then adjusting for how likely those responses would have been under the original target. We introduce Curriculum of Models (CoM), an alternative method that trains the investigator against a sequence of modified versions of the target, progressing gradually from a version that readily exhibits the specified behavior to the original target. For jailbreak discovery, training begins against a target version that rarely refuses harmful requests, and advances to the next, harder version once the investigator reliably elicits the behavior from the current one. We evaluate CoM on elicitation tasks involving CBRN materials, explosives, and illicit drugs, using two open-weight targets, gemma-4-31b-it and gpt-oss-120b. We compare against PRBO and direct training on the original target without a curriculum. When the investigator is trained to elicit a single behavior, CoM finds successful jailbreaks more reliably than either baseline. When trained on multiple behaviors simultaneously, the CoM-trained investigator can elicit held-out behaviors, though PRBO-trained investigators achieve higher success rates. Our results suggest that a simple curriculum over target models offers a promising approach for addressing sparse rewards in rare-behavior elicitation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Curriculum of Models（CoM），让调查模型先面对一个容易表现目标行为的目标模型版本，再逐步过渡到原始目标。在 CBRN、爆炸物与毒品诱导任务中，单一行为训练时 CoM 比 PRBO 与直接训练更可靠地找到越狱提示；多行为训练时 PRBO 的成功率更高。
AI.motivation: 直接对安全训练过的目标模型训练时，几乎所有提示都会被拒绝，调查模型只能获得稀疏奖励。已有方法 PRBO 从更顺从的目标采样响应，并按原始目标下的可能性进行校正，以此近似奖励。
AI.method: 训练调查模型面对一系列逐步变化的目标模型版本：从很少拒绝有害请求的版本开始，当调查模型能可靠地从当前版本诱导目标行为后，进入下一个更难的版本，直至原始目标。在 gemma-4-31b-it 与 gpt-oss-120b 两个开源目标上评估，并与 PRBO 以及不使用课程的直接训练对比。
AI.result: 训练调查模型诱导单一行为时，CoM 比两个基线更可靠地找到成功的越狱提示。同时训练多个行为时，CoM 训练的调查模型能够诱导留出的行为，但 PRBO 训练的调查模型成功率更高。
AI.conclusion: 对目标模型使用简单课程，为稀疏奖励下的稀有行为诱导提供了一种有前景的思路。

title: What to randomize matters: a controlled study of volume, axis and representation in low-data molecular generation
summary: Chemical language models can struggle to generate new molecules when trained on small datasets, where a model may reproduce training examples rather than learn a useful generative distribution. Randomized SMILES augmentation varies atom traversal, whereas Sequential Attachment-based Fragment Embedding (SAFE) also allows the order of fragment blocks to vary. How these distinct sources of representational variation affect low-data molecular generation has not been clearly studied. Here, using 1,000 seed molecules to train an autoregressive sequence model, we compare canonical SAFE with randomized SAFE at increasing corpus sizes, isolate atom-order and fragment-order axes of SAFE randomization, and compare fully randomized SAFE with randomized SMILES at molecule-by-molecule matched training corpora. Three findings emerge. First, randomization of SAFE alone raises the genuine yield of novel molecules more than 450-fold, turning a model that merely reproduces its training set into a practical molecular generator. Second, the two axes of randomization act jointly rather than additively: atom order alone reaches a tenth, and fragment order alone a seventh, of the genuine yield obtained when both vary, which is four times their combined contribution. Third, at matched corpus size and compute, randomized SAFE delivers 2.8 times the genuine yield of randomized SMILES. Welch tests with Games-Howell post-hoc comparisons resolve every difference on the primary outcomes. In the low-data regime, thus, what one randomizes rather than only how much determines whether augmentation produces new molecules or merely new spellings of the training set.

AI.tldr: 在仅1000个种子分子的低数据条件下，随机 SAFE 使真实新分子的产出提高450倍以上；SAFE 的原子顺序与片段顺序两个轴联合作用而非简单相加。在分子级匹配的训练语料下，随机 SAFE 的真实产出是随机 SMILES 的2.8倍。
AI.motivation: 化学语言模型在小数据集上训练时，容易复现训练样本而非学到有用的生成分布。随机 SMILES 与 SAFE 随机化引入的表示变化来源不同，但二者如何影响低数据分子生成尚不清楚。
AI.method: 以1000个种子分子训练自回归序列模型，在不同语料规模下比较规范 SAFE 与随机 SAFE；将 SAFE 随机化拆分为原子顺序与片段块顺序两个轴分别考察；在按分子匹配的训练语料与计算量下，比较完全随机化的 SAFE 与随机 SMILES；主要结果的差异以 Welch 检验及 Games-Howell 事后比较确认。
AI.result: 仅随机化 SAFE 就使真实新分子产出提高450倍以上。单独改变原子顺序，仅达到两轴同时变化时真实产出的十分之一；单独改变片段顺序，仅达到七分之一；而两轴联合作用的效果是二者单独贡献之和的四倍。在语料规模与计算量匹配时，随机 SAFE 的真实产出为随机 SMILES 的2.8倍。
AI.conclusion: 在低数据情形下，决定随机化的是什么被随机化，而不只是随机化多少，它决定了数据增强能否产生新分子，还是只产生训练集的新写法。

title: Discovery of Diverse and Realistic Financial Tail-Risk Using Generative Flow Networks
summary: Accurate modeling of rare, high-impact financial events is essential for robust risk management. Sampling-based techniques such as Sequential Markov Chain Monte Carlo (SMCMC) generate diverse scenarios but inefficiently explore high-risk regions, while Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) converges on narrow sets of scenarios, limiting diversity. We present GRID, which uses Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) -- samplers that draw objects in proportion to a reward -- to systematically generate diverse and realistic financial tail-risk scenarios. Building on continuous GFlowNets, GRID introduces a flexible mixture-policy architecture with variable-specific distribution families for high-dimensional, sequential macro-financial data, together with plausibility constraints that keep generated trajectories realistic. A central practical advantage is robustness to reward-proxy imperfection: because GFlowNets sample proportionally rather than maximize, they remain broadly exploratory even when the oracle's out-of-sample accuracy is low -- an unavoidable reality in financial forecasting. On three real-world crises, GRID improves scenario diversity, realism, and tail-risk coverage over RL and MCMC baselines, and ablations over oracle architectures and distribution families yield practical insights into continuous GFlowNet behavior under noisy rewards.

AI.tldr: 提出 GRID，利用生成流网络（GFlowNets）生成多样且真实的金融尾部风险情景。在三次真实危机上，相较强化学习与 MCMC 基线，GRID 提高了情景多样性、真实性与尾部风险覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 稀有且影响重大的金融事件建模对风险管理至关重要。序贯 MCMC 能生成多样情景，但对高风险区域的探索效率低；深度强化学习会收敛到狭窄的情景集合，多样性受限。
AI.method: 基于连续 GFlowNets，引入灵活的混合策略架构，为高维序贯宏观金融数据的各变量采用不同的分布族，并加入合理性约束，使生成的轨迹保持真实。GFlowNets 按奖励比例采样而非最大化奖励，因此在奖励代理不完美时仍保持探索性。
AI.result: 在三次真实危机上，GRID 相较强化学习与 MCMC 基线提高了情景多样性、真实性和尾部风险覆盖率。对预言机架构与分布族的消融研究，揭示了连续 GFlowNets 在噪声奖励下的行为。
AI.conclusion: 当金融预测中预言机的样本外精度较低时，GFlowNets 仍能保持广泛探索，这对金融尾部风险建模具有实际意义。

title: Contextual Embeddings Beyond the Gold Chunk
summary: Contextual embeddings represent chunks of a document with respect to the document's global context. These models are typically trained and evaluated under the assumption that a relevant document contains only a single relevant chunk. In this work, we argue that in real-world use cases a retriever should not only find answers spread over several chunks but also surface the evidence needed to verify them. To address this, we introduce pplx-embed-v2-context, a family of contextual embedding models trained by distilling graded chunk-level relevance from a query-aware context compression model. This removes the need for gold-chunk labels and makes the training targets independent of the chunking. We utilize a vision-language backbone for training and release pplx-embed-v2-context in 9B and 0.6B sizes with compatible embedding spaces. On the evaluation side, we introduce two benchmarks that label both the chunks that answer a query and the evidence needed to verify the answer. Context-bench is a controlled diagnostic, and Q2D-Chunk is built from real-world search queries. To encourage further research, we also publish Q2D-Chunk as a public leaderboard. Our 9B model sets a new state of the art on both benchmarks and ConTEB. We find that the visual retrieval capabilities of our 9B model transfer from its vision-language base model and propose to extend chunking to image inputs. We demonstrate that our models achieve state-of-the-art performance among dense retrievers on visual ViDoRe-V3 and that performance improves with granular image chunking.

AI.tldr: 提出上下文嵌入模型 pplx-embed-v2-context（9B 与 0.6B 两种规格），通过从查询感知的上下文压缩模型蒸馏分级块级相关性进行训练。9B 模型在两个新基准与 ConTEB 上达到最优水平，并可将分块扩展到图像输入。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文嵌入模型通常假设相关文档中只包含一个相关块，但真实检索中，答案可能分散在多个块中，且还需要找到用于验证答案的证据；此外，训练依赖金标块标签。
AI.method: 以视觉-语言模型作为训练骨干，通过蒸馏查询感知上下文压缩模型给出的分级块级相关性进行训练，无需金标块标签，且训练目标与分块方式无关。发布9B与0.6B两种兼容嵌入空间的模型。构建两个基准，同时标注回答查询的块与验证答案所需的证据：Context-bench 为受控诊断基准，Q2D-Chunk 基于真实搜索查询构建，并公开为排行榜。
AI.result: 9B 模型在两个基准和 ConTEB 上均达到新的最优水平。其视觉检索能力源自视觉-语言基座模型。在视觉基准 ViDoRe-V3 上，该模型在稠密检索器中达到最优，且图像的细粒度分块可进一步提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 上下文嵌入的训练与评估应同时考虑回答块与验证证据，并可自然扩展到图像分块。

title: Geometric Time Score Estimators: Bridging Self-Predictive Representations and Generative Occupancy Models For Reinforcement Learning
summary: In reinforcement learning (RL), temporal reasoning is essential for estimating the density of future outcomes under a policy's occupancy measure. While self-predictive representations have been a dominant paradigm for occupancy density estimation, we find that they yield surprisingly poor estimates. On the other hand, generative occupancy models can produce remarkably accurate samples from the occupancy measure. Yet, they cannot easily recover occupancy densities, limiting their use for control despite their expressivity. In this paper, we propose Geometric Time Score Estimators (GTSE), a framework that bridges the two paradigms by learning occupancy density estimators along probability paths. We analyze how GTSE implicitly induces better occupancy estimators through improved representation learning and show how to directly extract self-predictive representations from this framework. Through experiments across several locomotion and manipulation tasks, we show that GTSE improves performance over state-of-the-art methods by $2\times$ to $6\times$ in goal-conditioned RL settings, and that the representations learned using our framework transfer effectively to downstream RL tasks. Website: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出几何时间得分估计器（GTSE），沿概率路径学习占用密度估计器，在目标条件强化学习中相较现有最优方法性能提升2至6倍，且其学到的表示可有效迁移到下游强化学习任务。
AI.motivation: 自预测表示是占用密度估计的主流范式，但作者发现它给出的估计结果很差；生成式占用模型能够生成非常准确的占用测度样本，却难以恢复占用密度，限制了其在控制中的应用。
AI.method: 提出 GTSE 框架，沿概率路径学习占用密度估计器，以连接自预测表示与生成式占用模型两种范式。分析 GTSE 如何通过改进的表示学习隐式地得到更好的占用估计器，并展示如何直接从该框架中提取自预测表示。
AI.result: 在多个运动与操作任务上的实验表明，在目标条件强化学习中，GTSE 相较最优方法性能提升2至6倍；由该框架学到的表示能有效迁移到下游强化学习任务。
AI.conclusion: GTSE 将两种范式连接起来，在保留生成式模型表达力的同时，获得可用于控制的占用密度估计。

title: Structural-Test Geometry as an Inductive Bias for Partially Observable World Models
summary: Predictive world-model objectives need not organize latent histories according to distinctions required for later control. With privileged simulator access during training, should response-derived structural information be predicted, decoded, or imposed directly on latent geometry--and how do these choices compare with structured belief distillation? We define posterior-marginalized structural tests whose response distributions induce a pseudometric over histories, then train quotient-preserving (QP) world models by aligning shared latent Euclidean distances to that metric. Across a fixed six-task diagnostic suite, the largest differences appear under held-out structural variation: QP improves planning success by 26.1 points $[21.5,30.7]$ over metric decoding and 6.4 points $[3.8,9.0]$ over structured belief distillation. On GridWorld, metric decoding accurately recovers held-out structural distances ($\rho=.91$) while its native latent geometry remains more distorted than QP's (paired IQD difference $.22$ $[.20,.24]$), showing that relational recoverability and direct geometric alignment can diverge.

AI.tldr: 提出商保持（quotient-preserving, QP）世界模型，通过将潜在欧氏距离与后验边缘化结构测试诱导的伪度量对齐来训练。在六任务诊断套件中，相较度量解码与结构化信念蒸馏，QP 分别将规划成功率提高26.1与6.4个百分点；在 GridWorld 上，度量解码能恢复保留结构距离，但其原生潜在几何仍比 QP 更失真。
AI.motivation: 预测式世界模型的目标不一定会按后续控制所需的区分来组织潜在历史。在训练时可访问模拟器特权信息的条件下，应当预测、解码，还是直接约束潜在几何，以及这些方式与结构化信念蒸馏相比如何，尚不清楚。
AI.method: 定义后验边缘化的结构测试，其响应分布在历史上诱导一个伪度量；训练 QP 世界模型，使共享潜在空间中的欧氏距离与该伪度量对齐；并与度量解码和结构化信念蒸馏进行对比。
AI.result: 在固定的六任务诊断套件上，差异在留出的结构变化下最为明显：QP 相较度量解码的规划成功率高26.1个百分点（95% 区间为21.5至30.7），相较结构化信念蒸馏高6.4个百分点（区间为3.8至9.0）。在 GridWorld 上，度量解码能较准确地恢复留出结构距离（rho=0.91），但其原生潜在几何比 QP 更失真（配对 IQD 差异为0.22，区间为0.20至0.24）。
AI.conclusion: 关系可恢复性与直接几何对齐可能彼此分离，因此从解码器中读出结构信息，并不意味着潜在几何已经被正确组织。

title: Lev-3B: A Data Recipe for Compact Probabilistic Log Decision Models
summary: Many log-analysis tasks involve choosing among known options, such as detecting anomalous sessions or identifying attack techniques, and benefit from calibrated probabilities. We present Lev-3B, an open 3B-parameter decision model built on Granite-4.1-3B-Base with a shared pointer readout, and study its training recipe. The recipe has two key parts. First, training follows a curriculum: the model learns bounded natural-language decisions, using no log data, before it sees any logs. Second, the log stage mixes the target tasks with general log data spanning 35 auxiliary tasks unrelated to either evaluation task. We evaluate one shared checkpoint on sources seen in training and on sources excluded from training, calibration and model selection. The two-stage recipe transfers substantially better than training on log data alone. Adding general log data improves performance on excluded sources. At a fraction of their serving cost, Lev-3B outperforms prompted frontier models on anomaly detection, including on an excluded logging system, but trails them on attack-technique classification. Its probabilities are well calibrated on familiar sources, but on the excluded logging system it confidently misses anomalies. We release the checkpoint, recipe, data manifests, and prediction-level artifacts.

AI.tldr: 提出开源3B参数日志决策模型 Lev-3B，并研究其训练配方。该配方先用无日志数据的有界自然语言决策进行课程学习，再混合目标任务与35个辅助任务的通用日志数据。它在异常检测上超过提示的前沿模型，但在攻击技术分类上落后，且在未见过的日志系统上会自信地漏检异常。
AI.motivation: 许多日志分析任务需要在已知选项中做选择（如检测异常会话、识别攻击技术），并需要校准的概率。仅用日志数据训练的模型，泛化效果明显不如两阶段配方。
AI.method: 模型基于 Granite-4.1-3B-Base 构建，采用共享指针读出（shared pointer readout）。训练分两阶段：先用无日志的有界自然语言决策进行课程学习；再在日志阶段混合目标任务与35个与两个评估任务均无关的辅助日志任务。在训练中见过的与未见过的数据源上评估同一检查点，未见过的数据源未用于训练、校准或模型选择。
AI.result: 两阶段配方明显优于仅用日志数据训练。加入通用日志数据提升了在未见数据源上的表现。以远低于前沿模型的服务成本，Lev-3B 在异常检测上超过提示的前沿模型，包括在未见的日志系统上；但在攻击技术分类上落后。其概率在熟悉的数据源上校准良好，但在未见的日志系统上会自信地漏检异常。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种低成本的日志决策模型训练配方，并公开了检查点、配方、数据清单与预测级产物。模型在未见数据源上的概率校准不可靠，部署时需要额外验证。

title: Planned Restlessness: Delayed Meta Bandits with Budgets
summary: We study episodic finite-horizon Bayesian bandits, or meta-bandits, with independent arms. Each episode draws fresh arm qualities from unknown recurring priors. Observations arrive after known delays, and plays obey hard per-episode caps and total budgets. A play earns reward and informs both the current quality and the recurring prior: the learner must explore, use, and generalize. We formulate a common planning optimization over learning trajectories. Its LP relaxation values experiments through current reward, resource consumption and continuation: the value of future decisions from the learning state produced. Dual prices separate the arms into local programs and certify every admissible policy, including hierarchical Thompson sampling. Execution enforces the hard constraints while preserving the promised learning transitions or accounting for their loss. The framework also represents risk-sensitive objectives and prices purchased observations and buyout options. Delayed reports create planned restlessness: an arm's information changes while it is not played, through reports of its own earlier plays arriving on a known calendar. For stationary priors, finite reward alphabets, bounded report lag and nonbinding budgets, posterior sampling over the recurring priors bounds the price of not knowing them by $O(\sqrt{N})$ over $N$ episodes, with other parameters fixed. For one undelayed $T$-step episode with arms capped at $T/X$ plays each, we obtain the LP-relative approximation factor $1+(2\pi X)^{-1/2}+O(X^{-1})$, improving previous factors, with a matching lower bound for the leading term.

AI.tldr: 研究带硬性预算与延迟反馈的情节式有限时域贝叶斯多臂老虎机（元老虎机），提出基于 LP 松弛的规划框架与对偶定价。在循环先验下，后验采样对未知先验的代价为 O(sqrt(N))（N 个情节）；对无延迟的单段 T 步情形，得到 LP 相对近似因子 1 + (2 pi X)^(-1/2) + O(X^(-1))，并给出主导项的匹配下界。
AI.motivation: 现实中结果往往延迟到达，每个情节有硬性的拉动上限与总预算，同时先验未知，学习者需要在不同情节之间积累信息。已有的近似保证较弱，此前的近似因子也有待改进。
AI.method: 将学习轨迹上的规划写成一个优化问题，其 LP 松弛通过当前奖励、资源消耗与后续学习状态的价值来估价实验。对偶价格把各臂分离为局部程序，并为所有可行策略（包括分层 Thompson 采样）提供最优性证书。执行时强制满足硬约束，同时保留预期的学习转移或计入其损失。框架还可表示风险敏感目标，并为购买观测和买断选项定价。
AI.result: 对于平稳先验、有限奖励字母表、有界报告延迟以及不起约束作用的预算，后验采样对 N 个情节中未知先验的代价界为 O(sqrt(N))（其他参数固定）。对无延迟的单段 T 步情形，每臂至多拉动 T/X 次，得到 LP 相对近似因子 1 + (2 pi X)^(-1/2) + O(X^(-1))，并给出主导项的匹配下界。
AI.conclusion: 该框架把延迟反馈带来的“计划性不安定”纳入规划：臂的信息会在其未被拉动期间，随着其早先拉动的报告按已知日程到达而改变。该框架同时为未知先验的代价提供了可证明的界。

title: Communication-Efficient Clustered Federated Learning in Non-IID Wireless Networks
summary: Current and emerging mobile networks face increasing privacy, scalability, and performance challenges as distributed learning becomes essential for advanced 6G services. These challenges are amplified by the presence of non-IID data, naturally arising in heterogeneous wireless environments, that degrade the performance of standard Federated Learning (FL) approaches. To address non-IID data across clients, we propose a Clustered Federated Learning (CFL) framework that assigns clients to specialized models during training. Data-domain clustering initializes model-based clustering, enabling identification and exploitation of client similarities without sharing raw data while reducing communication cost. Motivated by mmWave beam selection, we evaluate our methods on a wireless simulation dataset (DeepMIMO) and complement it with two non-IID benchmarks (FEMNIST, Rotated CIFAR-10) to isolate different non-IID characteristics. Our best configurations improve accuracy over IFCA by 4.8 pp on DeepMIMO and 10.6 pp on FEMNIST while reducing downlink data volume by 83.1 % on FEMNIST compared to IFCA. We demonstrate that different clustering strategies suit different non-IID characteristics. These results show that our CFL methods enable resource-efficient, and high-performance distributed learning in future 6G networks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种聚类联邦学习框架，在非独立同分布的无线网络中将客户端分配到专门化的模型，并以数据域聚类初始化基于模型的聚类。在 DeepMIMO 上相较 IFCA 提高4.8个百分点，在 FEMNIST 上提高10.6个百分点，并将 FEMNIST 上的下行数据量减少83.1%。
AI.motivation: 异构无线环境中自然出现的非独立同分布数据会降低标准联邦学习的性能，而面向6G服务的分布式学习又需要兼顾隐私、可扩展性与性能。
AI.method: 提出聚类联邦学习（CFL）框架：通过数据域聚类初始化基于模型的聚类，在不共享原始数据的前提下识别并利用客户端相似性，同时降低通信开销。以毫米波波束选择为动机，在无线仿真数据集 DeepMIMO 上评估，并以 FEMNIST 与旋转 CIFAR-10 两个非独立同分布基准分离不同的非独立同分布特性。
AI.result: 最佳配置相较 IFCA，在 DeepMIMO 上提高4.8个百分点，在 FEMNIST 上提高10.6个百分点，并在 FEMNIST 上将下行数据量减少83.1%。不同的聚类策略适用于不同的非独立同分布特性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的 CFL 方法可在未来6G网络中实现资源高效且性能良好的分布式学习。

title: The Utility of Physics-Informed Machine Learning in Solar Power Production Forecasting
summary: Physics-informed machine learning (PIML) and hybrid modeling have attracted significant attention as approaches for combining physical knowledge with the flexibility of deep learning. In this work, we investigate whether these approaches deliver their commonly claimed benefits for large-scale photovoltaic (PV) power forecasting. We develop two hybrid forecasting architectures that integrate the ADR physical PV efficiency model with the TSMixer neural forecasting architecture through feature augmentation and residual learning. The proposed models are evaluated on a dataset comprising over 3 million samples from 3,713 PV installations across 33 European countries. We assess convergence speed, forecasting accuracy, transferability across geographical regions, and data efficiency. Although the physics-informed models seem to exhibit slightly faster convergence during training, they do not achieve consistent improvements in test-set accuracy, generalization, or performance under limited training data compared to the purely data-driven baseline. These findings suggest that, for modern deep forecasting architectures trained on large datasets, explicitly incorporating the ADR physical model provides limited practical benefit for day-ahead PV forecasting.

AI.tldr: 考察物理信息机器学习（PIML）与混合建模在大规模光伏发电预测中能否带来通常宣称的益处。在3713个欧洲光伏装置超过300万样本的数据上，将 ADR 物理效率模型与 TSMixer 结合的混合模型只略微加快了训练收敛，在测试精度、泛化、迁移性和有限数据下的表现上均未稳定优于纯数据驱动基线。
AI.motivation: 物理信息机器学习与混合建模被普遍认为能把物理知识与深度学习的灵活性结合起来，但它们在大规模光伏功率预测中的实际收益尚未得到检验。
AI.method: 构建两种混合预测架构，通过特征增强与残差学习，将 ADR 光伏效率物理模型与 TSMixer 神经预测架构结合。在33个欧洲国家的3713个光伏装置上评估，数据超过300万样本。比较的指标包括收敛速度、预测精度、跨地理区域的迁移性和数据效率。
AI.result: 物理信息模型在训练中收敛略快，但在测试集精度、泛化能力、跨地区迁移性以及有限训练数据下的表现上，均未相对纯数据驱动基线取得一致的改进。
AI.conclusion: 对于在大规模数据上训练的现代深度预测架构，显式引入 ADR 物理模型对日前光伏预测的实际帮助有限。

title: Why Speculative Decoding Works Better Than Predicted on Sparse MoE Models
comment: Accepted as at NeurIPS 2026 main track conference
summary: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates autoregressive inference by leveraging the memory bound nature of decoding, verifying multiple draft tokens in a single forward pass. For mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, prior work predicts a concave speedup-batch size relationship, with gains peaking at intermediate batch sizes due to expert saturation. We evaluate this across 10 sparse MoE models (30B--1T parameters, 8--512 experts) and find recent fine-grained models break this trend, showing higher speedup at low batch size. We find verification cost is governed not only by activated-expert bytes, but also by temporal overlap across draft tokens and GPU execution dynamics. At low batch size, MoE layers in fine-grained models account for a much smaller share of runtime than of weights; on H100, kernel profiling attributes this mainly to higher bandwidth utilization of MoE kernels relative to attention, with L2 absorbing repeated reads of co-routed experts. Across draft tokens, routing overlap further reduces the unique experts activated during verification relative to independence assumptions. We model this effect using a maximum-entropy Iterative Proportional Fitting (IPF) framework that predicts unique expert counts from routing-overlap statistics with less than 4\% error, and substantially narrows the gap to real-model curves and captures the qualitative low-batch trend from synthetic routing.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在细粒度稀疏混合专家（MoE）模型上，推测解码的加速比在低批量时反而更高。作者用基于最大熵迭代比例拟合（IPF）的模型，依据草稿词元间的路由重叠统计预测唯一激活的专家数，误差低于4%。
AI.motivation: 已有工作预测 MoE 模型的推测解码加速比与批量大小呈凹形关系，在专家饱和的中等批量时达到峰值。作者发现近期的细粒度模型打破了这一趋势。
AI.method: 在10个稀疏 MoE 模型（30B 至 1T 参数，8 至 512 个专家）上评估。通过 H100 上的内核分析与 L2 缓存行为分析，考察验证成本的来源；验证成本不仅取决于激活专家的字节数，还取决于草稿词元之间的时间重叠与 GPU 执行动态。用最大熵 IPF 框架，从路由重叠统计预测验证阶段唯一激活的专家数。
AI.result: 细粒度模型在低批量时的加速比高于预期。在低批量时，细粒度模型中 MoE 层占运行时间的比例远小于其占权重的比例；内核分析将其主要归因于 MoE 内核相对注意力更高的带宽利用率，且 L2 缓存吸收了共同路由专家的重复读取。草稿词元之间的路由重叠进一步减少了验证时唯一激活的专家数，低于独立性假设的预测。该 IPF 模型误差低于4%，显著缩小了与真实模型曲线的差距，并捕捉到合成路由中的低批量趋势。
AI.conclusion: 验证成本不能仅由激活专家的字节数决定，还取决于草稿词元间的时间重叠与 GPU 执行动态。因此，仅依据专家饱和的简单模型会对细粒度 MoE 的推测解码速度作出错误预测。

title: Benchmarking Graph Neural Networks for AC Power Flow: The Role of Inductive Biases and Physical Constraints
summary: Fast and accurate models for AC power flow (ACPF) are increasingly important as modern electrical grids require more frequent system analyses. Graph neural networks (GNNs) naturally exploit electrical grid topology, yet the effects of architectural design choices on predictive performance remain poorly understood given differences in graph representations and evaluation settings across studies. We present a unified benchmark of representative GNN architectures for ACPF prediction under a common experimental framework. All models use identical preprocessing and training procedures and comparable parameter budgets, isolating the impact of message-passing mechanisms and inductive biases. We also analyze errors by distance from the slack bus and systematically ablate key design components. We evaluate predictive accuracy and physical consistency on the IEEE 14-bus and IEEE 118-bus systems. Results indicate that anisotropic message-passing architectures offer the most favorable trade-off between predictive accuracy and physical consistency under the studied parameter and topology constraints. Explicit edge features encoding line impedances and global context aggregation are particularly important for representing electrical interactions and system-wide dependencies, especially for voltage-angle predictions on the topologically bottlenecked IEEE-118 grid. Under a budget with approximately fixed parameters, two or three message-passing layers generally provide the best balance between depth and representation width, while additional depth offers no consistent improvement. Ablations also show that standard residual and root connections are not necessarily beneficial in shallow models, and that aggregation operators involve trade-offs between statistical accuracy and physical consistency. These results provide practical guidelines for designing graph-based power system models.

AI.tldr: 在统一实验框架下对代表性图神经网络（GNN）架构做交流潮流（ACPF）预测的基准测试。结果表明，各向异性消息传递架构在预测精度与物理一致性之间的权衡最好，并在 IEEE 14 节点与 118 节点系统上给出设计指导。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络天然利用电网拓扑进行快速的 ACPF 预测，但由于不同研究的图表示与评估设置各不相同，架构设计选择对预测性能的影响仍不清楚。
AI.method: 所有模型使用相同的预处理与训练流程，以及相近的参数预算，以隔离消息传递机制与归纳偏置的影响。分析误差随距平衡节点距离的变化，并系统消融关键设计组件。在 IEEE 14 节点与 118 节点系统上评估预测精度与物理一致性。
AI.result: 各向异性消息传递架构在精度与物理一致性之间的权衡最优。显式编码线路阻抗的边特征与全局上下文聚合，对表示电气相互作用很重要，尤其对拓扑瓶颈明显的 IEEE 118 节点系统中的电压相角预测。在参数大致固定的预算下，两到三层消息传递通常效果最好，继续增加深度没有稳定的改进。在浅层模型中，标准残差连接与根连接不一定有益；聚合算子在统计精度与物理一致性之间存在权衡。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果为基于图的电力系统模型设计提供了实用指南。

title: Rethinking GFlowNet Training: Negative Reinforce Dynamics
summary: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) are models that learn to sample discrete objects proportional to a target reward. They are trained by minimizing balance errors over sampled trajectories, which inherently ties correctness to exploration: if a region is not visited, balance cannot be enforced there. Adaptive exploration is therefore crucial, yet standard training relies on a semi-gradient update that treats the sampling distribution as fixed at each optimization step. On the other hand, the full gradient reveals a second mechanism that reduces the observed errors in an anti-exploratory manner. In this paper, we establish a connection between the full gradient and min-min dynamics between the GFlowNet and a decoupled sampler, showing that the sampler reduces observed violations by avoiding high-error regions. This insight motivates a bridge between two-player games and single-policy dynamics, which underpins the design of our proposed method, Negative Reinforce Dynamics (NRD). By tying the parameters of an adversarial game together, we recover a single-policy dynamic that extends exploration while maintaining correctness. In standard benchmarks, our method outperforms existing approaches in both convergence speed and exploration efficiency, without training a separate teacher or auxiliary exploration policy.

AI.tldr: 提出负强化动力学（NRD）方法，通过把一个对抗博弈的参数绑定起来，恢复为单策略动力学，从而在不训练单独教师或辅助探索策略的情况下，提高 GFlowNet 的收敛速度与探索效率。
AI.motivation: GFlowNet 通过最小化轨迹上的平衡误差进行训练，因此正确性与探索紧密相连：未被访问的区域无法强制满足平衡。然而标准训练采用半梯度更新，把采样分布视为每一步固定，因此自适应探索至关重要。
AI.method: 通过完整梯度与 GFlowNet 及一个解耦采样器之间的 min-min 动力学建立联系，表明采样器会通过避开高误差区域来减少观测到的违背。由此把双人博弈与单策略动力学联系起来，通过绑定对抗博弈的参数恢复单策略动力学，从而在保持正确性的同时扩展探索。
AI.result: 在标准基准上，NRD 在收敛速度与探索效率上均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 完整梯度揭示了一种反探索式的误差减小机制，NRD 利用这一机制，在不增加单独探索策略的情况下，同时扩展探索并保持正确性。

title: Fed-IGTD: A federated learning-based framework for tabular-to-image encoding
summary: Tabular-to-image encoding methods, which transform tabular data into image-like representations, have shown promising results in predictive tasks. Despite their benefits, these methods follow a centralized paradigm, in which the data are collected and models are trained on a central device. This raises privacy and security concerns, particularly the risk of data leakage, unauthorized data collection and access to users' private information. Federated Learning (FL) provides a decentralized framework in which multiple clients jointly optimize a shared model without directly sharing training data. We introduce Fed-IGTD, a horizontal FL-based approach in which clients share a common feature space and upload only local statistics, from which the server reconstructs the global correlation matrix and obtains a feature-to-pixel mapping to train a convolutional neural network via Federated Averaging (FedAvg). We studied two differential privacy (DP) mechanisms: (i) a one-shot Gaussian mechanism protecting the correlation-aggregation step; and (ii) a client-level DP-FedAvg variant protecting the training with privacy loss composed via a Renyi-DP accountant. We evaluated Fed-IGTD on five datasets under a systematic sweep of non-IID severity and privacy budgets. Privacy protection applied to the mapping-construction step has little impact on predictive performance. By contrast, DP-FedAvg substantially degrades utility at moderate privacy budgets with a small client cohort (K=5). Ablation study indicates that this degradation is driven mainly by the injected noise rather than by uniform averaging or update clipping. Macro-F1 exhibits sensitivity to performance degradation than accuracy under non-IID heterogeneity and class imbalance.

AI.tldr: 提出 Fed-IGTD，一种基于联邦学习的表格转图像编码框架：服务器仅由客户端上传的局部统计量重构全局相关矩阵，得到特征到像素的映射后用 FedAvg 训练 CNN。映射构建阶段加隐私保护对性能影响很小，而 DP-FedAvg 在中等隐私预算、客户端数较少时明显降低效用。
AI.motivation: 现有表格转图像编码方法采用集中式范式，需要收集数据到中心设备训练，存在数据泄露、未授权收集和访问用户隐私的风险；联邦学习可避免共享原始数据，但尚未用于此类编码方法。
AI.method: 水平联邦学习设定，客户端共享公共特征空间并只上传局部统计量；研究两种差分隐私机制：对相关矩阵聚合步骤的一次性高斯机制，以及客户端级 DP-FedAvg（用 Renyi-DP 会计器组合隐私损失）；在五个数据集上系统扫描非 IID 程度与隐私预算。
AI.result: 映射构建步骤的隐私保护对预测性能影响很小；DP-FedAvg 在中等隐私预算且客户端数 K=5 时显著降低效用；消融实验表明性能下降主要由注入噪声造成，而非均匀平均或更新裁剪；在非 IID 与类别不平衡条件下，Macro-F1 比准确率更敏感地反映性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 对映射构建施加隐私保护代价较小，而训练阶段的差分隐私在小客户端规模下代价显著，说明隐私预算与效用之间需要权衡，且评估指标的选择应考虑异质性与类别不平衡。

title: Assessing feature scorer results on high-dimensional datasets with t-SNE
summary: While vast literature on high-dimensional data visualization is available, there are not many works regarding the visualization of feature scorers and their results. Feature scorers are algorithms that assign numerical importance to each feature of multi-dimensional datasets. These importance scores can be used in several applications, such as feature selection, knowledge discovery, and machine learning interpretability. There are several feature scorers to choose from, and often no single metric or ground truth is available to guarantee the quality of their results. In this scenario, visualization can become valuable to support the decision of which method to choose and how good its results are. For this goal, this work presents "weighted t-SNE." It modifies the relationship between data points in the embedded 2D space to reflect the importance of each dimension of the original datasets as assessed by a feature scorer. This research discusses how to implement weighted t-SNE, proposes the silhouette coefficient as a numerical evaluation of the results, and shows several examples of its use in practice. Synthetic and real-world tabular datasets are used in the experiments together with nine feature scorers, ranging from Mutual Information to neural networks. Each feature scorer produces unique visualizations, and weighted t-SNE can be used to compare and choose the one that better suits a given dataset and task. Weighted t-SNE can also visually show the importance of features learned by machine learning models and help us see how they are organizing the data, increasing their interpretability.

AI.tldr: 提出加权 t-SNE，将特征评分器给出的特征重要性编码进二维嵌入中点与点之间的关系，并用轮廓系数量化结果，从而可视化比较九种特征评分器的效果。
AI.motivation: 高维数据可视化文献丰富，但针对特征评分器及其结果的可视化研究较少；特征评分器往往缺乏统一的度量或真值，难以判断其结果质量。
AI.method: 修改嵌入空间中数据点之间的关系，使其反映每个维度的重要性；讨论加权 t-SNE 的实现，提出以轮廓系数作为嵌入结果的数值评估；在合成与真实表格数据上，使用从互信息到神经网络的九种特征评分器进行实验。
AI.result: 每种特征评分器产生各不相同的可视化结果；加权 t-SNE 可用于比较并选择更适合特定数据集与任务的评分器，也能直观展示机器学习模型学到的特征重要性。
AI.conclusion: 加权 t-SNE 为选择特征评分器提供了可视化辅助手段，并有助于理解模型如何组织数据、提升可解释性。

title: Representation Complexity Along Learning Trajectories: Trading Width for Precision and Time
summary: What computational role does overparameterisation play during learning? Information-plane analyses suggest that neural networks can traverse representations substantially more complex than those required by their final predictors. We explore when this transient complexity serves a computational purpose by comparing the representation complexity needed for prediction with that needed to make an unknown target statistically visible through gradient feedback. We introduce an oracle model of neural network learning and use Kolmogorov \(n\)-widths to quantify effective representation complexity. Our main technical result transfers complexity bounds from the forward representation to the corresponding gradient-query features. Combined with statistical-query lower bounds, this gives a task-agnostic lower bound on the initial effective width required for target-dependent gradient information to become detectable. For \(k\)-sparse parity in \(D\) dimensions, a known target admits an \(O(k)\)-width representation, while the general bound already implies a polynomial separation between representation and discovery. We then exploit parity's invariance under coordinatewise sign reflections to identify a sharper unsigned effective width, which removes sign distinctions invisible to the parity information channel. At a transfer-compatible measurement resolution, its critical scale is \(\widetilde{\Theta}_k\left( D^{k-1}\tau^2 \right)\), up to logarithmic factors. Thus, the representation resources required to discover a predictor can substantially exceed those required to represent it once learned. Interpreting precision through accumulation over fresh samples yields a corresponding width-time frontier. Experiments support the predicted dimension dependence and examine how optimisation and generalisation depart from this idealised frontier.

AI.tldr: 通过 oracle 模型与 Kolmogorov n-宽度分析，指出学习过程中的中间表示复杂度可能远高于最终预测器所需，并在 k 稀疏奇偶函数上给出表示与发现之间的多项式分离。
AI.motivation: 信息平面分析显示神经网络在学习中可能经过比最终预测器更复杂的表示，但这种瞬态复杂度是否具有计算作用尚不清楚。
AI.method: 提出神经网络学习的 oracle 模型，用 Kolmogorov n-宽度度量有效表示复杂度；将前向表示的复杂度界迁移到梯度查询特征上，并结合统计查询下界，得到与任务无关的下界；利用奇偶函数对坐标符号翻转的不变性，定义更锐利的无符号有效宽度。
AI.result: 在 D 维空间中，已知的 k 稀疏奇偶目标有 O(k) 宽度的表示，而目标依赖的梯度信息变得可检测所需的初始有效宽度临界尺度约为 D^(k-1) tau^2（忽略对数因子），两者存在多项式分离；实验支持维度依赖关系，并考察了优化与泛化如何偏离该理想前沿。
AI.conclusion: 发现一个预测器所需的表示资源可能远超表示它本身所需的资源；过参数化的瞬态复杂度可能具有计算意义，并可由宽度与时间之间的权衡前沿来刻画。

title: FairSplit: Decomposing the Embedding Space for Fair Classification
summary: Fair classification faces a twofold challenge: maintaining high classification accuracy while limiting reliance on sensitive information. Our method FairSplit achieves this by learning a decomposition of the embedding space into a Fair Space used for prediction and a Sensitive Space that isolates sensitive information. During training, the model must simultaneously learn the classification task and separate fair from sensitive information. The Sensitive Space gives sensitive attributes a destination, so the Fair Space can be used for prediction without relying on them. This decomposition is guided via a learnable mask and the Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC) as a measure of statistical dependence. We provide theoretical guarantees showing that the demographic parity gap is upper-bounded by both (i) the learned dimensionality of the Fair Space and (ii) the HSIC between the Fair Space and sensitive attributes. FairSplit effectively handles multiclass tasks and non-binary sensitive attributes, overcoming key limitations of existing fair classification methods. Experiments on established fairness benchmarks show that FairSplit achieves competitive accuracy-fairness trade-offs. Code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 提出 FairSplit，将嵌入空间分解为用于预测的公平子空间和隔离敏感信息的敏感子空间，在公平分类基准上取得有竞争力的精度与公平性权衡。
AI.motivation: 公平分类需要同时保持高分类精度并限制对敏感信息的依赖；现有方法在多类任务和非二元敏感属性上存在局限。
AI.method: 利用可学习掩码和 Hilbert-Schmidt 独立性准则（HSIC）度量统计依赖，将嵌入分解为公平空间与敏感空间，让敏感属性有明确的归属，使预测只依赖公平空间。
AI.result: 理论上证明人口统计学平等差距的上界同时由公平空间的学习维度以及公平空间与敏感属性之间的 HSIC 决定；在已有的公平性基准上，实验显示有竞争力的精度-公平性权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式分离敏感信息，FairSplit 为多类任务和非二元敏感属性的公平分类提供了一种有理论保证的方法。

title: Exponential-Nemytskii Neural Operators: Learning Field Evolution Across Step Sizes
summary: In variable-step operator learning, agreement at observed step sizes does not by itself determine predictions at other temporal resolutions. We propose an operator whose step-size dependence is prescribed by a first-order Duhamel approximation of semilinear dynamics. It combines exact linear propagation with a local nonlinear function of the field and its derivatives, allowing evaluation below the observation interval without supervision densely sampled across step sizes. Under suitable conditions and at fixed spatial resolution, we prove that agreement between models at two step sizes controls their prediction differences throughout a prescribed range. We also give conditions for local identifiability of both components from two step sizes, supporting interpretation of the learned structure. A latent extension applies the same construction to learned fields. We evaluate the base model on two synthetic problems and the extension on two real datasets against several baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出指数-Nemytskii 神经算子，其步长依赖由半线性动力学的一阶 Duhamel 近似规定，可在观测步长区间之外的时间分辨率上预测场的演化。
AI.motivation: 在变步长算子学习中，模型在已观测步长上吻合并不能决定其他时间分辨率下的预测；若要在没有跨步长密集监督的情况下外推，需要结构性约束。
AI.method: 结合精确的线性传播与作用于场及其导数的局部非线性函数；在固定空间分辨率下给出理论结果，并给出由两个步长识别两个分量的局部可辨识条件；隐变量扩展将同一构造应用于学到的场。
AI.result: 证明了两个步长上模型之间的一致性可以控制规定范围内的预测差异；基础模型在两个合成问题上评估，隐变量扩展在两个真实数据集上与多个基线比较（摘要未给出具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: 该构造利用半线性动力学的结构，使模型能够在未观测步长上给出有理论依据的预测，并支持对所学结构的解释。

title: Reinforcement Learning for the Game of Balatro: A Fast Simulator and Two-Policy Training Approach
comment: Accepted at EXAG 2026 (AIIDE Workshop on Experimental AI in Games)
summary: Balatro, a 2024 roguelike deckbuilder, presents three difficulties that have historically derailed reinforcement learning methods: a 3,000-action state-dependent action space, horizons of several hundred decisions with sparse rewards, and pervasive stochasticity in both card draws and shop generation. Published RL results on the game remain scarce. We introduce an end-to-end pipeline comprising (i) a high-throughput Rust simulator that is automatically state-diffed against the live game client via BalatroBot, (ii) a condensed observation-action interface with dynamic per-step masking of legal moves, and (iii) a multi-agent PPO architecture that decomposes play into a tactical blind policy and a strategic shop policy that share the full game state but act in disjoint phases. Long-horizon credit assignment is partially addressed by per-agent reward routing with explicit cross-agent credit. On the main joint run, training metrics show a sharp phase transition in which the first-blind clear rate converges above 99% and mean episode return increases by roughly an order of magnitude, plateauing at a mean maximum ante of 3 out of 8; single-agent baselines under identical rewards oscillated between greedy and hoarding failure modes and did not stably clear the first blind. These results establish the two-policy decomposition as a strong reactive baseline for Balatro and localise the remaining gap to long-horizon strategic planning rather than tactical blind play.

AI.tldr: 提出用于 Balatro 游戏的端到端强化学习流水线，包括 Rust 高速模拟器与双策略多智能体 PPO；第一盲注的通关率收敛至 99% 以上，但长程战略规划仍是瓶颈。
AI.motivation: Balatro 具有约 3000 个状态相关的动作、数百步决策的稀疏奖励，以及抽牌和商店生成的随机性，这些难点历史上使强化学习方法难以奏效，且已公开的相关结果很少。
AI.method: 包括三部分：通过 BalatroBot 与实际游戏客户端做状态差分校验的高吞吐 Rust 模拟器；带动态合法动作掩码的精简观测-动作接口；多智能体 PPO，将游戏拆分为战术性的盲注策略和战略性的商店策略，二者共享完整状态但作用于不相交的阶段，并通过按智能体的奖励路由与显式的跨智能体信用实现部分长程信用分配。
AI.result: 在主联合训练中，训练指标出现明显的相变：第一盲注通关率收敛至 99% 以上，平均回合回报增长约一个数量级，平均最大 ante 停在 3（满分 8）；在相同奖励下，单智能体基线在贪婪与囤积两种失效模式间振荡，无法稳定通过第一盲注。
AI.conclusion: 两策略分解可作为 Balatro 的强反应式基线；剩余差距主要在于长程战略规划，而非战术性的盲注游戏。

title: BASILISC: Bayesian Alignment of Siamese-Integrated Latents for Inferring Single-cell Correspondence
comment: 12 pages main text, 3 figures, 1 table; supplementary material with 10 figures and 10 tables (38 pages total). Code to be released on publication. Currently under review
summary: Single-cell assays study the genome one cell at a time. Unimodal assays measure one molecular layer, the newer multimodal assays measure several. Most data are single-modality, so integrating them relies on models trained on multimodal assays, where the cell correspondence across modalities is known. These models return a matching, but rarely a confidence measure. We present BASILISC (Bayesian Alignment of Siamese-Integrated Latents for Inferring Single-cell Correspondence), a framework for matching single-cell representations with uncertainty on the correspondence itself. A BASILISC model is a probabilistic siamese network over the two modalities with a predictive distribution over the correspondence for a cross-modal pair of cells. We instantiate it at two levels: at the cell-type level the question is whether two cells share a cell type, at the cell level which cell is the partner in the other modality. To our knowledge, this is the first uncertainty score on a learned cross-modal correspondence evaluated against a known ground-truth pairing. BASILISC learns a similarity across modalities that reflects cell lineage: an unseen cell type is matched to its lineage relative, matching still works on such held-out types (balanced accuracy 0.86 on unseen against 0.93 on seen types), and the predictive uncertainty rises on these out-of-distribution cells. The uncertainty score also selects high-quality matches for downstream analysis: discarding the least certain fifth of the pairs raises accuracy from 0.93 to 0.98. At the cell level, a deep ensemble of the deterministic matcher reaches 0.062 matching accuracy on the benchmark test set, above the competition winner; on the Bayesian matcher's assignment, the posterior flags the wrong matches that cross a cell-type boundary better than a deterministic read of the same scores (AUROC 0.68 against 0.64).

AI.tldr: 提出 BASILISC，一个概率孪生网络框架，用于跨模态单细胞匹配，并给出对匹配关系本身的不确定性；该不确定性可用于筛除低质量匹配。
AI.motivation: 大多数单细胞数据只含单一模态，而跨模态整合依赖在多模态数据上训练的模型；这些模型通常只返回匹配结果，很少给出置信度。
AI.method: 在两种模态之上构建概率孪生网络，输出跨模态细胞对之间对应关系的预测分布；分别在细胞类型层面（两个细胞是否属于同一类型）和细胞层面（另一模态中哪一个细胞是配对细胞）实例化。
AI.result: 对未见细胞类型仍可匹配，平衡准确率为 0.86（已见类型为 0.93），且分布外细胞的预测不确定性升高；丢弃最不确定的五分之一配对可将准确率从 0.93 提高到 0.98；在细胞层面，确定性匹配器的深度集成在基准测试集上达到 0.062 的匹配准确率，高于竞赛冠军；在跨细胞类型边界的错误匹配检测中，后验的 AUROC 为 0.68，高于确定性读数的 0.64。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性评分既能识别分布外细胞，也能筛选出高质量匹配，为下游分析提供更可靠的跨模态对应关系。

title: When Does Closed-Loop Curriculum Adaptation Help GRPO? An Analysis on Countdown
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, Accepted at IEEE ICTAI 2026
summary: Reinforcement fine-tuning has become an effective post-training paradigm for improving the reasoning ability of large language models, but it remains sample-inefficient when the training distribution is mismatched to the model's current capability. In group-relative objectives such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), problems that are too hard often produce uniformly failed rollouts, while problems that are too easy provide little useful advantage signal. In this work, we introduce CLOSEDLOOPGAUSSIAN, a lightweight adaptive curriculum method for efficient reinforcement fine-tuning on ordered reasoning tasks. Instead of following a fixed easy-to-hard schedule, CLOSEDLOOPGAUSSIAN preserves the structure of an Easy-to-Hard Gaussian sampler while dynamically adjusting its pace and spread using periodic probe estimates of per-difficulty accuracy. The controller accelerates training when the model is ahead of a reference curriculum, slows down when the model falls behind, and broadens sampling when earlier difficulties regress. This feedback mechanism keeps training focused on tasks that are challenging but still learnable, without changing the reward function, model architecture, or underlying GRPO optimizer. Experiments on symbolic arithmetic reasoning task show that CLOSEDLOOPGAUSSIAN improves exact-match accuracy over vanilla GRPO and fixed open-loop curricula, with the strongest gains in intermediate-difficulty regimes where group-relative learning signals are most informative. Codes are available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 提出 CLOSEDLOOPGAUSSIAN，一种闭环自适应课程方法：通过周期性探测估计各难度的准确率，动态调整由易到难高斯采样器的节奏与分布范围，在符号算术推理任务上优于普通 GRPO 与固定课程。
AI.motivation: 在 GRPO 等组相对目标中，过难的问题常产生全部失败的 rollout，过易的问题提供的优势信号很少；固定的由易到难课程无法随模型当前能力调整。
AI.method: 保留由易到难高斯采样器的结构，依据周期性探测得到的分难度准确率调整其节奏与离散程度：模型领先于参考课程时加速，落后时减速，早期难度出现退化时扩大采样范围；不改变奖励函数、模型结构和 GRPO 优化器。
AI.result: 在符号算术推理任务上，CLOSEDLOOPGAUSSIAN 的精确匹配准确率优于普通 GRPO 与固定开环课程，在中等难度区间增益最为明显。
AI.conclusion: 闭环反馈能让训练集中在有挑战但仍可学习的任务上，在不改变奖励与优化器的前提下提升强化微调的样本效率。

title: Closed Gates Leak: Decomposing Adjacent-Layer Cancellation in Gated Language Models
summary: In transformer language models with gated multilayer perceptrons (MLPs), adjacent layers write partly against each other into the residual stream. Previous work interpreted this cancellation as layers proposing features and the next layer selectively rejecting the inappropriate ones. We decompose the cancellation by removing the previous layer's write from the input of the next MLP: what the next layer writes along that write splits into what it writes anyway and how much less its MLP writes because the write is present, which we call the damping, and we trace the damping to the neurons that carry it. In gated MLPs the damping is carried by neurons whose gates are closed. SiLU and GELU are slightly negative below zero, so a closed gate still passes a small negative multiple of what the neuron reads, and a neuron whose output weight points along its input weight then subtracts a fraction of the direction it read. Summed over such neurons, closed gates contract the average direction a gated MLP reads, and the previous layer's write is not singled out: the same layer's write at another token is damped as much or more, and the eigenvalue signature from which that work concluded that the correction is selective appears for another token's write as well. Over training the damping grows while what the next layer writes anyway stays flat, and cancellation begins when the damping overtakes it; annealing the negative side of the gate activation away in continued pretraining removes the damping and the cancellation. Adjacent-layer cancellation is therefore weak evidence about which features a model rejects: it is produced by a contraction that gated MLPs apply, on average over directions, to whatever they read.

AI.tldr: 研究发现相邻层在残差流中的相互抵消主要来自门控 MLP 对所读方向的平均收缩，而非选择性地拒绝特征；在持续预训练中去除 gate 激活的负侧即可消除该抵消。
AI.motivation: 先前工作把相邻层的抵消解释为前一层提出特征、后一层选择性拒绝不合适的特征；本文质疑这一解释，希望厘清抵消的真实机制。
AI.method: 从下一层 MLP 的输入中移除前一层的写入，把下一层沿该写入方向的变化分解为“仍会写入的部分”和因该写入存在而减少的部分（称为阻尼），并追踪承载阻尼的神经元；分析门关闭时 SiLU 与 GELU 负区的小负值效应。
AI.result: 在门控 MLP 中，阻尼由门关闭的神经元承载；同一层对其他 token 的写入同样被阻尼，程度相当或更强，先前用于论证选择性的特征值特征在其他 token 上也会出现；训练中阻尼增长而“仍会写入的部分”保持平稳，阻尼超过后抵消开始出现；在持续预训练中去除激活函数的负侧可同时消除阻尼与抵消。
AI.conclusion: 相邻层抵消并不能有力地说明模型拒绝了哪些特征，它是门控 MLP 在平均意义上对其所读内容进行方向收缩所产生的结果。

title: Generating Critic-Guided Synthetic Experience in Latent World Models
summary: Learning from offline datasets is limited in scalability, as collecting new experience is often costly or unsafe in the real world. World models offer an alternative way to generate new experience through a learned dynamics model, yet learning policies in latent space is limited due to compounding errors in imagined rollouts. To this end, we propose using the world model as a local transition generator, leveraging critic guidance to choose actions inside that model to generate synthetic experiences. We study action refinement methodologies, introducing Critic-Guided Synthetic Experience (CGSE) generation in world models. Specifically, CGSE augments an existing offline dataset by sampling candidate actions using an offline policy and refining each to maximize a first-order approximation of the $Q$-function within a trust region. We then use a frozen latent world model to imagine the future state given each updated action, and use the critic to choose the best one, appending this synthetic transition to the replay buffer. Our method requires no additional real-environment interaction or test-time planner, as it generates synthetic experience offline using the world model. On three OGBench manipulation tasks, CGSE improves an offline policy by a relative improvement of $7.1\%$ on the average success rate.

AI.tldr: 提出 Critic-Guided Synthetic Experience（CGSE），在潜在世界模型中利用 critic 引导的动作精炼生成合成经验，在三个 OGBench 操作任务上使离线策略的平均成功率相对提升 7.1%。
AI.motivation: 离线数据集的规模有限，而真实环境中收集新经验代价高或不安全；在潜在空间中学习策略又受想象 rollout 中复合误差的限制。
AI.method: 把世界模型当作局部转移生成器：用离线策略采样候选动作，在信任域内对每个动作做一阶 Q 函数近似的精炼；再用冻结的潜在世界模型预测每个更新动作的未来状态，由 critic 选出最佳者并追加到回放缓冲区；无需额外的真实交互或测试时规划器。
AI.result: 在三个 OGBench 操作任务上，CGSE 使离线策略的平均成功率相对提升 7.1%。
AI.conclusion: 对动作做 critic 引导的精炼并用世界模型离线生成合成转移，是一种无需真实交互即可扩充离线数据、改进策略的方法。

title: From Local Recovery to Unified Generation: Discovering Triple Set in Knowledge Graphs via Observation-Anchored Latent Diffusion
summary: Triple set prediction (TSP) is to recover missing relational triples in a knowledge graph by predicting the triple set instead of isolated links. Existing approaches predominantly rely on the subgraph-based completion paradigm, where the original graph is first partitioned into local subgraphs which are then independently completed. Such a paradigm suffers from fragmented structural reasoning, limited cross subgraph dependency modeling, and missing predictions across subgraphs. This paper proposes LatentDiff, a novel unified latent generative framework for TSP, which reformulates knowledge graph completion as latent space graph generation. LatentDiff first learns a compact latent representation using a relation-aware residual-quantized knowledge graph autoencoder, which encodes the whole graph into relation-aware latent embeddings, quantizes them with chunked residual codebooks, and reconstructs triples through a factorized decoder. On top of this latent space, we introduce an observation-anchored latent graph diffusion model, where the target latent graph representation is perturbed toward the observed latent. The reverse process recovers missing triples through progressive latent denoising. Experiments on three benchmark datasets show that LatentDiff outperforms the SOTA in terms of F_{tsp} by 5.4 percentage points on average. Code: this https URL.

AI.tldr: 提出 LatentDiff，一个统一的潜在生成框架，将知识图谱中的三元组集合预测重构为潜在空间中的图生成，在三个基准数据集上 F_tsp 平均提升 5.4 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有三元组集合预测方法依赖子图补全，先把图划分为局部子图再独立补全，存在结构推理碎片化、跨子图依赖建模不足，以及子图之间的预测缺失等问题。
AI.method: 先用关系感知的残差量化知识图谱自编码器把整个图编码为潜在嵌入，经分块残差码本量化，并通过因子化解码器重建三元组；再在该潜在空间上构建观测锚定的潜在图扩散模型，使目标潜在图向观测到的潜在图扰动，反向过程通过渐进去噪恢复缺失的三元组。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上，LatentDiff 的 F_tsp 平均比当前最优方法高 5.4 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 把知识图谱补全统一为潜在空间中的生成问题，可避免子图划分带来的碎片化，从而改进三元组集合的恢复。

title: Uncertainty-Guided Cross-Modal Alignment for Diffusion-Based IoT Intrusion Detection
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS DynaFront 2026
summary: Diffusion models evolve noisy states toward a learned data distribution, so their sampling behavior depends on the geometry of the representation in which denoising occurs. This dependence is especially important for multimodal data: independently trained encoders can map synchronized views to incompatible latent regions, while uniform alignment can let an uncertain view distort the shared geometry. To address this gap, we introduce a novel reliability-guided alignment rule that uses normalized VAE posterior variance to control directional cross-modal influence before diffusion training. We study this issue in minority-attack generation for imbalanced Internet-of-Things intrusion detection. Tabular flow attributes, a DeepInsight image, and a packet sequence are encoded by modality-specific variational autoencoders. Per-modality normalized VAE posterior variances provide bounded, sample-specific weighting signals in an asymmetric stop-gradient alignment objective. We use these quantities as heuristic encoder-derived reliability proxies rather than calibrated probabilistic uncertainties. The full modality-specific latent means obtained after alignment fine-tuning are standardized and modeled jointly by a class-conditional EDM; a second-order sampler then generates paired attack-conditioned latent blocks for the three decoders. In controlled experiments on TON-IoT, uncertainty-aware alignment obtains the highest mean precision, recall, density, and coverage among three diffusion variants. Augmenting only the training split yields ROC-AUC 0.9515, PR-AUC 0.8954, balanced accuracy 0.8395, and attack-class F1 0.7940 on an untouched real test set. Among the two variants with matched alignment fine-tuning, posterior-variance-based weighting improves both tabular generative fidelity and downstream detection relative to uniform weighting.

AI.tldr: 提出基于可靠性引导的跨模态对齐规则，用归一化 VAE 后验方差控制扩散训练前的方向性跨模态影响，用于不平衡物联网入侵检测中的少数类攻击生成；在 TON-IoT 上，增强训练集后检测效果有所提升。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型的采样行为取决于去噪所在表示空间的几何结构；独立训练的多模态编码器可能把同步视图映射到不相容的潜在区域，而均匀对齐会让不确定的视图扭曲共享几何，这在少数类攻击生成中尤为重要。
AI.method: 三种模态（表格流量属性、DeepInsight 图像、数据包序列）分别由专用 VAE 编码；以各模态的归一化 VAE 后验方差作为有界的逐样本权重，用于非对称 stop-gradient 对齐目标；对齐微调后的潜在均值经标准化后由类条件 EDM 联合建模，二阶采样器生成成对的攻击条件潜在块，供三个解码器使用。作者强调这些方差是启发式的可靠性代理，而非校准的概率不确定性。
AI.result: 在 TON-IoT 的受控实验中，不确定性感知对齐在三种扩散变体中取得最高的平均精确率、召回率、density 与 coverage；仅增强训练划分时，在未参与训练的真实测试集上 ROC-AUC 为 0.9515，PR-AUC 为 0.8954，平衡准确率为 0.8395，攻击类 F1 为 0.7940；在两个对齐微调设置匹配的变体中，基于后验方差的加权优于均匀加权。
AI.conclusion: 基于可靠性的加权对齐能同时改善表格生成的保真度与下游检测，说明在扩散训练前控制跨模态影响对少数类攻击生成有实际价值。

title: Clean Sheets and Checkpoints: Evidence Complexity for Certifying Sequential Agent Risk
summary: Dangerous-capability evaluations often test an AI agent from prepared states at ordered milestones. A clean sheet records no successes. What it certifies about a campaign of $B$ attempts depends on what a failed attempt erases.
