We model the task as a chain of $k$ milestones divided into checkpoint segments and ask how many zero audit responses certify, at level $\alpha$, a completion probability of at most $\epsilon$. For segments chosen before the audit, counting possible completion windows gives a certificate for any specified budget. The bound also covers adaptive deployment processes that follow the chain's transitions, provided their success probabilities after every complete history are capped by the corresponding audit success probabilities. The audit does not test this transport assumption. In rare-risk phase interiors, each segment is either rarely completed within the budget (active) or nearly always completed (free). The minimum expected number of zero responses is asymptotic to $\log(1/\alpha)\,(B^a/(a!\,\epsilon))^{1/K_A}$, where the $a$ active segments contain $K_A$ milestones and are those at least as long as a budget-dependent threshold. The certificate attains this constant. Every asymptotically optimal evaluator must divide its expected response count equally among active milestones in the limit, with a vanishing share elsewhere. Where a single segment passes from active to free, each of its milestones receives a smaller limiting share than an active milestone; a crossover-aware certificate attains the optimal constant. For selected segments with known or unqueried prefix steps, counting failed cycles can sharpen the certificate.

AI.tldr: 研究如何用零成功的审计结果为智能体的危险能力风险提供认证：在里程碑链与检查点分段的模型下，给出以置信水平 alpha 证明完成概率不超过 epsilon 所需零响应数量的渐近最优常数。
AI.motivation: 危险能力评估通常从预设状态出发、在有序里程碑上测试智能体，零成功的“干净结果”究竟能证明什么，取决于失败尝试会抹去哪些进展；现有认证方法没有刻画这种依赖。
AI.method: 把任务建模为由 k 个里程碑组成、并划分为检查点段的链；对审计前确定的分段，通过计数可能的完成窗口给出认证；传输假设要求部署过程在每个完整历史之后的成功概率，不超过对应审计的成功概率；对活跃段与自由段做渐近分析，并讨论段间过渡情形下的 crossover 感知认证。
AI.result: 最小期望零响应数渐近于 log(1/alpha)(B^a/(a! epsilon))^(1/K_A)，其中 a 为活跃段数，K_A 为这些段包含的里程碑数；所给认证达到该常数；渐近最优的评估者应在活跃里程碑之间平均分配期望响应数，其余里程碑的份额趋于零；对从活跃过渡到自由的段，crossover 感知认证达到最优常数；对已知或未查询前缀步骤的选定段，计数失败循环可进一步改进认证。
AI.conclusion: 零成功结果能认证多大的风险，取决于评估设计以及失败尝试如何被遗忘；最优评估应把资源集中在活跃里程碑上，而传输假设本身无法由审计验证，需要审计之外的依据。

title: A Novel Approach to Evaluating Evaluation Metrics for Multi-Output Structured Prediction
comment: Extended version of the AAAI 2026 paper, including the technical appendix. 18 pages, 8 figures. Code: this https URL
summary: In multi-output structured prediction tasks, while only one ground truth label may be provided in the training data, multiple equally valid outputs may be possible, making reliable evaluation a persistent challenge. We postulate that human evaluators implicitly use task-specific invariants, e.g., object boundaries in colorized images or named entities in translations, to judge if an output is acceptable. Under this assumption, we introduce a notion of approximate task-specific invariants and use them as diagnostic tools to evaluate a variety of existing metrics for vision and language tasks. We use these task invariants as part of a framework to systematically test metric reliability by encouraging domain-relevant invariants in model outputs via an augmented loss function. In our experiments, we observe that enforcing invariants with an augmented loss yields substantial improvements in popular distributional metrics while more traditional metrics change only marginally. Through this invariants-driven evaluation, we expose where standard metrics fail to detect meaningful differences, and we highlight the conditions under which distributional metrics succeed or still fall short.

AI.tldr: 提出基于近似任务不变量的诊断框架，用于评估多输出结构化预测中的评估指标；通过增广损失强制不变量后，常用分布类指标明显改善，传统指标变化很小。
AI.motivation: 多输出结构化预测的训练数据通常只有一个真实标签，而多个输出都可能合理，因此可靠评估很困难；人类评估者似乎隐式地使用任务相关的不变量（如彩色化图像中的物体边界、翻译中的命名实体）来判断输出是否可接受。
AI.method: 引入近似任务特定不变量的概念，将其作为诊断工具评估视觉与语言任务中的多种现有指标；通过增广损失函数在模型输出中鼓励领域相关的不变量，从而系统检验指标的可靠性。
AI.result: 用增广损失强制不变量后，常用的分布类指标明显改善，而传统指标仅有微小变化；该框架揭示了标准指标在哪些情形下无法检测到有意义的差异，以及分布类指标何时成功、何时仍然不足。
AI.conclusion: 基于不变量的评估揭示了标准指标的失效之处，并说明了分布类指标的适用条件，为评估多输出结构化预测提供了新的诊断视角。

title: ACAM-J-MARS: Multi-Atlas Riemannian Spectral Representations for Decoding Advanced Meditation States from fMRI
summary: Inferring jhana-type advanced concentration absorption meditation (ACAM-J) states from fMRI data is challenging due to the spatially distributed nature of meditation-related effects, substantial inter-individual variability that can exceed within-subject state differences, and limited sample sizes. Conventional machine-learning approaches often formulate this problem as unimodal, Euclidean, atlas-based classification, thereby neglecting the non-Euclidean geometry of functional connectivity matrices and underrepresenting temporal information in functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI); these limitations can lead to suboptimal classification performance. We propose ACAM-J-MARS (\textbf{M}ulti-\textbf{A}tlas \textbf{R}iemannian \textbf{S}pectral representation), which computes functional connectivity using multiple atlases, represents symmetric positive definite (SPD) connectivity matrices on a Riemannian manifold, projects them into a log-Euclidean tangent space, and augments connectivity-derived features with low-frequency BOLD spectral energy to better resolve subtle state differences under heterogeneous variability. Evaluated on 204 segments from 22 practitioners, ACAM-J-MARS improves performance across multiple backbone models, achieving a balanced accuracy of 0.757 for early versus late ACAM-J classification and 0.545 for three-class classification, corresponding to a 10.8-point absolute improvement over the strongest baseline. These findings suggest that the proposed representation improves the decoding of advanced meditative brain states and may enable downstream applications such as closed-loop neurofeedback and real-time psychophysiological brain-computer interfaces.

AI.tldr: 提出 ACAM-J-MARS，用多图谱功能连接构建黎曼流形上的对称正定表示，并结合低频 BOLD 频谱能量，提升 jhana 类高级冥想状态的 fMRI 解码效果；在 204 个片段（22 名修行者）上，早期与晚期分类的平衡准确率为 0.757。
AI.motivation: 从 fMRI 推断 jhana 类高级冥想状态困难，因为相关效应在空间上分布广泛，个体间差异可能超过状态间差异，且样本量有限；传统的单模态、欧氏、基于单一图谱的分类忽略了功能连接矩阵的非欧几何，也低估了时间信息。
AI.method: 使用多个图谱计算功能连接，将对称正定连接矩阵表示在黎曼流形上，投影到 log-欧氏切空间，并将连接特征与低频 BOLD 频谱能量合并。
AI.result: 在 204 个片段、22 名修行者上，ACAM-J-MARS 在多个骨干模型上均有提升：早期与晚期 ACAM-J 分类的平衡准确率为 0.757，三分类为 0.545，较最强基线绝对提升 10.8 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 该表示有助于更好地解码高级冥想脑状态，并可能支持闭环神经反馈和实时心理生理脑机接口等下游应用。

title: Analyzing Condensation on Patterned Surfaces via Deep Learning
summary: Dropwise condensation is key to power and water systems. State-of-the-art condensation surfaces are often inhomogeneous, either patterned by design or random defects. Inhomogeneous surface features dictate the rates of each stage of dropwise condensation-nucleation, growth, coalescence, and shedding. Characterizing these rates requires the precise detection of thousands of droplets. Yet, existing segmentation methods are unable to detect droplets on inhomogeneous surfaces. We developed TileSAM3, a universal droplet segmentation tool built on the Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3). Hierarchical tiling with per-tile inference followed by post-processing extended SAM3's detection cap and raised the effective resolution of small droplets. We created two datasets: High Quality Droplet Dataset (N=365,826; HQDD) with homogeneous surfaces and Low Quality Droplet Dataset (N=63,577; LQDD) with patterned, defect-laden surfaces under adverse lighting. TileSAM3 closely reproduced thresholding annotations on HQDD, surpassed it over sixfold on LQDD (Average Precision 0.57 versus 0.088), and outperformed other deep learning models on all metrics evaluated. Combined with KD-tree tracking, TileSAM3 identified localized nucleation and coalescence in narrow active bands on a stiffness-patterned surface. TileSAM3 enables analysis of understudied inhomogeneous substrates with poor lighting and videography which facilitates faster, lower cost research of condensation materials.

AI.tldr: 提出基于 SAM3 的通用液滴分割工具 TileSAM3，通过分层分块推理与后处理，在非均匀表面的冷凝液滴分割上远超阈值法，并可结合 KD 树跟踪分析成核与合并过程。
AI.motivation: 现代冷凝表面常不均匀（人为图案或随机缺陷），现有分割方法难以在此类表面上检测液滴；而成核、生长、合并与脱落的速率需要精确检测成千上万个液滴才能表征。
AI.method: 基于 Segment Anything Model 3（SAM3）构建 TileSAM3，采用分层分块、逐块推理并结合后处理，以突破 SAM3 的检测数量上限并提高小液滴的有效分辨率；构建了高质量液滴数据集 HQDD（365,826 个样本，均匀表面）和低质量液滴数据集 LQDD（63,577 个样本，图案化、带缺陷且光照不佳）；并结合 KD 树跟踪。
AI.result: 在 HQDD 上，TileSAM3 基本复现阈值法标注；在 LQDD 上平均精度为 0.57，阈值法为 0.088，超过六倍；在所评估的全部指标上优于其他深度学习模型；在具有刚度图案的表面上，识别出狭窄活跃带中的局部成核与合并。
AI.conclusion: TileSAM3 使光照差、图案化且存在缺陷的非均匀基底也可进行分析，有助于更快、更低成本地研究冷凝材料。

title: Sparse Autoencoders as Implicit Diversification Regularisers for Cross-Sectional Cryptocurrency Returns
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the 7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance (ICAIF '26)
summary: Factor models are central to asset pricing and portfolio construction, but neural factors are often difficult to interpret, and their effect on portfolio risk is unclear. A sparse autoencoder (SAE) may address both concerns by describing daily returns across many assets with only a few active features. We ask whether this sparse representation produces stable financial factors and better-diversified portfolios. We study cryptocurrency returns, use equities as a secondary test, and compare the SAE with common benchmarks in a time-ordered evaluation. We find consistently lower volatility in SAE portfolios and link this result to lower correlations among the selected assets. However, the SAE does not outperform a simple contrarian strategy on risk-adjusted return, and its factor identities are not stable across training runs. Our contribution is to show that sparse coding can support portfolio diversification, while clearly separating this risk effect from claims about alpha or stable factor identities.

AI.tldr: 研究稀疏自编码器（SAE）用于加密货币截面收益的因子建模与组合构建，发现其组合波动率更低、所选资产间相关性更低，但风险调整收益并不优于简单的反向策略，且因子身份在不同训练运行间不稳定。
AI.motivation: 资产定价与组合构建中的神经因子难以解释，其对组合风险的影响也不清楚；稀疏自编码器有望同时带来可解释性与更好的分散化。
AI.method: 用 SAE 以少量活跃特征描述大量资产的日收益；以加密货币收益为主要研究对象、股票为次要检验；在按时间顺序的评估中与常见基准比较。
AI.result: SAE 组合的波动率持续较低，并与所选资产间较低的相关性有关；但 SAE 在风险调整收益上不优于简单的反向策略，其因子身份在不同训练运行间也不稳定。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏编码可以支持组合分散化，但这一风险效应应与关于超额收益（alpha）或稳定因子身份的主张明确区分。

title: Where Position Matters: Profiling-Guided Layer-Wise RoPE Allocation in Transformers
summary: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) typically uses uniform coverage across Transformer layers despite heterogeneous positional requirements. Phase-off interventions reveal non-uniform, model-specific rotary-phase dependence, while coverage interventions relate it to coverage-upgrade benefits. We propose profiling-guided layer-wise RoPE allocation, assigning high/low coverage under a fixed budget using early coverage-benefit profiles. The framework supports fixed-width query/key representations and physical rotary-dimension allocation in Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA). Normalized-depth mapping transfers profiles within model families, enabling small-model measurements to guide larger-model allocations before pretraining. A brief analysis relates selection and transfer to score calibration and inter-layer interactions. From-scratch experiments demonstrate validation-loss improvements over available budget-matched baselines, while analytical resource accounting identifies favorable quality--storage--compute trade-offs for physical MLA. These results connect positional demand to transferable, efficient architecture design.

AI.tldr: 提出基于剖析的逐层 RoPE 分配方法，依据早期覆盖收益剖析，在固定预算下为各层分配高或低的覆盖率；从头训练的实验显示，相对预算匹配的基线，验证损失有所改进。
AI.motivation: RoPE 通常在所有层采用统一覆盖，但不同层对位置信息的需求并不相同；相位关闭干预显示旋转相位依赖是非均匀且与模型相关的，覆盖干预则与覆盖升级的收益相关。
AI.method: 依据早期覆盖收益剖析，为各层分配高或低覆盖；支持固定宽度的查询/键表示，以及多头潜在注意力（MLA）中的物理旋转维度分配；通过归一化深度映射在模型族内迁移剖析结果，使小模型的测量可在预训练前指导大模型的分配。
AI.result: 从头训练的实验显示相对预算匹配基线的验证损失改进；解析的资源核算表明，对于物理 MLA，该方法具有有利的质量、存储与计算权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将位置需求与可迁移、高效的架构设计联系起来，可在预训练前利用小模型的剖析结果配置大模型的 RoPE 分配。

title: IMRouter: Imbalance-aware Temporal Pattern Routing for LLM-based Time Series Forecasting
summary: Accurate time series forecasting (TSF) is essential for Web applications, such as traffic monitoring and online resource management. Recent advances in leveraging pre-trained large language models (LLMs) have shown promising performance in TSF. However, existing LLM-based TSF methods largely optimize the overall forecasting objective while overlooking temporal pattern imbalance (TPI), where different temporal patterns occur at highly unequal frequencies. Our empirical analysis reveals that TPI is prevalent across widely used TSF benchmarks, with substantially higher forecasting errors on less frequent patterns. To address this issue, we propose IMRouter (Imbalance-aware Temporal Pattern Routing), a novel framework that mitigates TPI-induced biases in both temporal representation learning and cross-modal alignment. Specifically, IMRouter introduces Pattern-Adaptive Temporal Representation Learning (PATR), which leverages gradient conflict and local gradient density to guide expert specialization. By penalizing incompatible expert assignments with density-aware weighting, PATR reduces the dominance of frequent optimization signals in router training. Furthermore, Routing-Guided Semantic Alignment (RGSA) transfers the pattern-specific knowledge learned by the router to cross-modal alignment through mutual information maximization, preserving distinctive temporal information across different patterns. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of IMRouter, particularly in improving forecasting performance on less frequent temporal patterns.

AI.tldr: 提出 IMRouter，一个面向 LLM 时间序列预测的、感知不平衡的时序模式路由框架，缓解低频时序模式上的预测偏差，在低频模式上的预测性能尤为提升。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的预测方法主要优化整体预测目标，忽视了时序模式不平衡（TPI）：不同时序模式出现的频率极不均衡，而在广泛使用的基准上，低频模式的预测误差显著更高。
AI.method: 提出模式自适应时序表示学习（PATR），利用梯度冲突与局部梯度密度引导专家专门化，并以密度感知加权惩罚不兼容的专家分配，减弱频繁信号在路由器训练中的主导作用；提出路由引导的语义对齐（RGSA），通过互信息最大化把路由器学到的模式特定知识迁移到跨模态对齐中。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明 IMRouter 有效，尤其是在低频时序模式上的预测性能有所提升。
AI.conclusion: 针对时序模式不平衡进行路由与对齐，可以改善 LLM 时间序列预测在少见模式上的表现。

title: Strongly Adaptive Online Learning Achieves Uniform Discounted Regret
summary: Discounted regret measures the performance of an online learner by assigning exponentially decaying weights to past losses, reflecting the greater importance of recent losses in non-stationary online learning. While previous work obtains uniform discounted regret bounds over a continuous range of discount factors using a specialized meta-algorithm, its results are limited to convex functions. In this paper, we demonstrate that strongly adaptive regret bounds can directly imply uniform discounted regret guarantees for convex, strongly convex, and exp-concave loss functions. Our key observation is that discounted regret against a fixed comparator admits an exact decomposition into a convex combination of interval regrets. For convex functions, this reduction yields an $O(\sqrt{\log T/(1-\lambda)})$ discounted regret bound for all discount factors $\lambda\in(0,1)$, matching the previous rate over a broader range of discount factors. For strongly convex and exp-concave functions, we provide regret bounds of $O\left(\log T\left(1+\log\frac{1}{1-\lambda}\right)\right)$.

AI.tldr: 证明强自适应遗憾界可直接推出对凸、强凸和 exp-concave 损失的一致折扣遗憾保证，覆盖所有折扣因子，并给出相应的速率。
AI.motivation: 先前工作仅用专门的元算法在连续范围的折扣因子上得到一致折扣遗憾界，且结果局限于凸函数；本文希望把这类保证推广到更广的损失函数类。
AI.method: 关键观察是：对固定比较器的折扣遗憾可以精确分解为区间遗憾的凸组合，从而把强自适应遗憾界转化为折扣遗憾界。
AI.result: 对凸函数，得到对所有折扣因子 lambda 属于 (0,1) 的 O(sqrt(log T/(1-lambda))) 折扣遗憾界，速率与先前结果一致但覆盖更宽的折扣因子范围；对强凸与 exp-concave 函数，给出 O(log T (1+log(1/(1-lambda))))。
AI.conclusion: 强自适应遗憾与折扣遗憾之间的精确分解使后者可以直接由前者得到，从而在非平稳在线学习中统一覆盖更多损失函数与折扣因子。

title: There Is No Free Lunch in RLVR: Every pass@1 Gain Has a pass@k Price
comment: 19 pages, 4 figures. Code and verification package (34/34 automated checks): this https URL
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) makes a language model solve more problems on the first try and fewer when given many tries: it raises pass@1 while the base model overtakes it at large sampling budget k. Is this a failure of RL to add reasoning, or a transient that more training removes? We settle the question with a theorem. The reversal is a price, and we compute its exact rate. Modeling RLVR as an exponential tilt of a base policy over strategies shared across prompts, we prove that under exclusive specialization every update that raises pass@1 strictly lowers the success of some prompt; a strictly positive price on prompts (Stiemke duality) is the exact condition, and being merely the best strategy on a prompt is provably not enough. When the loss reaches the hardest prompts, it forces a pass@k crossover, and the number of crossings is at most the sign variation of the shift in per-prompt success, a totally positive bound that is tight and that recovers the known single-crossover result as its order-preserving case. The crossover is not a bug to patch: a constrained update traces the exact pass@1 versus pass@k frontier, and removing the crossover entirely costs the entire pass@1 gain. The same tilt identity yields entropy collapse and the entropy-performance law with an identifiable exponent, unifying two literatures under one mechanism. Reinforcement cannot widen the reasoning frontier; it can only move along it, at a price we make measurable by a diagnostic that reads the bound, the order-preserving test, and the price from any evaluation log. There is no free lunch, only a price.

AI.tldr: 本文证明在RLVR中，每一次提高pass@1的更新都会降低某些提示上的成功率，因此pass@1与pass@k之间必然出现交叉，并给出该代价的精确刻画。
AI.motivation: 已有观察表明RLVR提升了pass@1，但在大采样预算k下会被基模型超越；尚不清楚这是RL未能增加推理能力，还是可以通过更多训练消除的暂时现象。
AI.method: 将RLVR建模为基策略在跨提示共享策略上的指数倾斜（exponential tilt），在独占专门化假设下，用Stiemke对偶给出每提示正价格这一精确条件；交叉次数的上界由每提示成功率变化的符号变差决定；并通过约束更新追踪pass@1与pass@k的精确前沿，同时统一解释熵崩溃与熵-性能规律。
AI.result: 任何严格提高pass@1的更新都会降低某些提示的成功率；当损失触及最难的提示时必然出现pass@k交叉；交叉次数上界紧致，并包含已知的单次交叉结果作为保序情形；消除交叉会损失全部pass@1收益。论文还给出可从任意评估日志中读取界、保序检验和代价的诊断方法。
AI.conclusion: RL只能沿已有推理前沿移动而无法拓宽它，pass@1的提升需要付出可度量的pass@k代价，这为理解和诊断RLVR的效果提供了理论依据。

title: Multi-Solution Inverse Design of Pixelated Patch Antennas Using an Autoregressive Transformer
summary: Deep-learning-based inverse design has emerged as a promising framework for pixelated patch antenna synthesis by enabling broader exploration of discrete geometry spaces and reducing design time compared with conventional template-based methods. Existing methods, including surrogate-assisted metaheuristic optimization, tandem inverse networks, and diffusion models, have advanced the field but still face practical limitations. Metaheuristic methods such as binary particle swarm optimization (BPSO) are sensitive to initialization and search hyperparameters and are often time-consuming, tandem networks have difficulty capturing the one-to-many nature of inverse antenna design, and diffusion models may require excessive complexity and data for moderate-scale binary layout synthesis. In this paper, an autoregressive (AR) transformer is presented for the inverse design of 10 x 10 pixelated patch antennas. Its sequential discrete generation process enables the synthesis of multiple feasible structures for a given target response. The pretrained model is further fine-tuned for dual-band design using step-shaped target responses with sharp spectral transitions, allowing intuitive band specification without manually constructing detailed S11 curves. Compared with BPSO, our proposed method generates valid and diverse antenna candidates more efficiently. Fabricated and measured examples confirm that distinct pixelated layouts can realize the desired antenna responses, thereby demonstrating the multi-solution capability of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 提出一种自回归Transformer，用于10×10像素化贴片天线的逆向设计，可为同一目标响应生成多个可行结构，并通过微调实现双频设计。
AI.motivation: 基于BPSO的元启发式方法对初始化和超参数敏感且耗时；串联逆向网络难以刻画天线设计中的一对多关系；扩散模型对中等规模的二值版图合成可能过于复杂且需要大量数据。
AI.method: 利用自回归Transformer的序列离散生成过程；先进行预训练，再针对双频设计，用带有陡峭频谱过渡的阶跃形目标响应进行微调，无需人工构造详细的S11曲线。
AI.result: 与BPSO相比，该方法能更高效地生成有效且多样的天线候选；制作并测量的样例证实，不同的像素版图可以实现所需的天线响应。
AI.conclusion: 该框架展示了多解能力，为像素化天线的高效、多解逆向设计提供了可行途径。

title: Learning to Bound: Monotonic, Calibrated Neural Upper Bounds for MPE Inference
summary: Probabilistic graphical models (PGMs) compactly encode structured joint distributions, but Most Probable Explanation (MPE), which finds the highest-probability assignment to unobserved variables, remains computationally intractable in large, densely structured models. Anytime systematic search, such as branch-and-bound (B&B), is a popular approach, but its efficiency depends on tight admissible upper bounds that are often prohibitively expensive to compute using classical methods like Mini-Bucket Elimination (MBE). We introduce Learning to Bound (L2B), a data-driven framework that amortizes bound computation cost by training a neural predictor. L2B targets two key properties required for effective search bounds: admissibility, which is achieved via statistical calibration techniques, and progressive tightening as evidence accumulates, which is enforced through structural architectural constraints that ensure monotonicity by construction. Across challenging benchmarks, L2B delivers tighter, monotonic bounds at orders-of-magnitude lower cost on every PGM family, and yields measurable improvements when integrated with branch-and-bound on high-treewidth instances.

AI.tldr: 提出L2B（Learning to Bound），用神经预测器摊销MPE推断中分支定界所需的上界计算，得到可容许且随证据积累单调收紧的界。
AI.motivation: MPE在大型密集结构的图模型中计算困难；分支定界的效率依赖紧的可容许上界，而经典方法（如Mini-Bucket Elimination）计算代价过高。
AI.method: 训练神经网络预测器输出上界；通过统计校准技术保证可容许性，并通过结构化的架构约束在构造上保证单调性。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，L2B在每一类PGM上都以数量级更低的代价给出更紧且单调的界；与高树宽实例上的分支定界结合时带来可测的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 数据驱动的界学习能在保持可容许性的同时显著降低上界计算成本，使分支定界在高树宽模型上更具实用性。

title: TaxoMFM: A Taxonomy-Aware Foundation Model for the Human Gut Microbiome
summary: Existing gut microbiome foundation models typically use flat taxon representations, limiting their ability to exploit known taxonomic hierarchies. We introduce TaxoMFM, a microbiome foundation model that integrates taxonomic structure into self-supervised learning. TaxoMFM jointly learns abundance patterns across taxonomic ranks and relative proportions within groups through taxonomy-aware encoding and hierarchical compositional reconstruction. We further construct TaxoGut-HPP, comprising 100,806 gut microbiome profiles from 231 source cohorts and covering 40 classification and 8 regression tasks. TaxoMFM achieves competitive performance across disease, gut health, host trait, and liver ultrasound phenotype prediction. In cross-cohort zero-shot transfer, where target cohorts are excluded from both pretraining and downstream adaptation, TaxoMFM achieves AUROCs of 0.838, 0.736, and 0.722 for colorectal cancer, type 2 diabetes, and inflammatory bowel disease, respectively. Further analyses show that TaxoMFM recovers community changes across taxonomic scales, while preserving community information and producing consistent representations under database updates and species-vocabulary shifts. Our code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 提出TaxoMFM，一种将分类学结构融入自监督学习的人类肠道微生物组基础模型，并构建了包含100,806个样本的TaxoGut-HPP数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有肠道微生物组基础模型多使用扁平的分类单元表示，无法充分利用已知的分类层级结构。
AI.method: 通过分类感知编码和层级组合重建，联合学习各分类层级上的丰度模式以及组内相对比例；构建的TaxoGut-HPP覆盖231个来源队列、40个分类任务和8个回归任务。
AI.result: 在疾病、肠道健康、宿主特征和肝脏超声表型预测上性能具有竞争力；在跨队列零样本迁移中（目标队列未参与预训练和下游适应），结直肠癌、2型糖尿病和炎症性肠病的AUROC分别为0.838、0.736和0.722；模型能在不同分类尺度上还原群落变化，并在数据库更新和物种词表变化下保持表示的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 将分类层级显式纳入表示能够提升微生物组模型的泛化与跨队列迁移能力，并对数据库变动具有稳健性。

title: Class-aware Latent Attention Replay (CLAR): Class Incremental Hazard Diagnosis for Resilient AI in the Manufacturing Industrial Internet
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems provide critical computation services in the Manufacturing Industrial Internet (MII), and their resilience depends on timely diagnosis of hazards across the data, AI pipeline, and cyber-physical layers. During operation, new hazard types keep emerging with only a few samples each, hazards co-occur, and the diagnosis model runs on memory-constrained computation nodes. Replay-based class-incremental learning (CIL) can learn new hazard classes while revisiting a small memory of past samples, but existing methods assume single-label, balanced streams, store high-dimensional raw samples, and select them independently of the classifier. We propose Class-aware Latent Attention Replay (CLAR), which combines a dual buffer that stores mostly compact latent representations with a few raw samples, an Attention Leverage Score (ALS) that upper-bounds the classifier logit and guides class-balanced reservoir sampling, and an exponential-moving-average teacher that slows latent-space drift. For an idealized buffer model, we prove that the buffer is class-balanced and follows an ALS-weighted class distribution, and that below a critical per-class capacity, ALS-guided replay has a lower replay-gradient error than class-balanced uniform replay. In the case study, On hazard diagnosis data from an MII testbed, CLAR achieves the highest mean average weighted F1 score among the evaluated replay methods with the same buffer size

AI.tldr: 提出CLAR，一种面向制造工业互联网中新出现危险类别诊断的类增量回放方法，结合潜在表示缓冲区、注意力杠杆分数采样和EMA教师，以缓解潜在空间漂移。
AI.motivation: 现有回放式类增量学习假设单标签、类别均衡的数据流，并需存储高维原始样本，且样本选择独立于分类器；而在MII中，危险类型不断出现且每类样本稀少、危险还可能共现，诊断模型又需运行在内存受限的节点上。
AI.method: 双缓冲区主要存储紧凑的潜在表示，并保留少量原始样本；注意力杠杆分数（ALS）作为分类器logit的上界，用于指导类别均衡的蓄水池采样；指数移动平均教师用于减缓潜在空间漂移。对理想化缓冲模型，论文证明缓冲区类别均衡且服从ALS加权的类别分布，并证明在临界的每类容量以下，ALS引导的回放比类别均衡的均匀回放具有更低的回放梯度误差。
AI.result: 在MII测试平台的危险诊断数据上，相同缓冲区大小下，CLAR在所评估的回放方法中取得最高的平均加权F1分数。
AI.conclusion: 结合潜在表示与分类器感知采样的回放策略，可以在有限内存下更有效地支持工业场景中的危险类别增量诊断。

title: RetroChessBench: A Benchmark for Reconstructing and Proving Chess Histories
comment: 22 pages, 2 figures. Benchmark and RL environment: this https URL
summary: Frontier language models such as GPT 6 Astra have contributed to research mathematics, demonstrating substantial reasoning capabilities. Yet serious reasoning failures persist even in tasks governed by explicit rules. We demonstrate this in retrograde chess which is a playground for pure reasoning, where solvers reconstruct legal histories and distinguish possible events from forced ones. We introduce RetroChessBench, a 12-task benchmark covering exact-length constructions, unique endings, and exhaustive answer sets, with references, rubrics, and a terminal-reward environment. In two trials per task and condition, GPT 6 Astra High fails to produce the required final answer in 22/24 attempts without tools and 18/24 with code execution; mean terminal RL rewards are 14.75% and 27.19%, respectively. The examples identify faulty deductions: failed responses reject legal histories and treat temporary obstructions as permanent. Online retrograde archives often provide puzzles and final move sequences without detailed derivations. We hypothesize that limited exposure to these missing explanations in web-derived training data contributes to the observed reasoning failures. This questions how far frontier mathematical reasoning really generalizes beyond familiar solution patterns. Claims of general intelligence require evidence that models can transfer learnt principles to areas with few worked examples.

AI.tldr: 提出包含12个任务的逆向国际象棋基准RetroChessBench，用于重建并证明棋局历史；前沿模型GPT 6 Astra High在该基准上表现很差。
AI.motivation: 即使在规则明确的任务中，前沿语言模型仍存在严重的推理失败；逆向国际象棋是纯推理的测试场景，而网络上的逆向棋资料通常只提供谜题和最终走法，缺少详细推导。
AI.method: 基准覆盖精确长度构造、唯一残局和穷举答案集，并附带参考答案、评分标准和终端奖励环境；每个任务和条件进行两次试验，分别比较无工具和代码执行两种设置。
AI.result: GPT 6 Astra High在无工具设置下24次尝试中有22次未能给出所需的最终答案，有代码执行时24次中有18次未能给出；平均终端RL奖励分别为14.75%和27.19%。失败样例显示模型会拒绝合法历史，并把暂时性阻碍当作永久性阻碍。
AI.conclusion: 作者推测，网络训练数据中缺少详细解释是推理失败的部分原因，这对前沿模型的数学推理能否泛化到熟悉的解法模式之外提出了质疑。

title: MulClip: A table-free activation function with monotonic and folding regimes for reservoir computing on microcontrollers
comment: 15 pages (7 pages main text, 8 pages appendices), 2 figures
summary: This letter proposes MulClip, a lightweight activation function for reservoir computing (RC) on microcontrollers (MCUs). In a ring reservoir, a representative sparse RC topology, multiply-accumulate operations are few, and evaluating tanh accounted for 75% of the state-update time on a Cortex-M4. MulClip introduces curvature into the response using only comparison, absolute value, multiplication, and subtraction, and places its clipping threshold not at the extremum but at the point where the response returns to zero after passing the extremum. As a result, a single function has both a monotonic regime and a nonmonotonic folding regime that increases the expressiveness of a single unit. Which regime is used is determined by the usual hyperparameter search, e.g., over the input scale, so no task-specific threshold tuning is required. The state-update time measured on hardware was 0.34 times that of tanh and shorter than that of any of the 11 evaluated tanh approximations. In PC-based evaluation, third-order MulClip achieved a 22% lower NMSE than tanh on NARMA-20, where the pre-activations remained in the monotonic regime, and on 8-bit parity it raised the accuracy from 0.76-0.78 for the monotonic-clip variant without folding to 0.97-0.98. For these two tasks, on-device inference yielded nearly the same values as on the PC.

AI.tldr: 提出MulClip，一种无需查表、仅用比较、绝对值、乘法和减法实现的激活函数，兼具单调区与折叠区两种响应，用于微控制器上的储备池计算。
AI.motivation: 在Cortex-M4上，储备池的状态更新中tanh求值占用了75%的时间，而现有的各类tanh近似仍不够快。
AI.method: 在响应中引入曲率，并将截断阈值设在响应越过极值后回到零的点，使同一函数同时具有单调区和非单调的折叠区；所用区间由常规超参数搜索（如输入尺度）决定，无需针对任务调节阈值。
AI.result: 硬件上的状态更新时间为tanh的0.34倍，快于所评估的11种tanh近似；在PC上，三阶MulClip在NARMA-20上（预激活保持在单调区）的NMSE比tanh低22%；在8位奇偶校验任务上，将仅有单调截断的变体的准确率从0.76-0.78提升到0.97-0.98；这两项任务的设备端推理结果与PC上几乎一致。
AI.conclusion: MulClip以很低的计算代价提升了单个单元的表达能力，为资源受限设备上的储备池计算提供了一种实用的激活函数。

title: More Is Better? Exploring Latent Correspondence in Federated Hypergraph Learning
summary: Federated hypergraph learning with latent cross-client hyperedge correspondence poses fundamental identifiability and computational challenges, as the same local release can correspond to multiple global hypergraph structures. We characterize the tractability of recovering these latent correspondences, showing tractable pairwise assignment but generally intractable multi-client hyperedge matching. Building on this characterization, we derive a cross-entropy decomposition that reveals when local prediction can outperform predictors fitted with additional cross-client information. Motivated by this principle, we introduce Federated Adaptive Spectral Training with Representation Alignment (FedASTRA), which learns correspondence-invariant diffusion representations through adaptive heat diffusion and masked latent prediction while communicating model parameters only. We establish its asymptotic optimality with respect to the permitted local information and prove global population-risk convergence under explicit conditions on recovery, representation, and update alignment. Experiments on eight real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of FedASTRA against identifier-free federated graph and hypergraph methods. On ogbn-papers100M, FedASTRA reaches the performance-communication Pareto frontier, achieving 50.07 Accuracy and 29.73 Macro-F1 while communicating only 59.60 MiB per round.

AI.tldr: 分析联邦超图学习中跨客户端超边对应关系的可辨识性与计算难度，并提出只通信模型参数的FedASTRA方法，在八个真实数据集上取得有竞争力的结果。
AI.motivation: 跨客户端的超边对应是隐变量，同一份本地发布可能对应多个全局超图结构，由此带来可辨识性和计算上的困难。
AI.method: 证明成对分配是可解的，而多客户端超边匹配一般不可解；推导交叉熵分解，刻画在何种条件下仅用本地信息的预测可以优于使用额外跨客户端信息的预测器；提出FedASTRA，通过自适应热扩散和掩码潜在预测学习对应不变的扩散表示。
AI.result: 在八个真实数据集上优于不依赖标识符的联邦图与超图方法；在ogbn-papers100M上达到性能-通信的帕累托前沿，准确率50.07、Macro-F1 29.73，每轮仅通信59.60 MiB；论文还证明了相对于允许的本地信息的渐近最优性，并在恢复、表示和更新对齐条件下给出全局总体风险的收敛性。
AI.conclusion: 在通信受限的联邦超图场景中，即使不显式恢复跨客户端对应，也能进行有效学习，而且在某些情况下本地信息已经足够。

title: Safe Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning: Zero Constraint Violation and Primal-Averaging Convergence
summary: Many applications of multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) require policies that balance conflicting objectives while satisfying safety constraints. We study safe MORL with zero constraint violation throughout learning, covering both cumulative and stepwise constraints. A key challenge is to explore sufficiently under unknown dynamics and constraint costs without violating the constraints. For a given preference over objectives, we develop an algorithm to learn a safe Pareto optimal policy by combining optimistic reward estimates with pessimistic cost bounds. With high probability, every policy executed over $T$ episodes incurs zero constraint violation. The algorithm returns a safe Markov policy induced by the averaged occupancy measure and achieves an $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ suboptimality gap under smooth Tchebycheff scalarization. We further develop a preference-free algorithm that first explores safely without a prespecified preference and then computes a safe policy for any given preference without further interaction. Over $T$ exploration episodes and $K$ planning iterations, it retains the same safety guarantee and achieves an $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrt{T}+1/\sqrt{K})$ suboptimality gap. Both algorithms require knowledge of a policy that strictly satisfies the constraints and its costs. We then relax these requirements, incurring at most constant cumulative violation. To our knowledge, we provide the first sample-efficient MORL algorithms that guarantee safety for every executed policy.

AI.tldr: 提出零约束违反的安全多目标强化学习算法，保证学习全过程中每个执行的策略都满足安全约束，并给出次优性界。
AI.motivation: 多目标强化学习的许多应用需要在平衡冲突目标的同时满足安全约束；在动态和约束代价未知的情况下，如何在不违反约束的前提下充分探索是关键难点。
AI.method: 对给定偏好，结合乐观的奖励估计与悲观的代价界来学习安全的帕累托最优策略，同时适用于累积约束和逐步约束；另提出无需预设偏好的算法，先安全探索，再为任意偏好规划安全策略；放宽对严格可行策略的要求后，只允许至多常数的累积违反。
AI.result: 以高概率，T个回合中执行的每个策略都不产生约束违反；在平滑Tchebycheff标量化下，次优性差距为O~(1/sqrt(T))；无偏好算法在T个探索回合和K次规划迭代下，次优性差距为O~(1/sqrt(T)+1/sqrt(K))。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出了首批对每个执行策略都保证安全的样本高效多目标强化学习算法，但基础版本仍需已知严格满足约束的策略及其代价。

title: Dobb: Shard-Local Preconditioning in Block-Diagonal Eigenbases
summary: Training language models whose parameters and optimizer state exceed a single node's memory requires sharding these tensors across devices. Under tensor parallelism (TP) or fully sharded data parallelism (FSDP), matrix-aware optimizers such as Muon introduce communication to perform global matrix operations across shards. We propose Dobb (Distributed Optimizer with Block-diagonal Eigenbases), a matrix-aware optimizer designed to compute updates locally within parameter shards. Dobb approximates the input-activation second moment with diagonal blocks and tracks a complete basis within each block. It projects momentum into these bases, applies sign normalization to the coefficients, and reconstructs the update. When each block lies within one shard under TP or FSDP, Dobb applies its matrix update locally, requiring no communication beyond data-parallel synchronization of the activation second moments. We benchmark Dobb against Dion, a distributed matrix-aware optimizer designed to retain the benefits of orthonormalized updates while reducing communication. On GPT-2 XL (1.56B parameters), Dobb with 16 blocks reaches a validation loss of 2.476, compared with 2.511 for Dion at rank fraction 1/16. Under FSDP on 32 H100 GPUs, Dobb reduces the amortized optimizer-call time from 124.1 ms for Dion to 9.2 ms.

AI.tldr: 提出Dobb，一种在块对角特征基中计算更新、可在参数分片内本地运行的分布式矩阵感知优化器，在张量并行和FSDP下减少通信。
AI.motivation: Muon等矩阵感知优化器在张量并行或FSDP下需要跨分片的全局矩阵运算，从而引入额外通信。
AI.method: 用对角块近似输入激活的二阶矩，并在每个块内维护完整的基；将动量投影到这些基上，对系数做符号归一化后重建更新；当每个块位于单个分片内时，除激活二阶矩的数据并行同步外无需额外通信。
AI.result: 在GPT-2 XL（1.56B参数）上，使用16个块的Dobb验证损失为2.476，而Dion（秩比例1/16）为2.511；在32块H100上采用FSDP时，优化器调用的摊销时间由Dion的124.1 ms降至9.2 ms。
AI.conclusion: 局部化的矩阵感知更新可以在保持良好优化效果的同时，大幅降低分布式训练中的优化器通信和时间开销。

title: Accuracy is not compatibility: two Evo 2 checkpoints hinge on one FP8 matrix multiplication
comment: 18 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Data: this https URL ; code: this https URL
summary: FP8 formats specify how values are stored, not how products are summed; this gap can break checkpoints. Evo 2, a DNA language model, documents a Hopper FP8 requirement for its 1B and 40B checkpoints. On two Blackwell (sm_120) GPUs both fail the developers' forward test (the 7B passes); on an RTX 5070 Ti the 40B's next-base accuracy is 25.7%, near guessing. Greater accuracy breaks them, as BioNeMo saw for the 40B on Hopper: natively, 99.996% of one projection's outputs are correctly rounded (H100: about 30%), and fp32 accumulation of the same operands fails. Our H100 FP8 GEMM emulator, mmaemu (bit-exact on captured 1B projections), localises the dependence to the 1B's first projection (of 21), where exact sums fail but pass when shrunk by the H100's 1.4% (measured in-sample), not 2.1%. The 40B fails with only its first projection native. Emulating only that projection, weights unchanged, raises 40B BRCA1 variant-classification AUROC from 0.434 to 0.869 (H100: 0.868) on the RTX 5070 Ti, despite a narrow forward-test miss, and 0.481 to 0.867 on an RTX PRO 6000. We tested one model family but not training origin; releases should specify reference arithmetic.

AI.tldr: 揭示Evo 2的两个FP8检查点对FP8矩阵乘法的求和方式高度敏感：更精确的累加反而会使其失效，仅改变一个投影的计算即可恢复BRCA1变异分类性能。
AI.motivation: FP8格式只规定数值如何存储，不规定乘积如何求和，这一差距可能导致检查点在不同硬件上失效；Evo 2官方只记录了Hopper上的FP8要求。
AI.method: 在两块Blackwell（sm_120）GPU和RTX 5070 Ti上测试；提出H100 FP8 GEMM模拟器mmaemu，在捕获的1B投影上做到位精确；将依赖性定位到1B模型的第一个投影（共21个），并仅对40B模型的该投影进行模拟，权重保持不变。
AI.result: 两个检查点在Blackwell上的前向测试均失败（7B通过）；在RTX 5070 Ti上，40B的下一碱基准确率为25.7%，接近随机猜测；原生计算时，一个投影的输出中99.996%被正确舍入（H100上约为30%）。仅模拟该投影后，在RTX 5070 Ti上40B的BRCA1变异分类AUROC从0.434升至0.869（H100上为0.868），在RTX PRO 6000上从0.481升至0.867。
AI.conclusion: 数值格式兼容并不等于精度高，模型发布应明确说明参考算术规范；该研究只测试了一个模型家族，尚未检验训练来源的影响。

title: LinQuant: Functional Invariances for Low-Precision Linear Recurrences
comment: 35 pages, 16 figures. Code: this https URL
summary: Linear recurrences are emerging as practical alternatives to softmax attention in large language models, appearing in both standalone and hybrid architectures. However, despite their rapid emergence, low-precision inference remains much less developed for these models than for softmax attention. During prefill, chunkwise-parallel algorithms cast much of the recurrence as dense matrix multiplications, suggesting a natural path to low-precision execution. Simply quantizing these operations in their native form, however, can be fragile. In this work, we identify functional invariances that preserve the full-precision computation while making the operands more amenable to quantization. Building on this observation, we introduce LinQuant, a framework for low-precision recurrent prefill based on seven such invariances, including rotations, diagonal rescalings, and alternative placements of recurrent decay and write factors. We derive when these transformations remain valid across common recurrence families spanning linear, gated, and delta-rule updates, and show that they provide complementary degrees of freedom for improving low-precision accuracy. Finally, we translate this framework to production by augmenting SSDi8, an existing low-precision prefill pipeline for Mamba-2, with the applicable invariances. LinQuant improves perplexity at matched latency on Mamba-2 1.3B, 2.7B, and 8B and Nemotron-H 8B, demonstrating the practical utility of invariance-based quantization for recurrent models.

AI.tldr: 提出LinQuant，利用七种保持全精度计算不变的函数不变性（包括旋转、对角缩放以及衰减与写入因子的替代放置），改进线性递归模型的低精度分块预填充。
AI.motivation: 线性递归正在成为softmax注意力的替代方案，但其低精度推理远不如softmax注意力成熟；直接量化分块并行算法中的稠密矩阵乘法较为脆弱。
AI.method: 识别那些保持全精度计算不变、同时使操作数更易量化的函数不变性；推导它们在线性、门控和delta规则等递归族上的有效条件；将适用的不变性加入SSDi8（一条面向Mamba-2的现有低精度预填充流水线）。
AI.result: 在匹配延迟的条件下，LinQuant改善了Mamba-2 1.3B、2.7B、8B以及Nemotron-H 8B的困惑度。
AI.conclusion: 基于函数不变性的量化为递归模型的低精度部署提供了实用手段。

title: Softmax Routing Dynamics in Mixture-of-Experts Models: Collapse and Recovery
summary: Softmax routing in mixture-of-experts models can concentrate probability on a subset of experts, suppressing access to the others. We study how this concentration forms, why it persists, and how suppressed probabilities recover. For fixed experts, a stationary-loss barrier identifies the face supporting the optimal routed output. In a common-target square-loss model with freely trainable expert outputs, slow adaptation tracks fixed-expert dynamics on finite horizons, while every fixed positive adaptation rate yields an interior routing limit. An exact normal-velocity decomposition separates complementary-expert covariance from relative gradient advantage. Under positive two-sided power bounds along recovery paths, uniform over initial masses, the resulting coefficient's order of vanishing gives logarithmic or power-law recovery times. Integrations of constructed fields reproduce these orders. An exact discrete log-odds identity relates neural updates to threshold crossing. In paired Transformer-MoE training, removing a class-conditional router-gradient contrast delays confirmed recovery and reduces accumulated log-odds on fixed tokens, both with and without capacity constraints.

AI.tldr: 研究MoE中softmax路由概率的集中（collapse）如何形成、为何持续以及被抑制的概率如何恢复，给出恢复时间的对数或幂律阶数，并在Transformer-MoE训练中验证类条件路由梯度对比的作用。
AI.motivation: softmax路由可能把概率集中到少数专家上，压制其他专家的访问；需要理解这种集中如何形成、为什么会持续，以及被抑制的概率如何恢复。
AI.method: 固定专家时，用平稳损失屏障识别支撑最优路由输出的面；在共同目标的平方损失模型中，分析慢适应与固定专家动力学在有限时域上的关系；通过法向速度分解区分互补专家的协方差与相对梯度优势；在恢复路径上假设正的双侧幂界，并推导对数几率的精确离散恒等式。
AI.result: 在恢复路径上，系数的消失阶数给出对数或幂律形式的恢复时间，构造场的数值积分与之相符；在配对的Transformer-MoE训练中，去除类条件路由梯度对比会延迟已确认的恢复，并减少固定token上累积的对数几率，无论是否有容量约束。
AI.conclusion: 路由梯度的类条件对比是打破专家集中并促进恢复的关键因素，给出的恢复阶数为理解MoE路由动力学提供了依据。

title: End-to-End Guarantees for Masked Diffusion Models under Conditional Mixing
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Diffusion Language Models: Foundations, Efficiency, and Reasoning (DiffuLM). 26 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables
summary: Masked diffusion models train a denoiser on masked cross-entropy and generate by unmasking many positions in parallel. Existing MDM sampling bounds assume an exact denoiser or leave its error uncontrolled while training bounds cover only the masking distribution on which the model was trained. We present an end-to-end guarantee for a learned denoiser under conditional mixing (CM): stationary sources (e.g. floored order-$r$ Markov and two-sided-Doeblin hidden-Markov sources) for which revealing distant visible tokens moves a masked token's posterior on average exponentially little in the distance with correlation length $\tau_c$. We show the empirical risk minimizer trained under any masking distribution attains per-token excess $\varepsilon'$ on that distribution from $\varepsilon'^{-\mathcal{O}(\tau_c\log|\mathcal{V}|)}$ training sequences, independent of sequence length $N$ -- one sample budget serves every decoding schedule when each schedule's denoiser is trained under its own weighting. We further show that the exponent's order $\Theta(\tau_c\log|\mathcal{V}|)$ is minimax-optimal up to constants; more efficient rates require added structure. With this, we bound the end-to-end KL as $\mathrm{KL}(\pi\Vert p_{\mathrm{alg}})\leq \varepsilon+N\varepsilon'$ under a dilated schedule of $T=\mathcal{O}(\tau_c\log(N|\mathcal{V}|/\varepsilon))$ denoising steps versus $\Omega(N)$ steps for a fixed random order on an explicit CM source. Finally, we show that block-autoregressive samplers chain across blocks with no added error and that a $\Lambda$-looped order-$r$ message-passing class on order-$r$ sources achieves polynomial sample complexity, with approximation error improving per loop until saturation at $\Lambda r\approx \tau_c\log(1/\varepsilon')$. Experiments on released and retrained models support our results' qualitative predictions.

AI.tldr: 为在条件混合（CM）源上学习的掩码扩散模型去噪器给出端到端保证，证明样本需求与序列长度无关，并给出可在O(τc log(N|V|/ε))步内完成的扩张调度采样。
AI.motivation: 已有的掩码扩散采样界假设去噪器是精确的或忽略其误差，而训练界只覆盖训练时所用的掩码分布。
AI.method: 在平稳源（如有限阶Markov源和双侧Doeblin隐Markov源）上引入条件混合假设，即揭示远处可见token对被掩码token后验的平均影响随距离指数衰减，相关长度为τc；分析经验风险最小化器在任意掩码分布下的样本复杂度，并用扩张调度分析端到端KL；另外分析块自回归采样器以及Λ循环消息传递类。
AI.result: 训练样本数为ε'^(-O(τc log|V|))，与序列长度N无关，且该指数阶在常数因子内是极小化最优的；端到端KL满足KL ≤ ε + Nε'，扩张调度只需O(τc log(N|V|/ε))去噪步，而固定随机顺序在显式CM源上需要Ω(N)步；块自回归采样器跨块不引入额外误差；Λ循环模型的近似误差随循环次数改善，直到Λr约等于τc log(1/ε')时饱和，并具有多项式样本复杂度；在已发布和重新训练的模型上的实验支持这些定性预测。
AI.conclusion: 在条件混合假设下，掩码扩散的样本预算可以与解码调度解耦，并行解码能显著减少去噪步数，这为掩码扩散提供了端到端的理论保证。

title: Smooth Action Chunking Via Movement-Primitive Representations for Imitation Learning
summary: Imitation learning has become a widely adopted approach for vision-based robot policies, owing to its conceptual simplicity, scalability, and ability to leverage large-scale datasets. As these policies have grown more capable, action chunking has become their standard interface. At each decision step the policy outputs several future actions at once. Backbones from diffusion policies to large vision-language-action models all share it. Whatever backbone produces the chunk, its temporal structure is learned only implicitly. The commanded trajectory is therefore jerky both within a chunk and between successive chunks. On real hardware this appears as visible vibration and as repeated saturation of the follower's velocity limit. We address this issue by incorporating a movement-primitive-based trajectory representation into action chunking. Specifically, a trajectory segment is represented as a linear combination of smooth basis functions, yielding smooth trajectories by construction while leaving the policy architecture, training objective, and inference procedure unchanged. The same representation also yields a closed-form, inference-time correction for the second source of jerk. We condition the predicted coefficients so that the new chunk passes through a via-point at the previous chunk's last commanded action. This correction needs no retraining and, unlike asynchronous Real-Time Chunking, applies to policies queried in one shot. We instantiate it on a one-shot (ACT) and an iterative (DiT) backbone and evaluate in simulation and on a real bimanual ALOHA platform. The representation lowers within-chunk jerk by an order of magnitude on the one-shot backbone and by 2.4 times on the iterative one, with task success statistically non-inferior. The conditioning then removes 73-84% of the boundary discontinuity, at negligible per-step cost.

AI.tldr: 将运动基元（movement primitive）表示引入动作分块模仿学习，使分块轨迹在构造上平滑，并提出无需重训练、适用于一次性预测策略的推理时边界修正。
AI.motivation: 动作分块已成为视觉机器人策略的标准接口，但其时间结构只被隐式学习，导致分块内部及相邻分块之间的指令轨迹抖动；在真实硬件上表现为明显振动，并频繁触及跟随器的速度上限。
AI.method: 将轨迹片段表示为光滑基函数的线性组合；策略架构、训练目标和推理流程保持不变；通过对预测系数施加条件，使新分块经过上一分块最后一个指令动作（经由点），从而得到闭式修正。
AI.result: 在一次性预测的ACT骨干上，分块内抖动降低一个数量级；在迭代式的DiT骨干上降低2.4倍；任务成功率在统计上不低于基线；修正去除了73%至84%的边界不连续，且每步额外开销可以忽略。
AI.conclusion: 运动基元表示与推理时修正能有效平滑机器人动作分块的轨迹，并且适用于单次查询的策略，无需异步的Real-Time Chunking方法。

title: Sparse Fine-Tuning for Parameter-Efficient Adversarial Training
summary: Deep neural networks achieve strong performance across many tasks but remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations. Adversarial training (AT) is one of the most effective defenses, yet it suffers from high memory cost on large models and the persistent clean-robust accuracy trade-off. Recent work introduces parameter-efficient fine-tuning, such as LoRA, into AT, but this constraint induces a notable robustness gap relative to full-parameter AT. In this work, we revisit parameter-efficient adversarial fine-tuning from a parameter space perspective. Through gradient analysis, we find that adversarial optimization is highly concentrated on a small subset of parameters, which we call Robustness-Critical Parameters (RCPs), suggesting that robustness is encoded in a sparse subspace. Building on this observation, we propose Sparse Adversarial Fine-Tuning (SAFT), which identifies RCPs via adversarial gradient saliency and performs AT by updating only these parameters while freezing the rest. Across architectures and datasets, SAFT outperforms LoRA-based methods in both clean and robust accuracy with fewer trainable parameters, and approaches or surpasses full parameter AT in robustness while updating only about 5\% of parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出SAFT，通过对抗梯度显著性识别鲁棒性关键参数（RCP），仅更新约5%的参数进行对抗训练；在干净精度和鲁棒精度上均优于基于LoRA的方法，鲁棒性接近或超过全参数对抗训练。
AI.motivation: 对抗训练在大模型上内存开销高，且存在干净精度与鲁棒精度之间的持续权衡；将LoRA等参数高效微调引入对抗训练后，相比全参数对抗训练存在明显的鲁棒性差距。
AI.method: 从参数空间的视角分析梯度，发现对抗优化高度集中在一小部分参数（即RCP）上，说明鲁棒性编码在稀疏子空间中；SAFT依据对抗梯度显著性识别RCP，只更新这些参数并冻结其余部分。
AI.result: 在多种架构和数据集上，SAFT的干净精度和鲁棒精度均优于基于LoRA的方法，且可训练参数更少；在鲁棒性方面接近或超过全参数对抗训练，而只更新约5%的参数。
AI.conclusion: 对抗鲁棒性集中在稀疏的关键参数子空间中，据此进行稀疏微调是兼顾效率与鲁棒性的有效途径。

title: Achieving Minimax-Optimal First-Order and Best-of-Both-Worlds Regret Simultaneously in Multi-Armed Bandits
summary: We study first-order and best-of-both-worlds regret guarantees in multi-armed bandits. Pogodin and Lattimore (2019) proposed an algorithm that combines minimax-optimal worst-case regret with a first-order guarantee whose loss-dependent term is $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{K L^\star}\log T)$, where $T$ denotes the horizon, $L^\star$ denotes the smallest expected cumulative loss among fixed arms, and $K$ denotes the number of arms. However, a logarithmic gap remains between this loss-dependent term and the optimal first-order scale. In this paper, we remove this logarithmic factor by proposing an efficient and parameter-free algorithm that achieves the minimax optimal first-order regret guarantee $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{K L^\star})$. Technically, our algorithm is built upon FTRL with a Tsallis entropy regularizer (Zimmert and Seldin,2021), with a learning rate adapted to the learner's cumulative loss and a sampling distribution determined by a scalar fixed point. This construction controls the combined estimation and stability cost in terms of the learner's loss. Moreover, we show that the same algorithm achieves a best-of-both-worlds guarantee, with $\mathcal{O}(\sum_{i\ne i^\star}\frac{\log T}{\Delta_i})$ regret for i.i.d. losses with a unique best arm $i^\star$, where $\Delta_i$ denotes the suboptimality gap of arm $i$.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需调参的算法，在多臂老虎机中同时达到极小极大最优的一阶遗憾O(sqrt(K L*))（去掉了已有方法中的对数因子），并具有最佳两世界（best-of-both-worlds）保证。
AI.motivation: Pogodin和Lattimore（2019）的算法在损失相关项上多了一个对数因子O(sqrt(K L*) log T)，与最优一阶尺度之间存在对数间隙。
AI.method: 以带Tsallis熵正则项的FTRL为基础（Zimmert和Seldin，2021），学习率依据学习者的累积损失自适应调整，采样分布由一个标量不动点确定，从而同时控制估计与稳定性成本。
AI.result: 达到极小极大最优的一阶遗憾O(sqrt(K L*))；在i.i.d.损失且存在唯一最优臂i*时，遗憾为O(sum_{i≠i*} log T/Δ_i)，其中Δ_i为臂i的次优差距。
AI.conclusion: 同一算法同时满足最坏情形与随机情形下的最优性，并消除了一阶遗憾中的对数间隙，对多臂老虎机的遗憾分析有直接意义。

title: CBE: A Complexity-adaptive Boundary-aware Ensemble Method for Imbalanced Data
summary: In many real-world classification tasks, datasets exhibit class imbalance, which can degrade the generalization performance of conventional learning algorithms. Data complexity has recently been recognized as a more objective indicator of learning difficulty than the imbalance ratio alone, because class overlap and complex decision boundaries often impair classifiers more severely than imbalance itself. Samples near the decision boundary are inherently difficult to classify, which has motivated many researchers to focus on such instances to improve classifier performance. However, most under-sampling approaches fail to differentiate their sampling of boundary samples across datasets of varying complexity. To overcome this limitation, we propose a complexity-adaptive boundary-aware ensemble (CBE) framework that links the sampling weight distribution to data complexity and dynamically adjusts the boundary preference of under-sampling accordingly. We also introduce an overall complexity measure that combines metrics at multiple levels and use it to divide imbalanced datasets into three categories. Extensive experiments on 24 benchmark datasets from UCI and KEEL show that the proposed method outperforms many existing methods in terms of F-measure and G-mean on Easy and Median datasets, without degrading performance on hard cases.

AI.tldr: 提出复杂度自适应的边界感知集成方法CBE，根据数据复杂度动态调整欠采样对决策边界样本的偏好，用于不平衡分类。
AI.motivation: 大多数欠采样方法在不同复杂度的数据集上对边界样本采用相同的采样方式，缺乏区分；而与仅看不平衡比例相比，数据复杂度更能反映学习的难度。
AI.method: 将采样权重分布与数据复杂度联系起来，并据此动态调整欠采样的边界偏好；提出综合多层级指标的整体复杂度度量，用它把不平衡数据集划分为三类。
AI.result: 在来自UCI和KEEL的24个基准数据集上，CBE在Easy和Median数据集上的F-measure和G-mean优于许多现有方法，且在困难数据集上不降低性能。
AI.conclusion: 根据数据复杂度自适应调整边界采样偏好，可以在不同难度的不平衡数据上取得更稳健的效果。

title: Topology Survives Shuffling: Robust Long-Context Memory Access Prediction for Graph Analytics
summary: Graph analytics generates irregular, topology-dependent memory-access streams via indirect traversals, limiting data prefetching. Accurate prediction enables timely prefetches that hide memory latency. However, ML predictors couple short histories with fixed horizons, fitting the training trace's node layout rather than learning transferable graph patterns. We propose LoCoMAP, a long-context representation-learning framework for memory-access prediction with independently controlled observation history and prediction horizon. We evaluate Connected Components (CC), PageRank (PR), and Single-Source Shortest Paths (SSSP) on six synthetic graph families, with Erdos-Renyi (ER) and Grid as random and deterministic controls. We test two interventions: same-family regeneration changes connectivity, while node shuffling disrupts layout but preserves connectivity. Across 18 graph-workload pairs, extending history from 8 to 128 accesses improves F1 by 7.8%, while extending prediction horizon from 8 to 512 improves F1 by 88.3%. For CC, regeneration is less disruptive than shuffling: without retraining, long context retains 95.4% of original F1 and outperforms short context in six families. Under full shuffle, long context improves CC F1 by 33.6% across ER, Barabasi-Albert, Copying Model, and Stochastic Block Model (SBM), with a 2.06x gain on SBM, but not on Watts-Strogatz or Grid, where near-zero delta mass shifts into heavy tails beyond the predictor's range. Long context outperforms short context on six real-world CC graphs. At full shuffle, long-context PR retains 57.6% of original F1 and averages 11.0% above short context. Both SSSP models retain about 30% of original F1 under full shuffle as distance updates access vertex data in a new order. Within these bounds, long-context predictors are robust across related graphs and layouts without retraining, enabling a generalizable graph prefetcher.

AI.tldr: 提出LoCoMAP，一种长上下文表示学习框架，可独立控制观测历史长度与预测视野，用于图分析的内存访问预测；在不重训练的情况下，对同族图的重新生成和节点打乱具有较好的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 图分析中的间接遍历会产生不规则的、依赖拓扑的内存访问流，限制了数据预取；现有的机器学习预测器把短历史与固定视野耦合在一起，拟合的是训练轨迹的节点布局，而非可迁移的图模式。
AI.method: 在六类合成图（以ER和Grid作为随机与确定性对照）上评估连通分量（CC）、PageRank（PR）和单源最短路径（SSSP）；设计两种干预：同族重新生成（改变连通性）与节点打乱（破坏布局但保持连通性）。
AI.result: 在18个图-负载组合中，历史长度从8扩展到128使F1提升7.8%，预测视野从8扩展到512使F1提升88.3%；在CC上，不重训练时长上下文保留了95.4%的原始F1；全打乱时，长上下文使CC在ER、Barabasi-Albert、Copying Model和SBM上的F1提升33.6%（SBM上为2.06倍），但在Watts-Strogatz和Grid上没有提升；长上下文在六个真实世界CC图上优于短上下文；全打乱时，长上下文PR保留57.6%的F1，平均比短上下文高11.0%；两个SSSP模型在全打乱时均保留约30%的F1。
AI.conclusion: 长上下文预测器在相关图与不同布局之间具有较好的鲁棒性，无需重训练即可迁移，为可泛化的图预取器提供了可能，但对部分图族仍有局限。

title: Interpretable by Design Tabular Prediction via In-Context Local Linear Learning
summary: In-context learning (ICL) lets tabular foundation models make predictions without dataset-specific training or fine-tuning. These models achieve strong predictive accuracy, but interpreting how individual features contribute to the prediction remains difficult. In biology, for example, feature contributions can help identify biomarkers or risk genes. Post-hoc interpretability methods assign feature importance scores, but these scores do not indicate what the model actually uses and can lead to explanation errors. We introduce TICL$^3$ (Tabular In-Context Local Linear Learning), an interpretable-by-design predictor that uses a tabular foundation model to guide a simple linear prediction rule. TICL$^3$ first learns a shared linear model to capture dataset-level feature effects. Then, for each query, it retrieves similar training samples using representations from the foundation model and fits a second linear model to the residuals in that neighborhood. The shared model captures broad effects, while the local model corrects errors among similar samples. Their combined coefficients determine each feature contribution to the final query-specific linear score, so the same model makes and explains the prediction. Across 386 classification benchmark-dataset evaluations, TICL$^3$ trails TabICLv2 by 1.1 percentage points and outperforms CatBoost in 266 evaluations. It improves average support F1 over MAPLE by 4.7 points and achieves the best performance on both real-data selected-feature utility metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出TICL³，一种可解释的表格上下文学习预测器，利用表格基础模型引导一个简单的局部线性预测规则，使同一模型既做预测又给出特征贡献的解释。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型通过上下文学习能获得很高的预测精度，但难以解释各特征如何影响预测；事后解释方法给出的重要性分数并不能说明模型实际用了什么，可能导致解释错误。
AI.method: 先学习一个共享的线性模型，捕捉数据集层面的特征效应；对每个查询，用基础模型的表示检索相似的训练样本，并在该邻域的残差上拟合第二个线性模型；两者的合并系数决定每个特征对该查询特定线性得分的贡献。
AI.result: 在386次分类基准数据集评估中，TICL³比TabICLv2低1.1个百分点，并在266次评估中优于CatBoost；平均支持F1比MAPLE高4.7个点；在两项真实数据的所选特征效用指标上取得最佳表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过让预测与解释共享同一线性结构，TICL³在接近强基础模型精度的同时实现了设计层面的可解释性。

title: Last-Iterate Convergence for Constrained MDPs: From Dual Descent to Primal-Dual
summary: We study policy optimization for infinite-horizon, discounted constrained Markov decision processes. While primal-dual ($\texttt{PD}$) methods are widely used in practice, their theoretical guarantees typically hold for an impractical mixture policy. In contrast, dual descent ($\texttt{DD}$) methods output a single policy ("last iterate") with guarantees on its performance. However, such methods require iteratively solving entropy-regularized MDPs in an inner-loop, limiting their practical effectiveness. Moreover, existing analyses rely on strong coverage assumptions that are difficult to satisfy in practice. Consequently, we first provide a new analysis of $\texttt{DD}$ methods that does not require coverage assumptions. We then employ entropy-regularized natural policy gradient and dual regularization to eliminate the inner loop, resulting in an efficient $\texttt{PD}$ algorithm. We develop a novel tracking analysis which shows that, compared to existing methods, the proposed algorithm achieves improved last-iterate convergence guarantees. Furthermore, our theoretical framework allows us to analyze a truncated bilevel method that interpolates between $\texttt{DD}$ and $\texttt{PD}$ methods. Finally, we generalize our analysis to handle linear function approximation. Compared to prior last-iterate methods, we prove stronger guarantees under less restrictive assumptions.

AI.tldr: 研究约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）的策略优化，提出无需覆盖假设且无内层循环的原始-对偶算法，并给出更强的末次迭代收敛保证。
AI.motivation: 原始-对偶（PD）方法的理论保证通常针对不实用的混合策略；对偶下降（DD）方法输出单一策略，但需要在内层反复求解熵正则化MDP，且现有分析依赖难以满足的覆盖假设。
AI.method: 先在无覆盖假设下重新分析DD方法；再采用熵正则化自然策略梯度和对偶正则化消除内层循环，得到高效的PD算法，并通过跟踪分析证明其末次迭代收敛性；另分析介于DD与PD之间的截断双层方法，并将分析推广到线性函数逼近。
AI.result: 与已有末次迭代方法相比，所提算法获得改进的收敛保证，且在更弱的假设下证明了更强的理论结果；摘要未给出数值实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 为约束强化学习提供了实用且有理论保证的单策略输出算法，并统一了DD与PD两类方法的分析框架。

title: Explainable and Adaptive Machine Learning for Fraud Risk Detection in Bangladesh's Digital Banking Ecosystem
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Presented at the 11th Annual Banking Conference 2026, Bangladesh Institute of Bank Management (BIBM), Dhaka, Bangladesh, 28 October 2026
summary: The rapid expansion of digital banking and mobile financial services creates growing challenges for fraud detection, particularly under severe class imbalance and operational constraints. This study presents an explainable and adaptive machine-learning framework integrating chronological evaluation, leakage-conscious feature engineering, probability calibration, SHAP-based explainability, and adaptive risk prioritization. Experiments use the synthetic PaySim mobile-money benchmark and compare Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM. XGBoost achieved the strongest fixed-threshold performance, with PR-AUC of 0.5658, ROC-AUC of 0.9068, and F1-score of 0.5369. Platt calibration reduced the test Brier score from 0.1141 to 0.0245, improving probability reliability. SHAP analysis identified temporal, destination-account, transaction-type, and amount features as important model drivers. An adaptive top-1% policy reduced false positives from 192 to 117, but recall declined from 0.4236 to 0.2122, demonstrating a clear alert-capacity trade-off. The results provide a reproducible methodological framework rather than evidence of deployment performance in Bangladesh, since PaySim is synthetic. Validation using governed real-world financial data is therefore an important direction for future research.

AI.tldr: 针对孟加拉国数字银行场景，提出可解释、自适应的欺诈检测框架，在合成数据集PaySim上比较四种模型，其中XGBoost固定阈值下表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 数字银行和移动金融服务快速扩张，欺诈检测面临严重的类别不平衡和运营约束。
AI.method: 框架整合按时间顺序的评估、防止数据泄漏的特征工程、概率校准、基于SHAP的可解释性分析以及自适应风险优先级策略；在PaySim上比较Logistic Regression、Random Forest、XGBoost和LightGBM。
AI.result: XGBoost在固定阈值下表现最好，PR-AUC为0.5658，ROC-AUC为0.9068，F1为0.5369；Platt校准将测试集Brier分数从0.1141降至0.0245；自适应top-1%策略使假阳性从192降至117，但召回率从0.4236降至0.2122。SHAP分析显示时间、目标账户、交易类型和金额特征是主要驱动因素。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了可复现的方法框架，但因PaySim为合成数据，结果并不代表在孟加拉国的实际部署性能；需用受治理的真实金融数据验证，且告警容量与召回率之间存在明确权衡。

title: LatentWeave: Test-Time Latent Optimization for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Recent advances in test-time optimization have shown that the multimodal reasoning performance of large multimodal language models (MLLMs) can be improved during inference without modifying backbone model parameters. However, existing approaches primarily operate at the prompt or output level, leaving the latent reasoning process largely uncontrolled and insufficient to prevent error accumulation during autoregressive generation. To address this limitation, we propose LatentWeave, a test-time framework that treats multimodal reasoning as a controllable latent trajectory. LatentWeave performs structured Latent Weaving, progressively refining intermediate hidden states segment-wise to correct emerging deviations, and further introduces Reasoning Anchors via lightweight WEAVE tokens to stabilize reasoning structure and guide answer-oriented generation. These mechanisms are designed to enable fine-grained, step-aware intervention in the latent reasoning process while keeping the main MLLM backbone parameters fixed. Extensive experiments across diverse multimodal reasoning benchmarks report improvements over the evaluated baselines; the contribution of latent optimization, anchor training, and additional test-time computation is analyzed separately in the ablation and efficiency studies. Our code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 提出LatentWeave，一种测试时潜在空间优化框架，在保持多模态大语言模型主干参数固定的前提下，逐段修正推理过程中的隐状态偏差，以提升多模态推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时优化方法主要作用于提示或输出层面，无法控制自回归生成中的潜在推理过程，难以阻止误差累积。
AI.method: 提出Latent Weaving，对中间隐状态进行分段渐进修正；引入由轻量WEAVE token构成的Reasoning Anchors，以稳定推理结构并引导面向答案的生成，实现细粒度、感知步骤的干预。
AI.result: 在多个多模态推理基准上相对所评估的基线有所提升；潜在优化、锚点训练及额外测试时计算的贡献分别在消融和效率实验中分析；摘要未给出具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 将多模态推理视为可控的潜在轨迹，为不修改骨干参数的测试时干预提供了新思路。

title: Improving the Intrinsic Interpretability of Differentiable Decision Trees through Euclidean Feature-Concentration Regularisation
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Based on the author's MSc dissertation, University of Birmingham
summary: Differentiable decision trees (DDTs) support end-to-end optimisation and explicit decision paths, but dense oblique splits can obscure the role of individual input features. We propose the Euclidean-Concentrated Differentiable Decision Tree (EU-DDT), which regularises the relative absolute feature weights at each internal node using their normalised squared Euclidean distance from the uniform distribution. This encourages dominance by a small number of features while retaining probabilistic soft routing. Across five matched random seeds, EU-DDT reduces the mean effective number of features from 8.94 to 1.54 on Wine and from 45.28 to 9.06 on Digits. Mean test accuracy changes from 100.0% to 93.9% on Wine and from 92.3% to 94.6% on Digits, illustrating the dataset-dependent trade-off between concentration and predictive performance. We also use EU-DDT to parameterise a PPO actor with an MLP critic. Two random-seed runs per environment show a consistent qualitative increase in concentration while preserving effective task performance. In representative CartPole-v1 and MiniPacman runs, EU-DDT reaches 100% final evaluation success, while mean node concentration increases from 0.1272 to 0.7179 and from 0.0437 to 0.7237, respectively. These results support EU regularisation as a mechanism for reducing node-level feature complexity; the reinforcement-learning evidence remains preliminary because only two seeds are evaluated.

AI.tldr: 提出EU-DDT，在可微决策树每个内部节点上加入基于归一化欧氏距离的特征集中正则项，使少数特征占主导，从而提高可解释性；并初步用于参数化PPO策略。
AI.motivation: 可微决策树支持端到端优化和显式决策路径，但稠密的斜向分裂使单个输入特征的作用难以辨识。
AI.method: 对每个内部节点的相对绝对特征权重，施加其与均匀分布之间归一化平方欧氏距离的正则项，鼓励少数特征占优，同时保留概率软路由；并以EU-DDT作为PPO的actor，配合MLP critic。
AI.result: 在五个随机种子下，Wine数据集上平均有效特征数从8.94降至1.54，测试准确率从100.0%降至93.9%；Digits数据集上有效特征数从45.28降至9.06，准确率从92.3%升至94.6%。在CartPole-v1和MiniPacman的代表性运行中达到100%最终评估成功率，节点集中度分别从0.1272升至0.7179、从0.0437升至0.7237；强化学习结果仅用两个随机种子，属初步证据。
AI.conclusion: EU正则化可作为降低节点级特征复杂度的机制，但其对预测性能的影响依数据集而异；强化学习方面的证据有待更多随机种子验证。

title: A New AFIB Detection Method with Deep Neural Networks
summary: Early detection of atrial fibrillation (AFIB), characterized by irregular heart rhythms, can potentially save thousands of lives annually [20]. Numerous studies have attempted to address this challenge using various algorithms and methodologies. This paper introduces a novel and robust method that enhances the precision of AFIB detection. Neural Networks (NN) are widely recognized for their ability to identify complex electrocardiogram (ECG) patterns, facilitating the accurate detection of irregular heart rhythms. This study explores multiple conventional machine learning algorithms alongside neural network approaches to develop a robust AFIB detection system. To evaluate the effective- ness and robustness of the proposed method, the MIT BIH arrhythmia database (MITDB) and the Long-term Atrial Fibrillation Database (LTAFDB), both available on the Physionet site. Our approach presents a novel feature engineering technique, employing specific features such as a time series of the differences in successive heart rates (dBPM) rather than traditional inter-beat intervals. The model analyzes inputs labeled into five distinct classes, using only clean intervals identified through a new labeling method for training while treating others as outliers. This strategy ensures a more accurate and reliable AFIB detection process. The best-performing model, a Deep Neural Network (DNN), achieved an F1 score of 95.18% for binary atrial fibrillation classification on a benchmark dataset distinct from the training set. Models trained using our approach have demonstrated superior performance than previously published models.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于深度神经网络的房颤（AFIB）检测方法，以心率连续差值的时间序列作为特征并采用新的标注策略，在基准数据集上达到95.18%的二分类F1分数。
AI.motivation: 房颤的早期检测可挽救大量生命，已有方法众多，但仍需要更精确可靠的检测手段。
AI.method: 在MITDB和LTAFDB上，以连续心率差值时间序列（dBPM）替代传统的RR间期作为特征；通过新的标注方法将输入分为五类，仅用“干净”区间训练，其余视为离群值；同时比较传统机器学习方法与神经网络方法。
AI.result: 最佳模型为深度神经网络，在与训练集不同的基准数据集上，房颤二分类F1为95.18%；作者称优于已发表模型，但摘要未给出对比基线的具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 所提的特征工程与数据筛选策略有助于提高房颤检测的准确性和可靠性。

title: Event-SAMA: Language-Grounded Video Object Segmentation on Neuromorphic Event Streams
summary: Event cameras offer microsecond temporal resolution, high dynamic range and no motion blur, but referring video object segmentation (RVOS) lacks event-stream datasets and models. We introduce Event-SAMA-239K, a synthetic-event conversion of the SAMA-239K grounded video-chat corpus and all additional SAMA training data: 30,650 video clips and 392,162 images. Optical-flow, FILM or saccade upsampling followed by a linear event generator preserves all mask, referring-expression and dialogue annotations. We also introduce Event-SAMA, adapting SAMA-4B with a two-channel polarity patch embedding initialised from pretrained RGB weights and a zero-initialised event adapter. End-to-end training yields 24.37 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ on MeViS valid_u and 22.33 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ on the converted ReVOS valid subset, establishing the first event-native RVOS baseline (RGB SAMA-4B: 55.4 on MeViS). Frozen RGB SAMA-4B with pseudo-RGB renderings or E2VID reconstructions of the same events scores 13.23 and 15.94 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$. Without retraining, Event-SAMA works on real event-camera recordings when the accumulation window matches their event density. A seed-controlled ablation with a measured noise floor of 0.47 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ finds gains from diverse training sources over MeViS alone (+4.99), RGB-mean event-stem initialisation (+4.33), and a trainable SAM2 mask decoder (+2.76); the event adapter, partial ViT unfreezing and event polarity are within noise at this budget. An earlier, partially converted corpus snapshot trained with the identical recipe scores 1.38 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ higher on MeViS and 1.12 higher on ReVOS. Both are single runs that also differ in schedule length, so we draw no conclusion about corpus scale.

AI.tldr: 构建了面向事件相机的指代视频目标分割合成数据集Event-SAMA-239K，并提出首个事件原生RVOS基线Event-SAMA，其在MeViS上达到24.37 J&F，但仍明显低于RGB模型的55.4。
AI.motivation: 事件相机具有微秒级时间分辨率、高动态范围且无运动模糊，但指代视频目标分割（RVOS）缺乏事件流数据集和模型。
AI.method: 通过光流、FILM或扫视上采样结合线性事件生成器，将SAMA-239K语料及其他训练数据转换为事件流，并保留掩码、指代表达和对话标注；模型基于SAMA-4B，采用由RGB预训练权重初始化的双通道极性patch embedding和零初始化的事件适配器，进行端到端训练。
AI.result: 在MeViS valid_u上为24.37 J&F，在转换后的ReVOS验证子集上为22.33 J&F；RGB版SAMA-4B在MeViS上为55.4；冻结RGB模型配合伪RGB渲染或E2VID重建时分别为13.23和15.94。消融显示多样化训练来源（+4.99）、RGB均值事件stem初始化（+4.33）和可训练SAM2掩码解码器（+2.76）有提升，测量噪声底为0.47；事件适配器、部分ViT解冻和事件极性在噪声范围内。
AI.conclusion: 事件原生训练明显优于先将事件转换为RGB再使用RGB模型的做法，但与RGB基线仍有较大差距；由于均为单次运行且训练计划长度不同，作者不对语料规模得出结论。

title: Heterogeneous Co-Evolution Learning for Tool-Efficient Search Agents with Zero Labels
summary: Deep search agents extend language models by interleaving reasoning with external retrieval. However, effective search-agent training requires addressing two challenges beyond final-answer optimization. First, the capability frontier of agents is largely determined by training questions, whereas fixed or labeled task collections cannot adapt as agents improve. Second, outcome-only reinforcement learning treats all successful trajectories equally, even when some correct answers rely on redundant searches, creating an inherent tension between answer accuracy and tool efficiency. To address these issues, we introduce \textsc{ZEST-Search}, a zero-label and tool-efficient framework for search-agent training via heterogeneous co-evolution. Starting from unlabeled reference questions, \textsc{ZEST-Search} constructs validated search tasks online through an answer-first and evidence-path-guided generation process. A heterogeneous proposer adaptively constructs training tasks around the solver's evolving capability boundary, while the solver learns search-augmented reasoning through reinforcement learning. To jointly optimize task difficulty and search efficiency, \textsc{ZEST-Search} employs an intermediate-difficulty reward for the proposer and a task-local tool-aware reward for the solver, encouraging informative tasks and correct answers with fewer redundant searches. Experiments on seven general-domain and multi-hop question answering benchmarks demonstrate that \textsc{ZEST-Search} consistently improves search-agent performance while achieving higher tool efficiency without labeled search-training data or expert search trajectories. Further analyses show that heterogeneous generation, adaptive difficulty control, and tool-aware optimization enable more effective search-agent training.

AI.tldr: 提出ZEST-Search，一种无标签、工具高效的搜索智能体训练框架，通过异构协同进化在线构造训练问题，并在七个问答基准上同时提升性能与搜索效率。
AI.motivation: 搜索智能体的能力上限受训练问题约束，固定或有标注的任务集无法随智能体能力提升而自适应；且仅以结果为奖励的强化学习对冗余搜索一视同仁，使答案准确性与工具效率之间存在张力。
AI.method: 从无标签参考问题出发，通过先答后证（answer-first）和证据路径引导的生成过程，在线构造已验证的搜索任务；异构提议者围绕求解器的能力边界自适应地生成训练任务，求解器通过强化学习学习搜索增强推理；提议者采用中等难度奖励，求解器采用任务内工具感知奖励。
AI.result: 在七个通用领域与多跳问答基准上，ZEST-Search持续提升搜索智能体性能，并获得更高的工具效率；摘要未给出具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 异构生成、自适应难度控制和工具感知优化共同使搜索智能体训练更有效，且无需标注搜索数据或专家搜索轨迹。

title: Smartphone Indoor Localization Enhanced by Hierarchical Multi-Sensor Context Recognition
summary: Smartphone indoor localization requires low-cost, robust positioning across scene transitions and phone-use variations. Pedestrian dead reckoning (PDR) enables infrastructure-free deployment but accumulates errors from heading drift, structural transitions, and carrying-mode changes. Existing methods often treat contextual cues as a single event stream or local correction signal, limiting their ability to address distinct localization errors. This paper presents a framework enhanced by hierarchical multi-sensor context recognition. A jointly data- and model-driven recognition model predicts environment, scene, and activity probabilities, which are converted into scene-event and action-context segments. Scene-event segments guide scene-constrained PDR correction through corridor heading constraints, landmark attraction, fixed-lag backtracking, and vertical-transition handling. Action-context segments drive action-aware RoNIN-based position compensation for carrying-mode-dependent drift. Experiments on cross-floor and multi-action trajectories against LiDAR-SLAM references show that the proposed framework outperforms PDR and representative learned inertial odometry baselines, demonstrating that hierarchical semantics provide reliable, localization-specific correction cues.

AI.tldr: 提出一种由分层多传感器情境识别增强的智能手机室内定位框架，利用场景与动作语义为行人航位推算（PDR）提供针对性修正，效果优于PDR及代表性学习式惯性里程计。
AI.motivation: 基于PDR的无基础设施定位会因航向漂移、结构过渡和携带方式变化而累积误差；现有方法把情境线索当作单一事件流或局部修正信号，难以分别应对不同类型的定位误差。
AI.method: 联合数据驱动与模型驱动的识别模型预测环境、场景和活动概率，并转换为场景事件段和动作情境段；场景事件段驱动受场景约束的PDR修正，包括走廊航向约束、地标吸引、固定滞后回溯和垂直过渡处理；动作情境段驱动基于RoNIN的动作感知位置补偿，以应对与携带方式相关的漂移。
AI.result: 在跨楼层和多动作轨迹上，以LiDAR-SLAM为参考进行实验，所提框架优于PDR及代表性学习式惯性里程计基线；摘要未给出具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 分层语义能够提供可靠的、面向定位任务的修正线索。

title: Implicit Bias of (Stochastic) Gradient Descent on Deep Linear Diagonal Networks
summary: Modern machine learning models are often overparameterized, i.e., have more parameters than training data. This typically implies that the loss function admits multiple minimizers so that training methods (and their hyperparameter choices) have significant influence on the computed solution. We study this so-called implicit bias phenomenon in the context of training deep linear diagonal networks. Previous work has shown that the gradient flow for learning such networks converges to (almost) sparse solutions when initialized small. For an arbitrary number of layers, we extend this analysis to the practically more realistic (stochastic) gradient descent iterations. Our approach identifies (stochastic) gradient descent as a perturbed (stochastic) mirror gradient descent. This allows us to establish convergence and characterize the limiting solution, relating it to weighted $\ell_1$-minimization. Moreover, we provide sufficient conditions on the step sizes and quantify the influence of the step sizes on the implicit bias.

AI.tldr: 将深度线性对角网络中梯度流的隐式偏置分析推广到（随机）梯度下降，证明其收敛性并刻画极限解为加权l1最小化，同时给出步长条件及步长对隐式偏置的影响。
AI.motivation: 过参数化模型的损失函数存在多个极小值，训练方法及其超参数选择会显著影响最终解；已有工作仅证明小初始化下梯度流会收敛到（近似）稀疏解，而实践中更常用的是（随机）梯度下降。
AI.method: 将（随机）梯度下降视为带扰动的（随机）镜像梯度下降，从而分析任意层数深度线性对角网络中迭代过程的收敛性并刻画其极限解。
AI.result: 建立了收敛性，刻画了极限解与加权l1最小化之间的关系，给出了步长的充分条件，并量化了步长对隐式偏置的影响。
AI.conclusion: 理论上说明了（随机）梯度下降在深度线性对角网络中倾向于收敛到加权稀疏解，且步长选择会影响这一隐式偏置。

title: Grounding Predictive Reliability through Masked Observability
summary: An uncertainty estimate is meaningful only if its semantics can be tied to observable predictive behavior. Normal-Inverse-Gamma (NIG) evidential regression provides a structured decomposition of predictive variability into data-scale and predictive-mean components, but marginal likelihood does not identify their allocation. We address this semantic ambiguity in masked representation learning. MORSE (Masked Observability for Reliable Structured Encoding) predicts the same hidden target under controlled changes in visible context and uses normalized cross-context variation to ground predictive-mean uncertainty, while a Gaussian objective learns the conditional mean and data scale. The normalized variation plays the role of the NIG factor $1/\nu$, which the marginal leaves unidentified; this yields a policy-relative observability variance that measures dependence on visible evidence, distinct from variation induced by resampling the training set. On a Gaussian-process benchmark with a contextual reference built from analytic Bayes conditional means, MORSE has the lowest log-variance error among compared evidential, ensemble, and dropout estimators in all nine tested settings, while the estimator closest to training-set variation perturbs the model rather than its context in every setting, so the two references separate the estimators empirically. MORSE amortizes observability estimation into one forward pass per observation state. On a heteroscedastic pulse benchmark, its predictor's cross-context variance approaches a large-sample reference as training data increase. MORSE also improves low-label transfer on PTB-XL and in-distribution trajectory prediction on IMPTC.

AI.tldr: 提出MORSE，通过度量同一隐藏目标在受控变化的可见上下文下预测的归一化跨上下文变化，将NIG证据回归中的预测均值不确定性与数据尺度区分开，并以单次前向传播完成估计。
AI.motivation: 不确定性估计需要其语义能与可观测的预测行为相对应，但NIG证据回归中的边缘似然无法识别预测变化在数据尺度与预测均值两部分之间的分配。
AI.method: 在掩码表示学习中，对同一隐藏目标在受控改变的可见上下文下进行预测，以归一化跨上下文变化代替NIG因子1/ν，得到与策略相关的可观测性方差，用以衡量对可见证据的依赖，区别于训练集重采样引起的变化；高斯目标同时学习条件均值和数据尺度。
AI.result: 在包含解析贝叶斯条件均值参考的高斯过程基准上，MORSE在全部九种测试设置中对数方差误差均最低，优于对比的证据、集成和dropout估计器；在异方差脉冲基准上，其跨上下文方差随训练数据增加趋近大样本参考；在PTB-XL低标签迁移和IMPTC轨迹预测（同分布）上也有提升。
AI.conclusion: 以上下文扰动而非训练集扰动来定义不确定性，有助于获得更可靠的结构化不确定性估计，并可对可观测性估计进行高效摊销。

title: Going deep, reaching further: What can Boltzmann machines efficiently represent?
comment: 34 pages of main text + 32 pages of appendices, 14 figures, 2 tables
summary: While universal approximation theorems theoretically underpin the representation capabilities of machine learning models, they have two shortcomings: They do not focus on efficient representations and they tend to be insensitive to depth and other heuristically important properties. In this work we show that these two shortcomings are intertwined. We prove that machine learning models which are deeper or have higher-order interactions can efficiently represent a larger set of functions, i.e. have larger efficient reach. It follows that deep Boltzmann machines (DBMs) have maximal efficient reach, restricted Boltzmann machines (RBMs) sub-maximal, and k-body generalizations of RBMs form a hierarchy between the two, even though all are universal. More generally, (i) we provide a full characterization of machine learning models with maximal efficient reach; (ii) we derive separations between deep and shallow models for three representation tasks; and (iii) we prove that the efficient reach of shallow models constitutes an infinite hierarchy indexed by the interaction order. The proofs draw on different methodologies, namely on (i) a recent characterization of universal spin models; (ii) computational complexity bounds for spin models; and (iii) communication complexity bounds applied to shallow models. This work shows that universal machine learning models can strongly differ in their efficient representation capabilities, and provides a theoretical foundation for heuristic observations.

AI.tldr: 证明更深或具有更高阶相互作用的机器学习模型能高效表示更大的函数集合，由此区分了一类通用模型的高效表示能力：深玻尔兹曼机具有最大高效覆盖范围。
AI.motivation: 通用逼近定理不关注高效表示，且对深度等启发式重要性质不敏感；作者认为这两个缺陷相互关联。
AI.method: 以“高效覆盖范围”（efficient reach）刻画模型表示能力；证明借助通用自旋模型的刻画、自旋模型的计算复杂性界，以及浅层模型的通信复杂性界；给出具有最大高效覆盖范围模型的完整刻画，推导三类表示任务中深浅模型的分离，并证明浅层模型的高效覆盖范围构成一个以相互作用阶数为索引的无限层级。
AI.result: 深玻尔兹曼机（DBM）具有最大高效覆盖范围，受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM）为次最大，k体RBM推广则形成介于两者之间的层级；摘要未给出数值实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 尽管所有这些模型都是通用的，它们的高效表示能力可以有本质差异，该工作为启发式观察提供了理论基础。

title: Activation Probes Are Reliable With a Handful of Positive Examples
comment: Presented at the Mechanistic Interpretability workshop at NeurIPS 2025
