AI.tldr: 利用两个相位独立的语言切换与话题变化计时器构造受控文档，研究预训练语言模型中并发时间变量的联合表示；发现两个计时器可从同一隐藏状态线性解码，且存在近似因子化的几何结构。
AI.motivation: 已有工作识别了单个时间或上下文量的结构化表示，但语言模型如何联合组织多个独立演化的上下文变量仍不清楚。
AI.method: 构造独立相位的语言切换与话题变化计时器控制的文档；在十个预训练检查点上进行线性解码；通过移除计时器相关的质心平面检验其可访问性；分析联合状态质心间的可重复变异；在3至51个计时器取值以及Qwen3 0.6B至14B检查点上检验结果。
AI.result: 两个计时器均可从相同隐藏状态线性解码；移除某计时器的质心平面显著降低对其变量的可访问性，而对并发计时器影响甚微，尽管两平面不正交且包含跨计时器信息；各计时器的贡献解释了联合状态质心之间大部分可重复变异；所测试的质心位移未产生一致的计时器特异输出效应。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持基于选择性可访问性的近似因子化，以及重叠子空间中近似可加的联合状态几何。

title: A Unified Hessian-Guided Framework for Post-Training Quantization
summary: Low-bit quantization enables efficient deployment of large language models by reducing memory footprint and computational cost. Achieving high accuracy at low precision requires selecting quantization ranges, linear transformations, and weight rounding decisions. Existing approaches typically optimize these components independently using local reconstruction objectives, which fail to account for the varying impact of quantization errors on downstream predictions. Direct optimization of task-level metrics would provide a more faithful objective, but is challenging due to the discontinuous nature of quantization operations and the high computational cost of evaluating their downstream effects. In this work, we derive a Hessian-guided approximation of the output change induced by joint weight and activation quantization. Based on a tractable Fisher approximation, we formulate a unified post-training quantization framework that enables the joint optimization of quantization ranges, linear transformations, and weight rounding under a common output-sensitivity objective. The resulting method remains practical for modern large language models and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art transformation and rounding methods across both channel-wise and block-wise quantization settings.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于Hessian引导近似的统一训练后量化框架，在共同的输出敏感度目标下联合优化量化范围、线性变换和权重取整；在通道级和块级量化设置下均一致优于现有的变换与取整方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法独立优化各量化组件，且依赖局部重构目标，无法反映量化误差对下游预测的不同影响；直接优化任务级指标困难，因为量化操作不连续，且评估其下游效应的计算代价高。
AI.method: 推导联合权重与激活量化所引起输出变化的Hessian引导近似；基于可处理的Fisher近似，构建统一的训练后量化框架，在共同的输出敏感度目标下联合优化量化范围、线性变换与权重取整。
AI.result: 在通道级和块级量化设置下，该方法一致优于最先进的变换与取整方法（摘要未给出具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: 在统一的输出敏感度目标下联合优化量化组件，对现代大语言模型的低比特部署既实用又有效。

title: Your LR Schedule May Not Be Principled: Effective Learning Rate Scheduling in Weight-Normalized Training
summary: Weight-normalized (WN) training is emerging as a compelling alternative to conventional weight decay (WD), with recent studies reporting substantial pretraining loss gains. We show that these gains are driven primarily by the induced effective learning rate (ELR) trajectory rather than by normalization alone. Matching ELR trajectories largely collapses the training loss dynamics of WN and WD. Schedule design should therefore target ELR rather than the nominal learning rate (LR) alone. Building on this principle, we propose AIR (Affine Inverse-square-Root decay), which combines a theoretically derived $1/\sqrt{t}$ decay with an affine adjustment to satisfy prescribed peak and terminal LRs over a finite training horizon. We further identify late-stage ELR scheduling as a key source of its gains, because a shared late schedule attenuates the effect of earlier LR choices. Experiments on 128 B-token Mixture-of-Experts pretraining demonstrate that AIR outperforms cosine and other candidate schedules in training loss, downstream performance, and hyperparameter robustness, reducing terminal training loss by approximately 0.01 relative to cosine at matched cumulative LR. Applying the same ELR trajectory to WD reproduces the corresponding training dynamics, showing that the benefits extend beyond fixed-norm training and establishing ELR as the principled scheduling object.

AI.tldr: 指出权重归一化训练的收益主要来自其诱导的有效学习率（ELR）轨迹；提出AIR调度（仿射逆平方根衰减），在128B token的MoE预训练中，于训练损失、下游性能和超参鲁棒性上优于cosine调度。
AI.motivation: 权重归一化被报道可替代权重衰减并带来显著的预训练损失收益，但其收益来源尚不清楚，而且学习率调度通常以名义学习率设计。
AI.method: 通过匹配ELR轨迹检验权重归一化与权重衰减训练动态的一致性；提出AIR，将理论推导的1/sqrt(t)衰减与仿射调整结合，以满足有限训练时域上给定的峰值与终止学习率；分析晚期ELR调度在其收益中的作用。
AI.result: 匹配ELR轨迹后，两种训练方式的损失动态基本重合；在128B token的MoE预训练中，AIR在训练损失、下游性能和超参鲁棒性上优于cosine及其他候选调度，在累计学习率匹配时，终止训练损失相对cosine降低约0.01；将同一ELR轨迹用于权重衰减可复现相应的训练动态。
AI.conclusion: ELR应作为学习率调度的核心设计对象，其收益也超出固定范数训练的范围。

title: Is It the Curriculum or Just the Easy Start? Benchmarking Unsupervised Environment Design on Quadrupeds
comment: 22 pages, 10 figures. Code, level space and evaluation suite: this https URL
summary: Unsupervised environment design (UED) methods such as PLR, ACCEL, SFL and PAIRED are compared mostly on 2D mazes, grid worlds and BipedalWalker, while terrain curricula for legged robots are hand-designed and evaluated against a few baselines. We present a benchmark that runs fourteen UED, domain-randomisation and robotics curricula under one protocol on five 3D quadrupeds in MuJoCo MJX: the closed-chain W01-TEK and the open-chain Unitree Go1 and Go2, Google Barkour vB and Boston Dynamics Spot. Levels are vectors of eight interpretable terrain parameters, and all curricula drive the same PPO student at matched environment-step budgets. The evaluation reports success on random and held-out structured terrains, interquartile means with stratified bootstrap intervals, capability envelopes and a level-by-level domination comparison. We compare methods within each robot and report, per level set, the top group of methods not significantly below the best. No method is in the top group on every robot and level set. Methods with easy or low-difficulty training levels, curated or not, fill the top groups on in-distribution random levels of Go1 and Barkour, and of W01-TEK apart from PAIRED+BiBC. The success-driven terrain curriculum from legged-robot practice is in a top group most often, domain randomisation on uniform levels in none, and PAIRED in none outside Spot, where the fourteen methods lie within 3.8 points on random levels of difficulty 0.25. On three robots the leader on in-distribution random levels is not the leader on held-out terrain. We collect the results into a per-robot guide to choosing a curriculum.

AI.tldr: 在MuJoCo MJX中以统一协议，对五种三维四足机器人比较十四种无监督环境设计、域随机化及机器人课程方法；结果表明，没有任何方法在所有机器人和关卡集上都处于最优组。
AI.motivation: UED方法多在二维迷宫、格子世界和BipedalWalker上比较，而足式机器人的地形课程多为手工设计，且仅与少数基线对比。
AI.method: 构建统一协议的基准：关卡由八个可解释的地形参数向量表示，所有课程以匹配的环境步数预算驱动同一PPO学生；评估随机和留出结构化地形上的成功率，报告四分位均值及分层自助法区间、能力包络以及逐关卡的支配比较；在每个机器人内比较，并报告不显著低于最佳方法的顶组。
AI.result: 没有任何方法在每个机器人和每个关卡集上都位于顶组；在Go1、Barkour以及W01-TEK（PAIRED+BiBC除外）的分布内随机关卡上，低难度训练关卡的方法常居顶组；基于成功驱动的地形课程进入顶组最为频繁，均匀关卡上的域随机化从未进入，PAIRED在Spot以外也从未进入；在三台机器人上，分布内随机关卡的领先者并非留出地形的领先者。
AI.conclusion: 课程选择应依赖具体机器人与评估分布，研究结果被汇总为一份按机器人分类的课程选择指南。

title: Composing and Steering Diffusion Models with Generalized Feynman-Kac Correctors
summary: Diffusion models have become the leading paradigm in generative modeling, yet many applications require sampling from distributions that are not those of any single pretrained model, but are instead defined through combinations of several models, possibly tilted toward high values of a downstream reward. Naively combining the scores of the models yields incorrect samples, while existing corrections are restricted to specific families of targets. In this work, we introduce the generalized Feynman-Kac correctors (GFKC), a principled framework for sampling from an arbitrary target function of several pretrained diffusion models. We show that the geometric interpolation between an arbitrary initial function and the target function of the models satisfies a Feynman--Kac partial differential equation, and derive its potential in closed form. To evaluate this potential during generation, we further generalize the log-probability ODE to track the density of each model along trajectories driven by a different velocity field. The resulting algorithm operates entirely in the log domain, incorporates reward-based steering at no additional conceptual cost, and corrects the generation on the fly, without retraining or fine-tuning the models. We validate the method on analytic Gaussian models, where it closely matches the ground-truth targets, and on diffusion models trained on MNIST, where it samples from non-trivial combinations of the models and enables effective steering.

AI.tldr: 提出广义Feynman-Kac修正器（GFKC），用于从多个预训练扩散模型定义的任意目标函数中采样，可在不重新训练的情况下实现奖励引导；在解析高斯模型和MNIST扩散模型上得到验证。
AI.motivation: 许多应用需要从由多个模型组合定义、并可能偏向下游奖励的分布中采样；直接组合各模型的得分会得到错误样本，而已有修正方法仅适用于特定的目标族。
AI.method: 证明任意初始函数与模型目标函数之间的几何插值满足Feynman-Kac偏微分方程，并给出其闭式势函数；将对数概率ODE推广为沿由不同速度场驱动的轨迹追踪各模型的密度；整个算法在对数域中运行，并在生成过程中实时修正采样。
AI.result: 在解析高斯模型上，结果与真实目标分布高度吻合；在MNIST上训练的扩散模型上，方法可从模型的非平凡组合中采样，并实现有效的奖励引导。
AI.conclusion: GFKC为多扩散模型组合采样和奖励引导提供了有原则的统一框架，且无需微调模型。

title: SCARL: Sequence Confidence-Aligned Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves language-model reasoning by scoring sampled responses with a rule-based verifier and reinforcing those that pass. Where a classifier's training couples predicted probability to labels, nothing ties an RLVR policy's confidence in a response to its reward: aligned training would drive responses with the same advantage toward equal confidence, yet the advantage is blind to confidence. Under this sequence-confidence misalignment, a success the policy barely found earns the same update as one it produces with near certainty, and a confident error is corrected no harder than an exploratory one. We propose SCARL (Sequence Confidence-Aligned Reinforcement Learning), which reshapes, but never re-signs, each advantage with the alignment gap between the response's group-relative confidence and the outcome its advantage certifies, normalized into shares of each class's advantage budget. Misaligned samples absorb the force, responses with the same advantage are driven toward equal confidence, and repairing the misalignment doubles as a remedy for the entropy collapse that erodes exploration. SCARL provably reduces to its base estimator when a class's confidences agree, adds no extra passes and one hyperparameter. On Qwen3-4B-Base it lifts average Pass@32 by 2.4 points over DAPO and is best among nine compute-matched methods on both coverage and per-draw accuracy; applied unchanged across four estimators and four backbones, it improves 14 of 16 settings while preserving policy entropy and widening the confidence-correctness separation. Our code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 提出SCARL，通过用组内相对置信度与优势所认证结果之间的对齐差距重塑（但不改变符号）每个优势，缓解RLVR中的序列置信度失配；在Qwen3-4B-Base上，平均Pass@32比DAPO高2.4个点。
AI.motivation: 在RLVR中，策略对回答的置信度与奖励之间缺乏联系，同一优势的样本获得相同更新，无论策略是勉强发现还是近乎确定地产生，自信的错误也与探索性错误受到同等修正；这种序列置信度失配还会加剧熵崩溃。
AI.method: 对每个优势，用组内相对置信度与其所认证结果之间的对齐差距进行重塑，并将差距归一化为各类优势预算的份额；失配样本承担主要修正，使相同优势的回答趋向相同的置信度；在某类内部置信度一致时退化为基估计器；不增加额外前向传播，仅引入一个超参数。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B-Base上，平均Pass@32比DAPO高2.4个点，并在九种计算匹配的方法中，覆盖率与逐次采样准确率均最佳；应用于四种估计器和四种骨干网络，在16个设置中有14个获得提升，同时保持策略熵并扩大置信度与正确性之间的分离。
AI.conclusion: 修复序列置信度失配既能改善推理性能，也能缓解削弱探索的熵崩溃，且适用于多种估计器和骨干网络。

title: IMPACT: Inverter-Informed Multimodal Learning for Photovoltaic Generation Forecasting
summary: This work develops a physics-informed multimodal deep learning framework for 10- to 110-minute-ahead probabilistic photovoltaic power forecasting. The forecasting model is built on a four-branch architecture that separately encodes plant-level temporal history and inverter-level spatial cloud dynamics through a graph attention encoder with a learned adjacency, known-future solar geometry, and the current meteorological state, fused through gated cross-attention. The geometry branch adds two forward-looking physical signals, spatial cloud heterogeneity and inverter ramp-down activity, each empirically weighted toward the horizon where it is most predictive. The decoder anchors its prediction to a smart persistence baseline, learning a horizon-conditioned correction, and the resulting quantile forecasts are calibrated online through a kernel-weighted adaptive conformal calibration step. The proposed model outperforms all 14 baselines, achieving a forecast skill score (FSS) of 0.2950, 0.099 above the next-best model. A branch-composition ablation shows that every branch contributes positively and the model retains substantial skill in challenging overcast and variable sky conditions (FSS 0.198 and 0.255).

AI.tldr: 提出一种物理信息多模态深度学习框架，用于10至110分钟超前的光伏发电概率预测；模型融合四分支结构与在线核加权自适应保形校准，FSS达0.2950，比次优模型高0.099。
AI.motivation: 光伏功率预测需要同时利用电站历史、逆变器级的云层空间动态、已知的太阳几何以及当前气象状态，并希望引入具有物理可解释性的前瞻信号。
AI.method: 四分支架构：电站级时间历史，由带学习邻接矩阵的图注意力编码器编码的逆变器级空间云动态，已知未来太阳几何，以及当前气象状态，各分支经门控交叉注意力融合；几何分支加入空间云异质性和逆变器斜坡下降活动两个前瞻物理信号；解码器以智能持续性基线为锚点学习时域条件修正；分位数预测经核加权自适应保形校准进行在线校准。
AI.result: 相对全部14个基线取得最优，FSS为0.2950，比次优模型高0.099；分支组合消融显示每个分支均有正贡献；在阴天和多变天空条件下FSS分别为0.198和0.255。
AI.conclusion: 物理信息的多模态融合与在线校准可提升光伏概率预测的技能，各分支均有贡献，且在困难天气条件下仍保持可观性能。

title: NECA: Neighbor Event Curve Augmentation for Multi-Horizon ICU Deterioration Prediction
summary: Early prediction of ICU organ dysfunction events supports timely clinical monitoring and intervention, but estimating short-term organ-specific risk from early ICU records remains challenging due to irregular measurements, heterogeneous clinical variables, and the need to predict risk across multiple future horizons. Existing supervised models usually treat each patient as an isolated sample and do not explicitly use the observed event timing of similar historical patients. We propose Neighbor Event-Curve Augmentation (NECA), a model-agnostic method that retrieves training-set patients with similar early-window profiles and converts their subsequent organ dysfunction event onset times into cumulative event-curve features over 6h, 12h, 24h, and 42h. These features are concatenated with the original patient representation and used by standard downstream predictors. On PhysioNet 2012 and a 4,000-stay MIMIC-IV subset, NECA improves average PR-AUC and ROC-AUC across four organ dysfunction event tasks and seven supervised learners. The largest gain appears for neurological dysfunction events, where task-level average PR-AUC increases from 0.461 to 0.557 on PhysioNet 2012. Ablations show that clinically meaningful retrieval and horizon-specific neighbor risk drive most of the improvement, while the full cumulative curve adds task-dependent temporal context. These results support similar-patient event timing as a structured temporal risk signal for ICU organ dysfunction event prediction. The source code will be publicly released upon acceptance of this paper.

AI.tldr: 提出NECA（邻近事件曲线增强），通过检索相似历史患者的器官功能障碍事件发生时间并构造累积事件曲线特征，增强ICU多时域器官功能障碍预测；在PhysioNet 2012和MIMIC-IV子集上提升了PR-AUC与ROC-AUC。
AI.motivation: 现有监督模型将每位患者视为孤立样本，未显式利用相似历史患者已观测的事件时间；而在测量不规则、临床变量异质的条件下，估计短期器官特异性风险本身较为困难。
AI.method: 检索训练集中早期窗口特征相似的患者，将其后续器官功能障碍事件发生时间转换为6h、12h、24h和42h的累积事件曲线特征，与原患者表示拼接后输入标准下游预测器；该方法与模型无关。
AI.result: 在PhysioNet 2012和4000例住院记录的MIMIC-IV子集上，对四类器官功能障碍事件任务和七种监督学习器，平均PR-AUC与ROC-AUC均有提升；神经功能障碍事件的任务平均PR-AUC在PhysioNet 2012上从0.461提升至0.557；消融实验显示，具有临床意义的检索和特定时域的邻近风险贡献了大部分提升。
AI.conclusion: 相似患者的事件发生时间可作为ICU器官功能障碍事件预测中一种结构化的时间风险信号。

title: Uncertainty-aware Feedback Loop Diagnosis: integrating reinforcement learning and conformal prediction for reliable wafer defect classification
summary: Semiconductor manufacturing is a complex, multi-step process that requires both high precision and low operating costs. Therefore, detecting defects in a high-volume setting is an important component of wafer map analysis for reliable production. However, most state-of-the-art deep learning approaches require a full scan of the surface, which hinders the development of high-throughput inspection systems. To address this problem, we propose Uncertainty-aware Feedback Loop Diagnosis (UFLD), a novel algorithm that employs reinforcement learning for adaptive measurement acquisition and provides a prediction uncertainty level after each step, stopping the process once sufficient information is obtained. Unlike existing methods that rely on ensemble models or auxiliary confidence estimation deep learning models, UFLD utilizes a more parameter-efficient conformal prediction framework to determine the optimal stopping time. The proposed UFLD reduces acquisition time by about $40\%$ and achieves $98.4\%$ inspection accuracy, without requiring an additional learned confidence-estimation network. We validated our approach on the MixedWM38 dataset, demonstrating its advantages over existing adaptive acquisition procedures and standard convolutional neural networks.

AI.tldr: 提出UFLD（不确定性感知反馈回路诊断），利用强化学习自适应选择晶圆测量并借助保形预测给出不确定性与停止时机；在MixedWM38上采集时间约减少40%，检测准确率达98.4%，且无需额外的置信度估计网络。
AI.motivation: 多数先进的深度学习晶圆图缺陷检测需要全表面扫描，阻碍了高通量检测系统的发展；现有不确定性估计方法依赖集成模型或额外的置信估计网络。
AI.method: 利用强化学习进行自适应测量获取，每一步后给出预测不确定度，并以参数高效的保形预测框架确定最佳停止时间。
AI.result: 采集时间约减少40%，检测准确率98.4%，且无需额外学习的置信估计网络；在MixedWM38上优于现有自适应采集方法和标准卷积神经网络。
AI.conclusion: 将强化学习与保形预测结合，可在参数高效的前提下实现可靠且高效的晶圆缺陷检测。

title: A Pretrained Model for Bayesian Filtering in Heterogeneous Dynamical Systems
summary: Filtering has not yet had its foundation-model moment: state estimation is still dominated either by online Bayesian filtering algorithms that require known dy- namics as inputs, or by learning-based neural filters trained from scratch for a single system or parametric family. The core challenge is structural heterogene- ity: dynamical systems differ in their governing dynamics, physical scales, and noise levels, precluding a shared representation space for a reusable filter. To bridge this gap, we introduce FilterFM, the first pretrained model for Bayesian filtering that estimates latent states across heterogeneous dynamical systems with a single checkpoint. FilterFM employs a hierarchical two-level observation se- quence encoder and a prior-to-posterior state-reconstruction module that together handle varying observation and state dimensions across heterogeneous systems, while modeling state uncertainty via quantile prediction. Trained on a mixture of heterogeneous filtering tasks, FilterFM exhibits superior in-domain performance, delivering significant gains in estimation accuracy, runtime efficiency, and noise robustness compared to existing baselines. Beyond in-domain performance, it marks the first model to successfully enable zero-shot filtering on unseen dynamics, bridging the generalization gap in state estimation. Furthermore, we uncover clear scaling behaviors in foundation-model-based Bayesian filtering, which combined with comprehensive component ablation studies, validate the structural optimality of our design and broaden the generalization scope for this research field.

AI.tldr: 提出FilterFM，首个用于贝叶斯滤波的预训练模型，以单一检查点估计异质动力系统的潜在状态，并能对未见过的动力学进行零样本滤波。
AI.motivation: 状态估计仍依赖需要已知动力学的在线贝叶斯滤波算法，或针对单一系统或参数族从头训练的神经滤波器；动力系统在控制方程、物理尺度和噪声水平上存在异质性，难以形成可复用的滤波器共享表示空间。
AI.method: 采用分层的两级观测序列编码器和先验到后验的状态重建模块，以处理不同系统间变化的观测与状态维度；通过分位数预测建模状态不确定性；在异质滤波任务的混合数据上训练。
AI.result: 域内性能优于现有基线，在估计精度、运行效率和噪声鲁棒性方面均有显著提升；首次实现对未见动力学的零样本滤波；观察到基础模型式贝叶斯滤波中的规模律，组件消融实验验证了设计的结构合理性。
AI.conclusion: 预训练可用于异质动力系统的贝叶斯滤波，并拓展了状态估计的泛化能力。

title: Framework-Conditional Open Materials Generation
summary: Theoretical predictions of novel materials rely on a variety of techniques, from data-mining-based ion substitution methods to fully de novo generative models. Each approach imposes specific constraints and encounters unique challenges when extrapolating beyond the distribution of known materials to discover new ones. The foremost goal of materials generation is to produce stable, unique, and novel (S.U.N.) structures. Predicted structures that meet these criteria, however, typically result from novel chemical compositions mapped onto known structural prototypes or frameworks. We leverage this heuristic insight to present a new generative paradigm for the de novo prediction of inorganic crystalline materials constrained by their structural framework---i.e., the unit cell shapes and respective particle positions. Our method, termed OMatG-FC (Open Materials Framework-Conditional Generation), learns via a combination of discrete flow matching on the atomic species and stochastic interpolants for the volume scaling of the unit cell lattice, while fixing in-place the fractional coordinates and the unit-volume lattice vectors, dramatically reducing the dimensionality of the problem compared to unconstrained (framework-free) generation. Our method is more flexible than existing prototype-constrained methods, demonstrating capability for discovery of unseen, stable prototypes derived from known structural frameworks. We also investigate the number of unique frameworks in the MP-20 dataset, demonstrating the propensity of duplicate frameworks within the dataset and providing a framework-split version. We benchmark the performance of our model using the LeMat-GenBench suite using three ML interatomic potentials and achieve state-of-the-art S.U.N. rate below the convex hull, eschewing the need to learn atomic packings for materials discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出 OMatG-FC，一种以结构框架（晶胞形状与粒子分数坐标）为条件的无机晶体从头生成方法：固定分数坐标与单位体积晶格向量，仅用离散流匹配生成原子种类、用随机插值学习晶胞体积缩放，在 LeMat-GenBench 上取得最优的低于凸包 S.U.N. 比例。
AI.motivation: 新稳定材料多来自把新化学组成映射到已知结构原型或框架；数据挖掘式离子替换受限于已知材料分布，无约束的从头生成则需要学习原子堆积，维度高；既有原型约束方法灵活性不足。MP-20 数据集中也存在大量重复框架。
AI.method: 以结构框架为条件进行生成：对原子种类使用离散流匹配，对晶格体积缩放使用随机插值，并固定分数坐标与单位体积晶格向量，从而大幅降低问题维度；同时统计 MP-20 中的唯一框架数量并提供框架划分版本。
AI.result: 在 LeMat-GenBench 上使用三种机器学习原子间势评估，低于凸包的 S.U.N. 比例达到最优；能够发现源自已知框架的未见稳定原型。摘要未给出具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 框架条件生成比无约束生成更易学习，比原型约束更灵活，且无需学习原子堆积，为材料从头发现提供了一条有前景的路径；框架划分数据集也为后续评估提供了依据。

title: Reinforcement learning for control of partial differential equations
summary: Controlling dynamical systems governed by partial differential equations (PDEs) remains a challenging task in scientific computing, owing to high-dimensional state spaces, distributed actuation, nonlinear dynamics, and stringent real-time constraints. Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for synthesizing feedback controllers that adapt to varying operating conditions and can be deployed efficiently in real-time. This review provides a unified perspective on RL and PDE-constrained optimization, and surveys model-free, model-based, and multi-agent RL approaches to PDE control, with particular emphasis on sample efficiency, generalization across parametric variations, and scalability to high-dimensional problems. Two demonstrative examples, the stabilization of a chaotic system and a flow control problem, illustrate the performance and pitfalls of RL agents in practice. Finally, we discuss evaluation and benchmarking practices, current limitations, and open research directions toward reliable, data-efficient, and scalable RL for scientific computing.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理强化学习（RL）用于偏微分方程（PDE）控制的方法，涵盖无模型、基于模型和多智能体 RL，并通过混沌系统镇定与流动控制两个示例说明 RL 智能体的性能与陷阱。
AI.motivation: PDE 控制面临高维状态空间、分布式驱动、非线性动力学和实时性约束；RL 能合成可适应工况变化的反馈控制器，但缺少对 RL 与 PDE 约束优化关系的统一视角，以及对样本效率、泛化和可扩展性的系统讨论。
AI.method: 统一梳理 RL 与 PDE 约束优化之间的联系，按无模型、基于模型与多智能体三类方法综述 PDE 控制，重点关注样本效率、跨参数变化的泛化和高维可扩展性；以混沌系统镇定和流动控制问题两个示例展示实践表现。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量结果；两个示例揭示了 RL 智能体在实践中的性能与常见陷阱，文章同时讨论了评估与基准测试的现有做法。
AI.conclusion: 当前用于科学计算 PDE 控制的 RL 仍受可靠性、数据效率与可扩展性限制；文章指出了迈向可靠、数据高效、可扩展 RL 的研究方向，并强调评估与基准规范的重要性。

title: Rural Readiness: Domain Generalization with Adversarially Chosen Domains
summary: Predictive models trained at well-resourced data-rich institutions often fail when deployed in new populations. Motivated by the goal of building clinical diagnosis and decision-making algorithms for data-scarce rural populations using the general knowledge learned from data-rich hospitals, we formulate the fundamental question of \emph{domain generalization with adversarially chosen domains}, which asks a learner to perform on any unseen target domain nearly as well as the worst hypothesis consistent with the evidence from the observed source domains. Assuming only that the hypothesis class contains a "universal" predictor with small error on all $k$ source domains, we characterize the sample complexity of this objective up to logarithmic factors. Letting $d$ denote the VC dimension of the hypothesis class, we find, somewhat surprisingly, that the sample complexity reduces significantly from $\Omega(dk)$ to $O(d)$ under a small relaxation of the learning goal in which, roughly speaking, we allow the learned model to compete with hypotheses that perform well on 99% instead of 100% of the source domains. By applying this insight to the meta-distributional setting, in which source domains are selected according to a distribution on distributions, we obtain a corresponding improvement over known sample complexity upper bounds. We also study the effect of data access to the target domain and show that a small labeled sample from the target domain does not improve the worst-case sample complexity on the source domains.

AI.tldr: 提出“对抗性选择域的领域泛化”问题，证明若假设类中存在对全部 k 个源域都有小误差的通用预测器，则允许在 99% 而非 100% 的源域上竞争时，样本复杂度可由 Ω(dk) 降至 O(d)（至对数因子），并改进了元分布设定下的已知上界。
AI.motivation: 在数据丰富的医院训练的预测模型部署到新人群时常常失效；作者希望利用数据丰富医院的知识，为数据稀缺的农村人群构建临床诊断与决策算法，而既有领域泛化理论难以刻画对任意未见目标域的最坏情形表现。
AI.method: 以 VC 维 d 刻画假设类，将目标定义为：在任意未见目标域上，学习器的表现接近在已观测源域上与证据一致的最坏假设；比较严格目标与“在 99% 源域上表现良好即可竞争”的松弛目标；在源域本身服从域分布之分布的元分布设定下推广结论。
AI.result: 严格目标下样本复杂度为 Ω(dk)，松弛目标下降为 O(d)（至对数因子）；元分布设定下得到优于已知上界的样本复杂度结果；目标域的少量标注样本并不改善源域上的最坏情形样本复杂度。摘要未给出实验数值。
AI.conclusion: 对于对抗性选择的域，轻微放松学习目标即可显著降低样本复杂度；而目标域的少量标注数据在最坏情形意义下帮助有限，这对面向数据稀缺人群的临床模型泛化具有理论指导意义。

title: Nonlinear Dynamical Systems as Scalable and Efficient Physical Neural Networks
summary: The rapid growth in the size of state-of-the-art machine-learning (ML) models has led to increasing compute demands, spurring the development of energy-efficient hardware accelerators. Physical systems trained to perform ML inference, known as physical neural networks, have been proposed as accelerators in part because of their potential to be highly energy efficient. However, the ML inference accuracies reported in most investigations of physical neural networks have been substantially below the state of the art for conventional digital neural networks. In this work, we show in simulation studies that by applying modern ML training practices, including model compression, various candidate physical neural networks based on nonlinear dynamical systems can achieve accuracies as high as 99.2% on MNIST handwritten-digit recognition. We also show for one dynamical system that using it as the core building block of a parameter-efficient ML architecture inspired by MLP-Mixers enables accuracies of up to 86.4% on CIFAR-10 image classification (92.2% with pretraining and knowledge distillation), compared with 64% for the same system without the mixer architecture. The mixer approach achieved its accuracy while using $>5\times$ fewer trainable parameters than the baseline. Finally, we present back-of-the-envelope estimates for inference energy efficiency and speed when using an example physical dynamical system, suggesting that orders of magnitude improvements may be possible over digital-electronic neural networks.

AI.tldr: 仿真表明，将现代 ML 训练实践（包括模型压缩）应用于基于非线性动力系统的物理神经网络后，MNIST 手写数字识别准确率可达 99.2%；以其为核心构件的 MLP-Mixer 式参数高效架构在 CIFAR-10 上达到 86.4%（预训练与知识蒸馏后为 92.2%）。
AI.motivation: 物理神经网络因潜在的高能效被视为 ML 加速器，但大多数已报告的推理精度远低于数字神经网络的先进水平，限制了其实际前景。
AI.method: 对多种基于非线性动力系统的候选物理神经网络应用现代训练实践（包括模型压缩）进行仿真；对其中一个动力系统，将其作为 MLP-Mixer 启发的参数高效架构的核心构件；并以一个示例物理动力系统做推理能效与速度的粗略估算。
AI.result: MNIST 准确率最高 99.2%；CIFAR-10 上，该系统在 Mixer 架构下准确率为 86.4%，而不含 Mixer 结构时为 64%；Mixer 方法的可训练参数比基线少 5 倍以上；粗略估计显示推理能效与速度相比数字电子神经网络可能有数量级的提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 现代训练方法与合理的架构设计可以显著缩小物理神经网络与数字网络的精度差距，并展示了该类硬件的潜在能效优势，但上述结论基于仿真与粗略估算，仍需实物验证。

title: Preserving Utility in Continual LLM Unlearning via Orthogonal Projections
summary: Unlearning concerns the task of removing the influence of a sensitive portion of the training data, such as protected, copyrighted or private text, from a model without retraining it from scratch. While unlearning requests happen continuously during a model's lifetime, the vast majority of LLM unlearning methods are ill-suited for iterated removal, yielding steep decay in forgetting and utility upon sequential unlearning. This decay stems from interference between successive updates, as each new deletion can undo earlier ones or push the model further along directions already degraded by them. To address this, we introduce Continual Orthogonal Projection (COP), a gradient-projection scheme that restricts each update to the orthogonal complement of activation subspaces cached from prior forget sets. This approach provably guarantees first-order non-interference with earlier deletions. COP stores only a low-rank basis per layer, requiring neither past gradients nor previous forget sets, and plugs into unlearning methods that update the model through gradient steps on a differentiable loss without modifying its objective. Experiments on standard LLM unlearning benchmarks (TOFU and RWKU) show that COP preserves utility across sequential requests without weakening forgetting, preventing the collapse of standard objectives and forgetting more effectively than continual-specific baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出持续正交投影（COP），把每次遗忘更新限制在先前遗忘集激活子空间的正交补中，从而对早先的删除请求保证一阶无干扰，使 LLM 在顺序遗忘中同时保持效用与遗忘效果。
AI.motivation: 大多数 LLM 遗忘方法不适合迭代删除：顺序请求后，遗忘效果与模型效用都会急剧衰减，原因是后续更新会抵消先前删除，或沿已被削弱的方向继续退化。
AI.method: 提出梯度投影方案 COP，每层仅存储来自先前遗忘集的低秩激活子空间基，并将更新投影到其正交补中；无需保存历史梯度或历史遗忘集，且可嵌入任何通过可微损失梯度步更新模型的遗忘方法，而不改变其目标函数。
AI.result: 在 TOFU 与 RWKU 基准上，COP 在顺序请求中保持了效用且未削弱遗忘效果；能防止标准遗忘目标的崩溃，并且比持续遗忘专用基线遗忘得更有效。摘要未给出具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 基于激活子空间的正交投影为持续 LLM 遗忘提供了一种可证明一阶无干扰、存储开销小且通用的解决方案。

title: The Precision Wall: An Optimizer-Dependent Boundary for Optimization under Power-Law Measurement Spectra
summary: In low-rank matrix sensing of a rank-$D$ factor $U^\ast \in \mathbb{R}^{V \times D}$, replacing isotropic Gaussian designs with power-law measurement covariance $\Sigma = \mathrm{diag}(j^{-s})_{j=1}^V$ leaves the Burer--Monteiro landscape free of spurious local minima, yet division-normalised first-order optimizers stall above a critical exponent $s^\ast$. We trace this failure to a numerical precision wall. At the ground truth, the smallest non-gauge expected Hessian eigenvalue scales at leading order as $V^{-(s+1)}D^{-s}$. When this curvature drops below the effective denominator floor $\epsilon_O$ of optimizer $O$, normalisation noise overwhelms rare-direction gradients, yielding the leading-order boundary $s^\ast_O(V, D) = [\log(1/\epsilon_O) - \log V]/\log(VD) + \delta_O$, where $\delta_O$ is a metric-dependent detection lag. With $\delta_{\mathrm{Adam}}$ calibrated on four configurations and frozen, this formula predicts Adam's onset within $0.45$ across all 16 cells of a held-out grid ($V \in \{64,128,256,512\} \times D \in \{4,8,16,32\}$), separates fixed-$VD$ pairs, and distinguishes denominator-precision walls from conditioning and sign-quantisation walls. The approximation fails at $D = 2$, reflects a finite-$D$ spectral crossover, and saturates below $\varepsilon_0 = 10^{-8}$ at a dynamical floor.

AI.tldr: 分析低秩矩阵感知中，在幂律测量谱下归一化一阶优化器在超过临界指数 s* 后停滞的原因，指出其根源是数值精度墙，并给出由优化器分母精度下限决定的失效边界公式，在留出网格上以不超过 0.45 的误差预测 Adam 的起始点。
AI.motivation: 把各向同性高斯测量替换为幂律测量协方差后，Burer–Monteiro 景观中仍无虚假局部极小值，但归一化一阶优化器在某一临界指数以上会停滞，其机制尚不清楚。
AI.method: 分析真值处期望 Hessian 的最小非规范特征值的主阶标度；当该曲率低于优化器的有效分母下限时，归一化噪声会淹没稀有方向上的梯度，由此推导出临界指数公式，其中包含依赖度量的检测滞后项；该滞后项仅在四个配置上标定后冻结，再在留出网格上检验。
AI.result: 在 V 取 64、128、256、512，D 取 4、8、16、32 的 16 个留出格点上，该公式对 Adam 起始点的预测误差不超过 0.45；公式能区分固定 VD 的配对，并能区分分母精度墙与条件数墙、符号量化墙；在 D=2 时近似失效，且在 1e-8 附近饱和于动力学下限。
AI.conclusion: 对于幂律谱下的一阶方法，决定其失效边界的是优化器的分母精度而非景观本身；该边界可以预测，并可用于区分不同类型的失效机制。

title: Numerical Integration on Bounded Domains via Learned Reflected Diffusions
summary: We study high-dimensional integration on bounded convex domains. Given a non-negative integrand $r$, the goal is to estimate $Z=\int_{D}r(x)\,\mathrm dx$ on $D\subset\mathbb R^d$. Standard Quasi-Monte Carlo does not adapt its evaluation points to the integrand, while effective importance sampling requires a proposal that captures its concentration. Learned diffusion samplers can supply such a proposal, but existing methods are formulated on $\mathbb R^d$ and do not respect the domain constraint $x\in D$. We instead build the proposal from reflected dynamics that stay in $D$ by construction. A reflected diffusion progressively transforms the target distribution toward the uniform distribution on $D$, and a neural score model is trained to reverse this process. A change-of-measure formula for reflected diffusions yields a training objective without additional boundary terms and an unbiased importance-sampling estimator of $Z$. For non-smooth integrands, where reparameterization gradients may be undefined or uninformative, we derive a REINFORCE estimator of the training gradient using Gaussian proposal densities before reflection, without evaluating reflected transition densities or differentiating $r$. We evaluate on numerous synthetic targets and real-world problems, demonstrating strong performance of the proposed method, as well as favorable scaling with the dimension of the problem and the number of points used for the Monte Carlo estimate.

AI.tldr: 提出在有界凸域上以学习得到的反射扩散作为重要性采样提议分布的高维数值积分方法，反射动力学使样本始终位于域内，并给出无偏积分估计器，在大量合成与真实问题上表现强劲。
AI.motivation: 准蒙特卡罗方法不会根据被积函数调整采样点，而有效的重要性采样需要能够捕捉被积函数集中区域的提议分布；已有的学习扩散采样器定义在 R^d 上，不能保证样本满足域约束。
AI.method: 以反射动力学构造提议分布，使轨迹在定义域 D 内成立；反射扩散将目标分布逐步转化为 D 上的均匀分布，训练神经分数模型来逆转该过程；利用反射扩散的变量替换公式得到不含额外边界项的训练目标与无偏重要性采样估计；对非光滑被积函数，用反射前的高斯提议密度推导 REINFORCE 型梯度估计，无需计算反射转移密度，也无需对被积函数求导。
AI.result: 在大量合成目标与真实问题上表现强劲；方法随问题维度与蒙特卡罗点数的增长具有良好的扩展性。摘要未给出具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 反射扩散为有界域上的积分提供了一个与域约束相容、无偏且能处理非光滑被积函数的学习型重要性采样框架。

title: Machine Learning-Based Detection of Mobile Money Scan Messages in Ghana: A Comparative Evaluation of Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machine, and Randon Forest Classifiers
summary: Mobile money (MoMo) is Ghana's preferred retail payment channel, recording GHC518.4 billion in transactions in December 2025 and over 26.7 million active accounts (Graphic Online, 2026). This growth has coincided with increased social-engineering fraud over Short Message Service (SMS) and Unstructured Supplementary Service Data (USSD), where fraudsters impersonate network operators, agents, relatives, or regulators to obtain personal identification numbers (PINs), identity data, or funds. We present a supervised machine-learning pipeline for classifying scam and legitimate Ghanaian MoMo SMS messages using a labelled corpus of 220 messages across 18 scam and legitimate subcategories. Domain-specific normalisation of currency amounts, phone numbers, and USSD codes preceded TF-IDF vectorisation of unigrams and bigrams. Using stratified five-fold cross-validation and a 20% held-out test set, we trained and evaluated Multinomial Naive Bayes, linear support vector machine (SVM), and Random Forest classifiers using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC), and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC). Held-out accuracy, F1, and AUC were 1.00 for Naive Bayes and linear SVM; cross-validated accuracy averaged 96.6% (+/-3.3), 94.9% (+/-4.6), and 92.0% (+/-4.2). Discriminative n-grams reflected imperative urgency ("send," "claim," "please send") and PIN solicitation ("PIN," "pincode"); legitimate messages featured confirmatory and cautionary language ("balance," "successful," "do not share"). Findings are contextualised in Sub-Saharan African SMS fraud detection, small template-based corpus ceiling effects, and a pathway toward larger naturalistic multilingual corpora. Interpretable classical classifiers achieve high accuracy on structured MoMo scam text and suit carrier- or handset-level filtering in low-resource, on-device settings.

AI.tldr: 比较朴素贝叶斯、线性 SVM 和随机森林对加纳移动货币（MoMo）诈骗与合法短信的分类效果；在留出测试集上，朴素贝叶斯与线性 SVM 的准确率、F1 与 AUC 均为 1.00，三者的交叉验证平均准确率分别为 96.6%、94.9% 与 92.0%。
AI.motivation: MoMo 是加纳主要的零售支付渠道，但针对 SMS 与 USSD 的社会工程诈骗日益增多，诈骗者冒充运营商、代理、亲属或监管机构以骗取 PIN、身份信息或资金；需要适用于低资源、设备端场景的可解释分类方法。
AI.method: 构建含 18 个诈骗与合法子类别、共 220 条标注短信的语料；对货币金额、电话号码和 USSD 代码进行领域特定归一化，再进行 unigram 与 bigram 的 TF-IDF 向量化；采用分层五折交叉验证与 20% 留出测试集，比较多项式朴素贝叶斯、线性 SVM 与随机森林，评估指标包括准确率、精确率、召回率、F1、MCC 与 AUC-ROC。
AI.result: 留出测试集上朴素贝叶斯与线性 SVM 的准确率、F1 与 AUC 均为 1.00；交叉验证准确率分别为 96.6%（±3.3）、94.9%（±4.6）与 92.0%（±4.2）。判别性 n-gram 包括 "send"、"claim"、"please send" 等紧迫用语与 "PIN"、"pincode" 等索取 PIN 的表达；合法短信则含 "balance"、"successful"、"do not share" 等确认与提醒用语。
AI.conclusion: 可解释的经典分类器在结构化的 MoMo 诈骗文本上即可取得高准确率，适合运营商或手机端过滤，尤其适用于低资源的设备端场景；但作者也指出小规模模板化语料可能带来天花板效应，仍需更大、更自然、多语言的语料验证。

title: Training Foundation Models with a Single Algorithm
summary: Foundation models are typically trained in stages: pretraining, midtraining, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL), with changes in both data and learning algorithms. We show that this algorithmic separation is not fundamental. By deriving suitable RL objectives as maximum-likelihood fitting to model-generated target distributions, we place all of these stages under a single likelihood-based training algorithm, unified training. This perspective turns the foundation-model training lifecycle into a problem of choosing which data to train on, in what proportions, and when, with conventional staged training as a special case. We instantiate this framework in a unified training system that mixes static data and RL generations within a single trainer. Across controlled and real-world experiments, unified training improves the accuracy-compute tradeoff and task coverage while preserving broader capabilities, and provides a stronger starting point for continual learning. This work lays the groundwork for a unified science of foundation-model training, connecting mathematical principles, training infrastructure, and the development of model capabilities.

AI.tldr: 证明预训练、中训练、SFT 与 RL 可以统一到同一个基于似然的训练算法之下：将适当的 RL 目标推导为对模型生成目标分布的最大似然拟合，并在单一训练器中混合静态数据与 RL 生成样本，在受控与真实实验中提升准确率与计算量的权衡及任务覆盖。
AI.motivation: 基础模型通常分阶段训练，数据与学习算法在各阶段都发生变化，这种算法上的分离被视为基本的；作者认为它并非必然，并希望据此把训练生命周期转化为选择数据、比例与时机的问题。
AI.method: 把 RL 目标写成对模型生成的目标分布的最大似然拟合，从而将预训练、中训练、SFT 与 RL 统一为单一的似然训练算法（unified training）；在单一训练器中实现，同时混合静态数据与 RL 生成结果；常规分阶段训练被视为其特例。
AI.result: 在受控实验与真实世界实验中，统一训练改善了准确率与计算量的权衡及任务覆盖，同时保留了更广泛的能力，并为持续学习提供了更好的起点。摘要未给出具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型训练可以统一为选择训练数据、混合比例与训练时机的问题，为连接数学原理、训练基础设施与模型能力发展的基础模型训练统一科学奠定基础。

title: An ODE-based Sampler for Discrete Diffusion Models
summary: The marginals of a continuous diffusion model can be reproduced by a deterministic ordinary differential equation (ODE), known as the probability flow ODE, which provides a foundation for accelerated sampling and consistency distillation. In this paper we address the question whether an analogous formulation exists for discrete diffusion models and answer it affirmatively by introducing exponential residual flows (ERFs). Our framework augments the discrete state with a continuous residual variable for each token and position. These residuals evolve deterministically according to piecewise-defined ODEs whose vector fields depend on the current discrete state and the forward and backward rate matrices of the prescribed diffusion model. The discrete state changes whenever a residual reaches zero. We prove that this construction preserves the marginals of the original diffusion. We derive a practical discretization of our sampler and specialize it to masked and uniform diffusion. The deterministic trajectories of ERFs support consistency distillation and yield empirical improvements over previous approaches across a variety of benchmarks including code and text generation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出指数残差流（ERF），为离散扩散模型构造确定性的 ODE 采样器：为每个 token 与位置附加连续残差变量，残差按由前向与反向速率矩阵决定的分段 ODE 演化，并证明该构造保持原扩散模型的边缘分布。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散模型可用概率流 ODE 复现边缘分布，从而支持加速采样与一致性蒸馏；作者探讨离散扩散模型是否存在类似的确定性形式，并给出肯定回答。
AI.method: 为离散状态的每个 token 与位置增加一个连续残差；残差按分段定义的 ODE 确定性演化，向量场依赖当前离散状态及给定扩散模型的前向与反向速率矩阵；残差归零时离散状态发生改变；给出实用的离散化方案，并分别specialize 到掩码扩散与均匀扩散。
AI.result: 证明该构造保持原扩散的边缘分布；确定性轨迹支持一致性蒸馏；在代码生成与文本生成等多个基准上较既有方法取得经验性提升。摘要未给出具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 离散扩散模型同样存在确定性的 ODE 采样形式，为离散扩散的加速采样与蒸馏提供了可行途径。

title: world2vec: Mechanistic world models through latent dynamics learning
summary: World models can achieve strong control performance without faithfully capturing the dynamics of their environment, limiting their potential for mechanistic interpretability and scientific discovery. Here, we introduce world2vec to learn mechanistic world models without reward information directly from observations and actions. World2vec learns latent dynamics that faithfully reproduce the true system over long prediction horizons, with at least one order of magnitude fewer parameters than DreamerV3, TD-MPC2 and LeWM. This enables state of the art performance in controlling continuous environments from pixels and accurate system identification across a benchmark of 71 attractors, demonstrating how world models are amenable to scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出 world2vec，直接从观测与动作中学习不依赖奖励信息的机械式世界模型（潜在动力学）；在长预测时域上忠实复现真实系统，参数量比 DreamerV3、TD-MPC2 与 LeWM 少至少一个数量级，并在从像素控制连续环境和 71 个吸引子的系统辨识基准上取得领先表现。
AI.motivation: 世界模型即使控制性能强，也未必忠实捕捉环境的动力学，这限制了其在机械可解释性与科学发现中的应用。
AI.method: 仅从观测与动作中、不使用奖励信息，学习潜在动力学模型；摘要称其参数量远少于 DreamerV3、TD-MPC2 与 LeWM，但未详述架构细节。
AI.result: 在长预测时域上忠实复现真实系统；在从像素控制连续环境任务上达到领先性能；在 71 个吸引子构成的基准上实现准确的系统辨识。摘要未给出具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型可以被学习为与真实动力学一致的机械式模型，因而可以服务于科学发现。

title: Rethinking Neural Thickets Without Weight Perturbations
comment: Project page can be found here: this https URL
summary: The Neural Thickets hypothesis posits that pretrained language models lie in dense neighborhoods of task-specific experts in weight space, which random Gaussian perturbations can uncover. We reproduce the reported gains, but show that they do not require this geometric explanation. Perturbing a single decoder block already recovers much of the improvement, while keeping the model entirely frozen and adding a random bias to its output logits matches or exceeds full-weight perturbations on most reasoning tasks. This suggests an alternative explanation based on output diversity, validation-based selection, and voting. We formalize this view as Perturb-Select-Vote (PSV), a general procedure that generates perturbed predictors, selects high-performing members on a small validation set, and aggregates their predictions. This interpretation connects Neural Thickets to established inference-time methods, including sampling, self-consistency, and verifier-guided selection. A first-order analysis further shows that small weight perturbations act primarily through their induced logit shifts. We extend this analysis to vision, where logit PSV substantially improves performance under domain shift, including on Earth observation, while full-weight perturbations provide little additional benefit. Together, these results suggest that the gains attributed to nearby weight-space experts can instead be obtained through output diversity, selection, and voting. Logit PSV realizes these benefits with a fully frozen model, providing a simple, training-free alternative to full-weight perturbation ensembles across language and vision.

AI.tldr: 复现 Neural Thickets 的增益，并证明这些增益不需要权重空间邻域的几何解释：仅扰动单个解码器块，或保持模型冻结并向输出 logits 加入随机偏置，即可达到或超过全权重扰动的效果；作者据此提出 Perturb-Select-Vote（PSV）框架。
AI.motivation: Neural Thickets 假设认为预训练语言模型位于任务专家的稠密邻域中，随机高斯扰动可以发现这些专家；作者质疑这一几何解释是否必要。
AI.method: 将工作形式化为 Perturb-Select-Vote：生成扰动后的预测器，在小验证集上选出表现良好的成员，再聚合它们的预测；一阶分析表明，小的权重扰动主要通过引起的 logit 偏移起作用；将分析扩展到视觉任务，提出 logit PSV。
AI.result: 单个解码器块的扰动即可恢复大部分提升；保持模型冻结并加入随机 logit 偏置，在多数推理任务上与全权重扰动相当或更优；在视觉任务中，logit PSV 在域偏移（包括地球观测）下显著提升性能，而全权重扰动几乎没有额外收益。摘要未给出具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 归因于权重空间附近专家的增益，可以通过输出多样性、选择与投票获得；logit PSV 提供了一种跨语言与视觉、无需训练且基于冻结模型的简单替代方案。

title: Propose-Filter-Release: Scaling Noise to Typical Sensitivity via Private Filtering
summary: An estimator can be accurate and stable on typical data, yet sensitive to a few possible records. Differentially private mechanisms commonly scale their noise to the worst-case influence of a single record, which lets these records dictate the noise even when the remaining data would allow far less. Removing them first would restore the smaller scale, but the removal must itself be private. We introduce \emph{propose-filter-release} (PFR), which, by privately filtering its input, turns a mechanism that protects the addition or removal of a typical record, one that fits the remaining data, into one that is differentially private in the standard sense, on every input. Using our novel filtering step, PFR requires only a concave friendliness score, which measures how well a record fits a dataset, and a release mechanism that is friendly-DP, that is, private when the changed record fits the remaining data. For every such score and release mechanism, it guarantees differential privacy under public conditions on the number of records, so it is a general privacy primitive, comparable to propose-test-release, and FriendlyCore can be viewed as one of its implementations. We illustrate the generality of PFR by instantiating it for scalar statistics, principal subspace estimation, the KL divergence of user histograms, the effective resistances of a graph, and treatment-rule selection.

AI.tldr: 提出 propose-filter-release（PFR）：通过对输入进行私有过滤，将只对典型记录（即与其余数据拟合良好的记录）保护隐私的机制，转化为在任意输入上满足标准差分隐私的机制，使噪声尺度随典型敏感度而非最坏情形缩放。
AI.motivation: 许多估计量在典型数据上准确稳定，却对少数记录极为敏感；差分隐私机制通常按单条记录的最坏影响缩放噪声，使这些异常记录主导噪声水平；先删除它们可以恢复较小的噪声，但删除过程本身必须是私有的。
AI.method: PFR 包含一个私有过滤步骤，只需一个凹的友好度分数（衡量记录与数据集的拟合程度），以及一个友好差分隐私（friendly-DP）的释放机制；在记录数量为公共信息的条件下，对任意此类分数与释放机制给出标准差分隐私保证；FriendlyCore 可视为其一种实现。
AI.result: 摘要给出的是通用隐私原语的保证，并将其实例化到标量统计量、主子空间估计、用户直方图的 KL 散度、图的有效电阻以及处理规则选择等任务中；摘要未给出具体数值结果。
AI.conclusion: PFR 是一种与 propose-test-release 相当的通用隐私原语，能让噪声按典型敏感度缩放，适用于多类统计与学习任务。

title: Accelerated Dataflow: scaling inference in streaming data analytics with efficiency
summary: Streaming data analytics helps businesses identify opportunities and spot risks in a timely fashion. As large language model (LLM) usage grows, people are exploring incorporating agents or LLMs in streaming data pipelines to help find patterns in datasets without supervision or interpret natural languages for content moderation. However, most streaming systems are currently optimized for data movement and perform poorly on GPU intensive workloads such as performing inference with LLMs. We introduce a system on Google Cloud Dataflow designed to tackle hybrid streaming machine learning workloads with co-designed autoscaling on heterogeneous worker pools and prefix-aware batching. This increases throughput 1.5x to 2x for streaming pipelines using LLMs while maintaining similar latency with up to 75% peak resource savings and 84% lower peak tail latency compared with existing streaming data processing systems.

AI.tldr: 在 Google Cloud Dataflow 上提出面向混合流式机器学习负载的系统，通过异构工作池上的协同自动扩缩容与前缀感知批处理，使使用 LLM 的流式管线吞吐量提升 1.5 至 2 倍。
AI.motivation: 流式数据系统主要为数据移动而优化，在 LLM 推理等 GPU 密集型负载上表现较差；而越来越多的流式管线希望嵌入代理或 LLM 来发现数据模式或解释自然语言以进行内容审核。
AI.method: 系统设计包括异构工作池上的协同自动扩缩容（autoscaling）与前缀感知批处理（prefix-aware batching），两者经过协同设计，以支持混合流式机器学习负载。
AI.result: 与现有流式数据处理系统相比，使用 LLM 的流式管线吞吐量提升 1.5 至 2 倍，同时保持相近的延迟；峰值资源节省最高达 75%，峰值尾延迟降低 84%。
AI.conclusion: 针对 GPU 密集型推理重新设计流式系统的调度与批处理，可在延迟基本不变的前提下大幅提升 LLM 流式管线的吞吐量与资源效率。

title: The Best Second Opinion Is Right Where the Primary Is Wrong: Partner Selection for Selective Span Tagging
summary: A span tagger that ranks its outputs by risk can defer the riskiest ones to a person, and a second model can sharpen this ranking. Which second model should it be? Partner selection is conditional, not global: the best second opinion is the model that is right where the primary is wrong. Across eight tagger types, three seeds and three English benchmarks (576 evaluated primary-partner pairings), choosing the partner by held-out accuracy on the primary's errors recovers 82% of the best partner's gain, against 69-70% for span F1 or a random pick. Frozen before a fourth dataset was chosen, the rule replicated there (Spearman 0.40 vs. 0.04 for span F1). Partner value is also directional. The predictive distribution is the second opinion: hard labels discard half of a partner's value, and scoring the served label improves 94% of pairings. Fixed before the fourth dataset was chosen, this score also replicated there. For LoRA-tuned decoders, independently trained partners beat every readout of the primary network. Applied zero-shot to 51 MASSIVE locales, every primary has a helpful trained partner in every locale, and the preferred partner follows competence.

AI.tldr: 研究选择性 span 标注中的第二模型选择问题：最佳的第二意见来自在主模型出错之处正确的模型；按主模型错误样本上的留出准确率选择伙伴，可恢复最佳伙伴增益的 82%，优于按 span F1 选择（69% 至 70%）或随机选择。
AI.motivation: 能按风险对输出排序的 span 标注器可把风险最高的输出交由人工复核，而第二模型可以改善这一排序；关键问题是应选哪一个第二模型，且这种选择是条件性的而非全局的。
AI.method: 在八种标注器类型、三个随机种子与三个英文基准上评估 576 组主-伙伴配对，比较按主模型错误样本上的留出准确率、span F1 与随机选择伙伴的效果；选择规则在第四个数据集确定之前冻结并在其上复现；另考察以预测分布而非硬标签作为第二意见的打分方式，并在 LoRA 微调的解码器上与主网络的各种读出比较；最后零样本应用于 51 个 MASSIVE 语言区域。
AI.result: 按主模型错误上的准确率选择伙伴时，恢复了最佳伙伴增益的 82%；在第四个数据集上复现，Spearman 相关系数为 0.40，而 span F1 为 0.04；硬标签会丢弃伙伴约一半的价值，对服务标签打分在 94% 的配对上有所改进；对 LoRA 微调解码器，独立训练的伙伴优于主网络的所有读出；零样本应用于 51 个语言区域时，每个主模型在每个区域都有一个有益的训练伙伴，且较优伙伴与其能力相符。
AI.conclusion: 伙伴价值具有方向性，衡量伙伴在主模型出错之处的正确性比衡量整体 span F1 更能预测其效用；预测分布本身即是有价值的第二意见。

title: Exposure Is Not Commitment: Double-Stratified Evaluation of Latent Monitors for Tool-Using Agents
comment: Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Agents in the Wild (AIWILD); OpenReview: this https URL . 16 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: Tool-using language agents are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection, and a growing literature probes model internals to catch unsafe actions before they execute, with sharply conflicting results. We argue much of the conflict is an evaluation artifact, and propose a double-stratification protocol: separate injection exposure from behavioral commitment, in both the evaluation and the training population. On the primary Qwen AgentDojo grid, monitors trained on the naive mixed unsafe-versus-rest contrast mostly learn exposure: they flag exposed trajectories whether or not the agent complies, and barely predict which cases turn unsafe. Retrained on exposed cases only, the same probe families predict the model's own unsafe tool call up to two steps early, the maximum the three-step trajectories admit (logistic AUROC 0.853, matched by a trained TF-IDF text baseline at 0.855). Mistral-7B reaches 0.896 and OLMo-2-7B 0.912; their naive contrasts learn different things: inverted exposure ranking on one, both axes on the other. Representations separate on exposure (probe 1.000 versus trained text 0.908) and where visible context is sanitized or unavailable. Training contrast alone reproduces the shape of recent pre-action-probe negative results, one candidate explanation for the conflict: the signal exists, but the model's own zero-shot forecast and NLA verbalizations do not reliably recover it. An unstratified AUROC overstates what a latent monitor knows, and what a naive contrast learns is population-dependent: evaluations should stratify both.

AI.tldr: 提出双重分层评估协议，将注入暴露与行为承诺区分开来，指出关于工具使用智能体潜在监控器的冲突结论很大程度上源于评估与训练样本的混杂；仅在暴露样本上重新训练后，探针可提前两步预测模型自身的不安全工具调用（逻辑回归 AUROC 为 0.853）。
AI.motivation: 工具使用语言智能体易受间接提示注入攻击，文献中通过探查模型内部表示在执行前拦截不安全行为，但相关结果相互矛盾。
AI.method: 提出双重分层协议，在评估与训练两类群体中分别区分注入暴露与行为承诺；在 Qwen AgentDojo 网格上比较两种训练方式：朴素的不安全与其余样本对比，以及仅在暴露样本上重新训练的同类探针；并在 Mistral-7B 与 OLMo-2-7B 上验证，同时与训练的 TF-IDF 文本基线以及模型的零样本预测与 NLA 语言化表述作比较。
AI.result: 朴素对比训练的监控器主要学习暴露，而非承诺；仅在暴露样本上重新训练后，逻辑回归 AUROC 为 0.853，训练的 TF-IDF 基线为 0.855，达到三步轨迹所允许的最大提前量（两步）；Mistral-7B 为 0.896，OLMo-2-7B 为 0.912；两个模型上朴素对比学到的内容不同，其中一个出现暴露排序倒置。
AI.conclusion: 不分层的 AUROC 会高估潜在监控器的实际认知，而朴素对比学到的内容依赖于样本群体，因此评估应同时对暴露与承诺分层；信号确实存在，但模型自身的零样本预测与 NLA 语言化表述并不能可靠地恢复它。

title: Artifact Distillation: Training-Free Transfer from Frontier to Small Language Models
comment: 10 pages (4 pages main text), 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: Closing the gap between frontier and smaller language models is usually approached by distillation: fine-tuning the small model (student) on a frontier model's (teacher) outputs, which binds transfer to training compute and leaves the transferred knowledge largely opaque. We propose Artifact Distillation: a teacher solves training instances and externalizes its problem-solving procedure into an artifact bank that a student queries at inference time, with no gradient updates. Across four LiveBench tasks, a bank written by Claude Opus 4.5 lets Claude Haiku 4.5 outperform unaided Claude Sonnet 4.5 on spatial reasoning (0.707 vs. 0.647) at 60% of its cost, and reach Sonnet 4.5's level on table joining at 89% of its cost. The same raw bank raises Qwen3.5-27B's pooled score from 0.730 to 0.800, showing that transfer is not confined to the teacher's model family.

AI.tldr: 提出 Artifact Distillation：教师模型将解题过程外化为构件库（artifact bank），学生模型在推理时查询该库，无需梯度更新；在 LiveBench 上，Claude Haiku 4.5 借助 Claude Opus 4.5 编写的构件库，空间推理得分（0.707）超过未辅助的 Claude Sonnet 4.5（0.647），成本约为其 60%。
AI.motivation: 缩小前沿模型与小模型之间的差距通常依赖蒸馏，即在教师输出上微调学生，这使迁移绑定于训练算力，且迁移的知识难以理解。
AI.method: 教师求解训练实例，并把其解题程序外化为一个构件库；学生在推理时查询该库，全程不进行梯度更新。
AI.result: 在四个 LiveBench 任务上，Haiku 4.5 借助 Opus 4.5 构件库在空间推理上得分 0.707，高于未辅助的 Sonnet 4.5 的 0.647，成本约为其 60%；在表格连接任务上达到 Sonnet 4.5 的水平，成本约为其 89%；同一原始构件库可将 Qwen3.5-27B 的汇总得分从 0.730 提升至 0.800，表明迁移并不局限于教师所属的模型家族。
AI.conclusion: 无需训练的知识外化可以实现跨模型家族的前沿到小模型迁移，且迁移与训练算力解耦、知识更加透明。

title: Supervised Fine-Tuning for Reasoning Large Language Models: A Survey
summary: Large reasoning models have recently demonstrated remarkable capabilities in solving complex tasks, where supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on long chain-of-thought data serves as a crucial foundation for eliciting and enhancing their reasoning abilities. Despite rapid progress in both improving and analyzing reasoning-oriented SFT, the field still lacks a systematic survey that consolidates its fast-growing literature. To fill this gap, we present a comprehensive review of recent advancements in reasoning SFT, examining the literature through the dual lenses of methodological design and analytical investigation. First, we review methodological improvements across the SFT pipeline and categorize them into data-centric approaches and algorithm-centric innovations. Second, we reorganize analytical studies along three dimensions: data characteristics, optimization dynamics, and mechanistic insights. Finally, by synthesizing current research focuses and remaining bottlenecks, we outline promising future directions for reasoning SFT. We hope this survey deepens the understanding of reasoning SFT and paves the way for advanced reasoning models.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于推理大模型监督微调（SFT，基于长思维链数据）的综述，从方法设计与分析研究两条线索梳理该领域进展，将方法改进分为数据中心与算法中心两类，并按数据特征、优化动力学与机制洞察三个维度组织分析性研究。
AI.motivation: 推理导向的 SFT 文献增长迅速，但该领域仍缺乏一篇系统综述来整合这些快速增长的研究。
AI.method: 文献综述：将 SFT 流程中的方法改进分为数据中心与算法中心两类；将分析性研究按数据特征、优化动力学与机制洞察重新组织；通过梳理当前研究重点与剩余瓶颈提出未来方向。
AI.result: 综述性质，摘要未给出定量结果；主要贡献是对推理 SFT 的方法改进与分析研究进行了分类、梳理与总结。
AI.conclusion: 作者希望该综述能加深对推理 SFT 的理解，并为构建更先进的推理模型铺平道路。

title: Prompt-agnostic Language Models
comment: Master's thesis, University of Potsdam, Hasso Plattner Institute, 2026, Parts of this work also appear in the EMNLP 2026 paper "Prompt-Robust Language Models: Which Training Strategies Work?" (arXiv:2609.01217)
summary: Despite their strong performance, large language models remain highly sensitive to prompt formulation. This issue is typically addressed at inference-time through manual prompt optimization, which introduces overhead and lacks scalability. Conversely, we focus on train-time approaches that build prompt robustness into the model during instruction tuning. A common strategy is to mix multiple paraphrases of each prompt into training. We demonstrate that across trainable parameters, the per-paraphrasing gradients interfere, with 57% exhibiting sign conflicts and the naive gradient average discarding approximately a fifth of the magnitude. Therefore, we develop two gradient-merging methods, Prompt-TIES and Prompt-DARE, that address this interference by leveraging interference-resolution operators from model and gradient merging and applying them to prompt gradients. In this study, we compare the efficacy of our methods to increase model robustness to train-time robustness methods spanning all three established classes: data construction, consistency regularization, and contrastive alignment. The evaluation is conducted across four models from two families at two scales. We observe the interaction between prompt phrasing and the specific examples accounts for 54% of per-example variability on average, and exceeds 70% on tasks such as ANLI and WiC. The gradient-merging methods directly improve this local robustness and nearly halve per-example variance on fully fine-tuned models at little cost to overall accuracy. The other train-time methods enhance raw performance, but fail to improve per-example variance reliably. Code: this https URL. Model checkpoints: this https URL.

AI.tldr: 提出 Prompt-TIES 与 Prompt-DARE 两种梯度合并方法，将模型合并中的干扰消解算子应用于同一指令多个改写提示的梯度，以提升 LLM 对提示表述的鲁棒性；在完全微调模型上近乎将逐样本方差减半，且对整体精度影响很小。
AI.motivation: LLM 对提示表述高度敏感，推理时的人工提示优化成本高且难以扩展；训练时的鲁棒性方法通常把多种改写混入训练，但不同改写的梯度相互干扰，朴素平均又会丢失大量幅度。
AI.method: 分析发现，不同改写的梯度存在符号冲突（占 57%），朴素平均会丢弃约五分之一的幅度；据此提出 Prompt-TIES 与 Prompt-DARE，将 TIES 与 DARE 类干扰消解算子用于提示梯度；与数据构造、一致性正则化和对比对齐三类训练时鲁棒性方法比较，评估涵盖两个模型家族、两种规模的四个模型。
AI.result: 提示表述与具体样本的交互平均解释了 54% 的逐样本方差，在 ANLI 与 WiC 等任务上超过 70%；梯度合并方法直接改善局部鲁棒性，在完全微调模型上近乎将逐样本方差减半，且对整体精度影响很小；其他训练时方法提升了原始性能，但未能稳定地降低方差。
AI.conclusion: 提示鲁棒性应以逐样本方差作为局部指标进行衡量，梯度合并是比其他训练时方法更可靠的改进途径。

title: One Confidence Threshold, Unequal Coverage: Language Gaps in Typed Decision Interfaces and How Translating Inputs Reduces Them
summary: Deployed classifiers often act on a prediction only when its confidence clears a threshold and pass the rest to a person. We ask whether one threshold serves all languages equally on typed decision interfaces, APIs that return a probability for each option of a fixed multiple-choice question. In a confirmatory study with a written analysis plan, three vendors' interfaces classified 1,000 MASSIVE items, each in 51 languages, with a threshold of 0.9. Even when a request is answered correctly in both English and another language, the English version clears the threshold more often, by 8.6-11.7 percentage points on average. Observed coverage, the share of requests handled automatically, is lower than English's in every other language, while the requests the gate handles are rarely wrong. The gap remains when every language is reweighted to the same accuracy, and a standard calibration metric (ECE) does not detect it on one interface. In exploratory analyses, English's coverage stays higher when each language gets its own threshold fitted to the same 5% error target. Translating inputs into English nearly closes the gap at 0.9 but leaves English ahead at that error target. Requests written natively in African languages show a gap in the same direction when English is their human translation. We recommend reporting per-language coverage at the operating threshold.

AI.tldr: 在 51 种语言的 1000 条 MASSIVE 条目上，对三家供应商的类型化决策接口开展预先撰写分析计划的验证性研究（阈值 0.9）：即使同一请求在英语与其他语言中都被正确回答，英语版本通过阈值的比例平均高出 8.6 至 11.7 个百分点；将输入翻译成英语可几乎消除该差距。
AI.motivation: 部署的分类器常只在置信度超过阈值时自动执行，其余交由人工处理；需要检验单一阈值是否对所有语言同样公平。
AI.method: 研究类型化决策接口，即对固定多选题的每个选项返回概率的 API；三家供应商的接口对 1000 条 MASSIVE 条目（每条 51 种语言）分类，阈值为 0.9；分析按语言的覆盖率、按准确率重加权后的结果、ECE 校准指标；探索性分析中为每种语言拟合针对 5% 错误率目标的独立阈值；另测试将输入翻译为英语的效果，以及以非洲语言原生撰写的请求。
AI.result: 阈值 0.9 下，英语的覆盖率高于其他语言，平均高 8.6 至 11.7 个百分点；其他各语言的观测覆盖率均低于英语，而被自动处理的请求很少出错；按准确率重加权后差距仍然存在；ECE 在某一接口上无法检测到该差距；为每种语言单独拟合 5% 错误率目标阈值后，英语覆盖率仍然更高；翻译为英语几乎消除 0.9 阈值下的差距，但在该错误率目标下英语仍领先；以非洲语言原生撰写、并以英语作为人工译文的请求，也呈现同方向的差距。
AI.conclusion: 应在工作点阈值下按语言报告覆盖率，因为单一阈值并不对所有语言公平；翻译输入可以缩小但未完全消除差距。

title: Two-Colour Zig-Zag Numberlink on Rectangles: A Forbidden-Pattern Characterization, a Constructive Polynomial-Time Algorithm, and a Lean Verification
summary: In Zig-Zag Numberlink, pairs of endpoints in a grid must be joined by vertex-disjoint paths that together visit every cell. The problem is NP-complete when the number of pairs is un- bounded (Adcock et al.). For a single pair it is the Hamiltonian path problem in rectangular grid graphs, solved by Itai, Papadimitriou and Szwarcfiter. Two pairs on a rectangle form the paired 2-disjoint path cover problem. We settle the case of two pairs on rectangles with the endpoints anywhere in the grid. If both sides of the rectangle are at least 11, an instance is solvable if and only if no entry of a finite catalogue of forbidden patterns occurs. The catalogue consists of a parity condition, an alternation condition on the border, a handful of local corner and edge patterns, 65 listed corner configurations, and a rule that propagates forced routes out of the corners before testing alternation. If a side is at most 10, a frontier dynamic programming algorithm decides the instance in time linear in the long side. The characterization is construc- tive. Solutions are built by deleting empty lines, splitting the rectangle by straight cuts, and splicing the pieces back together, in time O((R+C) RC). Both directions of the characterization and the correctness of the dynamic programming algorithm are verified in Lean 4. The finite case analyses, which are window certificates for the corner configurations and a check of all irreducible instances with sides 11-22, are carried out by the Lean compiler via native decide. We describe the algorithm, the catalogue, the proof structure, the compromises made in the formalization, and implementations in Python, JavaScript and C that produce identical output.

AI.tldr: 本文完整刻画了矩形网格上两对端点的双色 Zig-Zag Numberlink 的可解性，给出有限禁止模式目录，并提供多项式时间构造算法及 Lean 4 形式化验证。
AI.motivation: 单对端点时问题即矩形网格图上的 Hamiltonian 路径问题，已由 Itai、Papadimitriou 和 Szwarcfiter 解决；两对端点的情形在任意矩形上的完整可解性条件尚未被刻画，构造性解法与形式化验证也缺失。
AI.method: 对两边均不小于 11 的矩形，实例可解当且仅当不出现有限禁止模式目录中的任何条目，该目录包括奇偶条件、边界交替条件、若干局部角与边模式、65 种角配置，以及在检验交替前沿角向传播强制路线的规则；若某边不超过 10，则用前沿动态规划在长边的线性时间内判定；构造通过删除空行、直线切割与拼接完成，时间为 O((R+C) RC)；刻画两个方向及动态规划的正确性均在 Lean 4 中验证，有限情形分析借助 native decide 完成。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量实验指标；主要结果是两边不小于 11 时的刻画、两边不大于 10 时的动态规划判定，以及 Python、JavaScript 和 C 三种实现输出完全一致。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出了该问题的完整可解性刻画、可实现的构造算法和机器验证的正确性保证，并说明了形式化过程中所做的取舍。

title: Bouba Beats Kiki, and Other Regularities in the Subjective Preferences of LLMs
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures in main text; 27 pages, 13 figures in supplement. To appear at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Users engage with large language models on tasks that are purely objective ("When was Netflix founded?"), purely subjective ("What should I name my child?") or anywhere in-between. We have rich tools for evaluating model accuracy with respect to objective criteria. However, when it comes to subjective aspects of a task, we do not have similarly developed methodology at hand. In this paper, we take some early steps towards framing the question of subjective evaluation. Rather than measure how often a model is right or wrong on a question, we instead ask, how do models make choices among multiple viable responses without a clear winner? To study this question, we restrict our focus to short-form content, and consider comparison tasks among three such content types: numbers, baby names, and fictional cities. We identify 29 aspects of these short-form examples covering many areas of syntax and semantics (length, alphabetic order, popularity, vowel mix, spoken sound, etc.). We show first that models tend to have strong and reproducible preferences for or against some of these aspects. Second, we show that variations in how the model is asked to express a preference may cause some of these aspects to activate or deactivate in the model's selection. Third, we show that overall preference distributions among pairs may vary radically based on seemingly-unimportant variations in the nature of the question posed to the model, raising new questions about manipulation. And finally, we show that, if models are used both to create lists of alternatives and to rank them, there are unexpected interactions between the two stages that may also drive the models' stated preferences.

AI.tldr: 论文以主观偏好而非对错来评估 LLM，在数字、婴儿名字和虚构城市三类短文本的成对比较任务中考察模型的选择规律，发现模型存在稳定可复现的偏好，且偏好会随提问方式变化。
AI.motivation: 现有评测方法主要衡量客观问题上的正确率，对于没有明确赢家的主观选择任务缺少系统的方法论，而用户恰恰常用 LLM 完成此类任务。
AI.method: 选取数字、婴儿名字和虚构城市三类短内容，识别出 29 个覆盖句法与语义的属性（如长度、字母顺序、流行度、元音组成、发音等），通过成对比较考察模型对这些属性的偏好；并比较表达偏好方式与提问措辞的影响，以及先列举候选再排序的两阶段使用中的交互作用。
AI.result: 摘要指出模型对部分属性表现出强且可复现的偏好或反偏好；偏好的表达方式变化会使某些属性激活或失效；看似无关的提问措辞变化可能使成对偏好分布发生根本改变；列举与排序两阶段之间存在意料之外的相互作用。摘要未给出具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 主观选择中的模型偏好具有规律性，但对提问细节敏感，这引出了被操纵的风险，也提示多阶段使用时需要关注阶段间的相互影响，为主观评测提供了起点。

title: Towards Myocardial Infarction Diagnosis: An Investigation into Machine Learning and Deep Learning Algorithms using ECG Data
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Based on the authors' undergraduate thesis at BRAC University (2023)
summary: Myocardial Infarction (MI) is a severe and potentially fatal cardiac condition caused by myocardial injury due to ischemia, and timely detection can substantially reduce its mortality. Electrocardiography (ECG) is the primary diagnostic modality for MI, but manual interpretation is susceptible to human error. In this work, we propose Visionary V2, a multi-step, adaptive filtration method for ECG signal normalization, and use it to study machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) approaches to MI detection on the PTB Diagnostic ECG Database using all 15 available leads. On statistical features extracted from the filtered signals, such as the R-R interval, a Bagging ensemble of decision trees reaches 96.6% accuracy, compared with 87.7% when the signals are processed with BioSPPy. We further generate an image dataset from the filtered signals, on which a custom ResNet-50 misclassifies only 1 of 7,000 validation images and a custom CNN reaches an F1 score of about 98.7%. Finally, we apply LIME, Grad-CAM and Integrated Gradients to verify that the image models attend to the ECG waveform rather than the background. These results indicate that careful signal normalization combined with ML and DL models can support fast and accurate automated MI screening.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Visionary V2 自适应滤波方法进行心电信号归一化，并在 PTB 数据库的全部 15 个导联上比较机器学习与深度学习方法的心肌梗死检测效果，结果显示该预处理结合简单集成模型和图像 CNN 均能取得较高准确率。
AI.motivation: 心电图是心肌梗死的主要诊断手段，但人工判读易出现人为误差，需要可靠的自动筛查；摘要暗示既有预处理（如 BioSPPy）的效果有限，因此需要更好的信号归一化。
AI.method: 提出多步自适应滤波的 Visionary V2 对心电信号进行归一化；在 PTB 诊断心电数据库的 15 个导联上，从滤波后信号提取统计特征（如 R-R 间期）并训练 Bagging 决策树；另由滤波后信号生成图像数据集，训练自定义 ResNet-50 与 CNN；并用 LIME、Grad-CAM 和 Integrated Gradients 检验图像模型关注的是心电波形而非背景。
AI.result: 基于滤波后统计特征的 Bagging 决策树准确率为 96.6%，而用 BioSPPy 处理时为 87.7%；自定义 ResNet-50 在 7000 张验证图像中仅误分 1 张；自定义 CNN 的 F1 分数约为 98.7%。
AI.conclusion: 细致的信号归一化结合机器学习与深度学习模型，可支持快速且准确的心肌梗死自动筛查；可解释性分析表明图像模型依据的是心电波形。

title: Generation, Not Selection: LLM Proposals for Certified Access-Control Policy Mining
summary: Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) policy mining---recovering a compact, auditable policy from an access log---is posed as minimum set cover and solved greedily, which enjoys an $s^{*}(1+\ln m)$ guarantee. That guarantee is \emph{conditional} on a precondition the literature never states: the candidate pool handed to greedy must contain the optimal rules. Generation, not selection, is the binding constraint, and existing generators are purely \emph{syntactic}---they surface a rule only when enough log records witness it, so they fail on precisely the rare exception rules that fill a heavy-tailed policy. We replace the generator with a language model proposing rules \emph{semantically}, from attribute names, and keep the combinatorial selector to carry the guarantee: every proposal is filtered against the observed denials, so soundness is independent of the proposal mechanism and an unreliable proposer can only waste candidates, never grant access. Over five seeds on each of two enterprise domains, adding semantic proposal to a syntactic miner dominates it on \emph{ten of ten} runs---strictly better on seven---with near-optimal policies ($9.2$--$9.6$ rules against $s^{*}=9$, versus $11.2$--$14.6$) and false grants cut four- to sevenfold. Replacing the syntactic miner rather than augmenting it wins only where witnesses are scarce. An anonymization ablation isolates the mechanism: opaque attribute names cost two thirds of the model's rule recovery while leaving the syntactic baselines provably unmoved, and cost nothing where witnesses are plentiful. Semantic knowledge and log evidence are substitutes.

AI.tldr: 论文用语言模型根据属性名称语义地提出 ABAC 策略规则，并保留组合贪心选择器以维持覆盖保证；在两个企业场景中，语义提议在十次运行中全部优于纯句法挖掘器，策略更接近最优且误授权减少四到七倍。
AI.motivation: ABAC 策略挖掘被建模为最小集合覆盖并用贪心求解，其近似保证以候选池包含最优规则为前提，而既有句法生成器只能发现日志中有足够证据支持的规则，因而会漏掉填补长尾的稀有例外规则。
AI.method: 用语言模型从属性名称语义地提出规则，并用观测到的拒绝记录过滤每个候选，使安全性与提议机制无关，由组合选择器承担保证；在两个企业领域各五个随机种子下，将语义提议加入句法挖掘器与其对比，并做匿名化消融，隐去属性名称以隔离机制。
AI.result: 十次运行中加入语义提议的方法全部优于句法挖掘器，其中七次严格更优；所得策略规则数为 9.2 至 9.6（最优值 s* 为 9），基线为 11.2 至 14.6；误授权减少四到七倍；属性名称匿名化使模型的规则恢复损失约三分之二，而句法基线不受影响；在证据充足时匿名化则几乎无影响。
AI.conclusion: 语义知识与日志证据在策略挖掘中可相互替代；替换而非增强句法挖掘器只在证据稀缺时更有优势。

title: Learning Graph Beliefs for Active Radio Mapping With Decision-Certified Multi-Step Sensing
summary: Radio maps provide essential wireless propagation knowledge for network optimization and autonomous platforms. Acquiring dense measurements, however, is prohibitively costly, requiring active sampling to prioritize informative measurements. Existing active sampling methods typically rely on variances from prescribed spatial models or learned pointwise uncertainty, which may not fully capture the spatial correlation of different measurements. This paper proposes GraphBARC, a graph-structured active radio map construction framework that integrates learned spatial modeling with analytical Bayesian inference. A graph network learns correlated node and edge factors using only acquired measurements, inducing a joint full-map belief that supports analytical observation updates without retraining. Rather than immediate one-step acquisition, it adopts a nonmyopic sensing strategy that evaluates joint map-wide Bayes risk reduction over feasible multi-step routes, accounting for information redundancy among planned measurements. We reuse candidate responses and derive residual-based bounds directly on route-value differences, retaining shared response-error structure to avoid uniformly high-accuracy evaluation. An error-aware continuation bound screens unpromising prefixes, after which only responses needed for unresolved comparisons are refined. We further establish a computable decision-gap bound and show that certified exclusions remain valid during refinement. Experiments show that GraphBARC reduces mean root-mean-square error (RMSE) by over 16% relative to the evaluated baselines and core planning time by 56% compared with the fixed-accuracy, unpruned implementation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GraphBARC，用图网络学习测量之间的空间相关性并结合解析贝叶斯推断，以多步非短视规划进行主动无线电地图构建，相比评估的基线将均方根误差降低超过 16%，规划时间减少 56%。
AI.motivation: 获取密集无线电地图的测量成本高昂，而现有主动采样方法依赖规定的空间模型或逐点不确定性，难以充分刻画不同测量之间的空间相关性，也没有考虑规划测量之间的信息冗余。
AI.method: 图网络仅基于已获取的测量学习相关的节点与边因子，由此得到全图联合信念，并支持无需重训练的解析观测更新；规划上不再只选择下一步测量，而是评估多步可行路线上全图贝叶斯风险的降低；通过复用候选响应并在路线价值差上推导残差界进行剪枝，给出可计算的决策间隙界，并证明认证的排除在细化过程中依然有效。
AI.result: 相比所评估的基线，GraphBARC 的平均均方根误差降低超过 16%；相比固定精度且未剪枝的实现，核心规划时间减少 56%。
AI.conclusion: 将学习到的空间建模与解析贝叶斯推断结合，并通过可认证的剪枝实现非短视规划，可以在相同测量预算下提高无线电地图的重建精度，同时加快规划。

title: LRMoE: Demand-Side Load Re-Calibration for Efficient MoE Training on Memory-Constrained Nodes
summary: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models offer scalable capacity for Web applications, but uneven routing creates computation and communication bottlenecks. Existing placement and replication methods redistribute this workload, yet additional expert copies compete with token-related buffers for limited GPU memory. We present LRMoE, a memory-aware MoE training system that jointly recalibrates backward demand and balances the retained workload. During forward execution, it plans retention quotas and expert placement under resource constraints while preserving all routed computations. During backpropagation, a load recalibration metric estimates each token-expert pair's contribution to the expert update and selects pairs within these quotas. A capacity-aware routing algorithm distributes retained pairs among eligible instances of their original experts. Physical compaction then forms smaller communication payloads and variable-size grouped GEMMs, reducing backward traffic, computation, and execution-buffer demand. Experiments on Qwen3-30B-A3B and GLM4.5-106B-A12B show that LRMoE reduces cumulative MoE-layer training time to fixed-loss targets by 21.2-44.8% relative to SYMI.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LRMoE，一个面向显存受限节点的 MoE 训练系统，通过在反向传播中重新校准需求并压缩保留的 token-专家对来降低通信与计算开销；在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 和 GLM4.5-106B-A12B 上，达到固定损失目标的 MoE 层训练时间比 SYMI 减少 21.2% 至 44.8%。
AI.motivation: MoE 路由不均衡会造成计算与通信瓶颈，既有的放置与复制方法通过增加专家副本重新分配负载，但这些副本与 token 相关缓冲区争夺有限的 GPU 显存。
AI.method: 前向阶段在资源约束下规划保留配额与专家放置，并保留全部路由计算；反向阶段用负载重校准指标估计每个 token-专家对对专家更新的贡献，在配额内选择保留的对；容量感知路由将保留的对分配给原专家的可用实例；随后物理压缩，形成更小的通信载荷和可变大小的分组矩阵乘，从而减少反向流量、计算量与执行缓冲区需求。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 与 GLM4.5-106B-A12B 上，LRMoE 达到固定损失目标所需的累计 MoE 层训练时间比 SYMI 减少 21.2% 至 44.8%。
AI.conclusion: 在反向传播中按需求校准并压缩计算，可以在显存受限条件下有效降低 MoE 训练的通信与计算成本。

title: Beyond Similarity Search: Knowledge Graph Metadata Enrichment for Enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: A key challenge of RAG systems is retrieving information from enterprise documents created by multiple teams over time, where it is not possible to enrich the information using the latest information and metadata available outside the scope of organizational documentation responsibility. We investigated whether using a knowledge graph to store metadata and frequently changing information would improve upon knowledge retrieval over similarity search over embeddings. To perform the experiment, we created a snapshot of the SEC EDGAR dataset for a quarter, comprising 167,050 filings from 10,511 companies and 508,714 embedded chunks of risk-factor text. To simulate the enrichment, we created a knowledge graph of 430,257 nodes and 561,144 edges carrying an accession number on every edge. To evaluate the gain obtained via a graph-based design, we evaluated three architectures: text-to-SQL over typed columns, dense-vector RAG with HNSW cosine search, and a two-stage GraphRAG design. All architectures share the same model and temperature to allow comparison. Results are scored programmatically by an LLM as judge over 20 questions divided across four categories, each question asked three times. GraphRAG solved 16 of 20 questions on all three attempts, compared to 10 for text-to-SQL and 3 for vector RAG. GraphRAG lost on structured aggregation queries. Vector RAG lost the single-document category it was expected to win, passing 3 of 15 where GraphRAG passed 15 of 15, because company attribution is not recoverable from cosine similarity at this scale. All six confident falsehoods in the benchmark were text-to-SQL conflating distinct people who share a surname, the failure that resolving identity to an identifier before reading any text prevents structurally; GraphRAG made none. We claim no advantage beyond this corpus, this model and this question set.

AI.tldr: 论文比较了三种企业文档检索架构，发现在 SEC EDGAR 风险因素文本的 20 个问题上，带知识图谱元数据的两阶段 GraphRAG 表现最好；作者声明该结论不超出本文的语料、模型与问题集。
AI.motivation: 企业文档由多个团队在不同时间产生，仅靠嵌入相似度检索难以融入组织文档之外的最新元数据和频繁变化的信息，尤其难以把文本正确归因到具体公司。
AI.method: 构建某一季度 SEC EDGAR 的快照，包含 167,050 份申报、10,511 家公司和 508,714 个风险因素文本块；建立含 430,257 个节点与 561,144 条边的知识图谱，每条边都带有申报编号；比较基于类型化列的文本转 SQL、基于 HNSW 余弦搜索的稠密向量 RAG，以及两阶段 GraphRAG，三者使用相同模型与温度，由 LLM 作为评判程序化打分，每题提问三次。
AI.result: GraphRAG 在三次尝试中全部答对的题目为 16 题（共 20 题），文本转 SQL 为 10 题，向量 RAG 为 3 题；GraphRAG 在结构化聚合查询上落败；向量 RAG 在预期胜出的单文档类别中仅通过 15 题中的 3 题，GraphRAG 则通过 15 题中的全部 15 题；文本转 SQL 的六个高置信错误全部源于混淆同姓的不同人，GraphRAG 未出现此类错误。
AI.conclusion: 在读取文本前先把身份解析为标识符的图谱设计，能够在结构上避免身份混淆类错误，但该结论仅限于本文的语料、模型和问题集。

title: Amortized Localized Posterior Inference for Model Calibration with Application to an Ocean Turbulence Closure
summary: Model discrepancy may prevent a single calibration parameter from reproducing a physical response across the context domain. In addition, uncertainties in observations and contexts affect calibration and must be accounted for and quantified. We construct a family of localized posteriors by weighting observation likelihoods according to their proximity to a target context. Gaussian localization weights incorporate context uncertainty through covariance inflation, with reflection at domain boundaries and an optional correction for uneven context sampling. A conditional normalizing flow approximates the family of posteriors through amortized variational inference. Integrating the localized posteriors under a prescribed context measure gives the marginalized parameter distribution. In a twin experiment with the Branin-Hoo model, we compare global and localized inference under uniform and skewed context distributions. Localization reduces the reported aggregate predictive errors relative to the global posterior. An application to the k-$\epsilon$ turbulence closure in a single-column ocean model, with atmospheric surface forcing as context, shows that localized posterior calibration reduces temperature and zonal-velocity errors relative to deterministic and global-posterior calibration. Both twin experiments are constructed to admit local compensation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出对观测似然按与目标上下文的接近程度加权，得到局部化后验族，并用条件归一化流做摊销变分推断，应用于海洋湍流闭合参数的标定；局部化后验在孪生实验和单柱海洋模型中都降低了预测误差。
AI.motivation: 模型差异可能使单一标定参数无法在整个上下文域上复现物理响应，观测和上下文的不确定性也会影响标定，而全局后验难以刻画这种随上下文变化的差异。
AI.method: 用高斯局部化权重对观测似然加权，通过协方差膨胀纳入上下文不确定性，在域边界处做反射，并可选地修正上下文采样不均匀的问题；用条件归一化流通过摊销变分推断近似该后验族；在给定的上下文测度下对后验积分，得到边际化的参数分布；在 Branin-Hoo 模型的孪生实验中比较均匀与偏斜上下文分布下的全局与局部推断；在以大气表面强迫为上下文的单柱海洋模型中标定 k-epsilon 湍流闭合。
AI.result: 在 Branin-Hoo 孪生实验中，局部化后验相比全局后验降低了汇总预测误差；在海洋模型中，局部化后验标定相比确定性标定与全局后验标定，降低了温度与纬向速度的误差。
AI.conclusion: 局部化后验能够处理随上下文变化的模型差异与不确定性，对海洋湍流闭合的标定比全局方法更准确；需注意两个孪生实验均被设计为允许局部补偿。

title: ThinkJev: One Thought, Every Budget for Calibrated Typed Decisions
summary: Many uses of language models end in a typed decision: a choice among a closed set of options, whose probabilities code can act on. Reading those probabilities from one forward pass is fast but often wrong on decisions that take several steps, such as arithmetic, counting, and date comparison. Letting the model think first fixes most of these errors, but costs seconds per decision instead of milliseconds. To pay for thinking only where it helps, ThinkJev builds a fast and a slow system from one open hybrid-thinking model that can answer directly or after a thought. System 1 reads the model's probabilities for the option letters when it answers directly; System 2 reads the same letters after the model has thought on the same cached prompt, so escalating repeats no work and both systems give probabilities over the same options. Because the letters can be read after any number of thought tokens, one sampled thought also gives the answer under every thinking budget. Without training, ThinkJev lets System 1 answer alone only where a statistical test on labeled dev data guarantees that its accepted answers stay under a target error rate. At a 5% target, Qwen3.5-27B answers 24.5% of 8359 test decisions this way with a realized error of 3.9% (Qwen3.5-4B and 9B: 6.5% and 0.0%). For the rest, stopping each thought as soon as its answer is confident reaches 81.6% accuracy, against 82.7% for always thinking, with 72% of the thought tokens. Choosing when to think from System 1's confidence alone saves less, because the decisions System 1 is least sure of are often not the ones thinking fixes. On the public items of JevBench, an independent benchmark of typed-decision services, Qwen3.5-27B thinks on 29.4% and is not distinguishable in accuracy from the two thinking APIs listed (exploratory). Code and data generators are available at this https URL.
