AI.tldr: 论文提出 ThinkJev，用同一个混合思考模型构建快、慢两个系统，仅在需要时才进行思考，并通过统计检验保证直接作答的错误率不超过目标；在 5% 目标下，Qwen3.5-27B 直接作答了 8359 个测试决策中的 24.5%，实际错误率为 3.9%。
AI.motivation: 在算术、计数、日期比较等需要多步推理的决策上，仅凭一次前向传播读取选项概率往往出错；而让模型先思考虽能修正这些错误，却每次决策要花费数秒，成本高昂。
AI.method: 两个系统共享同一模型和缓存的提示：快系统直接读取选项字母的概率；慢系统在同一缓存提示上思考后再读取同样的字母概率，因此升级时不重复计算，且两者在同一组选项上给出概率；由于字母可在任意长度的思考之后读取，一次采样的思考即可得到所有思考预算下的答案；无需训练，仅在带标注的开发数据上通过统计检验，保证快系统所接受答案的错误率低于目标；对其余决策，在思考过程中一旦答案足够自信即停止。
AI.result: 在 5% 目标下，Qwen3.5-27B 直接作答 24.5% 的测试决策，实际错误率为 3.9%（Qwen3.5-4B 与 9B 分别为 6.5% 与 0.0%）；对其余决策，按置信度提前停止思考的准确率为 81.6%，始终思考为 82.7%，而所用思考 token 仅为 72%；仅依据快系统的置信度决定是否思考，节省较少；在 JevBench 公开条目上，Qwen3.5-27B 有 29.4% 的决策进行思考，其准确率与所列两个思考 API 无法区分（探索性结果）。
AI.conclusion: 只在必要时思考，并借助统计保证直接作答，可以以较少的思考 token 获得接近始终思考的准确率；但快系统的置信度并不能很好地指示哪些决策真正需要思考。

title: OpenFrontiers: A Collection of Open Research Problems and a Benchmark for Scientific Rediscovery
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown increasing promise in research-level problem solving, yet a comprehensive collection of such problems is still missing, and evaluating them on research-level problems remains challenging. We introduce OpenFrontiers, a cross-disciplinary resource that combines a structured corpus of open research problems with a retrospective benchmark of recently resolved problems in mathematics. The corpus records problem statements, context, progress, and other information for 12,151 problems. The benchmark contains 200 problems, 110 resolved in 2026 and 90 still open, each with a Lean~4 statement checked by automated probes and two independent reviews; a subset HQ-50 further filters based on quality score, etc. Our evaluation protocol grades formal proofs with two independent checkers in an isolated sandbox under closed-book, frozen-retrieval, and live-web conditions. Evaluating seven LLM agents on the HQ-50 subset under a standardized budget, we find that closed-book rediscovery is rare, at most 7 of 40 resolved problems, whereas live-web success mostly reflects retrieval of published solutions. By linking a broad research-problem corpus to a formally graded evaluation subset with documented solutions, OpenFrontiers provides a foundation for measuring research-level rediscovery and studying progress toward solving currently open scientific problems. The dataset and benchmark could be found in this https URL.

AI.tldr: 论文发布 OpenFrontiers，包含 12151 个开放研究问题的语料库，以及一个由 200 个数学问题组成的回顾性基准，用于评测 LLM 对已解决研究问题的重新发现能力。
AI.motivation: 目前缺少系统收录的研究级开放问题集合，研究级问题的评测也很困难，难以判断 LLM 能否真正推进科学研究。
AI.method: 语料库记录 12151 个问题的陈述、背景、进展等信息；基准包含 200 个数学问题（110 个在 2026 年解决，90 个仍开放），每题都有经自动探针检查和两位独立审阅的 Lean 4 陈述；子集 HQ-50 按质量分等进一步筛选；评测在隔离沙箱中进行，分闭卷、冻结检索与实时网络三种条件，由两个独立检查器对形式化证明评分。
AI.result: 在 HQ-50 子集上、在统一预算下评估七个 LLM 智能体，闭卷条件下重新发现的已解决问题至多为 40 题中的 7 题；实时网络条件下的成功多反映的是检索到已发表的解答。
AI.conclusion: OpenFrontiers 为衡量研究级重新发现、以及追踪开放科学问题的求解进展提供了基础，同时表明实际成功往往依赖检索而非闭卷推理。

title: Agentic Backdoors via Pretraining Poisoning
summary: Large language models are pretrained on vast, uncurated corpora scraped from the public web. This creates a security risk from attackers who plant poisoned content in the pretraining data. We show for the first time that such poisoning can plant a remote code execution backdoor in an agent, causing it to execute attacker-chosen commands on the user's machine. To measure the threat end to end, we pretrain Qwen3 models from scratch at sizes 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B, and then post-train each into a CLI agent using a clean pipeline. Poisoning only 0.1% of the pretraining corpus with our new poison design implants the backdoor: the deployed agent executes the malicious command when the trigger is present while behaving normally on clean inputs. The attack success rate (ASR) increases with model scale, with the 4B model reaching roughly 92% ASR at a 0.1% poison rate and staying positive even when the poisoning rate drops to 0.0005%. Our code is available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 论文首次表明，对预训练语料投毒可以在智能体中植入远程代码执行后门，使其在触发器出现时在用户机器上执行攻击者指定的命令；仅投毒 0.1% 的预训练语料，4B 模型即可达到约 92% 的攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: LLM 的预训练依赖从公开网络抓取的未经筛选语料，攻击者可在其中埋入投毒内容；此前尚未证明这种投毒能否在最终部署的智能体中造成端到端的远程代码执行威胁。
AI.method: 从零预训练 Qwen3 的 0.6B、1.7B 与 4B 三种规模模型，再用干净的流程将每个模型后训练为命令行智能体；采用作者新设计的投毒方式向预训练语料中注入少量投毒数据；测量触发器出现时的攻击成功率，并检验干净输入下的行为是否正常。
AI.result: 投毒 0.1% 的预训练语料即可植入后门；攻击成功率随模型规模增大而上升，4B 模型在 0.1% 投毒率下约为 92%，投毒率降至 0.0005% 时仍保持为正的攻击成功率；在干净输入上智能体的行为正常。
AI.conclusion: 预训练数据投毒可以在智能体中造成隐蔽的远程代码执行后门，且攻击效果随模型规模增大而增强，这提示需要重视预训练数据筛选以及部署前的安全检测。

title: Selective and Hybrid-State Communication for Latent Multi-Agent Systems
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Resource-Aware Agentic AI (RAAAI)
summary: Efficient communication remains a major bottleneck in large language model multiagent systems. Latent communication reduces repeated natural-language exchange by transferring internal model states between agents, but these transfers remain costly and are typically designed around conventional KV-cache representations. We address this problem from two complementary perspectives. We introduce SelectKV, a boundary-aware method that selectively communicates KV states while protecting inherited context, and HyLaMAS, which extends latent collaboration to hybrid linear-attention models by communicating both KV caches and recurrent states through a shared workspace. Across six benchmarks, SelectKV reduces communicated KV positions and logical KV payload by 9.7-9.9%, with accuracy unchanged on two benchmarks, within one percentage point on three, and six points lower on HumanEval+. Across Qwen3.5 model scales, HyLaMAS reduces decoded output tokens by 53-80% and achieves 1.16-2.78x speedups relative to text-based multi-agent communication. Together, these independently evaluated methods represent two complementary approaches to efficient latent-state communication across conventional Transformer and hybrid model architectures.

AI.tldr: 论文针对多智能体 LLM 系统的潜在通信，提出 SelectKV 选择性传输 KV 状态，以及 HyLaMAS 在混合线性注意力模型中同时传输 KV 缓存与循环状态；两者都降低了通信开销，其中 HyLaMAS 相对基于文本的多智能体通信可实现 1.16 至 2.78 倍加速。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统中反复的自然语言交换效率低下；潜在通信虽能减少文本交换，但传输内部状态的成本仍高，且通常围绕传统 KV 缓存设计，难以直接用于混合线性注意力模型。
AI.method: SelectKV 是一种边界感知方法，有选择地传输 KV 状态并保护继承的上下文；HyLaMAS 将潜在协作扩展到混合线性注意力模型，通过共享工作区同时传输 KV 缓存与循环状态。
AI.result: 在六个基准上，SelectKV 使通信的 KV 位置与逻辑 KV 载荷减少 9.7% 至 9.9%，两个基准上准确率不变，三个基准上下降不超过一个百分点，HumanEval+ 上低 6 个百分点；在 Qwen3.5 的多个规模上，HyLaMAS 使解码输出 token 减少 53% 至 80%，相对文本多智能体通信实现 1.16 至 2.78 倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 两种方法分别面向传统 Transformer 与混合线性注意力架构，是高效潜在状态通信的两条互补路径；其中 SelectKV 的节省幅度有限，且在代码基准上有明显的精度代价。

title: Investigating the Early Signatures of Feature Learning in Deep Linear Networks
comment: 92 pages, 7 figures, 16 pages of main text
summary: Deep neural networks learn data-dependent features, a capacity widely credited for their empirical success. However, explicitly characterizing what features emerge -- and when they improve generalization -- is challenging, since training is nonlinear and non-convex and the data is often anisotropic. Here, we give a closed-form account of feature learning for a deep linear network in a mean-field parameterization, trained by one gradient step from initialization on high-dimensional data carrying a low-dimensional (spiked) signal. In the infinite-width mean-field limit, one step updates each layer's feature kernel by a target-aligned rank-one spike, amplified by both the learning rate and the layer depth. We next assess how these features impact prediction through kernel ridge regression (KRR), finding that KRR on the learned feature kernel yields scalar inflation of the KRR estimator at initialization -- an "anti-shrinkage" mechanism that reinflates task-relevant directions suppressed by ridge, while also amplifying noise. To study when this inflation improves generalization, in the overparameterized proportional limit we derive closed-form expressions for the bias, variance, and generalization errors of these estimators in terms of key macroscopic parameters -- notably the spike strength and spike-target alignment. Crucially, we find that a one-step generalization advantage vanishes for isotropic inputs and appears when both the spike strength and an effective signal-to-noise ratio are sufficiently large, demonstrating that a successful first gradient step both requires and benefits from low-dimensional task structure.

AI.tldr: 论文给出深度线性网络在平均场参数化下，经过一步梯度更新后特征学习的闭式刻画，并分析其对岭回归泛化的影响；结果显示一步梯度的泛化优势仅在尖峰强度与有效信噪比都足够大时出现，对各向同性输入则消失。
AI.motivation: 深度网络学到的数据相关特征被认为是其经验成功的关键，但训练是非线性、非凸的，数据又常呈各向异性，因此很难显式刻画学到了哪些特征、以及它们何时能改善泛化。
AI.method: 在无限宽的平均场极限下，对带有低维尖峰信号的高维数据，从初始化开始做一步梯度更新，每一层的特征核被一个与目标对齐的秩一尖峰更新，其幅度同时由学习率与层深放大；再通过核岭回归分析学到的特征核，并在过参数化的比例极限中推导偏差、方差与泛化误差的闭式表达式，核心参数为尖峰强度与尖峰-目标对齐程度。
AI.result: 摘要指出，在学到的特征核上做核岭回归会使初始化时的估计量产生标量膨胀，即一种“反收缩”机制，它既重新放大被岭正则压制的任务相关方向，也会放大噪声；一步泛化优势在各向同性输入下消失，而在尖峰强度与有效信噪比都足够大时出现。摘要未给出数值结果。
AI.conclusion: 成功的第一步梯度既需要低维任务结构，也能从中受益，这为理解深度网络早期特征学习何时有助于泛化提供了解析视角。

title: An $Ω(T^{3/4})$ lower bound for projection-free online learning with linear minimization oracles
summary: This work considers projection-free online learning algorithms with linear minimization oracles for handling the decision set. For Online Frank--Wolfe (OFW), regret upper bounds were already known for specific OFW tunings [Hazan and Kale, 2012, Hazan, 2016] which scaled as $T^{3/4}$ (where $T$ is the horizon length). However, it remained an open question whether the regret of all OFW tunings scaled as $T^{3/4}$. We answer that question, proving a universal worst-case regret lower bound $\Omega(T^{3/4} m^{-1/4})$ for any projection-free algorithm that makes at most $m$ linear minimization oracle calls per round. The analysis suggests an extended OFW to resort to multiple linear optimizations per round, for which we prove a regret upper bound $O(\max \{ T^{3/4} m^{-1/4}, \sqrt{T} \})$.

AI.tldr: 论文证明了使用线性极小化预言机的无投影在线学习算法存在普遍的 Omega(T^{3/4} m^{-1/4}) 遗憾下界（m 为每轮预言机调用次数），从而回答了在线 Frank-Wolfe 所有调参是否都具有 T^{3/4} 速率这一公开问题。
AI.motivation: 已知某些特定调参下在线 Frank-Wolfe 的遗憾上界为 T^{3/4}，但所有调参是否都达到该速率仍是公开问题。
AI.method: 理论分析：对每轮至多调用 m 次线性极小化预言机的任意无投影算法，构造最坏情形证明遗憾下界；基于该分析思路，提出每轮可进行多次线性优化的扩展在线 Frank-Wolfe，并证明其遗憾上界。摘要未涉及实验。
AI.result: 遗憾下界为 Omega(T^{3/4} m^{-1/4})；扩展算法的遗憾上界为 O(max{T^{3/4} m^{-1/4}, sqrt(T)})。
AI.conclusion: 在每轮预言机调用次数受限时，T^{3/4} 速率对在线 Frank-Wolfe 的所有调参都无法避免；允许每轮进行多次线性优化，可按 m^{-1/4} 的因子改善该主项。

title: Finite-Sample Optimal Conformal Prediction Sets under Covariate Shift
summary: We study conformal prediction under covariate shift with a known covariate density ratio, seeking prediction sets with minimum expected length under the target distribution. For every calibration sample size, we prove that the rule combining the inverse conditional-density score with randomized weighted conformal calibration minimizes this expected length among all rules valid over the full weighted-exchangeability class. We approximate the oracle using quantile and kernel histograms, including forest-weighted estimators, and select estimators and tuning parameters by resampling to estimate calibrated target length. On a bounded response domain, we bound excess length linearly in $L^1$ density error at fixed calibration size, without requiring a uniform positive lower bound on the true density. We also bound selection-pool and resampling errors. Under explicit growth conditions, the selected procedure approaches the same oracle while the calibration size remains fixed. Experiments on 36 known-density configurations and four public regression datasets compare coverage, prediction-set length, and runtime with existing methods. In targeted low-coverage and strong-shift comparisons, inverse-density selection yields shorter mean sets in most cases and lower mean runtime than the evaluated weighted baselines, with some differences in achieved coverage.

AI.tldr: 论文在已知协变量密度比的协变量偏移下，证明了逆条件密度分数与随机加权共形校准相结合的规则在期望长度意义下最优，并用分位数直方图、核直方图及森林加权估计器逼近该最优规则；在 36 种已知密度配置和四个公开回归数据集上，该方法在多数情形下给出更短的预测集。
AI.motivation: 协变量偏移下，共形预测需要在目标分布上得到尽可能短的预测集，而既有加权方法未必达到期望长度意义下的最优，且需要处理密度估计带来的误差。
AI.method: 对每个校准样本量，证明逆条件密度分数与随机加权共形校准的组合在所有加权可交换有效规则中期望长度最小；用分位数直方图与核直方图（包括森林加权估计器）逼近该最优解，并通过重采样估计校准后的目标长度来选择估计器与调参；在有界响应域上，给出超额长度与 L1 密度误差呈线性关系的界，并界定候选池与重采样误差。
AI.result: 在 36 种已知密度配置和四个公开回归数据集上，比较了覆盖率、预测集长度与运行时间；在有针对性的低覆盖与强偏移比较中，逆密度选择在多数情形下得到更短的平均预测集，平均运行时间也低于所评估的加权基线，但在达到的覆盖率上存在部分差异。
AI.conclusion: 理论与实验共同表明，逆密度分数结合重采样选择能在协变量偏移下给出更短的有效预测集，并保持较低计算成本；在明确的增长条件下，所选程序在校准样本量固定时也能逼近同一最优解。

title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Global Climate Policy Cooperation
comment: Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning: workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: International climate policy requires coordination among countries whose mitigation decisions impose local costs but generate global benefits. Classical game-theoretic and integrated assessment approaches can study these incentives, but typically rely on prescribed behavioural assumptions or equilibrium concepts. Recent work has therefore explored Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning as a way to model climate-policy cooperation as an emergent outcome of repeated strategic interaction. We extend an existing MARL climate framework with a multi-stage negotiation mechanism in which agents propose agreements, accept or reject commitments, and face penalties for non-compliance. This allows us to study how agreement design affects learned mitigation behaviour, compliance, and climate outcomes. In an idealized setting with four homogeneous agents, we find that non-binding agreements do little to overcome free-riding, while moderate non-compliance penalties improve cooperation and reduce warming. However, excessively strong penalties discourage ambitious commitments, revealing a trade-off between enforcement and participation. We position the framework as a methodological contribution for testing agreement design rather than a predictive model of real negotiations.

AI.tldr: 论文在一个 MARL 气候框架中加入多阶段谈判机制，让智能体提出、接受或拒绝协议，并对违约施加惩罚，以研究协议设计如何影响学到的减排行为与气候结果；在四个同质智能体的理想化设定中，非约束性协议难以克服搭便车，适度惩罚有助于合作，过强惩罚则抑制积极承诺。
AI.motivation: 国际气候政策需要各国协调，但经典博弈论与综合评估方法通常依赖预设的行为假设或均衡概念；MARL 可将合作视为重复战略互动的涌现结果，但此前缺少专门研究协议设计的框架。
AI.method: 扩展一个既有的 MARL 气候框架，引入多阶段谈判：智能体提出协议、接受或拒绝承诺，并对不遵守者施加惩罚；在四个同质智能体的理想化设定中，考察不同协议设计如何影响学到的减排行为、遵约情况与气候结果。
AI.result: 非约束性协议对克服搭便车的作用有限；中等程度的违约惩罚改善合作并降低升温；过强的惩罚则抑制积极的承诺，揭示了执行力与参与度之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 论文的贡献是一个用于检验协议设计的方法框架，而非对真实谈判的预测模型；结果表明，执行强度需要在鼓励合作与保证参与之间权衡。

title: When More Planning Hurts: Learned Planners for World Models
summary: On PushT, our fixed action updater (1,505 parameters) solves 8 of 16 scenes reserved from our configuration selection. The comparison planners perform as follows: Selected Adam (7 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 218.440s), adapted iCEM (2 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 49.309s), released LePlanner (16 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 5.652s). The total planning and encoding time for our action updater is 59.079s. Note that our action updater does not satisfy the task-cost criterion we fixed before evaluation. We also conduct another matched experiment where we only replay the first ten commands in each context and then allow the next solve 4, 8 or 12 updates (subsequent solves all get 8 updates). Among all 16 contexts (8 scene clusters), the 3 budgets get 9, 8 and 7 successes, respectively. Interestingly, the extra updates did not rescue any failing task in this experiment. All the changes in success/failure happen in one scene cluster, where we observe that the extra updates decrease the costs of the selected latent world-model trajectories for our updater, while the tasks that used to be successes become failures. The code, weights, evaluators, execution traces and cost accounting accompany the paper.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个仅含 1505 个参数的固定动作更新器，用于世界模型中的规划，并与 Adam、iCEM 和 LePlanner 等规划器在 PushT 上比较；结果显示更多的规划更新并不总能提高成功率，额外更新甚至使原本成功的任务失败。
AI.motivation: 基于世界模型的动作规划通常依赖迭代优化，但增加优化计算预算是否一定带来更好的任务成功率并不清楚。
AI.method: 训练一个固定的动作更新器（1505 个参数），在潜在世界模型中更新动作序列；将其与选定的 Adam、适配的 iCEM 以及公开的 LePlanner 进行比较；另做匹配实验，只重放每个上下文的前十条指令，之后分别允许 4、8 或 12 次更新（其后的求解均为 8 次更新）。
AI.result: 在为配置选择预留的 16 个场景中，固定更新器解决 8 个；Adam 解决 7 个（规划与编码耗时 218.440 秒），适配的 iCEM 解决 2 个（49.309 秒），公开的 LePlanner 解决 16 个（5.652 秒），本文更新器耗时 59.079 秒，但不满足事先确定的任务成本标准；匹配实验中，4、8、12 次更新分别成功 9、8、7 个上下文，额外更新没有挽救任何失败任务，变化集中在一个场景簇内。
AI.conclusion: 更多的规划更新并不必然改善结果，额外更新可能降低已成功任务的质量并导致其失败；此外，该更新器未满足预先设定的成本标准；作者同时公开了代码、权重、评估器与执行记录。

title: What Actually Matters? A Paired Evaluation of Inference Settings for $π_{0.5}$ on BEHAVIOR-1K
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising paradigm for general-purpose household robotics. However, inference and data-collection strategies that have been deployed in smaller-scale settings do not necessarily generalize to large-scale, diverse task suites. To address this gap, we conduct a systematic, paired evaluation of previously proposed inference and data-collection strategies across all 100 tasks. Our evaluation uses a fine-tuned $\pi_{0.5}$ model based on the 2025 BEHAVIOR Challenge winner, which achieves a Q-score of 0.39 on the public test set. These results show that proposed strategies do not transfer uniformly to new environments and tasks. Project page, videos, and detailed analysis: this https URL

AI.tldr: 论文在 BEHAVIOR-1K 的全部 100 个任务上，对既有的推理与数据采集策略进行系统的配对评估，所用模型为基于 2025 BEHAVIOR Challenge 冠军模型微调的 pi0.5；结果表明这些策略不能在新环境与任务之间均匀迁移。
AI.motivation: 面向家庭机器人的 VLA 模型，其在小规模场景中有效的推理与数据采集策略，未必能推广到大规模、多样化的任务套件。
AI.method: 对此前提出的推理与数据采集策略进行系统的配对评估，覆盖全部 100 个任务；评估所用的是微调后的 pi0.5 模型，其在公开测试集上的 Q 分数为 0.39。
AI.result: 摘要指出，所提出的策略并不能在不同环境和任务之间统一迁移；摘要未给出具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 在小规模场景中提出的推理与数据策略需要在大规模任务套件上重新验证，不能想当然地认为其普遍有效。

title: FAD-KV: Adaptive Dictionary KV Caching for Efficient Reasoning Decoding
summary: Key-value (KV) caching is a core mechanism in large language models, where intermediate key and value representations are stored to accelerate autoregressive decoding. As generation length increases, KV cache memory and computation grow linearly, making compression critical for efficient long-output reasoning. Dictionary-based sparse KV compression is appealing because it represents each token's KV states as a sparse combination of learned basis elements (atoms) in a dictionary, preserving token-level structure without enforcing a global low-rank constraint. However, existing dictionary-based methods face two practical limitations during decoding: iterative sparse coding methods such as Orthogonal Matching Pursuit add decoding-time overhead, and static dictionaries may mismatch evolving KV distributions under test-time generation. While adaptive dictionary updates can reduce this mismatch, naive append-only strategies lead to dictionary growth during generation. We propose FAD-KV, a \textbf{F}ast \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{D}ictionary KV caching framework for efficient reasoning decoding. FAD-KV integrates (i) a screening-based sparse coding scheme, where a one-shot Top-\(n\) selection identifies a small candidate pool followed by lightweight coefficient refinement, and (ii) a fixed-size dictionary adaptation mechanism that reuses inactive atoms instead of expanding the dictionary. By controlling both sparse coding cost and adaptive dictionary growth, FAD-KV provides a memory-bounded and computation-efficient KV compression framework for long reasoning workloads. Experiments on reasoning and long-context benchmarks show that FAD-KV achieves a strong quality-efficiency trade-off while avoiding unbounded dictionary growth during decoding.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FAD-KV，一种面向长推理解码的快速自适应字典 KV 缓存框架，通过筛选式稀疏编码和固定大小的字典自适应来控制计算成本与字典增长；摘要称其在推理与长上下文基准上取得了较好的质量-效率权衡，并避免了解码中字典的无界增长。
AI.motivation: KV 缓存的内存与计算量随生成长度线性增长；基于字典的稀疏 KV 压缩虽有吸引力，但迭代式稀疏编码（如 OMP）会增加解码开销，静态字典又可能与测试时变化的 KV 分布不匹配，而朴素的仅追加式字典更新会使字典不断膨胀。
AI.method: 结合两部分：(i) 筛选式稀疏编码，通过一次 Top-n 选择得到较小的候选池，再做轻量的系数细化；(ii) 固定大小的字典自适应机制，复用不活跃的原子，而不是扩展字典。
AI.result: 摘要称在推理与长上下文基准上，FAD-KV 实现了较强的质量-效率权衡，并避免了解码过程中字典的无界增长；摘要未给出具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 通过同时控制稀疏编码成本与字典增长，FAD-KV 为长推理负载提供了内存有界、计算高效的 KV 压缩框架。

title: Machine learning applications in the heliosphere
comment: Review chapter submitted to the book Machine Learning Techniques for Astrophysics and Cosmology by Spring Singapore
summary: Space weather is the study of the near-Earth impact of the processes on the Sun. In a this era of technology, space weather emerges as a crucial area of study wherein the state of the near-Earth conditions need to be modeled and forecasted. Crucially, the advent of machine learning provides us with opportunities to study this subject in a rather comprehensive manner. In this chapter, we treat the the processes arising from Sun to the impact on the ground as a set of coupled systems, which can be studied in isolation or in a coupled manner. We define these individual systems in terms of their state vector $\vec{S}$, which provides us with an opportunity to define the physical variables determining the system. This also allows us to consider the systems in terms of their observables, obtained through the action of operators as $\vec{O}[\vec{S}]$. In such a formalism, the machine learning algorithms serve as {\it learned operators}, defined generally as inference ($\mathcal{I}$), propagation ($\mathcal{P}$), and emulation ($\mathcal{E}$). Through such a formalism, we present how machine learning helps advance our understanding of the physical systems under study, while also accelerating the development of operational models for space weather forecasting.

AI.tldr: 这是一章综述性质的书稿，将从太阳到地面的空间天气过程视为一组耦合系统，并把机器学习形式化为推断、传播与模拟三类学习算子，服务于空间天气的理解与业务化预报。
AI.motivation: 空间天气对近地技术系统影响重大，需要对近地空间条件进行建模与预报；机器学习为这一综合性研究提供了新的机会。
AI.method: 用状态向量定义各个子系统，把可观测量表示为算子作用于状态的结果；将机器学习算法视为学习算子，分为推断、传播和模拟（emulation）三类。
AI.result: 摘要未报告实验结果，主要是对该形式化框架的阐述，说明机器学习如何帮助理解所研究的物理系统，并加速业务化空间天气预报模型的发展。
AI.conclusion: 学习算子的形式化视角有助于组织空间天气中的机器学习应用，并推动业务化预报模型的发展。

title: Understanding Large Language Models as Numerical Optimizers
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as potential tools for numerical optimization. Despite promising results, their intrinsic optimization capabilities and limitations remain poorly understood, particularly in high dimensions. This paper investigates the ability of LLMs to exploit mathematical problem structures and generate feasible, near-optimal solutions. We develop an evaluation framework that distinguishes solution quality from execution failures, including numerical inaccuracies, constraint violations, and output-format errors. Using representative problems from convex optimization, fractional programming, and constrained projection, we assess LLM performance against deterministic reference solvers across different dimensions. Our results reveal that LLMs can capture useful optimization structures and produce near-optimal solutions, even when their outputs fail to satisfy numerical or formatting requirements. However, reliability deteriorates with increasing problem dimension and depends strongly on the underlying optimization structure. To further investigate the limitations, we deploy an iterative refinement mechanism that provides targeted feedback on feasibility and solution quality. The results demonstrate that iterative refinement substantially improves reliability and extends the range of problem dimensions over which LLMs produce valid solutions. Nevertheless, persistent numerical and structural errors limit their applicability as standalone optimizers. These findings provide insights into the capacity and limits of LLM-based optimization and motivate hybrid approaches that combine LLM reasoning with deterministic numerical verification.

AI.tldr: 本文评估大语言模型作为数值优化器的能力，将解的质量与执行失败（数值误差、约束违反、格式错误）区分开来。结果显示LLM能给出近最优解，但可靠性随维度增加而下降，迭代反馈修正能显著提升可靠性。
AI.motivation: LLM已被用于数值优化，但其在高维问题上的内在优化能力与局限尚不清楚，且缺乏能区分解质量与执行失败的评估框架。
AI.method: 在凸优化、分式规划和约束投影等代表性问题上，以确定性参考求解器为基准，在不同维度下评估LLM；引入迭代细化机制，向模型提供关于可行性和解质量的针对性反馈。
AI.result: LLM能捕捉有用的优化结构并给出近最优解，即使输出未满足数值或格式要求；但可靠性随问题维度增加而下降，且依赖于底层优化结构。迭代细化大幅提高可靠性并扩展了有效维度范围，但持续的数值和结构错误限制了其作为独立优化器的应用。
AI.conclusion: LLM可作为优化的辅助工具，结合LLM推理与确定性数值验证的混合方法更为可行。

title: SkillMem: Compact External Skill Memory for Latent Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: Latent multi-agent systems reduce inference cost by keeping intermediate reasoning and inter-agent communication in continuous representations.\ Reusable skills, however, are commonly supplied as text or stored as layer-wise Key-Value states or skill-specific model parameters, introducing repeated processing or substantial per-skill storage.\ We introduce \textbf{SkillMem}, which represents each reusable skill as a small external latent memory and makes it directly available during latent multi-agent reasoning.\ A role-conditioned cross-attention reader allows the same memory to guide different agents according to their roles and current hidden states.\ We train the skill memories and shared reader through behavioral distillation, matching the change in token predictions induced by a textual skill while keeping the backbone frozen.\ For our experiments, we obtain textual skills from paired successful and failed multi-agent trajectories, although existing skills can also be compiled directly.\ Across six benchmarks and Qwen3 models ranging from 4B to 14B parameters, SkillMem provides strong gains for smaller backbones while preserving efficient latent multi-agent inference across model scales.\ We use the same $8\times256$ memory configuration across all evaluated model scales, requiring 9.6\,KB of skill-specific storage per skill, including its retrieval embedding.\ For a library of 100 skills, SkillMem reduces total storage by more than $38\times$ compared with alternative skill representations and achieves up to a $4.23\times$ end-to-end inference speedup.\ These results show that compact procedural memories can be reused without sacrificing the efficiency of latent multi-agent reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出SkillMem，将每个可复用技能表示为小型外部潜在记忆，并在潜在多智能体推理中直接调用，在较小骨干模型上带来明显增益，同时保持高效推理。
AI.motivation: 潜在多智能体系统中，技能通常以文本形式提供，或以逐层KV状态、技能专用参数的形式存储，这会导致重复处理或每个技能的存储开销较大。
AI.method: 采用角色条件的交叉注意力读取器，使同一记忆能根据智能体的角色和当前隐状态引导不同智能体；通过行为蒸馏训练技能记忆与共享读取器，使其匹配文本技能引起的词元预测变化，同时保持骨干模型冻结；技能来源于成功与失败多智能体轨迹的配对。
AI.result: 在六个基准和4B至14B参数的Qwen3模型上评估；采用统一的8x256记忆配置，每个技能仅需9.6 KB存储（含检索嵌入）；对于100个技能的库，总存储比其他技能表示减少超过38倍，端到端推理最高加速4.23倍。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的程序性记忆可以被复用，且不牺牲潜在多智能体推理的效率。

title: You Don't Need Aligned Representations: Knowledge Distillation via Random Prototype Spaces
comment: To appear at NeurIPS 2026. 10 pages main text plus appendices. Code: this https URL
summary: A widely held assumption in knowledge distillation is that teacher and student representations must occupy a compatible or explicitly aligned feature space. We propose RPKD (Random Prototype Knowledge Distillation), which discards this assumption by comparing both networks against a shared bank of randomly initialized, frozen prototype vectors. Alignment is therefore carried out in an external reference space rather than in the teacher's native feature coordinates: the teacher side is projected by fixed random maps that carry no trainable parameters, and only the student adapts. Two branches handle the transfer: a logit branch aligning global prototype similarity distributions and a feature branch matching spatially-resolved prototype activation maps. Both operate within the same fixed prototype space, which can be interpreted as a random feature embedding that approximately preserves inter-sample similarity structure, so the prototype bank and the distillation objective stay unchanged across teacher-student pairs while only the input projections are instantiated per architecture. In low-category settings, decoupling the prototype vocabulary from the task label space yields richer supervision than the label space alone, an advantage absent from logit-based methods, whose supervisory signal collapses as class count shrinks. This advantage is especially relevant in real-world scenarios where the label space is typically constrained. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of RPKD, achieving a maximum gain of +7.98% over OFA on CIFAR-100, +12.44% on ImageNet-100, and +1.28% on ImageNet-1K. Source code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出RPKD，通过共享的随机初始化冻结原型空间对齐教师与学生的表示，使知识蒸馏无需特征空间对齐，并在多个数据集上取得提升。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏通常假设教师与学生表示处于兼容或显式对齐的特征空间，这一假设限制了师生架构的组合；且在类别数较少时，基于logit的方法监督信号会退化。
AI.method: 教师端通过无可训练参数的固定随机映射投影到共享的随机原型空间，仅学生端适配；包含两个分支：对齐全局原型相似度分布的logit分支，以及匹配空间分辨原型激活图的特征分支；原型库与蒸馏目标在不同师生组合间保持不变，每种架构只需实例化输入投影。
AI.result: 相对OFA，RPKD在CIFAR-100上最高提升7.98%，在ImageNet-100上提升12.44%，在ImageNet-1K上提升1.28%；在低类别设置下，解耦原型词表与任务标签空间提供了比仅用标签空间更丰富的监督。
AI.conclusion: 知识蒸馏无需显式特征对齐，解耦原型词表与任务标签空间可带来更好的监督，这对标签空间通常受限的实际场景尤为有益。

title: Federated Learning for Semantic Communications over Multiple Access Channels
summary: This paper presents a federated learning (FL) framework for semantic communication (SemCom) over the multiple access channel (MAC), where multiple distributed transmitters simultaneously convey semantic information to a common receiver using end-to-end learned semantic representations. Semantic feature extraction, compression, wireless transmission, and semantic inference are jointly optimized through FL-based SemCom. Unlike conventional SemCom systems that train users independently, simultaneous semantic transmissions over the MAC enable concurrent training of multiple transmitters within the same transmission interval, thereby reducing training overhead and channel usage. Federated semantic aggregation is incorporated with shared and personalized encoder components, allowing transmitters with limited local training data to benefit from semantic representations learned from transmitters possessing larger datasets while preserving local adaptation. Evaluated using the CIFAR-10 dataset over fading channels, the proposed approach maintains high semantic inference accuracy under shared wireless access and significantly improves performance under severe data imbalance. In the meantime, simultaneous semantic transmissions can significantly reduce training overhead while preserving robust semantic performance across distributed transmitters with heterogeneous local datasets. These results highlight the potential of combining FL and SemCom to support scalable and communication-efficient edge intelligence in future wireless networks.

AI.tldr: 提出面向多址信道语义通信的联邦学习框架，多个发送端同时传输语义信息并联合训练，在CIFAR-10上保持较高的语义推理精度，并在数据严重不平衡时显著改善性能，同时降低训练开销。
AI.motivation: 传统语义通信中各用户独立训练，训练开销和信道占用较高；多个本地数据量不同的异构发送端需要协作，同时保留本地适应能力。
AI.method: 在多址信道上让多个发送端在同一传输间隔内同时传输语义信息并并发训练；联邦语义聚合结合共享与个性化的编码器组件，使数据较少的发送端能利用数据较多发送端学到的语义表示。
AI.result: 在衰落信道下使用CIFAR-10评估，共享无线接入时仍保持较高的语义推理精度，在严重数据不平衡下性能显著提升，同时显著减少训练开销。
AI.conclusion: 结合联邦学习与语义通信，可支持未来无线网络中可扩展、通信高效的边缘智能。

title: Meta-Initialization of Implicit Neural Representations to Accelerate Deformable Medical Image Registration
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. English-language author version of a paper presented at GraphiCon 2026, Saint Petersburg, Russia, 22-24 September 2026. Russian-language proceedings forthcoming. Related work updated for this version
summary: Implicit neural representation (INR) methods for deformable medical image registration require the network parameters to be optimized for each new image pair, making adaptation speed a practical limitation. This work investigates whether early adaptation can be accelerated using an initialization learned from a collection of previously solved registration tasks. We examine two schemes: Reptile meta-initialization and STRAINER transfer of the shared component of a coordinate network. KAN-IDIR is used as the base INR displacement-field model. Experiments are conducted on OASIS-1, with 364 consecutive pairs used for training and 49 pairs for test-time adaptation. Registration quality is evaluated using mean Dice and HD95, together with the fraction of voxels with a negative Jacobian determinant at iteration 1500. In the configurations studied, both schemes yield higher Dice and lower HD95 at early iterations than random initialization. Reptile numerically outperforms STRAINER under a small iteration budget, although their pretraining budgets are not matched. As the number of iterations increases, the differences between the schemes shrink. STRAINER pretraining takes 39-40 minutes, compared with 44.98 hours for Reptile.

AI.tldr: 研究如何利用从历史配准任务中学到的初始化，加速基于隐式神经表示的可变形医学图像配准；Reptile元初始化与STRAINER迁移均在早期迭代中优于随机初始化。
AI.motivation: 基于隐式神经表示的可变形配准需要为每个新图像对优化网络参数，自适应速度是实际应用的瓶颈。
AI.method: 比较两种初始化方案：Reptile元初始化，以及迁移坐标网络共享部分的STRAINER方法；以KAN-IDIR作为基础位移场模型；在OASIS-1上用364对进行训练、49对用于测试时自适应。
AI.result: 两种方案在早期迭代中都比随机初始化获得更高的Dice和更低的HD95；在较小的迭代预算下，Reptile数值上优于STRAINER，但两者的预训练预算不匹配；迭代次数增加后两者差异缩小；STRAINER预训练耗时39至40分钟，Reptile则需44.98小时。
AI.conclusion: 在所研究的配置下，学习得到的初始化能加速早期配准，且STRAINER在预训练成本上优势明显。

title: FORGE: Feasible Online Reduced-Order Reference Generation and Whole-Body Execution for Agile Humanoid Locomotion
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE-RAS 25th International Conference on Humanoid Robots (Humanoids)
summary: This paper presents a two-stage learning framework for versatile and agile humanoid locomotion that couples online reduced-order model (ROM) reference generation with whole-body tracking control. In the first stage, we train a command-conditioned whole-body reference generator using single rigid body dynamics combined with full humanoid kinematics. In the second stage, the frozen ROM policy is rolled out online to generate references for training a whole-body tracking policy on the full-order dynamics model. Learning a kino-dynamically consistent reference generator in the simplified ROM space enables us to generate references over a broad command space and over multiple locomotion strategies using a single unified framework. We demonstrate the approach on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, achieving longitudinal velocities from -2.0 m/s to 2.8 m/s, lateral velocities up to +-1.0 m/s, angular velocities up to +-3.0 rad/s, one-legged hopping, and continuous transitions across the commands, all using one unified reference policy and one whole-body tracking policy.

AI.tldr: 提出FORGE两阶段学习框架，先在降阶模型空间中在线生成运动参考，再训练全身跟踪策略，使Unitree G1人形机器人实现多样且敏捷的运动。
AI.motivation: 敏捷人形运动需要覆盖广泛的指令空间，并保持运动学与动力学一致的参考，以支持多种运动策略。
AI.method: 第一阶段在单刚体动力学与完整人形运动学结合的降阶模型中，训练指令条件的全身参考生成器；第二阶段冻结降阶模型策略并在线滚动生成参考，用于在全阶动力学模型上训练全身跟踪策略。
AI.result: 在Unitree G1上实现了纵向速度-2.0至2.8 m/s、横向速度最高±1.0 m/s、角速度最高±3.0 rad/s，单腿跳跃，以及指令之间的连续过渡，全部使用一个统一的参考策略和一个全身跟踪策略。
AI.conclusion: 在简化的降阶模型空间中学习动力学一致的参考生成器，可以用统一框架覆盖广泛的指令范围和多种运动策略。

title: New Multiple Descent Phenomena Induced by Heterogeneous Data
summary: Modern machine learning models are often trained on large datasets assembled from many different sources, whose statistical properties can differ substantially. Understanding how this heterogeneity affects generalization performance is therefore important for explaining how model performance changes as model size increases. In this work, we study this question in linear random-feature models and show that mixtures of datasets with different covariance structures can give rise to a range of multiple-descent phenomena. We derive exact asymptotic expressions for the test error of each data source in the high-dimensional regime, and show how heterogeneity in covariance scale and spectral structure can introduce additional, group-dependent interpolation thresholds as model size increases. These phenomena arise even with noiseless labels and linear activations, showing that neither label noise nor activation nonlinearity is necessary for multiple-descent. Our results therefore provide a different perspective from classical explanations of multiple descent. More broadly, our results have potential implications for algorithmic fairness by showing that model scaling can affect different data groups unevenly, amplifying disparities in their generalization errors. We validate our theoretical results on synthetic Gaussian mixtures and real-world datasets, including MNIST and CIFAR-10.

AI.tldr: 在线性随机特征模型中，不同协方差结构数据的混合会产生多重下降现象，且无需标签噪声或激活非线性。
AI.motivation: 现代模型常在来自多个来源的数据上训练，不同来源的统计性质可能差异很大，因此需要理解这种异质性如何随模型规模影响泛化；经典的多重下降解释依赖标签噪声或非线性。
AI.method: 在线性随机特征模型中，推导高维极限下每个数据源测试误差的精确渐近表达式；分析协方差尺度和谱结构的异质性如何随模型规模引入与分组相关的插值阈值。
AI.result: 即使标签无噪声、激活为线性，数据异质性仍会产生多重下降；理论结果在合成高斯混合数据以及MNIST和CIFAR-10上得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 模型扩展可能对不同数据群体产生不均衡的影响，从而放大其泛化误差的差异，对算法公平性有潜在意义。

title: Finite-step statistical mechanics of scale-invariant learning: spectral equations of state and curvature transport
summary: Stationary learning admits an ideal-gas description under restrictive noise assumptions. In neural networks whose gradient noise departs from these assumptions, however, an entropy-scaling relation resembling a Maxwell relation remains approximately valid. We ask which thermodynamic-looking relations follow from scale symmetry rather than equilibrium, and how departures from the ideal-gas description can be quantified, for discrete stochastic gradient dynamics with memory. An exact rescaling of trajectories explains the entropy relation without assuming thermal equilibrium. Within a local harmonic approximation, self-adjusting weight norms yield a spectral equation of state whose virial coefficients are set by moments of the curvature spectrum, and coupled parameter groups can sustain stationary probability currents. Our central result beyond this approximation is an exact curvature-transport identity. Together with a finite-step loss balance, it decomposes corrections to the harmonic fluctuation relation into measurable curvature changes, finite-step remainders, gradient-memory correlations and finite-window drift terms. A related displacement-weighted curvature change provides a diagnostic of the arrow of time; its mean and second moment give a lower bound on the relative entropy between forward and reversed state pairs. We also calculate the activation-boundary contribution to curvature for rectified teacher-student networks with Gaussian inputs. Tests in sphere models, teacher-student networks and convolutional networks on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 support the transport description and identify limits of the harmonic and cubic-remainder approximations. These results separate symmetry-based relations from equilibrium assumptions and provide quantitative diagnostics of nonideal fluctuations in learning dynamics.

AI.tldr: 在离散随机梯度动力学中，尺度对称性可以推出若干类热力学关系，并给出曲率输运恒等式，用于量化学习动力学中偏离理想气体描述的非理想涨落。
AI.motivation: 平稳学习在较强的噪声假设下具有理想气体描述，但真实神经网络的梯度噪声会偏离这些假设；需要区分由尺度对称性而非平衡假设得到的关系，并量化偏离程度。
AI.method: 利用轨迹的精确重标度解释熵关系，无需假设热平衡；在局部调和近似下，自适应权重范数给出谱状态方程，其维里系数由曲率谱的矩决定；推导精确的曲率输运恒等式，并结合有限步损失平衡，把调和涨落关系的修正分解为可测的曲率变化、有限步余项、梯度记忆相关和有限窗口漂移项；对带高斯输入的整流师生网络计算了激活边界对曲率的贡献。
AI.result: 在球面模型、师生网络以及CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上的卷积网络中测试，结果支持输运描述，并指出了调和近似与三次余项近似的适用范围；位移加权的曲率变化可作为时间箭头的诊断，其均值和二阶矩给出前向与反向状态对之间相对熵的下界。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果将基于对称性的关系与平衡假设区分开，并为学习动力学中的非理想涨落提供定量诊断。

title: Efficient Deep Gaussian Process Surrogates via Mini-Batch Latent MAP Estimation
comment: 35 pages including references, 11 pages appendix, 5 figures
summary: Deep Gaussian processes (DGPs) are flexible surrogate models for computer experiments with nonstationary response surfaces, but inference over their latent representations remains computationally challenging. Existing methods typically rely on variational inference or Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC), which impose variational-family assumptions or require costly posterior sampling. We propose the latent maximum-a-posteriori deep Gaussian process (LaMP-DGP), which uses gradient-based optimization to obtain MAP estimates of the latent representations and enables efficient probabilistic prediction through linked-GP calculations. To scale LaMP-DGP to large datasets, we develop a mini-batch optimization algorithm and, under a polynomial mini-batch bias-decay condition, establish a stationarity bound for latent-state optimization that motivates a growing batch-size schedule. Across numerical experiments and real-data analyses, LaMP-DGP provides consistently competitive predictive performance relative to doubly stochastic variational inference, stochastic gradient Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, and fully Bayesian Vecchia DGP inference. Computationally, LaMP-DGP is substantially faster than the Vecchia MCMC approach while remaining broadly competitive with the stochastic-gradient alternatives. These results position LaMP-DGP as a competitive and computationally efficient alternative for DGP inference. An R package, "LaMPDGP", is available for implementing the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 提出LaMP-DGP，用梯度优化求得深度高斯过程隐表示的MAP估计，并通过小批量算法实现可扩展推断，预测性能具有竞争力，计算速度显著快于Vecchia MCMC。
AI.motivation: 深度高斯过程是非平稳计算机实验的灵活代理模型，但其隐表示的推断依赖变分推断或MCMC，前者受变分族假设限制，后者的后验采样代价高昂。
AI.method: 用梯度优化获得隐表示的MAP估计，并借助链接高斯过程的计算实现概率预测；开发小批量优化算法，并在多项式小批量偏差衰减条件下建立隐状态优化的平稳性界，据此采用逐步增大的批量大小调度。
AI.result: 与doubly stochastic变分推断、随机梯度哈密顿蒙特卡洛以及完全贝叶斯Vecchia DGP推断相比，预测性能具有一致的竞争力；计算上明显快于Vecchia MCMC，与随机梯度方法相比也具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: LaMP-DGP是DGP推断中一种有竞争力且计算高效的替代方法，并以R包LaMPDGP的形式提供实现。

title: Conformal Predictive Distributions for Contextual Order Fulfillment Optimization
summary: Ship-to-home fulfillment requires a retailer to select a fulfillment location and carrier before the delivery time is known. These decisions often rely on static transit-time estimates, which cannot represent how delivery-time uncertainty varies across orders and fulfillment options. This paper constructs conformal predictive distributions (CPDs) using Conformal Predictive Systems (CPS) for regression and the cross Venn-Abers predictor (CVAP) for multiclass classification, and uses them in a contextual optimization model for fulfillment decisions. The model is solved by contextual sample-average approximation (C-SAA). The regret of each fulfillment decision, its expected cost above that of the best decision, is bounded by forecast error, scenario-evaluation error, and the candidate-generation gap. The forecast term depends on how well calibration residuals or class probabilities represent the current order. On more than five million proprietary order records, CVAP raises exact-day accuracy from 49.5% for the rule-based estimate to 64.1%. Paired with a decision rule that selects a quantile weighting late errors more heavily, the split CPS (SCPS) gives a point estimate that raises late-delivery detection from 3.8% to 79.4%. Residual-based CPS distributions also meet or slightly exceed nominal interval-coverage targets. In decision experiments with a this http URL simulator over six test dates, C-SAA with CVAP lowers mean total cost by 7.1% and C-SAA with the Mondrian CPS (MCPS) lowers it by 6.7%, relative to C-SAA with the original nonconformal forecast. Both cut the late-delivery rate from 5.7% to below 4.0%.

AI.tldr: 用共形预测分布刻画配送时间的不确定性，并将其嵌入上下文优化模型，在五百万余条真实订单上使平均总成本降低约7%，并将晚送率从5.7%降至4.0%以下。
AI.motivation: 电商配送选择仓库与承运商时，静态运输时间估计无法反映配送时间的不确定性如何随订单和履约选项而变化。
AI.method: 回归任务使用共形预测系统（CPS），多分类任务使用交叉Venn-Abers预测器（CVAP）构建共形预测分布，并将其用于上下文优化，采用上下文样本平均近似（C-SAA）求解履约决策；分裂CPS配合更重视晚到误差的分位数决策规则给出点估计；每个履约决策的后悔值由预测误差、场景评估误差与候选生成间隙共同界定。
AI.result: 在超过500万条专有订单记录上，CVAP将精确到日的准确率从规则估计的49.5%提升至64.1%；分裂CPS将晚送检出率从3.8%提升至79.4%；基于残差的CPS区间覆盖率达到或略超名义目标；在六个测试日的决策模拟中，C-SAA结合CVAP和C-SAA结合Mondrian CPS分别将平均总成本降低7.1%和6.7%，两者都把晚送率从5.7%降至4.0%以下。
AI.conclusion: 经过校准的配送不确定性概率预测能够同时改善履约决策的成本与时效。

title: Cooperative EV Charging Assignment Using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning: A Comparison of QMIX and Independent Q-Learning Under Urban Traffic Uncertainty
comment: 14 pages, 7 figures. Presented at ICATH 2026 (Rabat, Morocco, 15-17 July 2026); accepted for publication in MDPI Engineering Proceedings (in press)
summary: The allocation of electric vehicles to public charging stations is increasingly constrained by the fact that several heterogeneous facilities often serve the same stream of requests while observing only partial local information. An accept/reject decision that is defensible for one station may nevertheless reduce the efficiency of the charging district as a whole. We formulate this operational problem as a Decentralized Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (Dec-POMDP) and examine whether Centralized Training with Decentralized Execution (CTDE), instantiated through QMIX, improves assignment performance relative to a cooperative Independent Q-Learning baseline (IQL). The evaluation uses a six-station urban network simulated with SUMO, five independent random seeds, 200 training episodes, and four traffic flux scenarios ranging from 100 to 250 vehicles/hour. Under this protocol, QMIX reaches a mean reward per evaluated decision of +0.776, versus +0.578 for IQL (delta = +0.198, seed-paired Cohens dz = 2.98, exact two-sided Wilcoxon p = 0.0625, the minimum attainable value at this sample size), and raises the acceptance rate from 72.4% to 94.0% (delta = +21.6 pp, dz = 5.24, Wilcoxon p = 0.0625). A five-variant ablation suggests this gain is primarily attributable to the CTDE architecture when holding cooperative reward terms fixed, though not formally isolated with a single seed. By contrast, cooperative reward shaping and experience sharing show no clear descriptive benefit and may slightly reduce performance. These findings support the view that, for multi-station charging assignment, coordination should be embedded in the learning architecture rather than added only through heuristic cooperation terms.

AI.tldr: 将多站电动汽车充电分配建模为Dec-POMDP，比较QMIX与独立Q学习，在六站SUMO仿真中，QMIX将每个决策的平均奖励从0.578提升至0.776，接受率从72.4%提升至94.0%。
AI.motivation: 多个异构充电站常服务于同一请求流且只能观测局部信息，单站可接受的决策可能降低整个充电区域的效率，因此需要协调机制。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为Dec-POMDP，比较集中训练分散执行（CTDE）的QMIX与协作型独立Q学习（IQL）基线；在SUMO六站城市网络上，使用五个随机种子、200个训练回合，并考虑100至250辆/小时的四种车流场景；另做了五种变体的消融实验。
AI.result: QMIX每个评估决策的平均奖励为+0.776，IQL为+0.578（差值+0.198，种子配对的Cohen's dz=2.98，精确双侧Wilcoxon p=0.0625）；接受率从72.4%提升至94.0%（+21.6个百分点）；消融结果表明收益主要来自CTDE架构，而协作奖励塑形和经验共享没有明显的描述性收益，甚至可能略微降低性能。
AI.conclusion: 对于多站充电分配，协调应嵌入学习架构之中，而不应仅依赖启发式的协作项。

title: Progressive-Observation Physical-Layer Fingerprinting for Efficient Open-Set Ethernet Authentication
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICC 2027
summary: Physical-layer fingerprinting (PLF) has emerged as a promising authentication approach for Internet of Things devices. However, most PLF systems acquire and process a fixed-length waveform for every authentication query, burdening resource-constrained edge nodes. To address this issue, we propose a progressive-observation PLF method that adapts the waveform length to each query. Specifically, a lightweight convolutional neural network (CNN) first rejects clearly unknown devices from a short observation. Spectral matching then accepts clearly registered devices from a slightly longer observation. Only ambiguous queries proceed to the same matching on the full-length waveform, reducing both data acquisition and computation. Because fingerprints drift across days, we also design an adaptive calibration algorithm to avoid retraining the CNN. The algorithm realigns the features and decision thresholds using a few current-day references from registered devices. We evaluate the method with 100BASE-TX Ethernet devices of two controller types on held-out days. Compared with fixed-length processing, it keeps the false rejection and false acceptance rates equal or lower for both controller types on both days. It also reduces the waveform data per query by 75.1% and the CPU processing time on a Raspberry Pi 5 by 73.7% on average. With the same monitoring bandwidth, an edge node can therefore serve about four times as many authentication queries.

AI.tldr: 提出渐进观测的物理层指纹认证方法，按查询自适应调整波形长度，并用少量当日参考进行自适应校准；在100BASE-TX以太网设备上减少了75.1%的波形数据和平均73.7%的CPU处理时间。
AI.motivation: 多数物理层指纹系统对每次认证查询都采集并处理固定长度的波形，给资源受限的边缘节点带来负担；同时指纹会随天数发生漂移。
AI.method: 轻量级CNN先用短观测拒绝明显未知的设备；频谱匹配再用稍长的观测接受明显已注册的设备；只有模糊查询才在全长波形上进行同样的匹配；自适应校准利用已注册设备的少量当日参考重新对齐特征并更新决策阈值，无需重新训练CNN。
AI.result: 在两种控制器类型、留出日期的测试中，错误拒绝率和错误接受率都不高于固定长度处理；每次查询的波形数据减少75.1%，在树莓派5上CPU处理时间平均减少73.7%；在相同监测带宽下，边缘节点可服务约四倍的认证查询。
AI.conclusion: 渐进观测加上轻量级校准能在降低边缘资源开销的同时保持认证性能。

title: Neural Compression of Long ADMM Trajectory for Multiparametric Quadratic Program
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code: this https URL
summary: Solving large-scale multiparametric quadratic programs (mpQPs) in real time often requires thousands of iterative optimization updates, creating a major computational bottleneck in model predictive control and learning-enabled systems. This paper proposes TQPNet, a self-supervised neural compression framework that learns to compress long ADMM optimization trajectories into a compact neural warm start followed by a few refinement iterations. We derive a low-dimensional ADMM scheme operating on the primal-dual variables $(x,\beta)$ and show that its iteration admits an equivalent ReLU-layer representation, termed ADMM(ReLU). Building on this insight, TQPNet combines a multilayer perceptron with ReLU activations (MLP(ReLU)) and a small number of unrolled ADMM(ReLU) refinement layers. The network is trained offline using an optimality-condition-informed residual loss, eliminating the need for solver-generated labels. The proposed residual-based framework enables both self-supervised training and online solution certification through adaptive ADMM(ReLU) refinement. Experiments on large-scale mpQPs and real-time MPC applications demonstrate that TQPNet achieves high accuracy, strong generalization, and substantially faster inference than conventional optimization-based methods.

AI.tldr: 提出TQPNet，以自监督方式将长ADMM迭代轨迹压缩为紧凑的神经热启动，并辅以少量精修迭代，用于求解多参数二次规划，推断速度远快于传统优化方法。
AI.motivation: 大规模多参数二次规划的实时求解往往需要数千次迭代更新，成为模型预测控制等场景中的主要计算瓶颈。
AI.method: 推导在原始-对偶变量上运行的低维ADMM格式，并证明其迭代可等价写成ReLU层表示ADMM(ReLU)；网络由带ReLU激活的多层感知机和少量展开的ADMM(ReLU)精修层组成；以最优性条件引导的残差损失离线训练，无需求解器生成的标签。
AI.result: 在大规模多参数二次规划和实时MPC应用中，TQPNet取得较高精度和较强的泛化能力，推断速度显著快于传统的基于优化的方法；残差框架还支持通过自适应ADMM(ReLU)精修进行在线解的认证。
AI.conclusion: 将优化迭代轨迹压缩为神经热启动是实时优化的有效途径，且残差形式兼顾了自监督训练与在线验证。

title: Interpretable Feature Discovery from Unstructured Data Using LLMs and Statistical Choice Models
comment: Preprint. 88 pages, 21 figures, 12 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: Feature extraction from unstructured data typically relies on opaque embeddings unsuited to interpretable decision-making. Interpretable features, on the other hand, typically require costly, and often infeasible, hand-engineering. Large language models (LLMs) offer a natural bridge, as they can read raw data and describe it in interpretable terms. One could simply ask an LLM to extract features from a large sample of the dataset, but context limitations and diluted attention can lead to unsatisfactory results. We introduce a method that automatically discovers interpretable, decision-relevant features from unstructured data. Our key idea is to perform pairwise comparisons between items, asking an LLM to articulate, in interpretable terms, the features distinguishing each pair. We treat these explanations, or rationales, as data: we develop a statistical choice model that combines these rationales across the comparisons to identify relevant features and estimate per-item, per-feature scores. We first test our method on a synthetic hiring dataset of cover letters with known ground-truth features and show that it significantly outperforms direct LLM feature extraction in feature recovery. We then apply it to the ChangeMyView (Reddit) debate dataset, where it discovers several interpretable features associated with persuasion while reaching predictive accuracy comparable to established baselines. We also show how the same rationales can be used to audit LLM decisions, yielding a holistic score whose decomposition over interpretable features reveals what the LLM rewards.

AI.tldr: 提出一种借助LLM两两比较与统计选择模型的方法，从非结构化数据中自动发现可解释的、与决策相关的特征，并可用于审计LLM的决策。
AI.motivation: 非结构化数据的特征提取通常依赖难以解释的嵌入，而人工设计可解释特征成本高且往往不可行；直接让LLM从大样本中提取特征又会受上下文长度限制和注意力稀释的影响。
AI.method: 对数据项进行两两比较，让LLM用可解释的语言说明区分两者的特征，并将这些解释视为数据；构建统计选择模型，跨比较整合这些理据，以识别相关特征并估计每个数据项在每个特征上的得分。
AI.result: 在合成的招聘求职信数据上，该方法的特征恢复显著优于直接的LLM特征提取；在ChangeMyView辩论数据上发现了若干与说服相关的可解释特征，预测精度与既有基线相当；同一批理据还可分解LLM的综合评分，揭示LLM奖励了哪些内容。
AI.conclusion: 将成对理据作为数据，可以从非结构化文本中得到可解释特征，并支持对LLM判断进行审计。

title: Nemotron 3.5 Super and Lightning: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Models for Agentic AI
summary: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Super and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, open and efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer models designed for reasoning, long-context understanding, and agentic workloads. Super is a 120B-parameter, 12B-active multimodal model, while Lightning is a smaller 30B-parameter, 3B-active text model; both designed for efficient deployment. Both models combine large-scale distillation, long-context training, and native speculative decoding, while Super further incorporates Indic continued pretraining and agentic software-engineering mid-training. We develop a comprehensive post-training pipeline spanning supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning (RLVR and RLHF), complemented in Super by specialized teacher training and multi- teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). This transforms Super from a text-only base model into a multimodal agent capable of reasoning over text, images, video, and interactive tool environments. We further explore test-time scaling through parallel agent execution and self-verification. Across training and deployment, we jointly optimize capability and efficiency. Indic continued pretraining improves Indian-language benchmarks by up to 9.82 percentage points, while agentic mid-training strengthens software-engineering capabilities and robustness across agent harnesses. The post-trained Super model achieves 51.78% on SWE-bench Pro, surpassing Nemotron 3 Ultra despite using approximately 4.6x fewer active parameters. Post-training MTP boosting improves speculative- decoding acceptance length by up to 21.8% under probabilistic draft sampling, while NVFP4 quantization achieves 99.62% median accuracy recovery relative to BF16. Inference optimizations enable up to 4,856 output tokens/s/GPU on GB200 while sustaining at least 50 tokens/s/user.

AI.tldr: 介绍Nemotron 3.5 Super（120B总参数、12B激活，多模态）和Lightning（30B总参数、3B激活，纯文本）两款MoE混合Mamba-Transformer开源模型，面向推理、长上下文和智能体任务，其中Super后训练模型在SWE-bench Pro上达到51.78%。
AI.motivation: 摘要的表述较为概括，目标是为推理、长上下文理解和智能体工作负载提供开放且高效、便于部署的模型。
AI.method: 结合大规模蒸馏、长上下文训练和原生推测解码；Super另加入印地语等印度语种的持续预训练以及智能体软件工程方向的中期训练；后训练包括监督微调与强化学习（RLVR和RLHF），Super还采用专门的教师模型训练与多教师同策略蒸馏（MOPD），并探索并行智能体执行与自我验证的测试时扩展。
AI.result: Super后训练模型在SWE-bench Pro上达到51.78%，超过Nemotron 3 Ultra，且激活参数约少4.6倍；印度语基准最多提升9.82个百分点；后训练MTP增强使推测解码的接受长度最多提升21.8%；NVFP4量化相对BF16的中位精度恢复率为99.62%；在GB200上最高达到每GPU每秒4,856个输出词元，且每用户至少50词元每秒。
AI.conclusion: 作为面向智能体的开放高效模型，Super在能力与效率之间取得了兼顾的结果。

title: Evaluating Causal Reasoning in LLMs: A Case Study in the Challenges of Procedural Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) appear to represent and reason about a large range of phenomena. In particular, recent studies have examined whether LLMs can accurately reason about causation. One of the most commonly used benchmarks for evaluating formal causal reasoning in LLMs is CLadder, a framework for procedural generation of benchmark data sets that was released in 2023. Experiments with CLadder appear to indicate that LLMs can perform formal causal reasoning in a large percentage of generated examples. In this paper, we examine what can be reliably inferred when LLMs perform well on test sets produced by CLadder. We identify several examples of superficial and highly predictive patterns that the CLadder generator embeds in data sets it generates. We find that even simple models such as random forests perform well on CLadder-generated data sets after training on a sample of generated data. We also find that the performance of many commercial LLMs on CLadder test sets is extremely brittle and that removing large sections of the text that are critical for formal causal reasoning has almost no effect on performance. Given these results, the most likely hypothesis for the strong performance of state-of-the-art LLMs on CLadder is that they are exploiting superficial patterns learned from exposure to training data from the generator. Any inference that LLMs are exhibiting more complex causal reasoning must rule out this hypothesis.

AI.tldr: 本文指出CLadder因果推理基准中嵌入了可被简单模型利用的表面模式，LLM在其上的高表现很可能源于利用这些模式，而非形式化因果推理。
AI.motivation: CLadder被广泛用于评估LLM的形式化因果推理，已有实验似乎表明LLM在大比例的生成样本上能完成形式化因果推理，因此需要检验这一结论是否成立。
AI.method: 识别CLadder生成器嵌入数据集中的表面且高度可预测的模式；用随机森林等简单模型在生成样本上训练并测试；对商用LLM在CLadder测试集上进行删减文本关键部分的实验。
AI.result: 随机森林等简单模型在CLadder生成的数据集上表现良好；许多商用LLM在CLadder测试集上的表现十分脆弱，删去对形式化因果推理至关重要的大段文本几乎不影响其性能。
AI.conclusion: 最可能的解释是LLM在利用生成器产生的训练数据中的表面模式；若要断言LLM具备更复杂的因果推理能力，必须先排除这一假设。

title: Same Label, Different Interface: Beyond Action-Space Labels in Robot Learning
summary: Robot-learning studies often compare position and velocity actions as though each label identified a single experimental treatment, yet the label alone does not determine what the robot executes. Before affecting robot motion, bounded policy output passes through filtering, physical scaling, reference construction, feedback, timing, and effort limits. We study how these omitted properties affect attribution under one shared learner and training budget. Across three contact-rich Factory tasks (PegInsert, GearMesh, and NutThread), we compare five joint-space interfaces, with ten independently trained policies per condition. We first remain within the same position-feedback law and vary the executed interface: substituting only the physical action scale as the directly modified component changes sample-median evaluation success by 0.645-1.000 across tasks, while removing an exponential moving average produces task-dependent changes. We then move to a cross-law comparison and choose a velocity scale that exactly matches the position interface's local raw-torque command gain. This calibration raises the sample median on GearMesh and NutThread, with no median change on PegInsert. Yet clear residual sample-median gaps remain on PegInsert and GearMesh, while the NutThread interval includes zero. Thus, even this explicit equality leaves feedback and held-action dynamics unmatched and does not establish position-velocity trained-outcome equivalence. Action-interface comparisons should therefore report the executed pathway and state the physical quantity they match.

AI.tldr: 在三个接触密集的Factory装配任务上比较五种关节空间执行接口，发现仅改变动作标签对应的物理接口就能显著改变训练结果，因此动作接口的比较应说明实际执行路径并陈述所匹配的物理量。
AI.motivation: 机器人学习研究常把位置动作与速度动作当作单一的实验处理，但动作标签本身并不决定机器人实际执行的内容：有界的策略输出还要经过滤波、物理缩放、参考构造、反馈、时序和力矩限制等环节。
AI.method: 在共享的学习器和训练预算下，于PegInsert、GearMesh和NutThread三个任务上比较五种关节空间接口，每种条件独立训练十个策略；先在同一位置反馈律下改变执行接口（例如物理动作缩放，以及去除指数移动平均）；再进行跨律比较，选取使速度接口与位置接口局部原始力矩指令增益精确匹配的速度尺度。
AI.result: 仅替换物理动作尺度，就使样本中位评估成功率在各任务间产生0.645至1.000的变化；去除指数移动平均则产生依任务而异的变化；速度尺度校准提高了GearMesh和NutThread上的样本中位数，在PegInsert上没有变化；PegInsert和GearMesh上仍存在明显的残余中位数差距，而NutThread的区间包含零。
AI.conclusion: 即使做了这种显式的增益匹配，反馈与保持动作的动力学仍不匹配，因此不能确立位置与速度训练结果的等价性；动作接口的比较应说明执行路径并陈述所匹配的物理量。

title: Who Called? V33DA: A Physically Verified Multimodal Benchmark for Vocal Attribution in Zebra Finch Groups
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). 43 pages, 3 figures. Dataset: this https URL ; Code: this https URL
summary: Deciding which member of an animal group produced a vocalization and where that vocalization was produced are central to studying social communication but are rarely evaluated with physically verified ground truth. Existing resources either localize sounds without identifying the caller, or recognize individuals from isolated vocalizations without reliance on the 3D candidate geometry. We close this gap with V33DA, a dataset-centered multimodal benchmark for spatial vocal attribution in social zebra finches: it comprises 33,625 verified events coupling 5-channel audio with three camera views, calibrated 3D pose for every visible candidate, and per-bird radio telemetry across 10 individuals and three experiments. Caller identity is verified from an on-body accelerometer-derived vibration signal; this channel is withheld from benchmark models and used only by an on-body reference ceiling. Given a detected vocalization and the visible candidate birds, the task is to select the caller. We evaluate it under three regimes: session-disjoint testing on familiar birds from held-out recording dates, held-out-experiment transfer to a new cohort, and leave-one-individual-out evaluation on a bird whose vocalizations are held out from training. Reference methods expose a consistent gap between in-domain accuracy and transfer to unseen individuals: methods that can exploit familiar vocal identity perform well on known callers but degrade sharply on unseen ones, whereas candidate-aware methods preserving explicit spatial reasoning transfer substantially better. The on-body reference stays near-perfect across regimes, confirming the internal consistency of the accelerometer-verified labels. We release V33DA with fixed protocols and code for the evaluated methods, and V33DA++, an unevaluated companion set of verified overlapping-call events and +/-2 s context windows.

AI.tldr: 发布V33DA，一个基于斑胸草雀群体的多模态基准，包含33,625个经物理验证的发声事件，用于在候选个体的3D位置中选出发声者；参考方法对已知个体表现良好，但对未见个体的迁移明显下降。
AI.motivation: 现有资源要么只定位声源而不识别发声者，要么只在孤立发声上识别个体而不利用3D候选几何，并且缺少经物理验证的真值。
AI.method: 构建包含5通道音频、三路摄像头视角、每个可见候选的校准3D姿态以及无线电遥测的数据集；发声者身份由机载加速度计振动信号验证，该信号对基准模型保密，仅用作机载参考上限；在三种设定下评估：留出录制日期的会话分离测试、新队列的留出实验迁移，以及留一个体评估。
AI.result: 参考方法在熟悉个体上表现良好，但对未见个体显著下降；保留显式空间推理的候选感知方法迁移明显更好；机载参考在各设定下都接近完美，验证了加速度计标签的内部一致性。
AI.conclusion: 发声者归因需要同时利用候选几何并对个体具有泛化能力；该基准附带固定协议和评估方法的代码，另发布了未经评估的伴随数据集V33DA++。

title: Post-Training Large Language Models with LLMON
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) treat all context tokens uniformly, lacking explicit separation between executable instructions and passive data. This leads to prompt injection vulnerabilities, ambiguous instruction binding, and unreliable execution control. We present a post-training methodology using LLMON (LLM Object Notation), a framework that enables separating instructions from data and requires explicit identifier-based execution. We construct a large-scale structured training corpus of 4.6B tokens spanning general, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and tool-calling data, augmented with distractor-infused variants in which competing instructions and irrelevant data segments are present in context but not referenced. Post-training two Granite-4.1 base models (3B and 8B) through supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning, we show that LLMON-structured supervision reduces attack success rates on indirect prompt-injection benchmarks from 53-100% to 0.02-5.6% while preserving general capabilities. We further introduce attention-based interpretability metrics that diagnose failure modes at individual transformer layers for structured inputs, revealing how our approach reshapes internal attention patterns. Our results demonstrate that explicit execution semantics can be taught through standard post-training without architectural modification.

AI.tldr: 提出基于LLMON（LLM对象表示法）的后训练方法，要求以标识符显式执行指令；在Granite-4.1 3B和8B上，将间接提示注入攻击的成功率从53-100%降至0.02-5.6%，同时保持通用能力。
AI.motivation: LLM对所有上下文词元一视同仁，缺乏可执行指令与被动数据之间的明确区分，从而导致提示注入漏洞、指令绑定模糊和执行控制不可靠。
AI.method: 构建约46亿词元的结构化训练语料，涵盖通用、RAG和工具调用数据，并加入干扰变体，其中竞争性指令和无关数据片段存在于上下文中但不被引用；对Granite-4.1基础模型先进行监督微调，再进行强化学习；提出基于注意力的可解释性指标，用于诊断结构化输入在各层的失败模式。
AI.result: 在间接提示注入基准上，攻击成功率从53-100%降至0.02-5.6%，同时保留了通用能力；注意力指标显示该方法如何重塑了内部注意力模式。
AI.conclusion: 显式的执行语义可以通过标准后训练习得，无需修改模型架构。

title: What Does LOL Measure? Hidden Label Shifts in Low-Light Enhancement Benchmarks
summary: LOL-v1 and LOLv2-Real are the standard benchmarks for supervised low-light image enhancement, and several leading methods ship hand-set test-time adjustments with their evaluation scripts. We audit both benchmarks with 18 public checkpoints of eight methods under one metric implementation that reproduces every published number to within 0.09 dB, and find that their test labels differ from their training labels. (i) The 15 LOL-v1 test labels are rendered differently: the same captures appear in LOLv2 with labels of identical luminance but 1.48x lower saturation, and LOL-v1's own training labels match the LOLv2 rendering; we confirm this on the official release. (ii) The LOLv2-Real test set is the contiguous block of images 690-789, whose labels are 14% darker than the training labels (Cliff's delta = -0.45, p < 1e-12) with no comparable shift in the input statistics we examined; methods trained without any labels score up to 5.5 dB higher on test than on train. (iii) All 15 LOL-v1 test inputs reappear in LOLv2-Real, 12 in its training set. The released test-time settings are consistent with compensating for these shifts. Separating what can be calibrated on training data from what only test-set tuning finds, the test-only residual has median 0.00 dB on LOLv2-Syn, which has no shift, but 0.37 dB on LOL-v1 and 0.92 dB on LOLv2-Real (up to 3.9 dB). Under the shift, test-set checkpoint selection inflates a from-scratch model by 0.9-2.0 dB, and removing the released settings changes which method ranks first. We give concrete reporting recommendations.

AI.tldr: 审计LOL-v1与LOLv2-Real两个低光增强基准，发现测试标签与训练标签存在系统性偏移，且已发布的测试时设置与这些偏移相吻合，说明测试集调参会虚高报告的性能。
AI.motivation: 低光图像增强的标准基准被广泛用于监督训练与评估，部分方法随评估脚本附带了手工设定的测试时调整，因此需要核查基准本身是否存在标签偏移。
AI.method: 使用一个能复现各已发表数值（误差在0.09 dB以内）的指标实现，审计八种方法的18个公开检查点；比较训练与测试标签及输入统计量，检验官方发布版本，并分析测试时设置的作用，区分可在训练数据上校准的部分与只能依靠测试集调参得到的部分。
AI.result: LOL-v1测试标签的渲染方式与LOLv2不同，亮度相同但饱和度低1.48倍；LOLv2-Real测试集（图像690至789）的标签比训练标签暗14%；不使用标签训练的方法在测试集上比训练集高出最多5.5 dB；测试集残差的中位数在LOLv2-Syn上为0.00 dB，在LOL-v1上为0.37 dB，在LOLv2-Real上为0.92 dB（最高3.9 dB）；在这种偏移下，测试集上的检查点选择会使从零训练的模型虚增0.9至2.0 dB，移除已发布的设置会改变排名第一的方法。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出了具体的报告建议，强调应区分可在训练数据上校准的部分与仅靠测试集调参才能得到的部分。

title: MiniMMD: Minimization of MMD for Sampling, Inference and Integration
summary: Many problems in computational statistics and machine learning can be formulated as approximating a target distribution by minimizing a discrepancy over a restricted class of candidate distributions. This minimum-discrepancy viewpoint appears, for example, in numerical integration, sampling, generative modelling, and statistical inference, but these instances are often studied separately in the literature. This thesis develops the first unified treatment of these many problems through the minimization of the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD), a kernel-based discrepancy between probability measures. The central theme is that MMD is not only a statistically meaningful distance between probability distributions, but also a tractable optimization objective to design practical and efficient algorithms. This thesis summarizes the recent theoretical and empirical advancements of such minimum-MMD based algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇论文式综述，提出以最小化最大均值差异（MMD）统一处理数值积分、采样、生成建模和统计推断等问题，并总结这类算法近期的理论与实证进展。
AI.motivation: 许多计算统计与机器学习问题都可归结为在受限候选分布类中最小化某种差异，但这些实例在文献中常被分开研究，缺少统一的处理框架。
AI.method: 以MMD作为核化的概率测度距离，同时把它作为可计算的优化目标，据此设计基于MMD最小化的实用高效算法。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，仅说明总结了基于MMD最小化的算法近期的理论与实证进展。
AI.conclusion: MMD既是有统计意义的分布距离，也是可操作的优化目标，为采样、推断与积分等问题提供统一且实用的算法视角。

title: On Worst-Case Guarantees for Graph-Based Nearest-Neighbor Search
summary: Graph-based nearest neighbor search algorithms like HNSW, DiskANN, NSG, and others have surged in popularity in recent years due to their excellent empirical performance in comparison to space-partitioning methods like IVF data structures and Locality Sensitive Hashing (LSH). However, in contrast to LSH and related methods, obtaining strong worst-case theoretical guarantees for graph-based search has proven challenging. In this paper, we prove a strong lower bound that helps explain the lack of progress towards such guarantees. We show that no standard graph-based method (any that runs a variant of greedy search on a flat or hierarchical graph) can achieve sublinear query time for approximate nearest neighbor search in Euclidean space, even for an arbitrarily large approximation factor. On the other hand, we prove that sublinear query time is possible if we allow for Steiner points in the search graph. We obtain bounds comparable to LSH, showing e.g., that graph-based search with Steiner points can solve $c$-approximate nearest neighbor search in Euclidean space with query time $\tilde{O}(n^{1/(c-1)})$. We complement this result with initial experiments exploring how Steiner points can be incorporated into practical graph-based methods.

AI.tldr: 证明只使用标准图结构和贪心搜索的图基近似最近邻方法（如HNSW、DiskANN、NSG）在欧氏空间无法达到亚线性查询时间，但引入Steiner点后可获得与LSH相当的理论保证。
AI.motivation: 图基搜索的经验表现优异，但与LSH相比缺少最坏情况理论保证，且此前进展有限，需要解释这一缺口的根源。
AI.method: 构造下界证明：任何在平面或层次图上运行贪心搜索变体的标准图方法都无法在欧氏空间实现亚线性查询时间；进一步考虑允许Steiner点的搜索图并分析其查询复杂度。
AI.result: 含Steiner点的图搜索可以解决欧氏空间中的c近似最近邻问题，查询时间为O~(n^{1/(c-1)})，与LSH相当；另给出将Steiner点纳入实用图方法的初步实验。
AI.conclusion: 标准图搜索的理论局限来自其结构本身，引入Steiner点是获得最坏情况保证的可行途径，但实验部分仅属初步探索。

title: In-Context Learning for Multi-Fidelity Multiscale Model Closure and Cross-Operator Out-Of-Distribution Generalization
summary: Multi-fidelity learning uses low-fidelity information (coarse-scale PDE models) together with limited high-fidelity data (fine-scale solutions) to obtain high-accuracy PDE solutions. It is a data-driven approach to downscale reduced-order models to solve PDEs efficiently and accurately. Standard multi-fidelity learning focuses on one operator or PDE; given a new PDE, retraining using additional coarse-fine solution pairs may be required, which is costly. In this work, we propose an in-context multi-fidelity learning framework for learning multiple multi-fidelity operators with one shared model. The model is trained using paired low- and high-fidelity examples as demonstrations from multiple operators, together with a new coarse-scale solution query, to predict the corresponding fine-scale solution. Once trained, given a new PDE operator, a few (fewer than five) coarse-fine demonstration pairs, and a low-cost coarse query, the model predicts the corresponding fine-scale solution without fine-tuning. When the target operator appears in the training dataset but has a different prediction goal, such as predicting beyond the training time interval, no additional demonstrations are needed. Instead, the model uses training coarse-fine pairs from that PDE and information from other training operators. Testing then only requires generating a low-cost coarse-scale solution query, without fine-tuning. Notably, our smallest model contains only 255,364 trainable parameters, corresponding to approximately 456 parameters per training operator for 560 operators.

AI.tldr: 提出一种上下文多保真学习框架，用一个共享模型同时学习多个PDE算子的多保真映射；对新算子只需少于五组粗细解示例和一个低成本粗解查询，即可无需微调地预测细尺度解。
AI.motivation: 标准多保真学习针对单一算子，遇到新PDE通常需要用额外的粗细数据重新训练，成本较高。
AI.method: 训练时把多个算子的低保真与高保真成对样本作为演示，连同新的粗尺度查询一起输入模型，预测对应的细尺度解；测试时只需生成低成本粗解查询，不做微调；对同一算子的不同预测目标（如超出训练时间区间），模型利用该算子及其他算子的训练数据。
AI.result: 最小模型仅有255,364个可训练参数，覆盖560个算子，平均每个训练算子约456个参数。
AI.conclusion: 单一共享模型可以跨多个PDE算子泛化，降低了多保真建模的数据与训练成本，为多尺度PDE的高效求解提供了一种思路。

title: Barren Plateaus in Quantum Linear Combinations: Interference and Lie-Algebraic Control
summary: A coherent sum of quantum circuits introduces interference that can alter the training signal. We distinguish a single linear combination of unitaries (LCU) from a circuit that repeatedly alternates branch operations and ancilla mixing. For a single-pass LCU, independent branches with zero matrix means cannot erase the differentiated branch's gradient variance: the total variance is at least the branch variance times the fourth power of its coefficient magnitude. This bound holds at any gate position and does not require the circuit unitaries to be Haar-random. Beyond this lower bound, we derive exact loss and gradient formulas that quantify the additional contributions from interference between branches. One of these terms depends on relative coefficient phases and vanishes when the branch ensemble is invariant under multiplication by $i \mathbb{I}$; a four-qubit matchgate example shows that it can be nonzero. For repeated interleaving with full special-unitary ancilla control, we determine the generated Lie algebra from the associative algebra of the branches, including the available central phase directions. This control result predicts concentration only with additional assumptions on circuit sampling. Matchgate examples exhibit polynomial single-pass LCU variances and exponential concentration under joint Haar-random sampling. We also derive coefficient-selection rules and bounds for postselection, measurement error, and approximate moments.

AI.tldr: 对单次线性组合酉算子（LCU）给出梯度方差下界及干涉项的精确损失与梯度公式；在交替插入分支与辅助比特的重复结构中，由分支代数确定的李代数表明，只有附加采样假设时才会出现梯度集中。
AI.motivation: 量子电路的相干叠加会引入分支间干涉，从而改变训练信号，影响对变分量子算法中贫瘠高原（梯度消失）现象的判断，因此需要区分单次LCU与重复交错两种结构。
AI.method: 对独立且矩阵均值为零的分支，证明总方差至少为被微分分支的方差乘以其系数模的四次方；推导包含分支间干涉的精确损失和梯度公式；对带完整特殊酉群辅助控制的重复交错结构，由分支的结合代数确定生成的李代数。
AI.result: 方差下界对任意门位置成立，且不要求电路酉算子为Haar随机；四比特matchgate例子表明干涉项可以非零；matchgate例子在单次LCU下方差为多项式，在联合Haar随机采样下出现指数级集中；还给出后选择、测量误差和近似矩的系数选择规则与界。
AI.conclusion: 单次LCU不必然导致指数级梯度集中，集中与否依赖于电路采样假设，而不只取决于结构本身。

title: GearUp: DAG-aware Acceleration for Serverless Inference Serving via Slack-guided Pre-loading
summary: Serverless platforms increasingly host machine learning (ML) inference workflows, modeled as directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) of interdependent functions. Beyond container startup, each ML node must load libraries, model weights, and CUDA kernels before it can run. These costs accumulate along dependent DAG paths and place initialization on the end-to-end critical path. Existing systems optimize one half of this problem. DAG-agnostic pre-loading prepares nodes the request may never reach, wasting host and GPU memory. DAG-aware serving routes and scales whole functions, leaving the loading stages inside a node untouched. This paper presents GearUp, a serverless DAG inference serving system that removes ML-node loading from the end-to-end critical path at low resource cost. GearUp profiles the loading stages of each node and schedules them inside the slack time the DAG exposes, hiding initialization behind upstream execution. It reuses initialized instances within and across requests to avoid redundant cold starts. A probabilistic, traffic-adaptive keep-alive policy sets how long idle instances are retained, balancing memory cost against cold-start risk under bursty load. On the AMBER Alert and FINRA-ML workflows with NVIDIA L40S GPUs, GearUp reduces median end-to-end latency by 64.5% and 75.9% against SMIless, for median speedups of 3.1x and 10.0x over cold execution. Integrated GPU and host memory allocation fall by up to 83.9% and 94.6% against eager pre-loading in InstaInfer. GearUp achieves 4.2x strong scaling on four workers.

AI.tldr: 提出GearUp，一种面向DAG结构机器学习推理工作流的无服务器推理系统，把模型节点的加载阶段调度到DAG暴露的时间松弛中，使初始化脱离端到端关键路径。
AI.motivation: 无服务器平台上，各节点需依次加载库、模型权重和CUDA内核，这些开销沿DAG路径累积并占据关键路径；现有DAG无关的预加载会浪费内存，而DAG感知的调度又不处理节点内部的加载阶段。
AI.method: 剖析每个节点的加载阶段，并在DAG的时间松弛中调度它们，使初始化隐藏在上游执行之后；在请求内和请求间复用已初始化的实例；采用随流量自适应的概率化保活策略，决定空闲实例的保留时长，以平衡内存成本与冷启动风险。
AI.result: 在AMBER Alert和FINRA-ML工作流上（NVIDIA L40S GPU），相对SMIless，中位端到端延迟分别降低64.5%和75.9%，相对冷执行的中位加速比为3.1倍和10.0倍；相对InstaInfer的即时预加载，GPU与主机内存分配最多分别降低83.9%和94.6%；在四个worker上实现4.2倍强扩展。
AI.conclusion: 利用DAG的时间松弛隐藏加载开销，并配合资源受控的实例复用与保活策略，可以显著降低机器学习推理工作流的冷启动延迟，同时节省内存。

title: Embodied at Sea: Imitation Learning for Multi-Task Underwater Manipulation
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures. For associated files, see this https URL
summary: Behavior Cloning has demonstrated promising generalization capabilities for robotic manipulation in terrestrial environments. However, marine visual distortions and dynamic currents create a severe domain shift that remains a key bottleneck in adapting generalist architectures to underwater field manipulation. To address this, 1616 episodes of underwater manipulation data were collected in calm and turbulent waters and were used to train 14 generalist Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models (DynamicVLA) with varying proprioception observation configurations. Across three tasks on 1260 gradable on-hardware rollouts in a pool, 10 models outperformed the baseline, with the highest-performing model achieving a 93.3% overall success rate, including partial successes. Results are also introduced from a case study evaluating the performance of a single-task Action Chunking Transformer (ACT) and a generalist VLA (SmolVLA) policy for two tasks in marine archaeology and conservation: grasping and mooring. Experiments are performed on an ROV on and around the WWII wreck Coralita X127 and at Manoel Island Marina, Malta. Across 748 collected episodes and 508 gradable on-hardware rollouts, the ACT policy substantially outperformed SmolVLA (47.9% vs. 7.9% pooled success rate), earning a 66.7% success rate on the most successful task at the marine archaeological site. To enable further contributions to embodied intelligence in marine field robotics, the BLUEMBODIED KIT used to collect data, train models, and deploy policies on the ROV has been open sourced.

AI.tldr: 利用1616个水下真实操作示范训练14个通用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，并以海洋考古场景中ACT与SmolVLA的对比案例研究说明水下操作的域偏移问题，同时开源相关工具包。
AI.motivation: 海水造成的视觉畸变和动态洋流带来严重的域偏移，使在陆地上表现良好的行为克隆通用架构难以迁移到水下现场操作。
AI.method: 在平静与湍流水域采集水下操作数据，训练14个具有不同本体感受观测配置的DynamicVLA通用模型，并在水池中对三项任务进行硬件实测；另在马耳他一处沉船及码头附近用ROV，对单任务ACT与通用SmolVLA进行抓取与系泊两项任务的案例研究。
AI.result: 水池实验中1260次可评分的硬件滚动，10个模型优于基线，最佳模型整体成功率为93.3%（含部分成功）；现场案例中748个episode、508次可评分滚动，ACT汇总成功率为47.9%，SmolVLA为7.9%，ACT在考古现场最成功的任务上达到66.7%。
AI.conclusion: 在水下场景中，小型专用的ACT策略明显优于通用SmolVLA，开源的BLUEMBODIED KIT可以支持海洋机器人具身智能的后续研究。

title: Skeleton Coding: Program Structure as a Specification for Agents
summary: Coding agents are typically provided end-to-end behavioral specifications that the code they produce should satisfy, such as tests and input--output examples. How many such specifications must a developer provide, and which ones, for the agent to produce the developer's intended program? We argue that this cannot be determined a priori, for it depends on the structure of the implementation, which is left to the agent to decide. An agent first commits to a structure---a decomposition into data types, modules, and functions---which fixes a class of candidate programs; behavioral specifications then select a program within that class. A set of tests that suffices for one structure may leave another badly underdetermined, requiring different edge cases or exponentially more examples. Since the structure is chosen by the agent, developers cannot ensure their specification is complete without reverse-engineering it from thousands of lines of generated code. To resolve this, we introduce Skeleton Coding, in which developers jointly specify the structure---in high-level, code-like format---alongside behavioral specifications. Theoretically, we model AI-assisted coding as a control problem, and show that skeletons can reduce exponentially the number of tests developers must supply to steer an agent toward an acceptable program. Empirically, across four models and three benchmarks, the best-performing skeleton specifications reduce mean test error by 48.4% relative to the best end-to-end behavioral specifications. Even when the agent can query a complete reference implementation, adding a skeleton reduces mean test error relatively by up to 27.0%. Skeletons also narrow the average gap between small and large models by about 52.4% while lowering implementation cost by 15--26x, and reduce code erosion by 24.7% on average.

AI.tldr: 提出骨架编码（Skeleton Coding），让开发者在提供行为测试的同时，用类代码的高层格式指定程序结构，从而大幅减少引导编码智能体生成正确程序所需的测试数量。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体会自行决定程序结构（数据类型、模块与函数分解），同一组测试对不同结构的约束强度不同，开发者无法事先确定规格是否完整，只能从大量生成代码中反推结构。
AI.method: 把AI辅助编码建模为控制问题，从理论上证明骨架可以将开发者需要提供的测试数量减少到指数级；实证上在四个模型和三个基准上比较骨架规格与端到端行为规格。
AI.result: 最佳骨架规格相对最佳端到端行为规格，平均测试误差降低48.4%；即使智能体可以查询完整参考实现，加入骨架仍可使平均测试误差相对降低最多27.0%；骨架还使小模型与大模型的平均差距缩小约52.4%，实现成本降低15至26倍，代码侵蚀平均降低24.7%。
AI.conclusion: 程序结构是编码规格的关键组成部分，显式指定结构能以更少的测试和更低的成本引导智能体生成可接受的程序。

title: The Endgame of FSDP Communication: Layout-Aware Collectives on Copy Engines, RDMA, and NVSwitch
