We argue that both are governed by one quantity, the value of information, and propose to estimate it from archived rollouts with a learned world model. We obtain that, when read at the observation, it yields a provable lower bound on the optimal value of the acquiring action, which floors its TD target and attributes this floor to the observation that earned it. Read at the decision, it defines the optimal retrieval set. A pilot retrieval system, to be trained and improved with this signal, solves a memory task with reduced context.

AI.tldr: 提出用学习到的世界模型从归档 rollout 中估计信息价值（value of information），由同一个量同时解决强化学习中检索代价高和获取记忆的信用分配两个问题。
AI.motivation: 强化学习中的记忆机制面临两个问题：注意力机制需要对整个存储打分，对受延迟与能耗限制的机器人代价过高；当检索到的记忆带来收益时，获取该记忆的信用需要跨越整个序列进行分配。
AI.method: 用学习到的世界模型从归档 rollout 中估计信息价值。在观测处读取该量，可得到获取动作的最优价值的可证明下界，该下界作为其 TD 目标的下限，并被归因于带来收益的观测；在决策处读取该量，则定义最优检索集合。作者提出了一个试验性检索系统，计划用这一信号进行训练与改进。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果，仅称该试验性检索系统在一个记忆任务上以更少的上下文解决了该任务。
AI.conclusion: 信息价值可以统一地指导检索选择与信用分配，为机器人记忆机制提供了理论依据。该工作目前仍处于试点阶段，后续仍需训练与验证。

title: Reinforcement Learning Under Runtime Confounding: Policy Learning and Off-Policy Evaluation
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly used to train robust, adaptable systems across healthcare, e-commerce, and robotics. In these settings, legal, ethical, or logistical concerns may preclude certain key variables that drive decisions from being collected during deployment time. This gives rise to a setting known as runtime confounding: the logged data hold full observability, but deployment time lacks knowledge of certain variables, known as runtime confounders. Unlike single timepoint and non-adaptive settings, runtime confounding under reinforcement learning has the potential to propagate over time, as earlier decisions affect future states, observations, and action assignments, leading to biased learning. We address these problems with three contributions: we (1) develop policy learning algorithms under runtime-confounding, (2) develop semi-parametric efficient off-policy estimation procedures, and (3) provide diagnostics for understanding the price of runtime confounding.

AI.tldr: 研究强化学习中的运行时混杂问题，即日志数据完全可观测而部署时缺失部分决策变量，论文给出策略学习算法、半参数高效的离策略评估方法以及运行时混杂代价的诊断工具。
AI.motivation: 在医疗、电商和机器人等场景中，出于法律、伦理或后勤原因，部署时可能无法收集驱动决策的关键变量。与单时间点、非自适应的设定不同，运行时混杂会随决策序列传播，导致学习结果产生偏差。
AI.method: 论文提出三项贡献：(1) 运行时混杂下的策略学习算法；(2) 半参数高效的离策略估计程序；(3) 用于理解运行时混杂代价的诊断方法。摘要未给出具体算法细节。
AI.result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 论文为存在运行时混杂的强化学习提供了策略学习、离策略评估及代价诊断的方法基础，有助于在部署时缺失变量的场景中减少有偏的学习与评估。

title: Fisher Contrastive Learning to Mitigate Feature Suppression: A Case Study in Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia Diagnosis
comment: 31 pages, including supplementary material; 3 figures and 2 tables
summary: Self-supervised contrastive learning (SSCL) learns representations by contrasting augmented views of the same sample, but it can exhibit feature suppression, where dominant or easy-to-learn factors suppress other class-relevant signals, degrading the performance of representations, particularly in high-dimensional data with heterogeneous features. We introduce Fisher Contrastive Learning (FCL), which uses a regularized Fisher trace criterion to address feature suppression. FCL learns embeddings by maximizing the discriminative strength of Fisher discriminant functions, producing representations that preserve class-relevant information implied by the augmentation process. We prove that the representations learned by FCL could alleviate the feature suppression effects. We demonstrate FCL on simulated benchmarks designed to induce feature suppression and on a real-world biomedical application, pretraining on large white blood cell microscopy image dataset and transfer learning for diagnosis of acute promyelocytic leukemia in an external cohort. In all experiments, FCL outperforms the self-supervised baselines and yields more robust and discriminative representations.

AI.tldr: 提出 Fisher 对比学习（FCL），用正则化的 Fisher trace 准则缓解自监督对比学习中的特征抑制问题，并在白细胞显微图像上用于急性早幼粒细胞白血病诊断的迁移学习。
AI.motivation: 自监督对比学习可能出现特征抑制：占主导或容易学习的因素压制了其他与类别相关的信号，在高维异构数据中尤为明显，导致表示质量下降。
AI.method: FCL 通过最大化 Fisher 判别函数的判别强度来学习嵌入，使表示保留增强过程所隐含的类别相关信息，所用准则为正则化的 Fisher trace。作者证明 FCL 学到的表示可以缓解特征抑制效应。
AI.result: 在为诱导特征抑制而设计的模拟基准上进行了验证；在大规模白细胞显微图像数据集上预训练，并迁移到外部队列中的急性早幼粒细胞白血病诊断，所有实验中 FCL 均优于自监督基线，表示更稳健且判别性更强。
AI.conclusion: FCL 在理论证明与实验验证两方面表明，它能够缓解高维异构数据中的特征抑制，并为生物医学图像诊断提供更稳健的表示。

title: Hidden Disparities in Ranking: Category-Aware Fairness via Distributional Stability
summary: We study the problem of fair ranking in recommender systems. We provide a formal probabilistic framework in which ranking policies are distributions over permutations, and the utility of a user is the exposure given to the items they interact with, relative to that of an ideal ranking. We consider utility parity across user groups, as well as its category-aware refinement, conditional utility parity, which requires parity within each category of items. Following a recent view of fairness as distributional stability, we show that both criteria are equivalent to the stability of the utility under changes in the composition of user groups. Optimizing over mixtures of ranking policies leads to a second-order cone program, for which we provide generalization bounds. A numerical study validates our theoretical findings.

AI.tldr: 研究推荐系统中的公平排序，将群体效用平等及其类别感知的条件版本等价地刻画为效用对用户群体组成变化的分布稳定性，并给出基于二阶锥规划的优化方法及泛化界。
AI.motivation: 公平排序要求不同用户群体之间的效用平等，并进一步要求每个物品类别内部也保持平等。这些准则的形式化与优化方式尚需统一的理论框架。
AI.method: 构建概率框架，将排序策略视为排列上的分布，用户效用定义为其交互物品所获曝光相对于理想排序的比例。沿用将公平视为分布稳定性的观点，证明两类准则都等价于效用在用户群体组成变化下的稳定性。对排序策略的混合进行优化，得到二阶锥规划，并给出泛化界。
AI.result: 数值研究验证了理论结论；摘要未给出具体数值结果。
AI.conclusion: 两类公平准则可统一理解为分布稳定性，为类别感知的公平排序提供了可优化、并具有泛化保证的理论基础。

title: Understanding axial attention in TSFMs through single location regression
summary: Recent advances in Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) increasingly rely on axial attention mechanisms, but despite their empirical success, the theoretical properties of axial attention remain largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we extend the Single Location Regression framework introduced in Marion et al. [2025] to 2D structured data, in order to study sparse information settings where a target depends on a small number of tokens. We formulate an analytically tractable axial attention-type predictor and rigorously analyze its statistical properties and training dynamics. We prove that under a specific asymptotic regime and with knowledge of the underlying oracle parameters, our predictor achieves Bayes optimality, whereas a class of semi-linear simplifications strictly fails to do so, underlining the role of the inner non-linearity. We prove that for a specific temperature scaling, Projected Gradient Descent converges globally to the optimal oracle parameters. Extensive numerical experiments validate our theoretical findings and highlight the critical role of inverse temperature scheduling in empirical convergence.

AI.tldr: 借助单位置回归框架分析时间序列基础模型中轴向注意力的统计性质与训练动态，证明在特定条件下其预测器达到贝叶斯最优，且投影梯度下降在特定温度缩放下全局收敛到最优参数。
AI.motivation: 时间序列基础模型越来越多地依赖轴向注意力，但其理论性质基本未被探索，尤其是目标仅依赖少量 token 的稀疏信息场景。
AI.method: 将 Marion 等人（2025）提出的单位置回归框架扩展到二维结构化数据，构造一个可解析处理的轴向注意力型预测器，并分析其统计性质与训练动态。
AI.result: 在特定渐近区域并已知真实 oracle 参数时，该预测器达到贝叶斯最优，而一类半线性简化版本严格达不到，说明内部非线性的关键作用。对特定温度缩放，投影梯度下降全局收敛到最优 oracle 参数。数值实验验证了理论结论，并表明逆温度调度对经验收敛至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 论文揭示了非线性在轴向注意力中的必要性，并指出逆温度调度是影响实际收敛的关键因素。

title: DYNAS: A Dynamic Network Penetration Testing Framework Using Deep Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted at the NSS 2026: 20th International Conference on Network and System Security (submission version)
summary: As network scale and uncertainty complicate automated penetration testing, reinforcement learning (RL) environments must support controlled evaluation under defensive and non-stationary conditions. We present DYNAS (Dynamic Network Attack Simulator), which combines parameterized large-scale scenario generation with stateful intrusion detection responses, explicit scan false-positive and false-negative noise, temporary service unavailability, and duration-based action timeouts. We further introduce Pen-DHRL, a recurrent manager--worker policy that selects persistent subgoals using IDS-conditioned global context. We compare Pen-DHRL with GNN, Invariant, and Attention baselines across four scenario variants and multiple training regimes. Under IDS-disabled training followed by IDS-enabled evaluation, Pen-DHRL obtains approximately 64\% and 24\% higher reward per step on Bridge and Dynamic, respectively, and approximately 26\% and 30\% more captured hosts on VarA and VarB than the next-best baseline. With all defensive dynamics active from the beginning of training, Pen-DHRL achieves positive mean episode returns in all four scenarios, whereas the flat baselines produce negative mean returns in all 12 architecture--scenario combinations; staged curriculum training produces positive mean returns across all 16 evaluated combinations.

AI.tldr: 提出 DYNAS，一个包含入侵检测响应与扫描噪声等防御动态的动态网络渗透测试仿真环境，并提出 Pen-DHRL 分层强化学习策略，在防御与非平稳条件下优于 GNN、Invariant 和 Attention 基线。
AI.motivation: 网络规模与不确定性增加了自动化渗透测试的难度，而现有强化学习环境难以支持在防御和非平稳条件下的可控评估。
AI.method: DYNAS 结合参数化的大规模场景生成、有状态的入侵检测响应、扫描的假阳性与假阴性噪声、临时服务不可用以及基于持续时间的动作超时。Pen-DHRL 是一个循环的 manager-worker 策略，利用 IDS 条件化的全局上下文选择持久子目标。
AI.result: 与 GNN、Invariant、Attention 基线比较，覆盖四种场景变体及多种训练方式。在 IDS 关闭训练、IDS 开启评估的设定下，Pen-DHRL 在 Bridge 和 Dynamic 上的每步奖励分别高出约 64% 和 24%，在 VarA 和 VarB 上捕获的主机数分别多约 26% 和 30%（均相对于次优基线）。当所有防御动态从训练开始即全部启用时，Pen-DHRL 在四个场景中均获得正的平均回合回报，而平坦基线在全部 12 种架构与场景组合中均为负；分阶段课程训练则在全部 16 种组合中得到正的平均回报。
AI.conclusion: 动态仿真环境与分层策略相结合，使渗透测试策略能在防御条件下更稳定地学习；课程训练是在防御动态下获得正回报的有效方式。

title: LLM-guided Planar Loco-Manipulation for Quadruped Robots
summary: Robotic navigation typically assumes a collision-free route to the goal exists; in cluttered environments with movable obstacles, however, reaching the goal may require physical interaction. Classical solutions encode these behaviors through geometric rules and task-specific logic, while learning-based approaches often constrain the decision space to low-dimensional motion commands or predefined action sets. We instead consider a broader decision space, jointly selecting the skill, relevant object, and geometric target. Our language-conditioned task planner, fine-tuned with LoRA on synthetic data, maps natural-language tasks and a structured scene representation to variable-length sequences of parameterized actions, executed by low-level reinforcement-learning policies. The planner learns the geometric relations underlying interactive navigation and outperforms a classical planner and a prompted frontier model on interactive navigation tasks. Comparisons with models trained from scratch indicate that composition does not require pretraining when the representation is structured, whereas pretraining yields more reliable geometric targets. At the low level, we introduce an end-to-end whole-body planar pushing policy that achieves a 93.3% success rate in simulation, versus 83.5% for a hierarchical baseline, while reducing completion time by more than 60%. On hardware, the hierarchy yields the correct skill composition in 44/45 trials and end-to-end success in 34/45. Project website: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出一个语言条件的任务规划器（LoRA 微调，合成数据训练）与端到端全身平面推动策略，使四足机器人能联合选择技能、物体与几何目标，完成需要物理交互的导航任务。
AI.motivation: 在杂乱环境中，到达目标可能需要移动障碍物，而经典方法依赖任务特定的几何规则与逻辑，学习方法常把决策空间限制在低维运动指令或预定义动作集合中。
AI.method: 规划器将自然语言任务与结构化场景表示映射为可变长度的参数化动作序列，由底层强化学习策略执行。底层引入端到端的全身平面推动策略。论文还比较了从头训练的模型，以考察预训练的作用。
AI.result: 规划器在交互式导航任务上优于经典规划器与提示式前沿模型。从头训练的模型显示，在结构化表示下组合无需预训练，但预训练能得到更可靠的几何目标。推动策略在仿真中成功率为 93.3%，分层基线为 83.5%，完成时间减少超过 60%。实机上，分层结构在 45 次试验中有 44 次正确组合技能，端到端成功 34 次。
AI.conclusion: 结构化表示与学习得到的任务规划可以支持四足机器人的交互式导航，端到端推动策略在仿真与实机上均有效；实机上的端到端成功率为 34/45。

title: Conformal Annotation with Randomized Expert Review: Application to Online Cell-Type Labeling
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) models can accelerate cell-type annotation in digital pathology, but safely scaling their use requires determining, with error control, which model-generated labels can be accepted without expert review. This is challenging in evolving workflows because cell morphology and type composition may change across tissue regions and slides, making one-time calibration unreliable. We propose Conformal Annotation with Randomized Expert review under Distribution shift (CARED), a distribution-free framework that leverages randomized expert audit to achieve long-run error control for AI-assisted annotation under distribution shift. For each incoming batch, CARED uniformly selects a subset of cases for expert review and uses the acquired labels to calibrate later decisions. Among unreviewed cases, CARED determines a subset of them to safely skip expert labeling, while suggesting candidate labels for the others for downstream resolution. We prove that this workflow provides long-run control of cumulative error over both the full stream and the cells outside of the audit sample, without stationarity or exchangeability assumptions. We further enhance the framework by introducing class-conditional guarantees to ensure error control within important but rare cell types, together with a utility module to target more automatic resolutions, smaller candidate sets, and greater biological coherence, without compromising validity. Experiments on pancreas, lung, and ovary annotation streams, together with a stream constructed from real expert annotations, show that CARED controls the cumulative errors while a substantial fraction of cells (up to 70%) bypass expert review.

AI.tldr: 提出 CARED 框架，利用随机化专家审核在分布漂移下为 AI 辅助的细胞类型标注提供长期误差控制，最多使 70% 的细胞无需专家审核。
AI.motivation: 数字病理中，AI 可以加速细胞类型标注，但要安全地扩大其使用，需要在误差可控的前提下判断哪些模型标签可以直接接受。细胞形态与类型组成会随组织区域和切片变化，一次性校准并不可靠。
AI.method: 对每个到达的批次，CARED 均匀抽取一部分病例进行专家审核，并用获得的标签校准后续决策。在未审核病例中，它确定可以安全跳过专家标注的子集，并为其余病例给出候选标签。框架还引入类条件保证以控制稀有细胞类型的误差，并加入一个工具模块，在不损害有效性的前提下提高自动解析程度、缩小候选集并增强生物学一致性。该方法基于分布无关的框架，不假设平稳性或可交换性。
AI.result: 在胰腺、肺和卵巢的标注流以及由真实专家标注构成的标注流上，CARED 能够控制累积误差，同时有相当比例（最多 70%）的细胞绕过专家审核。
AI.conclusion: 随机化专家审核结合分布无关的校准，可在无平稳性或可交换性假设下为 AI 辅助标注提供长期误差控制，从而安全地降低专家工作量。

title: Confidence-Aware Speed-over-Ground Estimation from Doppler Spectra via Reconstruction-Based Representation Learning
summary: Reliable speed-over-ground estimation from ground-facing Doppler spectra is essential for mobile platforms such as railway systems. Classical signal-processing approaches can provide accurate estimates under favorable conditions, but often degrade in challenging conditions. We propose confidence-aware speed-over-ground estimation trained on rail-domain data that estimates speed over ground and frame-level confidence from Doppler spectra with several novel contributions: First, we transfer the idea of exploiting a reconstruction task by an autoencoder for performance estimation from previous work to Doppler RaDAR. Second, we append a speed-over-ground estimation head operating on the autoencoder's latent space features. Third, we omit the reconstruction decoder during inference but add a low-cost dedicated confidence head for frame-wise error-bound estimation. Fourth, we reveal how noise augmentation training can provide high robustness to the method. Experiments show that our approach improves speed estimation accuracy over classical baselines while providing informative confidence estimates that indicate the reliability of individual predictions, even under adverse signal conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于重构表示学习的置信度感知地速估计方法，从地面朝向的多普勒谱中同时估计地速与逐帧置信度，面向铁路等移动平台。
AI.motivation: 地面朝向多普勒谱的可靠地速估计对铁路等移动平台至关重要，但经典信号处理方法在不利条件下往往性能下降。
AI.method: 将自编码器的重构任务用于性能估计，并从既有工作迁移到多普勒 RaDAR。在自编码器潜在空间上附加地速估计头；推理时舍去重构解码器，增加低成本的置信度头以估计逐帧误差界；并引入噪声增强训练以获得较高的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在地速估计精度上优于经典基线，并提供能够指示单次预测可靠性的置信度估计，即使在不利信号条件下也是如此。摘要未给出具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 重构辅助的表示学习加上逐帧置信度，可以在多普勒地速估计中同时兼顾精度与可靠性信息。

title: Statistical Analysis of Synthetic Data with Verification: A Linear Regression Framework
summary: Synthetic data are widely used for training modern AI systems. However, their statistical understanding remains limited. It is well recognized in statistics that repeated self-training on synthetic data can amplify errors inherited from pre-trained models, leading to model collapse. Verification plays a crucial role in selecting high-quality synthetic data to help prevent model collapse and improve model performance. We study verified self-training in a linear regression framework, where a pre-trained estimator generates synthetic data with injected generation noise and a verifier selects samples according to a verification threshold. Post-training on the accepted samples updates either all coordinates (full fine-tuning) or only an active subset (partial fine-tuning). Our analysis reveals three potentially counterintuitive effects. We establish that tighter verification does not always lead to lower prediction risk. We also find that a suitable level of injected generation noise can reduce prediction risk, while excessive noise can increase it. Moreover, full and partial fine-tuning can respond differently to the same verification rule, since pre-training error in the frozen coordinates affects both sample selection and post-training risk. We analyze these effects by deriving finite sample risk bounds for four separate regimes determined by the relative scales of the verification threshold, generation noise, and pre-training error. The bounds precisely characterize how verification affects prediction risk across these regimes. In particular, we quantify how the generation noise, the effective accepted sample size, and the covariance of the accepted covariates affect prediction risk. The analysis extends to iterative verified full fine-tuning, where sufficiently tight verification reduces the initial error contribution at a geometric rate.

AI.tldr: 在线性回归框架中分析带验证的合成数据自训练，揭示更严格的验证不一定降低预测风险，存在适度的生成噪声可降低风险的情形，并给出全量与部分微调的有限样本风险界。
AI.motivation: 合成数据被广泛用于训练 AI 系统，但其统计性质理解有限。重复在合成数据上自训练会放大预训练模型的误差并导致模型崩溃，因此验证对于选择高质量合成数据、防止模型崩溃至关重要。
AI.method: 在线性回归框架中，预训练估计器生成带注入生成噪声的合成数据，验证器按阈值筛选样本。在接受的样本上进行后训练，既可以更新全部系数（全量微调），也可以只更新活跃子集（部分微调）。论文依据验证阈值、生成噪声与预训练误差的相对尺度划分出四种情形，推导有限样本风险界，并将分析扩展到迭代的验证全量微调。
AI.result: 分析得到三个反直觉的效应：更严格的验证不一定降低预测风险；适度的生成噪声可以降低风险，过量噪声则会增加风险；全量与部分微调对同一验证规则的响应可能不同。在迭代的验证全量微调中，足够严格的验证使初始误差的贡献以几何速率下降。
AI.conclusion: 验证强度、生成噪声与微调方式需要联合考虑，简单地加强验证并不总是最优的，理论界刻画了它们在不同情形下对预测风险的影响。

title: Latent Path Exploration via Potential-Guided Subtrajectory Balance
summary: Continuous latent reasoning enables language models to perform intermediate computation without generating explicit reasoning traces. Advances in stochastic latent reasoning allow multiple paths to be sampled in continuous space, but stochasticity alone does not ensure effective exploration. A key challenge is guiding stochastic transitions between intermediate latent states toward useful reasoning paths. We introduce SubLAT, which couples a relative answer potential with Subtrajectory Balance to learn stochastic latent exploration. The relative potential evaluates the answer support of sampled states against replacement states, with a correctness signal at the terminal state. Subtrajectory Balance relates potential differences to forward and backward transition densities across subtrajectories of different lengths. The model is jointly trained with answer supervision, CoT supervision, and representation distillation. Experiments on arithmetic and deductive reasoning show increasing solution coverage with larger sampling budgets across in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks, as well as improvements on several structural OOD benchmarks. Trajectory analyses reveal progressive divergence among sampled latent paths and higher mean relative potentials for correct trajectories across arithmetic benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出 SubLAT，将相对答案势函数与子轨迹平衡（Subtrajectory Balance）结合，学习连续潜在推理中的随机探索，以提高解的覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 连续潜在推理可以在连续空间中采样多条路径，但仅有随机性并不能保证有效探索。关键在于如何引导潜在中间状态之间的随机转移趋向有用的推理路径。
AI.method: 相对答案势函数通过与替代状态比较，评估采样状态的答案支持度，并在终止状态使用正确性信号。子轨迹平衡将不同长度子轨迹上的势函数差与前向、后向转移密度联系起来。模型与答案监督、CoT 监督及表示蒸馏联合训练。
AI.result: 在算术与演绎推理任务上，随着采样预算增大，解的覆盖率持续提升，在域内与域外基准上均如此，并在若干结构性 OOD 基准上有所改进。轨迹分析显示采样得到的潜在路径逐渐分化，且在算术基准上正确轨迹的平均相对势更高。
AI.conclusion: 结合势函数的子轨迹平衡能够有效引导连续潜在推理中的探索，在多样化采样下提升解的覆盖率。

title: Only Accepted Tokens Count: An Energy Accounting of Speculative Decoding Under Latency Targets
summary: Large language model serving is limited by facility power. Energy per token determines how many tokens a datacenter can serve, while a latency target bounds how quickly each user receives them. During decode, every weight is read from memory for every generated token. Batching amortizes this read across users but makes no individual user faster. Speculative decoding does: a drafter proposes several future tokens, and the target model verifies them in a single forward pass that reuses the same weight read. Because every drafted token must be verified whether or not it is accepted, the energy speculation saves depends on how many drafted tokens are accepted. This saving is hard to pin down. It varies across target models from different attention families and across drafting schemes, and it depends on the text being served. Every drafter we evaluate accepts fewer tokens on conversation than on code, and every trained drafter accepts fewer on Romansh, a low-resource language, than on English. We measure speculative decoding under production serving conditions (SGLang, CUDA graphs enabled) on H100 and H200 GPUs, at batch sizes up to 64 across 5 corpora. On dense models, verification, not drafting, dominates the energy cost. The saving shrinks as the batch grows, because batching has already shared the weight read that speculation would divide among the accepted tokens. At large batch sizes, block drafters push verification past the balance point between arithmetic and memory traffic into the compute-bound regime, where the saving becomes a loss, and a drafter with low acceptance raises energy per token. Meeting a tighter latency target with speculation then costs additional energy. Larger batches lower energy per token without speculation. Speculation adds to that saving only when acceptance is high, and on the model we tested it leaves little headroom for latency-preserving DVFS.

AI.tldr: 通过能耗核算研究推测解码在延迟目标下的节能效果，发现节能取决于接受率，并随批量增大而减少，在大批量下甚至会变为能耗损失。
AI.motivation: LLM 服务受限于机房功率，每个 token 的能耗决定可服务的 token 数量，而延迟目标限制了每位用户获得 token 的速度。推测解码可以在不增加权重读取的前提下加快单个用户的生成，但其节能效果难以确定。
AI.method: 在生产级服务条件（SGLang，启用 CUDA graph）下，于 H100 与 H200 GPU 上测量推测解码，批量最大 64，覆盖 5 个语料。比较了不同注意力家族的目标模型、不同的草稿方案，以及对话、代码、罗曼什语（低资源语言）与英语文本。
AI.result: 在稠密模型上，能耗主要来自验证而非草稿。节能随批量增大而缩小；在大批量下，块状草稿器使验证进入计算受限区域，此时节能转为能耗损失，接受率低的草稿器还会提高每个 token 的能耗。在更严格的延迟目标下，使用推测解码需要额外能耗。只有在接受率较高时，推测解码才会在大批量无推测的节能基础上进一步节能，并且在所测模型上几乎没有为保持延迟的 DVFS 留出余量。
AI.conclusion: 推测解码的节能收益高度依赖接受率与批量大小，并非普遍有效；在高批量或低接受率的场景下，它可能增加能耗。

title: Rimuru: Unified Memory Management for Modern LLM Serving via Elastic Expert Offloading
summary: Modern LLMs strain device memory through large model weights and attention states, particularly in resource-constrained scenarios. Existing systems separately provision memory for model weights and attention states, imposing fixed fixed boundaries that cannot adapt to the changing memory demands of workloads. Under heavy workloads, insufficient state capacity limits request concurrency and reduces throughput; under light workloads, idle memory in one region cannot be reallocated to another, wasting device memory. Meanwhile, modern LLM architectures introduce heterogeneous tensors with diverse layouts and lifetimes, further complicating memory management. These problems motivate unified memory management for heterogeneous tensors. However, a shared pool alone does not make memory directly reusable across tensors with different allocation granularities and execution layouts. This paper presents Rimuru, a modern LLM serving system that unifies memory management through elastic expert offloading. Rimuru establishes a shared page pool to enables elastic memory sharing across heterogeneous tensors. To accommodate different allocation granularities, Rimuru introduces memory views that allow each tensor type to interpret the shared memory space using its own page size and page table. Furthermore, Rimuru combines huge-page alignment with a multi-level page allocator that splits and merges pages, enabling cross-type capacity reuse. A page-table-aware fused MoE kernel directly accesses non-contiguous expert weights, avoiding copy overhead. Building on these mechanisms, Rimuru employs a workload-aware adjuster that dynamically reallocates pages across tensor types according to runtime demands. Implemented on top of vLLM, Rimuru remains compatible with modern LLMs. Evaluations show that Rimuru achieves up to 19.03x baseline throughput and reduces TTFT by 98.1% on average.

AI.tldr: 提出 Rimuru，通过弹性专家卸载（elastic expert offloading）实现 LLM 服务中的统一内存管理，在 vLLM 上实现后最高达到基线吞吐的 19.03 倍，TTFT 平均降低 98.1%。
AI.motivation: 模型权重与注意力状态分别预配固定的内存边界，无法随负载变化而调整：负载重时状态容量不足，限制并发与吞吐；负载轻时一个区域的空闲内存无法分配给另一区域。异构张量的不同布局与生命周期进一步增加了管理难度。
AI.method: 建立共享页池，使异构张量之间能够弹性共享内存；通过内存视图，让每类张量以自己的页大小与页表解释共享空间；结合大页对齐与可拆分、合并页面的多级页分配器，实现跨类型的容量复用；页表感知的融合 MoE 内核直接访问非连续的专家权重，避免拷贝开销；工作负载感知的调节器则依据运行时需求在张量类型之间动态重分配页面。
AI.result: 在 vLLM 上实现后，Rimuru 最高达到基线吞吐的 19.03 倍，TTFT 平均降低 98.1%。
AI.conclusion: 统一的页级内存管理使异构张量能够共享显存，在资源受限场景下可显著提升 LLM 服务的吞吐量并降低首 token 延迟，且与现代 LLM 保持兼容。

title: Multistep and Multivariate Time Series Explainability with GradientSHAP: A Wind Power Case Study
summary: As the effects of climate change become increasingly apparent, the demand for renewable energy sources such as wind power continues to grow. However, renewables' variable and intermittent nature presents significant challenges in their integration into energy grids. Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a powerful tool to address these issues. Still, its adoption in the energy sector has been hindered by the opacity of many AI models, which often function as black boxes. This paper introduces a carefully adapted GradientSHAP approach to provide interpretability for multivariate, multistep wind power forecasting -- a largely underexplored area. This capability is critical for day-ahead grid management and, to the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to apply GradientSHAP in the context of wind power forecasting. To address the inherent dimensionality, we developed novel visualizations that deliver both local and global explanations, uncovering intricate relationships between environmental factors, site-specific conditions, and temporal dynamics. While GradientSHAP is not an out-of-the-box solution, our findings demonstrate that, with thoughtful handling of SHAP values and domain expertise, it can offer valuable insights into model behaviour, supporting more informed and trustworthy decision-making. Nevertheless, its complexity poses challenges for practical implementation. Future research should focus on streamlining these interpretability methods to make them more actionable for routine deployment in critical energy applications.

AI.tldr: 将 GradientSHAP 适配到多变量、多步的风电功率预测，并设计同时给出局部与全局解释的可视化，揭示环境因素、站点条件与时间动态之间的关系。
AI.motivation: 风电的波动性给电网集成带来挑战，而 AI 模型的黑箱性阻碍了其在能源领域的应用。多变量、多步风电预测的可解释性研究仍然较少。
AI.method: 对 GradientSHAP 做了审慎的适配，以应对多变量、多步预测带来的维度问题，并开发了新的可视化方法，同时提供局部与全局解释。分析依赖于对 SHAP 值的细致处理以及领域知识。
AI.result: 结果表明，该方法能揭示环境因素、站点条件与时间动态之间的复杂关系，为日前电网管理提供有价值的洞察。据作者所知，这是首次将 GradientSHAP 用于风电预测。摘要未给出定量指标；作者同时指出，该方法并非开箱即用，实施较为复杂。
AI.conclusion: GradientSHAP 在风电预测中可以提供有价值的模型行为解释，但需要结合领域知识，并需要进一步简化以便在关键能源应用中常规部署。

title: Deep Learning Based Behavioral Drift Modeling for Continuous Biometric Authentication
summary: This research proposes a two-level keystroke dynamics authentication system that provides defense-in-depth security through continuous behavioral drift monitoring. Level 1 employs fixed-text password authentication using Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCN) with contrastive learning and population-based training (PBT), achieving 3.77% EER for high-security login verification. Upon successful authentication, Level 2 continuously monitors user typing during natural free-text sessions using a 4-Model Deep Learning Ensemble. If suspicious behavioral drift is detected during monitoring, the system re-authenticates the user by returning to Level 1, providing a feedback loop against session hijacking and behavioral anomalies. The system explicitly models long-term behavioral drift through the fixed-text component's PBT mechanism, which adapts to temporal variations in password typing patterns. This research leverages free-text (Buffalo dataset) and fixed-text (GREYC dataset) keystroke dynamics datasets, extracting temporal and spatial features including hold times, up-down latencies, down-down intervals, and trigram patterns. The final system achieves 96%+ accuracy for fixed-text authentication (3.77% EER) and 83.53% True Acceptance Rate (TAR) at 5% False Acceptance Rate (FAR) for free-text continuous authentication (10.05% EER), demonstrating superior performance and strong resistance to impostor attacks through continuous behavioral monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出两级击键动态认证系统：第一级用 TCN、对比学习与群体训练（PBT）进行固定文本登录认证（EER 为 3.77%），第二级在会话中持续监测自由文本输入的行为漂移，发现异常时返回第一级重新认证。
AI.motivation: 登录认证之后，会话劫持与行为异常仍可能发生，因此需要在会话过程中持续监控用户击键行为的变化，实现纵深防御。
AI.method: 第一级使用时序卷积网络（TCN）结合对比学习与群体训练（PBT）进行固定文本密码认证，其中 PBT 机制用于适应密码击键模式的长期变化。第二级在自然的自由文本会话中使用 4 模型深度学习集成进行持续监测，提取保持时间、上下键延迟、下下间隔与三元组模式等特征。数据集为 Buffalo（自由文本）与 GREYC（固定文本）。
AI.result: 固定文本认证准确率达到 96% 以上（EER 为 3.77%）；自由文本持续认证在 5% 误接受率下的真接受率为 83.53%（EER 为 10.05%）。摘要称系统对冒充攻击有较强的抵抗力，但未给出相应的实验数字。
AI.conclusion: 两级反馈结构使固定文本认证与自由文本持续监测相互配合，为击键动态认证提供了一种纵深防御的思路。

title: Continuous-Action World Models: Learning Cross-Embodiment Spatiotemporal Dynamics Priors
summary: We introduce Continuous-Action World Models (CoAWM), a framework for learning cross-embodiment spatiotemporal dynamics priors that support robot action generation across embodiments and execution frequencies. At its core is a shared latent function space that captures the spatial and temporal structure of robot actions. We learn this space through two stages. First, function pretraining brings trajectories from different embodiments and sampling frequencies into a common representation, learning shared dynamics priors through action reconstruction and consistency across temporal sampling views. By accommodating heterogeneous robot trajectories, this stage broadens the range of data sources available for pretraining and facilitates scaling to larger and more diverse datasets. Second, we connect the pretrained function space to a world-model backbone, enabling observations, language instructions, and the current robot state to condition the prediction of a latent action function. A single decoder takes any query time and returns the corresponding end-effector action. By separating shared dynamics priors from task-conditioned action selection and temporal sampling, our approach provides a unified foundation for transferring robot experience across embodiments and control frequencies.

AI.tldr: 提出 CoAWM，通过共享的潜在函数空间学习跨本体、跨执行频率的时空动力学先验，并支持在不同机器人本体与控制频率之间进行动作生成与经验迁移。
AI.motivation: 来自不同本体与不同采样频率的机器人轨迹难以统一用于共同预训练，这限制了可用的数据来源与预训练规模。
AI.method: 分两阶段。第一阶段为函数预训练，将不同本体与采样频率的轨迹映射到共同表示，通过动作重建以及跨时间采样视图的一致性学习共享动力学先验。第二阶段将预训练的函数空间接入世界模型主干，由观测、语言指令与当前机器人状态条件预测潜在动作函数；单一解码器可在任意查询时间返回对应的末端执行器动作。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 将共享的动力学先验与任务条件的动作选择、时间采样分离，为跨本体与跨控制频率的机器人经验迁移提供了统一的基础。

title: OCCAMS: A Multi-Task Learning-Based Investigation of the CMB Power Spectra
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables, plus appendices. Comments are welcome
summary: How many latent variables are needed to fit the cosmic microwave background (CMB) temperature and polarisation power spectra when a neural network is given no cosmological model, and to what extent do they map onto the standard cosmological parameters? We use multi-task learning with variational autoencoders trained on CLASS-generated spectra (TT, TE, EE) over $2\le\ell\le2500$. No cosmological model is built into the network, and the number of latent variables, $L$, is varied over $L=5$, $6$ and $7$. Their fits are compared to the Planck 2018 data using $\hat{\chi}^2$, AIC, BIC and Bayesian evidence. Their correspondence with cosmological parameters is measured with normalised mutual information post-training. The loss weights are set within a single training run by uncertainty weighting, with the weight of the disentanglement term either fixed (semi-automated, SA) or learned (completely automated, CA). The reconstruction loss is split over multipole ranges in three configurations that separate the roles of temperature and polarisation and of the low- and high-$\ell$ ranges. In four of the six combinations of configuration and strategy, the fit improves from $L=5$ to $L=6$ and not beyond, and $L=6$ is the best, or close to the best, in five of the six cases. So, six latent variables are needed, as many as the free parameters of the standard, model-dependent approach. SA gives clearer disentanglement, while CA needs no a priori choice of the disentanglement weight and has the higher evidence at $L=5$ and $6$: the two strategies are points on a trade-off between interpretability and fit to the data. Notably, the latent variables for $\tau$ and $A_s$ share almost no information in any model, consistent with large-scale polarisation separating the two, as in standard analyses. A deep-learning approach can thus give a compact, data-driven parametrisation of the CMB spectra.

AI.tldr: 用多任务变分自编码器在不引入宇宙学模型的前提下拟合 CMB 温度与偏振功率谱，发现六个潜在变量即可充分拟合数据，且其中部分变量与标准宇宙学参数存在对应关系。
AI.motivation: 在不给定宇宙学模型的情况下，需要多少潜在变量才能拟合 CMB 温度与偏振功率谱，以及这些变量与标准宇宙学参数的对应程度，目前尚不清楚。
AI.method: 用多任务学习训练变分自编码器，数据为 CLASS 生成的 TT、TE、EE 谱（2≤ℓ≤2500），潜在变量数 L 取 5、6、7。拟合结果与 Planck 2018 数据比较，使用 χ̂²、AIC、BIC 与贝叶斯证据评估。与宇宙学参数的对应通过训练后的归一化互信息衡量。损失权重通过不确定性加权设定，解耦项的权重或固定（半自动，SA）或可学习（全自动，CA），重建损失按多极范围分段。
AI.result: 在六种配置与策略组合中的四种，拟合从 L=5 改善到 L=6 后不再继续提升；L=6 在六种情形中的五种为最佳或接近最佳。SA 解耦更清晰，CA 无需预先选择解耦权重，并在 L=5 与 L=6 时具有更高的证据值，两者在可解释性与拟合效果之间存在权衡。τ 与 A_s 对应的潜在变量在各模型中几乎不共享信息。
AI.conclusion: 六个潜在变量即可对 CMB 功率谱给出紧凑、数据驱动的参数化，其数量与标准模型依赖的自由参数数目相同，表明深度学习方法可以给出简洁的 CMB 谱参数化描述。

title: Adaptive search with path-constrained mobile sensors using multi-arm bandits
summary: We study a constrained sequential decision problem for detecting regions of interest from noisy online measurements collected by a team of energy-constrained mobile sensors. The sensor motion is restricted to a precomputed set of feasible paths that satisfy mobility constraints, limited available energy by requiring return to charging stations, and avoidance of known obstacles. We cast the resulting active path selection as a multi-armed bandit problem and propose an iterative search algorithm that adaptively assigns paths using confidence bounds computed from the collected data. We also propose a graph-based method to construct low-cardinality path covers under the team's constraints. We establish finite-time and anytime probabilistic correctness guarantees for the proposed algorithm, derive non-asymptotic upper bounds on the times required to detect all regions of interest and to label all nodes, and show that these bounds match algorithm-independent lower bounds up to constant factors for a broad class of problem instances. Using numerical simulations, we illustrate the behavior of the proposed approach and the effect of path redundancy and team size on search performance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于多臂老虎机的自适应搜索算法，供能量受限的移动传感器团队在预计算的可行路径集合中检测感兴趣区域，并给出有限时间与任意时间的正确性保证。
AI.motivation: 能量受限的移动传感器需要在移动约束、返回充电站和避开障碍物的条件下，从噪声在线测量中检测感兴趣区域，因此需要一种能在受限路径中有效分配探测任务的主动策略。
AI.method: 将主动路径选择建模为多臂老虎机问题，提出迭代搜索算法，依据已收集数据计算的置信界自适应地分配路径。另提出一种基于图的方法，在团队约束下构造低基数的路径覆盖。
AI.result: 建立了有限时间与任意时间的概率正确性保证，推导了检测全部感兴趣区域与标注全部节点所需时间的非渐近上界；对较广的一类问题实例，这些上界与算法无关的下界只相差常数因子。数值仿真展示了路径冗余与团队规模对搜索性能的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该方法具有可证明的理论保证，且时间界接近算法无关的下界，适用于有能量与路径约束的传感器搜索任务。

title: Soil Moisture Estimation in Precision Agriculture: A Knowledge Distillation Approach
summary: Accurate soil moisture estimation is critical for precision agriculture, influencing irrigation, fertilization, and harvesting strategies. Traditional methods primarily rely on meteorological and soil property data, while recent approaches incorporate visual modalities such as aerial and geospatial imagery. However, these high-resolution images are expensive and computationally demanding to analyze. In this work, we propose Soil Moisture Distillation (SMD), a Knowledge Distillation (KD)-based multimodal learning framework that leverages unimodal teachers to enhance multimodal soil moisture estimation. SMD surpasses not only traditional multimodal fusion techniques, including MIS-ME, but also outperforms unimodal models, demonstrating the benefits of guided unimodal knowledge transfer. Additionally, we conduct a comparative analysis of soil patches and crop images, showing that crop images provide superior visual cues, leading to improved prediction accuracy. SMD achieves a 2% improvement in MAPE for soil patches and 1.2% for crops over state-of-the-art baselines, highlighting the effectiveness of leveraging both meteorological and visual data through knowledge distillation for enhanced soil moisture forecasting.

AI.tldr: 提出土壤湿度蒸馏（SMD），用单模态教师网络的知识蒸馏提升多模态土壤湿度估计，相对最先进基线在 MAPE 上分别改进 2%（土壤斑块）与 1.2%（作物图像）。
AI.motivation: 精准农业中的土壤湿度估计主要依赖气象与土壤属性数据，而高分辨率的航拍或地理空间图像昂贵且计算量大，需要在利用视觉信息的同时控制成本。
AI.method: 基于知识蒸馏的多模态学习框架，利用单模态教师指导多模态模型，实现有引导的单模态知识迁移。同时比较了土壤斑块与作物图像作为视觉输入的效果。
AI.result: SMD 优于包括 MIS-ME 在内的传统多模态融合方法，也优于单模态模型。相对最先进基线，土壤斑块上的 MAPE 改进 2%，作物图像上改进 1.2%。作物图像比土壤斑块提供更好的视觉线索，预测精度更高。
AI.conclusion: 结合气象数据与视觉信息的知识蒸馏可以提升土壤湿度预测的精度，且作物图像是更有效的视觉输入。
